title: Security Business Partner
description:
Ko wai mātou – About us

Kia ora. We’re Foodies. You know New World, PAK’nSAVE and Four Square right? That’s us!

With 300+ stores and over 27,000 Foodies across Te Ika-a-Maui, our North Island Co-op has the privilege of helping New Zealanders get more out of life. Locally owned, we reflect the communities we serve, and we celebrate our people - our taonga, every day for being uniquely them.

Our Support Centre is 1,000+ people strong, which includes 300+ IT employees, who all play a vital role in ensuring the cogs of our Co-op stay turning and our systems stay ‘byte’-sized and ‘bug’-free.”.

Te Tūranga – About the role

We’re looking for an experienced Security Business Partner to help embed security into how our business thinks, plans and delivers.

You’ll be a trusted security advisor to business and technology leaders, bringing security into conversations early and helping teams navigate risk without creating unnecessary barriers. You’ll connect the dots between business priorities, technology delivery and cyber security, translating complex security requirements into practical, commercially minded solutions.

At the heart of the role is a simple philosophy: we do security with our teams, not to them.

Ngā painga - What we offer

We’re committed to providing awesome experiences for our people, including offering a range of benefits

  • Free carparking - we’ve got over 1,000 carparks including EV plugs
  • Southern cross health insurance
  • Onsite café with subsidised meals, mini mart, 5% discount at our retail stores
  • Flexible working options, a day off on your birthday, long service leave
  • Inhouse learning and development programmes and courses, flu vaccinations, and social network groups (we call them Tribes).

He kōrero mōu - About you

  • Around 10 years’ experience in enterprise technology, with significant experience across information or cyber security.
  • Strong security knowledge across controls, secure design, cloud and platform security, identity, endpoint security and detection.
  • A strong understanding of both technology and business, with the ability to turn security requirements into practical outcomes.
  • Proven ability to influence, advise and build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Experience embedding security into delivery, operational or business change, ideally including security awareness or champion programmes.
  • Strong risk-based judgement, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, challenge constructively and know when to escalate.
  • Experience leading change and adoption, with knowledge of approaches such as ADKAR beneficial.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Knowledge of relevant security, risk and governance frameworks.

Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, ISC2, ISACA or CSA qualifications are desirable, although practical experience, security credibility and the ability to influence are equally important.

Experience awesome. Achieve awesome. Be awesomely you.

We’re proud to have a focus on Diversity & Inclusion here at Foodies and welcome courageous behaviour, encourage togetherness, inspire our people to be their best selves in our Foodies whānau.

We encourage you to apply with all your awesomeness and welcome your diverse background, including any disability, additional health and mental health needs, and/or neurodiversity.

If you require accessibility support to ensure you can fairly access our recruitment process, please reach out to Recruitment.Foodstuffs@foodstuffs.co.nz. Accessibility support could include, interview location, sign language interpreter, assistive technology.

Are you stocked up & ready to head to the checkout – apply now!

title: Manager, Recruitment Events & Engagement
description:
Georgian is more than just an employer – we're a community. With multiple campuses located across Central Ontario, Georgian College offers rewarding employment opportunities in academics, administration, research, and more. We take pride in working alongside a dynamic team of student-focused educators, dedicated supporters, and passionate advocates. Together, we can advance our mission to inspire innovation, transform lives, and connect communities through the power of education.

Our exciting work environment offers the opportunity to learn and grow, while collaborating in a team-oriented culture that promotes equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging. Together, we deliver unrivaled experiences for our students, employees and the communities we serve. Read our 2025-2030 strategic plan.

If you share our energy and passion, please consider joining Team Georgian.

Position Overview\:

Reporting to the Associate Director, Marketing and Recruitment, the Manager, Recruitment Events and Engagement is responsible for the strategic leadership, planning, execution, and continuous evolution of Georgian College’s student recruitment events, engagement initiatives, and experiential brand activations in support of domestic enrolment objectives and institutional brand awareness.

The Manager leads the development of high-impact student recruitment experiences that strengthen awareness, consideration, connection, and intent across the prospective student journey. This includes oversight of major institutional recruitment events, system-wide and community-based engagement opportunities, campus engagement initiatives, partnership activations, and targeted experiences designed to elevate Georgian’s brand presence and support enrolment growth.

As recruitment events increasingly serve as critical expressions of institutional brand and student experience, the Manager ensures all engagement initiatives are intentionally designed to reflect Georgian’s value proposition, create meaningful audience connection, and drive measurable recruitment and conversion outcomes.

A collaborative and influential partner, the Manager works closely with academic leadership, peers across the institution, marketing and digital, student recruitment, communications, and student-facing departments to develop integrated experiences aligned with institutional priorities, reputational strengths, market opportunities, and audience expectations.

The Manager provides leadership to staff responsible for recruitment event coordination, engagement logistics, and experiential execution, ensuring operational excellence, consistent brand representation, and high-quality audience experiences across all recruitment engagement activities.

Working closely with the Student Recruitment team and Manager, Marketing and Digital, the incumbent contributes to a coordinated enrolment ecosystem that integrates brand, engagement, recruitment outreach, and conversion strategy in support of Georgian College’s Strategic Enrolment Plan.


Job Details\:

Job posting date\: November 10, 2026
Department\: Marketing, Communications and Recruitment
Location\: Barrie Campus -hybrid work environment
Classification\: Administration
Employment Type\: Full Time
Hours of Work\: 37.5 hours per week
Salary Range\: $88,112-$110,140 (Pay Band 10)

Key Responsibilities\:

  • Leads the strategic planning, development, and continuous evolution of Georgian College’s major recruitment events and engagement initiatives in alignment with institutional enrolment priorities and brand objectives.
  • Develops and implements event and engagement strategies designed to strengthen awareness, consideration, belonging, and enrolment intent across the prospective student journey.
  • Ensures recruitment events and engagement experiences reflect Georgian’s brand standards, value proposition, and strategic priorities, while creating meaningful and differentiated experiences for prospective students and supporters.
  • Identifies, recommends, and pilots innovative recruitment event concepts, audience engagement approaches, and experiential activations aligned with changing learner expectations and market trends.
  • Establishes event objectives, audience strategies, performance measures, and post-event evaluation frameworks to support continuous improvement and measurable recruitment outcomes.
  • Collaborates with the recruitment team and Manager, Marketing and Digital to ensure event experiences, recruitment outreach, marketing campaigns, and conversion initiatives operate as an integrated enrolment ecosystem.
  • Leads Georgian’s participation in external recruitment events, system-wide initiatives, partnership opportunities, and community engagement activities that support brand awareness and domestic enrolment growth.
  • Identifies and cultivates strategic partnerships and engagement opportunities aligned with Georgian’s reputational strengths, target audiences, and institutional priorities.
  • Provides strategic guidance on Georgian’s representation, activation approach, and audience engagement strategy at recruitment and partnership events.
  • Represents Georgian College within regional and provincial recruitment and engagement networks, contributing to sector collaboration, best-practice development, and coordinated initiatives.
  • Leads cross-functional event planning processes involving academic, service, facilities, marketing, and external partners to ensure seamless execution and alignment with event objectives.
  • Ensures recruitment event materials, environments, signage, activations, and experiences are delivered on brand, on time, and to established standards.
  • Monitors event participation, engagement metrics, lead generation, and operational outcomes to inform future planning and investment decisions.
  • Provides leadership, coaching, and performance management for staff responsible for recruitment events and engagement initiatives, fostering a high-performing, collaborative, and student-centered team environment.
  • Oversees staffing models, onboarding, scheduling, and resource allocation associated with recruitment event operations and engagement activities.
  • Manages recruitment event and engagement budgets, monitoring expenditures and identifying risks, pressures, or opportunities related to operational delivery and investment effectiveness.
  • Ensures effective operational practices, resource utilization, and compliance with college guidelines, policies, and procedures.


    Qualifications\:
  • Successfully completed a Three-year diploma or degree in marketing, communications, business, event management, public relations, or a related field
  • Minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in recruitment events, engagement strategy, experiential marketing, event management, or related functions.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional initiatives and coordinating complex event or engagement activities involving multiple partners
  • Experience managing budgets, operational logistics, timelines, and event-related resources.
  • Strong understanding of the Ontario post-secondary environment, student recruitment landscape, and evolving learner expectations.
  • Progressive experience in event strategy, engagement initiatives, experiential marketing, recruitment events, or related functions within a post-secondary or complex service-oriented environment.
  • Demonstrated experience planning and delivering large-scale, multi-partner events and audience engagement initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of brand experience, audience engagement strategy, and experiential activation approaches.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence across departments and with external partners.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and operational planning skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities and timelines.
  • Strong communication, presentation, relationship-management, and partner engagement skills.


Why Work with Us?

Georgian’s multiple campuses are in some of the most sought-after areas in Central Ontario. Our campuses play important roles in each of these communities, serving as centers for academic, social, and cultural activities, and contributing to the social and economic well-being of the areas.

In addition to a rewarding career, here are some of the other benefits offered to full-time employees of Georgian College\:

• We offer a competitive compensation rate, comprehensive benefits plan and a generous vacation policy as well as CAAT defined-benefit pension plan which includes fully matched contributions.
• A tuition reimbursement program that offers reduced course fees for college staff and their dependents.
• A holiday shut down period that allows employees to rest and relax with family and friends.
• A flex work program for most positions allowing employees the flexibility of working both on campus and remotely.
• All Georgian Employees have access to the EFAP\: Employees and their family members can call the program 24/7 for completely confidential support, information, and assistance.
• Campus Safety Services\: Georgian is committed to providing a safe, respectful and inclusive environment through the delivery of professional health and safety, security, parking, emergency management, conflict resolution and investigative services.

For a more in depth look at what Georgian has to offer, check out our website.

Are you ready to Experience Georgian?

If this opportunity matches your interest and experience, please apply online at\: https\://www.georgiancollege.ca/about-georgian/career-opportunities/ quoting Competition #148-26 by 11\:59 pm on November 19, 2026. We thank all applicants; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.


Georgian College supports diversity, equity and a workplace free from harassment and discrimination and is committed to an inclusive, barrier-free environment. We invite applications from all qualified candidates and actively encourage applications from members of groups with historical and/or current barriers to equity, including, but not limited to persons of Indigenous ancestry, racialized persons, persons with disabilities, women and members of the 2SLGBTQ+ community. If you are contacted to participate in the interview, please advise the coordinator of any accommodations needed with respect to any materials or processes used to ensure you have access to a fair and equitable process.

Alternate formats will be provided upon request throughout the recruitment and selection process.

title: Electrical Journeyperson
description:
ABOUT

At Fitzpatrick Electrical Contractor Inc. (FITZE), we've been delivering trusted electrical and datacom solutions across Ontario since 1981. As a growing company with expertise spanning commercial, industrial, telecommunications, renewable energy, and critical infrastructure projects, we take pride in our commitment to quality, safety, and customer service. Joining FITZE means becoming part of a skilled, supportive team that values professional growth, innovation, and the opportunity to work on diverse and challenging projects throughout the province.

SUMMARY

The Electrical Journeyperson holds a valid Certificate of Qualification issued by the province in which the work is performed and who has passed any examination which may be required. This role is responsible for operating facility systems; performing preventative and corrective maintenance, routine and on-demand services on facility mechanical and electrical equipment and systems for the assigned facility within the limits of company policy and trade certification. The Technician IV is also responsible for performing work in accordance with established processes and practices and for complying with internal and external requirements including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, fire protection.

At this position level:

  • Operates facility systems
  • Performs preventative and corrective maintenance on facility mechanical and electrical equipment and systems
  • Trade certification or license of the following - required:
    • Journeyperson level Electrical license

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Subject to legislative licensing requirements and company policy:

  • Performs work in accordance to established processes and practices
  • Complies with all internal and external requirements including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, fire protection
  • Performs regular facility, facility mechanical and electrical equipment and systems monitoring and inspection, preventative and corrective maintenance to ensure facility uptime objectives are met, uninterrupted client operation and asset integrity of assigned facility are maintained.
  • Provides observations about facility, facility mechanical and electrical equipment and systems conditions and deficiencies and provides recommendations for enhancement and repair.
  • Monitors assigned facility by conducting facility walkthroughs, mechanical and electrical equipment and system monitoring and inspection
  • Maintains, troubleshoots and repairs mechanical and electrical building systems and equipment within the limits of company policy and trade certification and oversees service providers.
  • Responds to routine and on-demand service requests and performs preventative and corrective maintenance on facility mechanical and electrical equipment and systems within the limits of company policy and trade certification
  • Manages work order life cycle progressing the work form dispatched through to complete and records resolution data within service maintenance management database. Ensures work completed meets quality, contract response and all other requirements
  • Receives, tracks, monitors and reports status of maintenance and repair work within service maintenance management database. Initiates documents to obtain formal approval of work required.
  • Assists in the implementation of preventative maintenance (PM) program. Ensures that deficiencies are identified, recorded and escalated, and that related documents are maintained.
  • Participates in facility-related projects.
  • Ensures the manner in which work is performed is in compliance with corporate and legislated policies, procedures, practices and guidelines related to environmental, health and safety, fire protection and any other applicable requirements.
  • Maintains all assigned tools and arranges for repair and replacement where required
  • Submits all expenditures on a timely basis
  • Assists in enhancing tenant and customer satisfaction and maintaining positive relations through manner in which work is performed and services delivered.
  • Other duties as assigned

Work Requirements

  • Must be able and willing to work shifts, be available for on-call/standby and emergency call-outs as they arise.
  • Must strictly adhere to Health and Safety policies and processes including wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • 3-5 years of facility operations and maintenance work experience
  • High school diploma plus trades training and certification or licensing
  • Advanced ability to adhere and to properly execute processes and practices relating to facility operations and maintenance
  • Advanced ability to maintain and repair mechanical and electrical building systems and equipment within the limits of certifications and policies
  • Advanced troubleshooting and resolution skills in order to determine and resolve building mechanical and electrical equipment and system issues
  • Current knowledge of fire, life, safety and building codes and standards and ability to research and apply related codes and standards
  • Possesses a strong environmental, health and safety mindset. Ability to perform work in a safe manner
  • Strong client-service orientation along with a high sense of urgency
  • Effective communication skills for the purpose of data relay, exchange, feedback, and clarification

Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation

Trade certification or license in one or more of the following - required:

  • Journeyperson level Electrical license
  • Journeyperson level Refrigeration license considered an asset
  • Gasfitter I or II license in addition to a refrigeration license considered an asset.

In addition:

  • Must be capable of obtaining appropriate security clearance where required
  • Valid drivers’ license if required

This is a regular, full-time position with a hourly range of $39.20 - $46.12 per hour. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role.

title: Head of Data
description:
At SheMed, our mission is to revolutionise women’s health by providing accessible and personalised solutions tailored specifically for women. We are a startup consisting of enthusiastic people who are committed to empowering women with the knowledge and tools they need to take control of their health and well-being.

SheMed is an innovative and advanced weight loss programme that is groundbreaking in the world of women’s health. We have an unwavering dedication to quality care, and strive to create a supportive and compassionate community where every woman can thrive and achieve optimal health. In doing so, we believe SheMed will be a strong force in closing the women’s health gap.

We’re looking for a Head of Data to join our UK-based team and lead the company’s data strategy during a pivotal stage of growth. This role is designed to transform complex clinical, operational, and commercial data into clear, actionable insights that drive smarter decisions, improve patient outcomes, and accelerate growth across the business.

You’ll work closely with leadership, product, marketing, clinical, and engineering teams to build upon SheMed’s data infrastructure, own company-wide analytics, optimise the SheMed subscription model, and uncover insights from one of the UK’s largest emerging datasets in women’s metabolic health. You’ll play a critical role in helping senior leaders make faster, more confident, data-driven decisions while laying the foundations for future research, AI, and personalisation initiatives.

Please note: This is an office-based role, Monday to Friday, 9am – 6pm. We are based in Euston, London.

Purpose of Role:

We are looking for an exceptional Head of Data to build and lead the data function at SheMed during a critical phase of growth and retention.

This is a highly strategic and hands-on role spanning analytics, data infrastructure, experimentation, clinical insights, and AI enablement. You will work directly with the founders and leadership team to turn one of the richest datasets in women’s metabolic health into actionable insights that improve outcomes, operations, and product experience.

You’ll own the company’s data strategy end-to-end, from defining/improving infrastructure and dashboards to uncovering clinical insights and supporting future research initiatives.

What You'll Work On:

Data Strategy & Infrastructure

  • Define and execute SheMed’s company-wide data strategy
  • Build scalable data architecture and pipelines across product, clinical, operational, and marketing systems
  • Own data governance, integrity, quality, and security standards
  • Partner with engineering to establish a modern analytics stack and warehouse

Analytics & Insights

  • Deliver high-impact reporting and dashboards across growth, retention, patient outcomes, operations, and finance
  • Identify trends and opportunities within patient and clinical datasets
  • Lead cohort analysis, forecasting, LTV modelling, churn analysis, and behavioural analytics
  • Translate complex datasets into clear recommendations for leadership

Clinical & Research Analytics

  • Work closely with clinical and research teams to analyse outcomes related to GLP-1 treatments and female health conditions
  • Support publication-grade analysis and future research studies
  • Develop frameworks to measure treatment efficacy, adherence, and patient success

Product & Experimentation

  • Partner with product and growth teams on experimentation and optimisation
  • Build frameworks for A/B testing, funnel analysis, and lifecycle analytics
  • Support personalisation and AI-driven product initiatives

Leadership

  • Build and lead the data team over time across analytics, engineering, and data science
  • Establish a data-driven culture across the organisation
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to founders and senior leadership

What We're Looking For:

  • 6+ years experience in data, analytics, data science, or related fields
  • Experience in a high-growth startup, healthtech, consumer subscription, or marketplace business
  • Strong SQL and analytics capabilities with experience across modern BI tools and cloud data infrastructure
  • Experience building scalable reporting systems and data pipelines
  • Strong commercial intuition and ability to influence strategic decisions
  • Comfortable operating both strategically and hands-on
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Passion for women’s health and mission-driven healthcare innovation

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in healthcare, telehealth, clinical research, or regulated environments.
  • Experience working with patient or healthcare datasets.
  • Familiarity with experimentation frameworks and AI/ML applications.
  • Experience scaling data teams from early stage to growth stage.
  • Understanding of customer journey analytics, lifecycle marketing, segmentation, and retention modelling
  • Experience supporting A/B testing, landing page optimisation, creative testing, or funnel experimentation

Perks at Work:

  • A mission-driven team focused on closing the women’s health gap
  • Competitive Salary
  • 25 days holiday
  • Breakfast and all day snacks
  • Monthly socials
  • Health care Cash Plan including physio, digital clinical appointments and wellbeing for you, your partner and children
  • £80 contribution to noise cancelling headphones
  • Life insurance cover of 4x salary
  • Pension contribution matched up to 5%
  • Cycle to work scheme
We want to make sure our interview process is fully accessible to everyone. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments or physical accommodations for your visit to our office.
Please note that offers of employment are subject to receipt of satisfactory references and a enhanced DBS check.
WORKING AT SHEMED
Whether you work in one of our amazing offices, clinics or part of our remote clinician workforce, SheMed is highly collaborative and fun! You’ll have a chance to work in a fast-paced environment with experienced industry leaders. We have a learning environment where you can make an impact.
WHO WE ARE
At SheMed our people aren’t just part of a team, they’re part of something bigger. We’re a vibrant community of creative thinkers and doers, forging the way for a new generation of healthcare. We’re only as good as our people. So, finding the best people is everything to us. We serve millions, but we choose our people one at a time…
DIVERSITY
We believe that difference inspires a better, healthier world. That’s why it’s at the heart of everything we do. From our people to our products, difference enriches every part of our business and creates a culture based on equality of opportunity, and in which all employees can progress their careers. We’re committed to creating an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, pregnancy status, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Director of Finance
description:
Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Competitive Compensation – Salary and benefits package designed to reward your expertise, leadership, and contributions.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage – Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options to support you and your family.
  • Future Security – 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching to help you build long-term financial stability.
  • Generous Paid Time Off – Paid Time Off (PTO) and Extended Illness Bank (EIB) to support work-life balance and personal well-being.
  • Career Growth Opportunities – Professional development, leadership training, and advancement opportunities across our organization.
  • Recognition & Reward Programs – We celebrate employee achievements and contributions to our success.
  • Exclusive Employee Discounts & Perks – Access to special savings and benefits designed for our team members.

Job Summary

The Director, Finance provides strategic financial leadership and operational oversight for all financial activities at the facility level. This role is responsible for budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, variance analysis, capital planning, and compliance with regulatory and accounting standards. The Director partners with facility and network leadership to optimize financial performance, support long-term growth, and ensure strong internal controls. This role typically serves as the second most senior financial leader within the facility.

title: Quality Control Specialist
description:
SUMMARY: Inspect and inventory fresh and non-perishable in-bound produce to insure freshness before distribution to member stores. Be responsible for on hand inventory for quality checks and date checks daily. Address produce staff and other AWG associates with questions regarding product either in the warehouse or product arriving.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The individual must have the ability to perform the responsibilities listed below. The list is not all inclusive of duties that may be requested by the department head or a member of upper management but are intended for an understanding of the purpose of the position. It is the responsibility of each individual at AWG to provide ultimate customer service to our members to support their efforts in increasing same store sales and profits.

  1. Inspect all incoming product to meet established USDA and AWG standards.
  2. With coordination of department manager and buying staff, authority to reject product if it fails to meet established standards, utilizing the tools provided.
  3. Communicate to Corporate and Divisional produce teams any quality issues from either in bound or outbound product.
  4. Work with lumper service and receiving team to expedite all incoming trucks in a timely manner.
  5. Order and ripen bananas.
  6. Inform warehouse out bound supervisors of which rooms to use and put back into the needed bananas for the days selection.
  7. Observe the bananas being selected to insure product shipped is from the proper banana rooms and is properly covered.
  8. Monitor reserve stock verifying that proper rotation procedures have been observed.
  9. Monitor merchandise in picking slots and reserve in order to check product age and if necessary expiration dates so they adhere to AWG standards.
  10. Inventory all slots weekly and reviewing surplus locations for either missing or “discovered” product.
  11. Examine damaged cases and repair if possible.
  12. Examine returned merchandise and determine disposition of product.
  13. Monitor proper temperature control throughout the warehouse.
  14. Work as a member of the AWG team so the total job responsibilities are met. Actions must always stress a sense of cooperation, integrity, tact and consideration with our members, associates and division management.
  15. This position requires strong communication and computer skills with the ability to use and learn new technology. All records required by management must be complete, accurate and submitted on time.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. A reasonable accommodation will be considered according to the ADA if it would not impose an undue hardship on the operations of the business without significant difficulty or expense. The accommodation would permit a qualified employee the ability to perform all essential functions of the job within the safety and contractual guidelines of the position.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE: Degree or equivalent; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume. Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.

REASONING ABILITY: Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS: Operation of warehouse mobile equipment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk or hear; and taste or smell. The employee frequently is required to sit.

The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 80 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee frequently works near moving mechanical parts and is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions and extreme cold. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

title: Greenhouse Technician
description:
Want to make a meaningful difference in peoples’ lives while earning a competitive salary? At Jushi Holdings Inc. ”) (CSE: JUSH) (OTCQX: JUSHF), we are shaping the future of the cannabis industry, the fastest growing jobs sector in the U.S. Jushi is seeking a Greenhouse Technician to support daily cannabis cultivation in a commercial greenhouse in northern Virginia, from seed sowing and propagation through harvest and preparation for the next crop. This hands-on role follows approved site procedures, maintains clean work areas, records completed work, and promptly reports crop or equipment concerns. Cultivation duties are performed under the required qualified supervision, with a qualified supervisor on duty whenever cultivation areas are operating or accessed.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Prepare trays, containers, growing media, labels, and work areas for scheduled production.
  • Sow seeds and support seedling care, cloning, transplanting, and plant movement as assigned.
  • Perform pruning, defoliation, plant spacing, trellising, and other plant care according to approved site procedures and supervisor direction.
  • Assist with harvest, crop handling, and greenhouse resets while protecting product quality and maintaining plant and batch identification.
  • Observe plants for pests, disease, damage, or unusual growth and promptly report concerns to the supervisor.
  • Support routine watering, irrigation checks, and approved measurements after training; report leaks, clogged emitters, and irregular delivery.
  • Record assigned environmental readings and report alarms or equipment issues. Adjust controls or perform repairs only when trained and authorized.
  • Clean and sanitize tools, trays, benches, floors, and shared equipment according to site procedures.
  • Follow hygiene, protective equipment, and plant movement practices that help prevent contamination and pest spread. Follow the facility alcohol-free, drug-free, and smoke-free workplace policy.
  • Keep aisles and exits clear, organize supplies, and handle plant waste and other materials according to approved procedures.
  • Complete assigned task logs, plant counts, labels, and production records accurately and on time.
  • Communicate completed work, delays, supply needs, and safety concerns. Immediately report suspected diversion, theft, loss, inventory discrepancies, or unauthorized changes to records to the supervisor.
  • Follow facility security and access controls; wear identification showing your name and position. Support other cultivation duties only within your training and authorization

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Entry-level candidates are welcome for supervised cultivation work. Previous greenhouse or commercial cultivation experience is preferred rather than required.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.
  • Complete required criminal background screening and meet Virginia employment eligibility requirements, including no felony conviction within the preceding five years.
  • If a license or registration was suspended, revoked, or denied, it must have been reinstated and be current and unrestricted, as required by 3VAC10-30-90 J.
  • Comply with pre-employment and ongoing random drug screening under company policy and applicable law.
  • Ability to follow written procedures and verbal instructions, complete training, and ask for clarification when needed.
  • Basic reading, math, and recordkeeping skills; ability to count plants, record measurements, and use a tablet or computer.
  • Reliable attendance, attention to detail, teamwork, and the ability to complete assigned tasks within required supervision.
  • Willingness to learn repetitive production tasks, accept feedback, and maintain work quality as priorities change.
  • Preferred experience includes greenhouse, nursery, farm, cultivation, or production work; plant care, irrigation, sanitation, or pest observation; and production or inventory records.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Work in greenhouse conditions with heat, humidity, changing temperatures, bright light, and exposure to plant material and growing media.
  • Stand and walk for extended periods; bend, reach, kneel, and perform repetitive hand tasks while handling plants and tools.
  • Move trays, containers, supplies, and carts using appropriate equipment or team assistance as needed.
  • Wear required protective equipment and follow training for chemical handling, equipment use, and safe work practices.
  • Work the assigned production schedule, which may include early starts, weekends, or holidays based on crop needs.

WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER OUR EMPLOYEES AT JUSHI

We offer benefit packages that may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Short-and Long-Term Disability, Flexible Spending Accounts, Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, and 401(k).

title: Chief Medical Officer (CMO) - Tucson, AZ
description:
Job Summary

The Chief Medical Officer (CMO) provides strategic clinical leadership, ensuring high-quality, cost-effective medical care and compliance with accreditation standards. The CMO collaborates with medical staff, administration, and board leadership to support clinical excellence, performance improvement, and effective resource allocation. This role plays a key part in shaping the health system's strategic plans and aligning clinical practices with organizational goals.

Essential Functions
  • Oversees the development, implementation, and enforcement of Medical Staff Bylaws, ensuring compliance with accreditation and licensure requirements.

  • Acts as a liaison between administration and the medical staff, facilitating communication and collaboration on clinical program activities and performance standards.

  • Provides strategic advice to facility management, particularly regarding clinical operations, program development, and resource allocation to achieve facility and medical staff goals.
  • Participates in budget development, strategic planning, and program evaluation, ensuring alignment of resources with clinical and organizational priorities.
  • Fosters a collaborative and productive working relationship among the medical staff, management, and the board of directors, promoting a culture of excellence and accountability.
  • Engage teams around institutional and departmental goals and objectives, with a focus on clinicians. Support, lead and facilitate a meaningful and open dialogue in meetings and as appropriate in clinical settings
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
Qualifications
  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) required or
  • Doctor of Osteopathy (DO) required
  • More than 10 years of clinical practice experience, with at least five (5) years in a medical leadership role, such as Chief Medical Officer, Medical Director, or similar position required
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • In-depth knowledge of medical staff governance, credentialing processes, and performance improvement methodologies.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with medical staff, administration, and board members.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with a focus on clinical quality and patient safety.
  • Strategic thinking and financial acumen, with the ability to participate in budget planning and resource allocation.

  • DO - Doctor of Osteopathy required

Kot Analitik kontrole kakovosti II na področju Samples & Standards boste sodelovali pri vzpostavitvi sistemov in procesov za učinkovito upravljanje vzorcev in standardov ter skrbeli za njihovo ustrezno sledljivost, transport in shranjevanje. S svojim delom boste zagotavljali pomembno podporo laboratorijem za kontrolo kakovosti in prispevali k zanesljivemu delovanju novega QC okolja na Brniku.

Vaše ključne odgovornosti:

  • Sodelovanje pri vzpostavitvi sistemov za transport in shranjevanje vzorcev od proizvodnje do internih ali zunanjih analiznih laboratorijev.

  • Ravnanje z vzorci in standardi v skladu z veljavnimi postopki, vključno z naročanjem, prevzemom, odpremo, sledenjem, označevanjem, sortiranjem in izvajanjem internih prenosov.

  • Upravljanje vzorcev in standardov v elektronskih sistemih ter zagotavljanje ustrezne sledljivosti podatkov.

  • Priprava in izpolnjevanje dokumentacije za pošiljanje in prevzem vzorcev v skladu z veljavnimi dobrimi praksami (cGxP).

  • Zagotavljanje kakovostnega in pravočasnega izvajanja aktivnosti ter ustreznega dokumentiranja v skladu z internimi postopki in zahtevami kakovosti.

  • Sodelovanje z laboratorijskimi in drugimi strokovnimi ekipami za zagotavljanje učinkovitega pretoka vzorcev in standardov.

Pričakujemo

Vaš doprinos k delovnem mestu:

  • Najmanj srednješolsko izobrazbo s področja farmacije, kemije, veterine ali druge primerljive smeri.

  • Najmanj 2 leti delovnih izkušenj z laboratorijskimi procesi.

  • Zaželeno poznavanje GMP oziroma cGxP okolja in laboratorijske dokumentacije.

  • Izkušnje z upravljanjem vzorcev, standardov, laboratorijskih materialov ali uporabo laboratorijskih elektronskih sistemov so prednost.

  • Osnovno znanje angleškega jezika.

  • Poznavanje orodij Microsoft Office.

  • Natančnost, odgovornost in dobra organiziranost pri delu z vzorci, podatki in dokumentacijo.

  • Pripravljenost na sodelovanje pri vzpostavljanju novega laboratorijskega okolja in procesov.

Nudimo

Kaj nudimo:

Lokacija dela: Brnik (do odprtja obrata bo delo potekalo v Ljubljani)

Vrsta pogodbe: pogodba za nedoločen čas s 6-mesečnim poskusnim obdobjem

Predvideni tedenski delovni čas: 40 ur

Plačni razpon (letna bruto plača): 20.320 – 30.480 EUR*

*Plača v Sandozu temelji na nivoju delovnega mesta, kvalifikacijah, specifičnih veščinah in znanjih ter delovnih izkušnjah. Visoko usposobljeni kandidati so običajno umeščeni okoli mediane plačnega razpona, manj izkušeni na spodnji del razpona, kandidati z izrazito močnimi ali nišnimi kompetencami pa višje. Pri umeščanju v plačni razpon upoštevamo tudi notranjo uravnoteženost plač in zunanje tržne podatke.

Naš paket ugodnosti dodatno vključuje:

  • Letni bonus (STI): odstotek letne plače.

  • Regres za letni dopust: leta 2026 je znašal 2.450,00 EUR (neto).

  • Božičnica: leta 2025 je znašala 2.100 EUR (bruto).

  • OurShare: Vsako leto bo zaposleni v družbi Lek d.d. upravičen do prejema delnic družbe Sandoz AG.

  • Prostovoljno dodatno pokojninsko zavarovanje: družba Lek d.d. v celoti krije mesečni prispevek za dodatno pokojninsko zavarovanje v višini 5,844 % vaše mesečne bruto plače (zgornja zneskovna omejitev je 3.224,18 EUR letno).

  • Dodatek za izmensko delo (15 %); turnusno delo (20 %), nočno delo (70 %), delo ob nedeljah in praznikih (50 %), nadurno delo (30 %).

  • Kolektivno življenjsko in nezgodno zavarovanje (kritje velja 24/7).


Ste pripravljeni na naslednji korak v karieri?
Prijavo z življenjepisom v angleškem in slovenskem jeziku lahko oddate najpozneje do 24. novembra 2026.

Zakaj Sandoz?

Sandoz je vodilni svetovni proizvajalec generičnih in podobnih bioloških zdravil – segmenta zdravstvene industrije, ki zagotavlja 80 % vseh zdravil na svetu po 30-odstotni ceni ter s tem vpliva na življenja več kot milijarde ljudi v več kot 100 državah. Čeprav smo ponosni na svoje dosežke, si prizadevamo narediti še več, da bi vsakdo imel dostop do temeljne človekove pravice – pravice do dobrega zdravja.

Z naložbami v nove razvojne zmogljivosti, proizvodne lokacije, nove pridobitve in partnerstva imamo priložnost oblikovati prihodnost Sandoza ter še večjemu številu ljudi omogočiti trajnostni dostop do cenovno ugodnih in visokokakovostnih zdravil.

Naš zagon temelji na odprti kulturi sodelovanja, katere srce so naši talentirani in ambiciozni sodelavci in sodelavke. V okolju, kjer so raznoliki načini razmišljanja dobrodošli in kjer se podpira osebna rast, imajo v zameno za uporabo svojih znanj možnost v celoti izkusiti delo v agilnem in povezovalnem okolju ter razvijati svojo uspešno kariero.

Pridružite se nam in nam pomagajte povečati pravičnost in hitrost zdravstvenega varstva.

Prihodnost je v naših rokah.

Predani smo raznolikosti in vključenosti:

Zavzemamo se za raznolikost, enake možnosti in vključenost. Prizadevamo si za oblikovanje raznolikih timov, saj ti predstavljajo naše bolnike in skupnosti, ki jih oskrbujemo.

O podjetju

Lek, član skupine Sandoz, je prva in najstarejša farmacevtska družba v Sloveniji, kjer razvijamo, izdelujemo in tržimo učinkovita, varna ter kakovostna generična in podobna biološka zdravila, namenjena bolnikom po vsem svetu. Pri delu nas vodijo visoki etični standardi, inovativno razmišljanje in prebojni dosežki naših vrhunskih strokovnjakov. Z več kot 4000 sodelavci že desetletja dejavno soustvarjamo slovenski, evropski in svetovni razvojno-raziskovalni prostor. Gradimo kulturo odprtega dialoga in ponosno ter odgovorno nosimo naziv najuglednejšega delodajalca v Sloveniji.

title: Operations Management Trainee
description:
Job overview\:

Schneider is seeking an Operations Management Trainee to participate in our Rotational Leadership Program. You will have the unique opportunity to gain experience and leadership skills at our Green Bay, WI corporate headquarters for one-year before transitioning to your Driver Manager role which may be located in GA, FL, IL, NJ or MA.

During the one-year Rotational Leadership Program you will train with our Intermodal departments and gain experience in leadership, pricing strategy, dispatching, sales and customer/rail services. The time that you spend in each area will equip you with a well-rounded understanding of Intermodal transportation and give you a competitive edge in yoru career as an up and coming leader as you progress within the organization.

Once you have completed the program, you will begin your Driver Manager position. In this safety focused role, you will provide excellent leadership to a group of our hardworking drivers in a fast-paced environment and be the key link between the business, our drivers, and our customers. You will also be accountable for fielding calls from drivers and working one-on-one to solve problems with creative solutions that exceed our customer expectations and our company objectives.

Responsibilities\:

  • Make safety-conscious decisions that ensure compliance with all policies and procedures.
  • Balance the needs of our customers, drivers and the business.
  • Provide continuous, structured and proactive performance management and coaching to drivers.
  • Manage driver payroll and home time.
  • Collaborate with various teams to identify and implement creative solutions to improve retention and drive business.

title: Lead Cardiac Monitor Interpret Tech
description:
The Lead Cardiac Monitoring and Interpreting Technician is a technical subject matter expert that supports leadership efforts by providing training and troubleshooting support while also contributing to quality and process improvement efforts throughout the lab. Responsibilities may include supporting staffing/scheduling, timekeeping, training or orientation, and supporting other departmental initiatives. Additionally, the Lead Cardiac Monitoring and Interpreting Technician provides surveillance, analysis, synthesis and preliminary interpretation of patient's heart rhythm patterns and physiological parameters while at rest and/or during exercise and/or in response to medication administration or other impacting procedure. The Cardiac Monitoring and Interpreting Technician provides direct patient care for a variety of patient populations. Responsibilities also include a working knowledge of various monitoring/testing devices and systems, equipment calibration, identifying and troubleshooting equipment failures, preparing patients/equipment for testing and/or monitoring, assessing for appropriate type of testing/monitoring, providing patient education on procedures, and accurately recording physiological data and preliminary interpretations in multiple reporting systems. The Cardiac Monitoring and Interpreting Technician works in collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team, communicating abnormal or critical physiological responses and activating medical emergencies response plans.

*This vacancy is not eligible for sponsorship / we will not sponsor or transfer visas for this position.

Requires one of the following:

  • A high school diploma or GED and a minimum of 4 years' direct care experience in a healthcare or residential care setting.

  • A high school diploma or GED and Certified Rhythm Analysis Technician Certification or Certified Cardiographic Technician (CCT).

  • A Bachelor's degree in a related health science field with at least 1 year of related direct care experience in a healthcare or residential care setting.

Direct patient care experience, or currently in a nursing or other health care program, is preferred. Must be able to work collaboratively and to lead others in a team setting to ensure high quality patient care. Basic knowledge of ECG interpretation, cardiac terminology and cardiac medications is preferred. Must demonstrate strong critical thinking skills, be able to multitask, and be flexible with changes in the work flow. Must have excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Must be able to concentrate, pay attention to detail and remain focused for extended periods during the work shift.

Licensure or Certifications:

  • CRAT (Certified Rhythm Analysis Technician) or CCT (Certified Cardiographic Technician) required.

  • BLS certification required.

title: Junior beleidsmedewerker dagelijks beheer en grondstoffen
description:
📍 Katwijk | 🕒 32 - 36 uur per week | 💶 schaal 9 | Jaarcontract met mogelijk uitzicht op vast

Je werkt aan beleid dat inwoners elke dag merken. Van afvalinzameling en afvalscheiding tot zwerfafval, de milieustraat en het dagelijks beheer van de openbare ruimte. Als junior beleidsmedewerker Dagelijks Beheer en Grondstoffen verbind je beleid, uitvoering en inwoners. Je leert het beleidsvak in de praktijk en draagt ondertussen bij aan een schone, veilige en verzorgde leefomgeving in Katwijk, Rijnsburg en Valkenburg.

Je hoeft nog niet alles te kunnen. We zoeken iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar hoe een gemeente werkt, graag leert en informatie goed kan uitzoeken en opschrijven. Je werkt samen met collega’s uit de uitvoering, beleid, communicatie en data. Zo krijg je een breed beeld van het werk en ontdek je stap voor stap waar jij het verschil kunt maken.

Wat je gaat doen
Geen dag is precies hetzelfde. De ene keer bereid je een bestuurlijk stuk voor, de andere keer werk je mee aan communicatie over afvalscheiding of zwerfafval. Je haalt informatie op uit meldingen, data, bewonerssignalen en de dagelijkse praktijk buiten. Daarmee help je om keuzes goed te onderbouwen en verbeteringen voor inwoners mogelijk te maken.

Je verantwoordelijkheden zijn onder andere:
  • Je ondersteunt bij beleidsstukken over grondstoffen, afvalinzameling, zwerfafval, de milieustraat en het dagelijks beheer van de openbare ruimte.
  • Je werkt mee aan collegevoorstellen, raadsinformatiebrieven, memo’s, rapportages en de beantwoording van vragen.
  • Je verzamelt, ordent en analyseert informatie uit meldingen, data, bewonerssignalen en de dagelijkse praktijk buiten.
  • Je helpt bij communicatie richting inwoners over afvalscheiding, bijplaatsingen, zwerfafval en werkzaamheden in de openbare ruimte.
  • Je bereidt overleggen en werksessies voor en maakt notities, verslagen en actiepuntenlijsten.
  • Je denkt mee over het verbeteren van processen, werkafspraken en rapportages binnen Dagelijks Beheer.
  • Je ondersteunt het cluster bij praktische en administratieve zaken, zoals rond opleidingen en bedrijfskleding.

Je krijgt begeleiding van ervaren collega’s en krijgt steeds meer ruimte om zelfstandig zaken op te pakken. Je leert daardoor niet alleen hoe beleid wordt gemaakt, maar ook wat ervoor nodig is om beleid in de praktijk te laten werken.

Wie jij bent
Je bent leergierig, praktisch en nieuwsgierig naar hoe een gemeente werkt. Je vindt het leuk om informatie uit te zoeken, te ordenen en begrijpelijk op papier te zetten. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen verschillende mensen en onderwerpen.

De ene keer spreek je een collega van de milieustraat, de andere keer werk je samen met een communicatieadviseur of beleidsmedewerker. Je luistert goed, stelt vragen en zoekt actief uit wat je nodig hebt om een vraagstuk verder te brengen.

Je hoeft nog geen ervaren beleidsmedewerker te zijn. Wel neem je initiatief, werk je zorgvuldig en wil je groeien in het vak. Je begrijpt dat goed beleid pas waarde heeft als het in de praktijk werkt.

Dit breng je mee
  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in de richting bestuurskunde, ruimtelijke ontwikkeling, duurzaamheid, milieukunde of een vergelijkbare opleiding.
  • Interesse in gemeentelijke dienstverlening, de openbare ruimte, grondstoffen en afvalinzameling, duurzaamheid of communicatie met inwoners.
  • Je schrijft helder en begrijpelijk.
  • Je kunt informatie verzamelen, structureren en samenvatten.
  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar politiek-bestuurlijke besluitvorming en wilt je hierin verder ontwikkelen.
  • Ervaring bij een gemeente of publieke organisatie is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste.
  • Je zoekt makkelijk contact, werkt graag samen en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de afspraken en werkzaamheden die je oppakt.

Waar je terechtkomt
Je komt terecht in het cluster Dagelijks Beheer. Dit cluster is zeven dagen per week zichtbaar in onze dorpen. We zorgen voor grondstoffen- en afvalinzameling, het beheer van de milieustraat en het dagelijks onderhoud van de openbare ruimte.

Samen met collega’s van wijkbeheer, afvalinzameling, communicatie, data en beleid werken we aan een gemeente waar inwoners prettig buiten kunnen zijn. Je staat daarbij dicht bij de dagelijkse praktijk: je ziet wat er buiten gebeurt en kunt helpen om signalen en informatie te vertalen naar beleid en verbeteringen.

Je werkt samen met ervaren collega’s en krijgt de ruimte om het vak te leren. Stap voor stap pak je meer zelfstandig op. We houden van aanpakken, duidelijke afspraken en korte lijnen. Je krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen en zoekt actief de samenwerking op die je nodig hebt.

Wij bieden jou
  • Een betekenisvolle functie waarin je zichtbaar bijdraagt aan de leefomgeving van Katwijk, Rijnsburg en Valkenburg.
  • Een salaris van minimaal €3.568 en maximaal €5.096 bruto per maand (schaal 9) op basis van 36 uur per week - met eventueel een aanloopschaal 8, afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring.
  • Een individueel keuzebudget van 17,05%, dat je naar eigen inzicht kunt inzetten. Bijvoorbeeld voor extra salaris, verlof of opleiding.
  • Pensioenopbouw via ABP.
  • Een jaarcontract met mogelijk uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
  • Ruimte om te leren, jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien in het beleidsvak.
  • Een betrokken team met korte lijnen en veel kennis van de dagelijkse praktijk buiten.

Enthousiast?
Wil je het beleidsvak leren in een omgeving waar je snel ziet waar je werk voor nodig is? En spreekt het je aan om samen met collega’s te werken aan onderwerpen die inwoners dagelijks merken?

Stuur ons dan je cv en een korte motivatie uiterlijk 2 december toe. Laat vooral zien waarom jij wilt leren, wat je nieuwsgierig maakt en waarom je wilt bijdragen aan het dagelijks beheer en de grondstoffenopgave van Katwijk.

Voor vragen over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Anne-Marie van der Bent, clustermanager Dagelijks Beheer op 06-12604559.
Heb je vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure of werken bij gemeente Katwijk? Neem dan contact op met Evelien van Hest, recruiter, op 06-42220781.

Even praktisch
We houden de sollicitatieprocedure graag overzichtelijk. De sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats op dinsdagochtend 8 december zodat je hier alvast rekening mee kunt houden.

title: Robot Teleoperator (Data Collection), Short-Term Contract
description:
THE COMPANY

LUDO ROBOTICS is dedicated to building general-purpose robotic intelligence systems that are robust, adaptive, and capable of handling real-world scenarios. We believe that data-driven machine learning at massive scale is the key to unlocking these capabilities and enabling the widespread deployment of robots across society.

We are a new startup headquartered in Bay Area, California, with an office in Seoul, Korea. Our team spans a wide range of backgrounds and experience, from new graduates to seasoned domain experts. What matters most to us is ownership, speed, and intellectual curiosity - people who take responsibility, move fast, and enjoy thinking deeply about hard problems.

We are supported by a highly advanced AI Center within KRAFTON, a leading global video game company best known for the genre-defining worldwide success PUBG: Battlegrounds. KRAFTON has extensive experience building and operating large-scale, data-rich products, and we have secured investment from them. This gives us strong long-term backing, deep technical partnership opportunities, and access to world-class infrastructure and talent networks as we push robotic intelligence forward.

We are looking for passionate builders who want to explore uncharted territory, take on difficult problems, and ship ambitious, industry-shaping work. You will collaborate across diverse teams as we bring our technology from research into real-world deployment.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Ludo is hiring in-house Robot Teleoperators for a data collection project at our Palo Alto office. You'll control robot arms by hand to do everyday tasks and say out loud what you're doing as you do it.

Your movements and your voice are recorded together. That data goes straight into training our AI models, so robots learn to connect words like "pick up the red cup" with the matching action. The cleaner and more consistent your demonstrations, the better our robots learn.

No prior robotics experience is needed; we will train you on the robots, scripts and data tools during your onboarding.

A TYPICAL SHIFT

Each shift is 8 hours, split into recording blocks with breaks in between. You start by powering on the robots, running the calibration check and confirming the cameras and microphone are recording, then get the day's tasks and scripts from your lead. Most of the shift is spent recording episodes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Operate robots

  • Control robot arms with a leader-follower setup (such as YAM arms): you move the leader arm by hand, and the follower robot copies you in real time.
  • For some tasks, operate robots with VR gear such as a Meta Quest headset and hand controllers.
  • Example tasks: packing items into boxes or bags; sorting cups, plates and utensils into bins; opening and closing jars and drawers; folding towels and clothes; wiping a table.

Talk through each task

  • Say the scripted line for each step as you do it, using the same words every time, for example "Opening the drawer." "Grabbing the blue sponge."
  • Speak at a steady pace and normal volume, timed to what your hands are doing.
  • Flag the episode whenever your words and actions don't match.

Keep quality high

  • Repeat tasks many times at steady speed and quality. This role has per-shift targets for both volume and quality.
  • Adjust quickly when tasks, objects or scripts change.

Report problems

  • Spot failed grasps, hardware glitches, recording errors and unclear instructions.
  • Report them to the engineering and research teams with the episode ID, the time and a one-line description.

Manage data

  • Upload and tag the episodes you record.
  • Keep a short log for each shift.

Look after equipment and safety

  • Start up and shut down robots correctly, and fix simple problems, such as reseating a loose cable or restarting the software.
  • Keep the workspace safe for yourself, your teammates and the robots.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Excellent hand-eye coordination, sense of space and focus.
  • Comfort talking and moving at the same time. You can describe your actions clearly in real time without slowing down or making mistakes.
  • Clear spoken English
  • You're comfortable having your voice recorded and used to train our AI models.
  • The ability to stand and move for most of your shift.
  • You pick up new physical tasks quickly and look for the best way to do them.
  • You welcome feedback and keep getting better.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required. An Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree is a plus.
  • Physical Stamina: Ability to stand, move, and stay focused for long periods.
  • Independence: Ability to work on your own with minimal supervision once trained.
  • Collaboration: A positive, team-first attitude and openness to feedback from the engineering and research teams.
  • Availability for the full project period, November 15 – December 22, 2026.

Nice to have

  • Experience with robots, VR, teleoperation systems or robot arms.
  • Experience doing voice-over, live streaming, coaching, or any job where you talk while doing something with your hands.
  • Gaming, drone flying, or other hobbies that need precise control.

Contract details

  • Work: In-house teleoperation at Ludo's Palo Alto office
  • Pay: $40/hour (Free lunch provided, unpaid break)
  • Dates: November 15 – December 22, 2026
  • Hours: Up to 8 hours per day; exact schedule to be confirmed
  • Payment: Every two weeks, based on the hours you actually work

Reasonable Accommodation

LUDO ROBOTICS is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, the Company will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to apply for an open position, perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact the Operations Team, to begin the interactive process.

EEOC Statement

LUDO ROBOTICS provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type.

This position may be filled at multiple levels depending on experience, scope, and business need. In California, the expected range for this position is $40/hour. The listed expected range represent good faith estimates. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors including experience, education, skills, performance, and work location. This position is also eligible for equity compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.

Due to recent scams, our recruiters will only reach out to you via @ludorobotics.ai, @sds.com, @krafton.com or @pubg.com. If you received an email and are unsure you can always email recruiting_KA@Krafton.com

title: Power Systems Coordinator 3 4P/923
description:
Title: Power System Coordinator III – Transmission Operations
Location: Gulfport, Mississippi
Contract: 3 Years
Schedule: 12-hour rotating shifts, including days, nights, and weekends

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Power System Coordinator III to support real-time monitoring, operation, and control of the Bulk Power Transmission System.

This position is responsible for minute-to-minute system monitoring, responding to abnormal system conditions, coordinating restoration activities, and ensuring compliance with applicable NERC and FERC requirements.

Candidates must already possess an active NERC certification as a Transmission Operator or Reliability Coordinator.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and control the Bulk Electric System in real time.

  • Maintain safe and reliable transmission system operations under normal conditions.

  • Analyze system conditions and identify potential reliability concerns.

  • Evaluate abnormal system conditions and determine appropriate corrective actions.

  • Develop and implement system restoration actions when required.

  • Coordinate transmission operations during outages, disturbances, and other critical events.

  • Maintain current knowledge of applicable NERC reliability standards.

  • Ensure operational activities comply with NERC requirements.

  • Support transmission switching, system control, and operational decision-making.

  • Communicate system conditions and required actions to appropriate stakeholders.

  • Provide leadership during time-sensitive or critical system events.

  • Maintain accurate operational records and documentation.

  • Coordinate with transmission, substation, generation, protection, and control personnel as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Current NERC certification as a Transmission Operator or Reliability Coordinator is required.

  • Prior experience with transmission systems, including one or more of the following:

    • Transmission operations

    • Substations

    • Transmission lines

    • Protection & Controls

  • Strong understanding of interconnected electric power system operations.

  • Ability to make sound decisions under significant time constraints.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple inputs and operational priorities simultaneously.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong computer skills and ability to work with multiple operational applications.

  • Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented control center environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Extensive transmission system operations experience.

  • Strong knowledge of transmission system characteristics and operating limits.

  • Experience with substation equipment and its operating characteristics.

  • Knowledge of generation control and system protection.

  • Knowledge of power system control and restoration practices.

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline.

Regulatory Requirements

  • Must maintain compliance with applicable NERC reliability standards.

  • Must sign and adhere to applicable FERC Standards of Conduct.

  • Must maintain required NERC certification throughout the assignment.

Schedule Requirements

  • Rotating shift schedule.

  • 12-hour shifts.

  • Schedule includes:

    • Days

    • Nights

    • Weekends

  • Ability to work in a real-time operational environment is required.

Key Skills

Power System Operations | Transmission Operations | NERC | Reliability Coordinator | Transmission Operator | Bulk Electric System | Substations | Transmission Lines | Protection & Controls | System Restoration | Power System Control | NERC Compliance | FERC | Control Center Operations

title: Ljubljana, PE Barvne kovine - zaposlimo Strojnika
description:
Vas veseli delo s stroji in napravami? Iščete stabilno in varno zaposlitev v dinamičnem delovnem okolju?

V svojo ekipo na PE Barvne kovine, Koprska ulica 92, 1000 Ljubljana, vabimo novega sodelavca – Strojnika (m/ž).

​​Delovne naloge Strojnika:

  • vozi ter upravlja mobilne in stabilne delovne stroje,

  • dela z napravami na strojih ter stabilnimi napravami,

  • skrbi za pravilno razkladanje in nakladanje,

  • skrbi za vzdrževanje stroja in naprav,

  • za stroje in naprave vodi ustrezno dokumentacijo,

  • opravlja fizična dela pri transportu materiala in pri vzdrževanju, naklada in razklada transportna sredstva in delovne priprave,

  • po potrebi čisti, sortira, stiska, reže, razstavlja, lupi, različne materiale kovinskega in nekovinskega izvora, komunalne odpadke, kosovne odpadke, stroje, gradbene objekte in postrojenja ter druge predmete.

Pričakujemo

Zahtevana dodatna znanja:

  • izpit za TGM,

  • zaželen izpit za dvigala (ni pogoj),

  • vozniški izpit B kategorije.

Nudimo

Nudimo:

  • redna usposabljanja,

  • možnost napredovanja in dodatnega nagrajevanja,

  • sodelovanje za določen čas, z možnostjo podaljšanja in željo po dolgoročnem sodelovanju.

Vabimo vas, da se nam pridružite in skupaj z nami soustvarjate zdaj že 75-letno zgodbo podjetja, ki je s svojimi poslovnimi enotami prisotno po vsej Sloveniji.

Prijavo z življenjepisom in kontaktnimi podatki oddajte preko portala MojeDelo do 15.11.2026.

Veselimo se vaše prijave!

title: Sr. Cyber Security Engineer, Security Validation
description:
Job Summary

Community Health Systems is one of the nation’s leading healthcare providers. Developing and operating healthcare delivery systems in 47 distinct markets across 16 states, CHS is committed to helping people get well and live healthier. CHS affiliates operate 70+ acute-care hospitals and more than 1,000 other sites of care, including physician practices, urgent care centers, freestanding emergency departments, occupational medicine clinics, imaging centers, cancer centers and ambulatory surgery centers.

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer in the Security Validation team, you will be a key member of our Red Team operations, assist in efforts to emulate real-world threat scenarios and validate the effectiveness of enterprise defenses across our expansive healthcare environment. This role requires advanced offensive security capabilities, deep knowledge of adversary tactics, and the ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and executive stakeholders.
You will design and execute advanced threat simulations against our infrastructure—cloud, clinical systems, APIs, IoT medical devices, and enterprise platforms—helping CHS proactively identify and mitigate systemic weaknesses. You will also work with internal teams and third parties to provide feedback on the relevance of vulnerabilities to CHS systems, ensuring alignment between threat findings and risk remediation efforts. Your work will directly impact patient safety, data integrity, and regulatory compliance across a network of hospitals and clinics.


Essential Functions

  • Red Team engagements emulating real-world threat actors, including APTs and insider threats, aligned with MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Conduct Security Validation Exercises across cloud, on-prem, hybrid, and medical environments to measure resilience against defined threat scenarios.
  • Develop and maintain custom tools, exploits, and payloads to simulate evolving adversarial behavior.
  • Collaborate with Blue Teams to refine detections, validate logging, and improve response capabilities.
  • Identify and characterize security risks in critical systems such as EMRs, PACS, medical IoT, and enterprise SaaS platforms.
  • Produce detailed reports and executive summaries, translating technical findings into actionable mitigation strategies.
  • Design tabletop and live-fire exercises that evaluate organizational readiness, incident response workflows, and security control efficacy.
  • Work with the threat intelligence team specific to the healthcare industry intelligence and adjust validation activities accordingly.
  • Enrich threat hunting with current IoC’s and TTP’s to identify vulnerabilities and gaps in monitoring across the CHS enterprise.
  • Ensure Red Team operations follow defined rules of engagement, safeguarding patient care and system availability.
  • Participate in compliance-driven assessments (e.g., HIPAA Security Rule, HITRUST) by providing validation evidence and attack simulations.
  • Mentor junior staff and foster a culture of offensive security awareness and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; or the equivalent required
  • 5-7 years of experience in cybersecurity, information technology operations, or a related field required
  • 3+ years in offensive security or Red Team roles preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proven experience performing Red Team or Purple Team engagements in large enterprise environments
  • Expertise in security validation, threat modeling, and adversary simulation
  • Demonstrated experience in regulated environments—healthcare industry experience highly preferred
  • Hands-on proficiency with tools such as Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, BloodHound, Covenant, Caldera, or similar
  • Familiarity with security challenges in cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), medical IoT, and EHR/EMR systems
  • Competencies:
    • Deep understanding of attack lifecycle, threat emulation frameworks, and operational security
      Strong written and verbal communication skills—ability to brief executive leadership

Licenses and Certifications

  • Relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, GIAC, or OSCP) preferred
  • PNPT, OSCP, OSCE, CRTO, GXPN, or GPEN
  • CISSP is a plus when paired with offensive security certs
