title: Informatieanalist
description:
Wil jij werken bij een organisatie met impact op het milieu en de kwaliteit van onze leefomgeving? Krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van de informatievoorziening en ken jij als geen ander het belang van goede en betrouwbare data? Wil jij met gedegen advies bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van onze organisatie? Kom dan werken als informatieanalist bij Omgevingsdienst Drenthe.


Wat ga je doen?
Als informatieanalist maak je deel uit van ons cluster I&A (Informatisering en Automatisering), dat bestaat uit achttien professionals. Omgevingsdienst Drenthe ontwikkelt zich steeds verder tot een informatiegestuurde organisatie. In onze dagelijkse praktijk verwerken we veel data uit in- en externe informatiebronnen. De vraag naar producten die deze data omzetten in waardevolle inzichten groeit snel. Actuele onderwerpen zijn dan bijvoorbeeld GEO-informatie, CO₂-toezicht, drones en energietoezicht. Met informatieproducten die daarin voorzien, dragen we bij aan een schoon en veilig Drenthe.

Je onderzoekt de mogelijkheden om de informatievoorziening binnen onze organisatie verder te optimaliseren. Daarnaast adviseer je over de aanpassingen die nodig zijn om het gewenste niveau te bereiken. Als het gaat om inrichting en sturing ben je een sparringpartner voor de directie en onze leidinggevenden. Je draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons informatieplatform op basis van Microsoft Azure. Voor het bewerken van data werk je met SQL, Python, DBT (data build tool) en Databricks, waarbij je verschillende gegevensbronnen integreert. Daarnaast ontwikkel je informatieproducten en implementeert deze in de organisatie.

Je krijgt alle ruimte om met vernieuwende ideeën te komen en deze te vertalen naar toepassingen binnen onze organisatie. Als informatieanalist zorg jij ervoor dat we met onze systemen kunnen analyseren wat er speelt, wat er mogelijk gaat gebeuren en hoe we daarop kunnen anticiperen.

Wat bieden we jou?
Werken bij Omgevingsdienst Drenthe betekent werken bij een organisatie die midden in de maatschappij staat en onder een (politiek) vergrootglas ligt. Dat maakt je werk dynamisch, veelzijdig en altijd actueel. Dit wordt door collega’s ervaren als inspirerend, leerzaam en leuk. Onze primaire taak is van directe invloed op de kwaliteit van de leefomgeving, de natuur en de balans met economische ontwikkeling in Drenthe.

Onze werksfeer is informeel. We helpen elkaar en nemen verantwoordelijkheid voor wat we doen. De medewerkerstevredenheid (MTO) is hoog. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden om je kennis en vaardigheden op peil te houden. We hebben een werkomgeving waarin je kunt leren én jezelf ontwikkelen. Uit een recent MTO weten we dat ruim 90% van onze medewerkers dit met een 7 of meer waardeert. Er bestaat een goede werk-privébalans met flexibele werktijden.

Lees de verhalen van onze collega’s op .

In het kader van onze Regeling Duurzame Mobiliteit gelden er vergoedingen woon-werkverkeer. Zo kun je kosteloos eerste klas met het OV reizen, bieden we een aantrekkelijke vergoeding voor actief vervoer (zoals de fiets) of het gebruik van de auto. Naast je salaris ontvang je een Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB) van 17,05% van je brutosalaris en een thuiswerkvergoeding. Het IKB kan (maandelijks) flexibel worden ingezet voor bijvoorbeeld het kopen van vakantiedagen of het aanschaffen van een fiets. Tijdens een kennismaking vertellen we graag meer over onze (secundaire) arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Wij bieden je in eerste instantie een arbeidsovereenkomst voor één jaar. Bij goed functioneren kunnen we die termijn verkorten en een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd met je afsluiten. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring wordt het salaris gebaseerd op schaal 11. Hierbij geldt een bruto maandsalaris van maximaal € 6.525,- (salaristabel per 1 januari 2027) bij een dienstverband van 36 uur.

Wie ben jij?
In deze veelzijdige functie schakel je gemakkelijk tussen strategie, tactiek, uitvoering en techniek. Daar komen je communicatieve vaardigheden, analytisch- en probleemoplossend vermogen goed bij van pas. Je bent een kritische denker, doorgrondt onze bedrijfsprocessen snel en maakt je deze gemakkelijk eigen.

Met je vermogen om de cultuur, belangen en informele regels goed aan te voelen weet je zaken voor elkaar te krijgen; daadkrachtig en overtuigend. Je hebt ruime ervaring met methoden en technieken voor data-engineering, zoals SQL, databases, ETL-frameworks, BI-platformen en datamodellen. Kennis van en ervaring met Scrum, het Microsoft Azure-platform, Databricks, DBT en Python zien we als een pre.

Daarnaast vragen we:
  • aantoonbaar wo- of hbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur op het gebied van informatietechnologie;
  • minimaal drie jaar werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie;
  • ervaring op het snijvlak van business en IT.

Wie zijn wij?
Omgevingsdienst Drenthe zet zich met 260 bevlogen en deskundige medewerkers in voor een schone, veilige en duurzame leefomgeving in Drenthe. Dat doen wij in opdracht van de twaalf Drentse gemeenten en onze provincie. Wij houden milieutoezicht, handhaven milieuregels, verlenen vergunningen en adviseren onze opdrachtgevers over uiteenlopende milieuthema’s. Zo beschermen we de leefomgeving van nu én van volgende generaties.

Met onze kennis van milieuwetgeving kunnen inwoners en bedrijven op ons rekenen. Dat moet ook, want we hebben te maken met een sterk veranderende omgeving waarin volop wordt geïnvesteerd en het milieu steeds meer aandacht krijgt. Onze organisatie groeit daarin mee.

Werken bij Omgevingsdienst Drenthe betekent werken bij een betrokken organisatie, die zich continu ontwikkelt en volop ambitie heeft. Daar kun jij onderdeel van uitmaken!

Voor meer informatie over onze organisatie, kijk verder op onze website en op vind je meer over het werkveld van een omgevingsdienst.

Ben je enthousiast?
Dan ontvangen we graag je sollicitatie!

Stuur ons je motivatiebrief en cv via onderstaand sollicitatieformulier ter attentie van Richard Schwieters. Dit kan tot en met zondag 29 november 2026. De gesprekken staan gepland op vrijdag 4 december 2026. We vragen je hier rekening mee te houden.

Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen, maar beschik je wél over relevante vaardigheden, ervaring en ambities? Stuur ons dan toch je sollicitatie. We horen graag van je.

title: Material Review Board Engineer / Liaison Engineer
description:
We’re more than aviation experts, we’re pioneers. We challenge what’s possible. From breaking the sound barrier to advanced tiltrotor systems. Today, Bell is shaping the future of aviation through specialized engineering. And we want you.

We are developing the future of Army Aviation with the Bell Future Long-Range Assault Aircraft (FLRAA) part of the US Army’s Future Vertical Lift (FVL) modernization effort. We are also developing the Bell 525 Relentless and Bell's High-Speed Vertical Take-Off and Landing (HSVTOL) program, a next generation aircraft.

This position is onsite at the Bell's Drive Systems Center in Grand Prairie, Texas.

Operations Support Material Review Board (MRB) Engineering

This position is for a Material Review Board (MRB) member that works discrepant part evaluation and disposition needs on the production floor and on procured components. The Engineer will be required to disposition defects and oversee the planning, repair, and/or acceptance of flight articles.

The candidate will lead internal and external technical discussions to assess part conditions and repair capabilities as part of the disposition process. They will work closely with engineering support groups – such as drive system design, drives stress, and fatigue – as well as production supervisors and managers to support the assessment of part conditions and execution of repairs, where applicable, assuring MRB approved documents are followed and repairs are done correctly.

The candidate will participate in root cause corrective action teams in the factory and with suppliers as required to reduce recurring defects.

What you’ll be doing as a Material Review Board Engineer\:

The candidate is expected to become an MRB board member and be certified to disposition non-conforming drive system components (gears, bearings, shafts, housings, and other supporting components) including the design of original repairs (example\: bushings/sleeves/liners) based on fit/form/function at the next assembly.

The candidate is expected to become a member of the Planning Review Board and be responsible for reviewing and approving fabrication planning as well as providing repair dispositions for items that are designated as Controlled Items (Primary, Critical, & Flight Safety Parts).

Additional responsibilities include providing Engineering cross-function support, design interpretation to manufacturing/production teams, and supporting new/existing program development/improvements.

title: Strategy & Operations Associate, GTM
description:
Behind many of life’s most important transactions like buying a house, applying for a mortgage, getting a small business loan, or refinancing a credit card, is a network of credit relationships. Setpoint provides critical infrastructure for relationships between the world’s largest banks, credit funds and capital markets counterparties. Because when capital works together, ambition goes further.

Strategy & Operations Associate, GTM

Location: New York, New York | Hybrid (Tuesdays/Thursdays)

About the role

Behind many of life’s most important transactions like buying a house, applying for a mortgage, getting a small business loan, or refinancing a credit card, is a network of credit relationships. Setpoint provides critical infrastructure for relationships between the world’s largest banks, credit funds and capital markets counterparties. Because when capital works together, ambition goes further.

We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Associate, GTM hire to join our team. This role sits at the intersection of sales, operations, and AI. Today, much of what happens in our deals lives in email threads, Slack channels, and call recordings, and only part of it reaches HubSpot through manual rep updates. You will build the company intelligence layer that captures all of it, and the AI agents on top of it that keep our CRM current, surface insights for leadership, and give reps their time back to sell.

Who will love this job:

  • An AI builder – you reach for Claude, GPT, and automation tools first, and you have built workflows, agents, or internal tools that people use every day
  • A systems thinker – you see the CRM, inboxes, Slack, and call recordings as one data set and want to connect them
  • A data-driven strategist – you use metrics to shape sales process and go-to-market strategy, not only to report on them
  • An owner – you find the manual, low-value work that slows reps down and remove it without being asked
  • A strong collaborator – you work across sales, marketing, product, and finance, and can explain technical work to a non-technical audience

What you’ll do:

  • Company Intelligence Layer - Design and build an always-on intelligence ecosystem that captures what happens across email, Slack, and call recordings and connects it to HubSpot, so the full history of every account and deal lives in one place instead of in reps' inboxes and memories
  • AI Agents for the Sales Team - Build and maintain agents on top of that data that do work on reps' behalf: monitoring calls, updating projected close dates, deal stages, and product mix in HubSpot, flagging at-risk deals, and drafting follow-ups
  • Systems & Data Integrity - Own HubSpot (our CRM) end to end. Move the CRM from rep-entered data to system-maintained data, with clear field definitions, automated hygiene, and an audit trail so leadership can trust what it sees
  • Reporting & Forecasting - Partner with sales leadership on pipeline management, quarter-end close, and the forecast that feeds financial planning, executive, and board materials. Build dashboards and reports that give visibility into key sales metrics
  • GTM Strategy & Analysis - Analyze performance across the sales process, pricing, product mix, and ideal customer profile, and turn the findings into recommendations for leadership
  • Account Management - Manage account distribution so reps keep a healthy pipeline, equitable account assignments, and a balanced mix of core ICP and experimental accounts. Use AI-driven enrichment to fill account data gaps that support qualification
  • Enablement & Cross-Functional Collaboration - Roll out new tools and processes to the sales team with clear guides and training, and work with marketing, finance, product, and implementation to keep systems and processes aligned

You should have:

  • 4-6+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy & Operations, or a related role (ex. Business Operations, GTM Strategy)
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience (required), including workflows, custom properties, integrations, and reporting
  • A track record of building with AI: you have shipped workflows, agents, or internal tools using Claude, GPT, or similar models, and can walk us through what you built
  • Experience working with unstructured data such as call transcripts, email, and chat, and turning it into structured fields a system can act on
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience modeling sales data, reporting, and forecasting
  • Comfort with APIs, SQL, and scripting in Python or JavaScript; experience with automation platforms (ex. n8n, Zapier, Make) or agent frameworks is a plus
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is preferred

Compensation: $130,000 - $150,000 OTE, dependent on multiple factors, which may include the successful candidate's skills, experience, and other qualifications.

About Setpoint:

Setpoint provides purpose-built capital and technology to asset-backed borrowers and lenders. Our platform is the funding operating system for originators: it verifies and stores documents; automates critical calculations and compliance reporting; and digitizes assets like homes or cars. Setpoint’s technology makes warehouse transactions instant and error free.

In August 2024, Setpoint announced the successful completion of its $31 million Series B funding round. 645 Ventures led the round, with significant strategic investments from Citi and Wells Fargo, alongside Andreessen Horowitz, NextView Ventures, Floating Point, Henry Kravis, Zillow founder’s 75 & Sunny, Vesta Ventures, Fifth Wall, Eltura Ventures, and Outrunner Capital.

For all our employees, we offer a full slate of benefits from competitive salaries, stock options, medical, dental and vision coverage, 401k, disability coverage, and flexible vacation. Setpoint has offices in Austin, New York, and Park City, UT and we’re currently hiring remote team members for specific roles.

Setpoint provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

About Setpoint:

Setpoint is the new operating standard for asset-backed finance. Our collaborative, AI-native platform brings capital providers and borrowers together around the same verified information: extracting and verifying asset and servicer data, automating reporting and compliance, and surfacing risk and opportunity in real time. Leading institutions use Setpoint to strengthen oversight, reduce risk, and make better decisions across $550B+ in financed assets.

In August 2024, Setpoint announced the successful completion of its $31 million Series B funding round. 645 Ventures led the round, with significant strategic investments from Citi and Wells Fargo, alongside Andreessen Horowitz, NextView Ventures, Floating Point, Henry Kravis, Zillow founder’s 75 & Sunny, Vesta Ventures, Fifth Wall, Eltura Ventures, and Outrunner Capital.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive salaries, stock options, unlimited paid time off, medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), and health and wellness support through One Medical and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program. We have offices in Austin, TX, New York, NY, and Salt Lake City, UT, with hybrid roles based in these locations and an expectation of two days a week in office (Tuesdays and Thursdays).

title: Senior Consultant - Lead Java & AWS Integration Engineer / Architect (Energy Trading)
description:
Role: Senior Consultant - Lead Java & AWS Integration Engineer / Architect (Energy Trading)

Location: India

Work Model: Remote

About capSpire:

capSpire is a rapidly growing global consulting and solutions company with ten offices in key markets worldwide. Renowned for our people-first, entrepreneurial, and collaborative culture, we have been consistently recognised as a Great Place to Work. As a vendor-independent consultancy, capSpire partners with major energy and commodity companies, offering deep technical and industry expertise to deliver practical solutions.

Role Overview:

We are expanding our delivery capability in India and are looking for a senior Java and cloud integration engineer, who will also act as technical lead and architect, to join a team supporting a European energy trading client’s post-trade transformation programme. You will design, build and support event-driven integration and trade processing services around an Endur ETRM platform, using Spring Boot, Kafka, AWS Kinesis, AWS Lambda and AWS EKS, and deliver the infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines that underpin them. You will own the technical design of these services, lead the India-based engineers, and work closely with onshore architects and with business and technical stakeholders in the UK and Europe. In addition, you will be supporting the growth of capSpire’s Energy and Commodities technology practice.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test and support hybrid (on-premises/cloud) integration services for bidirectional data exchange between the Endur ETRM system and surrounding applications, using Spring Boot, AWS Kinesis and AWS Lambda.
  • Build and enhance trade processing services that enrich, transform and route incoming trades, based on Spring microservices running on AWS EKS (Kubernetes) together with AWS Lambda and Kinesis.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines using Terraform, AWS CDK and Azure DevOps Pipelines.
  • Design and implement event-driven and stream-processing solutions (Kafka Streams, Kafka Connect, Confluent Schema Registry/Avro) for post-trade message translation, routing and processing.
  • Own the software architecture and technical design of the integration and trade processing services, making sure solutions meet project objectives and non-functional requirements for performance, resilience, scalability, security and maintainability.
  • Define and document target-state architecture, integration patterns and technical standards, and record key decisions (e.g. architecture decision records) in agreement with onshore architects.
  • Lead the redesign and modernisation of existing components where needed, for example moving to event-sourcing and stream-processing patterns, and plan safe migration paths from legacy systems.
  • Act as technical lead for the India team: break down work, provide estimates, review designs and code, and be accountable for the technical quality of the team’s deliverables.
  • Represent the offshore team in design forums and technical governance with the client and onshore architects, and evaluate new tools and technologies.
  • Gather and clarify functional and non-functional requirements with onshore business and technical stakeholders, and build proof-of-concept applications to validate technical approaches.
  • Remain hands-on, writing performant, testable and maintainable code with good unit and integration test coverage, and uphold engineering standards across the SDLC.
  • Implement monitoring and observability (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana) and provide production support, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for business-critical services.
  • Prepare and maintain solution design, technical and operational documentation.
  • Mentor and develop engineers in the India team, give technical presentations and share knowledge with the wider onshore/offshore delivery team.

Key Requirements:

  • Solution Architecture: Strong experience designing distributed, event-driven and microservice-based systems, including integration patterns, cloud architecture on AWS, data flow design, security (e.g. OAuth2) and resilience.
  • Technical Leadership: Proven ability to lead engineering teams, set standards, run design and code reviews, and guide delivery with limited supervision.
  • Java Development: Strong hands-on experience in Java with Spring, Spring Boot and Spring microservices, Hibernate/JPA and Maven, building business-critical, multithreaded applications.
  • AWS Cloud: Practical experience designing and running solutions on AWS, in particular Kinesis, Lambda and EKS, including hybrid on-premises/cloud integration.
  • Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD: Proficiency with Terraform, AWS CDK and Azure DevOps Pipelines; experience with Jenkins, Sonar, Git and GitHub Enterprise.
  • Messaging and Streaming: Expertise in Apache Kafka (Streams, Connect, Confluent Schema Registry/Avro) and familiarity with RabbitMQ; good understanding of event-driven, event-sourcing and stream-processing patterns.
  • Containers and Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Database Development: Strong SQL skills across Oracle (PL/SQL) and MS SQL Server (T-SQL), including data modelling and query performance tuning.

This role is intended for a senior leader who brings together technical knowledge, market understanding, client relationships, and business development experience. Preferred Qualifications

title: Growth and CRM Analyst
description:
About AppLovin

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: .

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

The Role

AppLovin Ads Manager is opening up to e-commerce and DTC brands at scale, and none of it can be done by hand. CRM runs the whole span: reaching brands who haven't heard from us yet, getting the ones who sign up live and spending, helping them spend better once they are, and winning them back when they stop. Your job is to help build and optimize that machine. You'll own your slice of it alongside our CRM lead, and grow your scope as the platform does.

Where You'll Have Impact

  • Activation and onboarding. The core of the job: getting new advertisers through setup and into a live campaign, triggered by where someone is actually dropped rather than how many days have passed.
  • Engagement and performance. The milestone that matters isn't the first campaign, it's the first one that works.
  • Retention and win-back. Advertisers pause for all sorts of reasons. Getting them back is its own discipline.
  • Outbound. Reaching advertisers who haven't heard from us yet, targeted on criteria or intent signals.
  • More than email. SMS, LinkedIn, direct mail and event-driven outreach are all in play.
  • The data and logic layer. Segmentation, triggers and suppression, and the flow between our data platform, Salesforce and HubSpot — understood well enough to fix at source.

This is a build job, not a maintenance one. What you build compounds — in revenue, in efficiency, and in time the team gets back.

What We're Looking For

Someone AI-fluent who can do the whole job — a real track record of moving the needle, high impact through their own work, and the curiosity and creativity to find the next thing without being pointed at it.

  • Results you can show. Campaigns you've run, what you changed, and the number it moved.
  • Initiative and curiosity. You'll find problems we didn't know we had, and you'll be first to try the next tool.
  • Creativity. You write it, design it, and ship it yourself.
  • Revenue-focused. You go after the opportunities that move the number, not the ones that are easiest to ship. You care whether advertisers activate and spend, not how many emails went out.
  • You've made mistakes and learned from them. We would rather hear about the campaign that didn't work and what you changed than a run of clean wins.
  • Comfortable building the logic, not just the copy — segmentation, triggers, branching, suppression.
  • Hands-on with AI — Claude or Cursor to write, design and build, and you check the output before it ships.
  • Technical enough to answer your own questions: HubSpot, Salesforce, SQL, PostHog.
  • An individual contributor at heart. You go deep on execution without a team beneath you.
  • 2–4 years in technical role, preferably growth and CRM marketing.

Nice To Have

  • Outbound or enrichment tooling — Clay, Apollo or similar.
  • Email deliverability — sender reputation, authentication, inbox placement.
  • Superset, Trino or similar big data tooling.
  • B2B SaaS, adtech, or e-commerce and DTC background.

AppLovin provides a competitive total compensation package with a pay for performance rewards approach. Total compensation at AppLovin is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Depending on the position offered, equity, and other forms of incentive compensation (as applicable) may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to dental, vision, and other benefits.

This posting is for a new position.

title: IT Security Engineer II
description:

This role will also serve as a Tier-3 escalation point for our internal Help Desk. This is a highly collaborative role, and communication skills are critical. This is a hybrid role that requires in-office presence at CMT’s headquarters in Cambridge, Massachusetts, at least 3 days per week, or as the work demands.

CMT is looking for an IT Security Engineer II to help us change the world. CMT has helped protect over 65 million drivers and prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. We build AI to solve some of the most difficult challenges in mobility — understanding and reducing risk, detecting crashes, and getting people life-saving help. The problems are hard. The impact is real. No matter your role, your work will matter at CMT.

  • Work on a mission with real impact: crashes prevented, injuries avoided, lives protected around the world
  • Join an industry leader — 65 million drivers protected, powering 140+ programs across 25 countries
  • Recognized innovator in mobility AI, earning top honors including the TIME Industry Leader in AI, a Gold Edison Award, and the Artificial Intelligence Excellence Award for AI for Social Good. CMT is also Great Place to Work Certified
  • Be part of the team inventing the future of mobility and road safety
  • Move fast, own outcomes, do work that matters

  • Unlimited PTO, flexible scheduling, competitive salary, annual performance bonus, RSUs, and full benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 401k match

Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) is the world’s largest telematics and AI company for safer mobility. Its mission is to make the world’s roads and drivers safer. Headquartered in Cambridge, MA, CMT operates globally with offices in Budapest, Hungary; Chennai, India; Seattle, Washington; Tokyo, Japan; and Zagreb, Croatia. Learn more at www.cmt.ai.

We partner with Sponsors to deliver drug development, treatment access, and commercialization solutions, helping patients worldwide gain access to life-changing therapies.

The IT Intern – AI & Transformation will support the Information Technology function by partnering with cross-functional departments to identify opportunities where AI and automation can streamline work, improve data-driven decision-making, and enable digital transformation. This role provides hands-on experience in AI-enabled tools, process and workflow automation, Python scripting, data analysis, and system optimization, within a responsible-AI framework and a GxP-regulated environment.

  • Participate in project meetings, provide status updates and contribute ideas to continuous improvement and innovation initiatives.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into automation and AI-enabled solutions.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks at once, work independently and contribute effectively as part of a collaborative team.

  • Experience with Python for scripting, automation and data analysis, and working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Understanding of data fundamentals, including data cleaning, transformation and reporting, and familiarity with Tableau, Power BI or other data visualization and business intelligence tools.
  • Familiarity with generative AI tools, prompt engineering and AI assistants such as Microsoft Copilot, along with exposure to AI and machine learning concepts, tools or frameworks.
  • Familiarity with workflow automation or low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Power Automate, Power Apps), and a basic understanding of systems, data flows and technology-enabled process improvement.
Preferred (Desirable)
  • Experience with APIs, ETL processes, RPA or data integration tools, and exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure) and cloud-based AI services.
  • Understanding of AI governance, data protection or regulated (GxP) environments.
  • Prior internship, academic project or practical experience involving AI, automation, data or systems.

title: Used vehicle reconditioning technician
description:
Used vehicle reconditioning technician

Ennis, TX

Quick Snapshot

  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday; Saturdays as needed to complete work
  • Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off
  • Shop: Newly remodeled facility with air-conditioned bays

About Ennis Ford

At Ennis Ford, part of the Toliver Auto Group family of stores, we believe great work starts with a workplace where people feel respected and supported. As a family-owned and operated dealership, we value transparency, professional growth, and the technicians who help keep our customers moving.

Job Description

Ready for a fresh start in a shop that supports your skills? Ennis Ford is looking for a Used vehicle reconditioning technician with at least 3 years of professional automotive repair experience. In this role, you will inspect, diagnose, service, and repair dealership-owned used vehicles to prepare safe, reliable inventory for resale. You will document needed work, complete approved repairs, and verify vehicle readiness through quality checks and road testing. Ford experience is a plus, but it is not required. We welcome technicians who take pride in quality repairs and enjoy working with a team.

Our newly remodeled facility offers air-conditioned bays and up-to-date equipment to help you work efficiently and comfortably. If you are looking for a long-term opportunity where your experience is appreciated, we would like to hear from you.

Job Type

  • Full-time

Schedule

  • Monday through Friday
    • Saturdays as needed to complete your work

Pay

  • Pay is negotiable based on experience and qualifications.

Work Requirements

  • Ability to commute to our Ennis, TX location.
  • A valid driver’s license and a clean driving record. A minimum of 19 years old and 3 full years of driving experience necessary.
  • Ability to pass a background check and drug screening.
  • Your own comprehensive set of professional tools.

Responsibilities

  • Inspect incoming used vehicles for safety concerns, mechanical issues, and maintenance needs.
  • Diagnose concerns and complete approved repairs and maintenance, including brakes, tires, fluids, and worn components.
  • Road-test vehicles and verify repair quality before they are released for sale.
  • Document inspection findings, repair recommendations, and completed work clearly and accurately.
  • Use shop equipment and diagnostic tools to troubleshoot vehicle concerns efficiently.
  • Coordinate with the used-car manager, service team, sales manager and parts department to secure repair approvals and keep inventory moving toward sale readiness.
  • Perform new vehicle PDIs as assigned
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of professional automotive technician experience.
  • Strong knowledge of automotive systems and hands-on diagnostic and repair skills.
  • A self-motivated approach with attention to quality, efficiency, and teamwork.
  • A professional work ethic and a commitment to a clean, safe work area.
  • Ford dealership or Ford vehicle repair experience is a plus but not required.

Why Join Ennis Ford

  • A comfortable, updated shop: Enjoy new floors, fresh paint, upgraded insulation, air conditioning, new roll-up doors, and refreshed bathrooms and break room.
  • Equipment that supports your work: Up-to-date tools and shop equipment help you tackle repairs efficiently.
  • A family-owned workplace: Be part of a team that combines a personal, family-run approach with the stability of the Toliver Auto Group.
  • Confidential inquiries: If you are currently employed, you can explore this opportunity with confidence. All inquiries will be kept strictly confidential.

Benefits

  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid Holidays
  • Employee vehicle purchase and service discounts

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

Ennis Ford is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants and do not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any characteristic protected by law.

title: Structural Restoration Consultant/Engineer
description:
How Your Role Will Shape Our Success

In this role, you will provide forensic engineering, restoration, and building repair consulting services while managing your own projects and client relationships. You will lead investigations, analyze structural and waterproofing deficiencies, and develop repair recommendations for a variety of structures, including high-rises, historical buildings, parking structures, plazas, etc. You will be involved throughout all phases of a project, including forensic investigations, condition assessments, repair design, budgeting, and construction administration.

Qualified candidates will have experience in forensic engineering, structural restoration, building repair, or related consulting fields, along with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, self-directed, collaborative, and able to build relationships with clients and project teams.

What You'll Do

-Perform investigations, surveys, and testing of existing buildings to identify and diagnose deficiencies contributing to damage or deterioration.-Critically analyze plans, specifications, and calculations prepared by others.

-Assist with developing project proposals and reviewing agreements.

-Participate in the quality control process.

-Monitor progress of projects, adherence to project requirements, and closely track budget and procedural standards.

-Perform or review condition appraisals, develop repair schemes, and provide repair recommendations.

-Complete and maintain all project documentation in project management software.

-Manage multiple projects.-Maintain, market, and promote restoration and forensic engineering consulting services to new and existing clients.

-Other duties as assigned.

What You'll Bring

Education Requirements:

-Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Architectural Engineering, Architecture, or similar.

Other Requirements:

-Professional license in architecture, structural engineering preferred or actively pursuing licensure

-5-8 years of experience preferred in forensic engineering, structural restoration, building repair, or related consulting fields.

-Strong writing, communication, and team skills.

-Experience in developing and maintaining client relationships.

-Ability to travel to project sites.

We offer a robust total compensation and rewards package designed to support our employees’ well-being, growth, and diverse needs, including:

  • Opportunity to purchase Walker stock – Walker is 100% employee-owned!

Why Walker Consultants?

Walker offers various comprehensive services spanning structural integrity and building performance, encompassing forensic investigations, building envelope analysis, and restoration. Our forensic specialists excel in pinpointing the underlying causes of intricate issues, be it structural complexities, architectural hurdles, or building envelope uncertainties. Leveraging thorough investigations, meticulous assessments, and advanced analyses, we deliver enduring solutions.

The building envelope's significance transcends protection; it profoundly influences energy efficiency, occupant comfort, and aesthetic allure. Our building envelope experts ensure continuity, durability, and performance, maintaining project integrity from inception to a structure's lengthy service life. With a broad geographic footprint across the United States, Walker's extensive presence allows swift responses to local demands while harnessing the proficiency of our adept designers and practitioners.

title: Toimintakoordinaattori
description:
Tampereen Kehitysvammaisten Tuki ry etsii oma-aloitteista, organisointikykyistä ja yhteistyöhenkistä toimintakoordinaattoria vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Tampereen Kehitysvammaisten Tuki ry on yksi Suomen suurimmista kehitysvammaisten tukiyhdistyksistä. Edistämme paikallisesti kehitysvammaisten ja vastaavaa tukea tarvitsevien ihmisten sekä heidän perheidensä ja läheistensä oikeuksia ja hyvinvointia. Työllistämme vuosittain noin 40 kurssi- ja leiriohjaajaa. Yhdistyksemme rahoituspohja on vakaa, emmekä saa toimintaamme STEA-rahoitusta.

Vuonna 1961 perustettu yhdistyksemme tarjoaa tietoa, ohjausta ja neuvontaa sekä mahdollisuuksia vertaistukeen, harrastamiseen ja virkistäytymiseen. Järjestämme osallistujien yksilölliset tarpeet huomioivaa leiri- ja harrastekurssitoimintaa sekä muuta vapaa-ajan toimintaa.

Lisätietoja yhdistyksestämme: www.kvtukitampere.fi

Olisitko sinä etsimämme henkilö?

Pysyykö sinulla monta lankaa käsissä yhtä aikaa? Nautitko organisoinnista, ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja siitä, että saat asiat sujumaan? Haluaisitko tehdä työtä, jolla on aidosti merkitystä?

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Toimintakoordinaattorina vastaat harrastekurssien, kesätoiminnan, vertaistuen, diskojen ja tapahtumien suunnittelusta ja koordinoinnista.

Teet yhteistyötä oppilaitosten ja muiden toimijoiden kanssa sekä osallistut yhdistyksen viestintään, kuten tapahtumien markkinointiin, verkkosivujen päivittämiseen ja someviestintään.

Olet toiminnanjohtajan läheinen työpari sekä vastaavan ohjaajan ja ohjaajien esihenkilö. Kehität toimintaa yhdessä muun työyhteisön kanssa.

Työ on monipuolista ja käytännönläheistä. Suunnittelun ja koordinoinnin lisäksi osallistut aktiivisesti myös toiminnan käytännön toteutukseen ja yhteisiin arjen tehtäviin.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Soveltuvaa koulutusta (esimerkiksi sosionomi tai yhteisöpedagogi) tai muuta vastaavaa kokemusta

  • Hyviä organisointi-, yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

  • Itsenäistä, vastuullista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

  • Viestintätaitoja ja valmiuksia digitaalisten kanavien käyttöön

  • Esihenkilökokemusta ja kykyä hallita useita kokonaisuuksia samanaikaisesti

  • Tahtotila kehitysvammaisten ihmisten osallisuuden vahvistamiseen.

Toivomme aikaisempaa kokemusta kehitysvamma-alalta tai järjestötyöstä. Arvostamme moninaisuutta ja yhdenvertaisuutta. Hakijoiksi toivomme kaikki tehtävästä kiinnostuneet sukupuolesta, iästä, etnisestä taustasta tai muista henkilökohtaisista ominaisuuksista riippumatta.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työn, jossa pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi, kehittämään uutta ja vaikuttamaan konkreettisesti kehitysvammaisten ihmisten mahdollisuuksiin osallistua, harrastaa ja olla tasavertaisesti yhteisön jäsen.

Meillä pääset osaksi lämminhenkistä ja avointa työyhteisöä, jossa puhalletaan yhteiseen hiileen.

Työsuhteen tiedot

title: Client Advisor - Sherman Oaks
description:
Company

Rebag, the ultimate destination for buying and selling the most coveted designer handbags and accessories, is an e-commerce company reimagining the role of luxury in the secondary market. Rebag has opened a world of endless access to luxury, with a unique business model that puts the seller first, offers upfront payment, and makes the resale experience smooth and clutter-free.

Since its inception, Rebag has catered to a rapidly growing segment of consumers who are exploring ownership of luxury goods in a sustainable and affordable way. The company operates online and in stores, with locations in Los Angeles, New York, Miami, and Connecticut. Founded in 2014 by a team out of Harvard Business School, Rebag is backed by prestigious venture capital investors including General Catalyst, Novator, Crosslink and FJLabs, and has raised over $100m in funding to date. In 2020, Rebag was named one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies. Rebag has been featured in the New York Times, Business of Fashion, VOGUE, TechCrunch and more.

Role Description:

Our Sr. Store Experience Leads are the critical contributors to driving sustainability in the fashion industry. In this role, you will be responsible for building rapport, capturing leads, and converting them through a charismatic presentation of our product and superb follow-through.

You will be challenged to support and manage your sales peers, build customer relationships, educate others about resale and match the benefits of selling their once loved luxury items to the needs of your customers. You will also assist leadership and training teams in the development of the in-store experience within the team. At the end of the day, you will be measured and rewarded for your ability to convert new business and also your ability to create Rebag fans who will tell our story to their friends and family.

To succeed at Rebag, you must be energetic, highly organized, and hard-working. You should have a passion for fashion, sustainability, and the ability to create exceptional customer experiences. While individual contributions will be recognized, teamwork is essential to achieve the highest level of success. We will reward team players who help others succeed and empower the team around them.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Welcome customers to Rebag by making their journey and understanding of Resale a memorable and exciting experience.
  • Identify and overcome objections and obstacles, including quoted items, financing options, and customer education, and resale pricing.
  • Coordinate all aspects of the sellers' final transaction, including receipt of final payment.
  • Contribute ideas toward improving the Rebag's sales and trade experience, as well as back-end processes and procedures.
  • Demonstrate a mastery of all Rebag products and services. Keep up with industry trends and best practices.
  • Proactively and consistently update our CRM system to ensure accurate customer experience information is captured to build stronger rapport.

title: Linux sistemski administrator (m/ž)
description:
Delo obsega vzdrževanje preko 1.800 večinoma lastnih fizičnih in virtualnih strežnikov lociranih v Sloveniji, Švici, na Hrvaškem in v Srbiji ter načrtovanje, vzpostavljanje, nadzor in vzdrževanje strežnikov in rešitev na področju virtualizacije, omrežij in informacijske varnosti.

Si želiš nadgraditi svojo kariero v svetu tehnoloških rešitev?
Če si ambiciozen, iščeš dodatno znanje in se želiš dokazati ter biti del uspešne ekipe, ki je št. 1 na svojem področju, potem si na pravem mestu …

V podjetju Webtasy, d.o.o., ki nudi široko paleto spletnih rešitev več kot 36.000 strankam pod blagovno znamko Domenca.com, iščemo za dolgoročnejše sodelovanje novega sodelavca/ko v oddelku Sistemske administracije, v kateri je trenutno 6 članov.

Postani del super ekipe, ki širi svoja znanja tudi izven Slovenije – Domenca je namreč del mednarodne skupine DHH SpA, ki združuje 13 podjetij s področja spletnih tehnologij. Poleg možnosti pridobivanja znanj na konferencah in podobnih dogodkih (Kubecon, PromCon, Shift, CloudFest, RIPE, …), letno organiziramo srečanje strokovnjakov znotraj skupine. Možno je tudi začasno delo iz katerekoli lokacije skupine.

Ker si želimo še naprej ostati vodilno podjetje v svetu spletnih storitev, bomo še posebej veseli karierno usmerjenih posameznikov, ki so pripravljeni trdo in pametno delati ter hitro prevzeti odgovornost.

*Brez skrbi – pri spoznavanju okolja in osvajanju novega znanja boš deležen/a podpore celotne ekipe naših strokovnjakov, ki ti bo pomagala do hitrejšega napredka.

Predstavitev podjetja in ekipe
Podjetje Webtasy, d.o.o. upravlja blagovno znamko Domenca.com ter je največji slovenski ponudnik spletnega gostovanja in registracije domen.

Poleg ekipe 25 sodelavcev (v Sloveniji) in več kot 25 let izkušenj, se lahko pohvalimo s tem, da skrbimo za več kot 36.000 strank z več kot 89.000 domenami.

Domenca je del mednarodne skupine DHH SpA, ki združuje 13 podjetij v 6 evropskih državah (Slovenija, Švica, Italija, Hrvaška, v Srbija in Bolgarija). Vsa podjetja so specializirana za storitve gostovanja v oblaku, računalništva v oblaku ali internetne povezljivosti.

Opis delovnega mesta

Kaj bo obsegalo tvoje delo?
Delo obsega vzdrževanje preko 1.800 večinoma lastnih fizičnih in virtualnih strežnikov lociranih v Sloveniji, Švici, na Hrvaškem in v Srbiji ter načrtovanje, vzpostavljanje, nadzor in vzdrževanje strežnikov in rešitev na področju virtualizacije, omrežij in informacijske varnosti.

Naše poslanstvo je, da tehnično kompleksne rešitve poenostavimo in jih naredimo prijazne za končnega uporabnika, zato vedno iščemo nove načine (in postopke), kako lahko še izboljšamo uporabniško izkušnjo.

Uporabljamo sledeče tehnologije in rešitve:

  • mrežna oprema: Juniper, Fortinet,
  • strežniki in diskovna polja: Supermicro, Dell, NetApp,
  • operacijske sisteme: CloudLinux, AlmaLinux, CentOS, Debian,
  • virtualizacija: CloudStack, Proxmox, KVM,
  • relacijske podatkovne baze: MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL,
  • spletni strežniki: LiteSpeed, Apache, HAProxy,
  • nadzorne plošče: cPanel, Plesk,
  • avtomatizacija: Puppet, Ansible,
  • nadzor delovanja sistemov: Prometheus, Grafana
  • in drugo.

V našo ekipo se boš super vključil/a če:

  • rad delaš v ekipi,
  • se hitro učiš
  • si natančen in proaktiven,
  • si vedoželjen,
  • si iznajdljiv in usmerjen h konstruktivnim rešitvam,
  • si prijazen in pozitivno naravnan.

Delovni čas

polni delovni čas

Pričakujemo

Pričakovana znanja in izkušnje:

  • napredne izkušnje z Linux strežniki,
  • poznavanje virtualizacijskih tehnologij,
  • izkušnje pri delu z infrastrukturno in mrežno opremo (požarni zid, stikala),
  • analitične veščine in veščine pri odkrivanju napak,
  • poznavanje omrežnih protokolov in storitev (TCP/IP, DNS, usmerjevalni protokoli, SNMP),
  • izkušnje pri administraciji spletnih strežnikov,
  • poznavanje Python-a, PHP-ja, MySQL-a,
  • poznavanje orodij za monitoring,
  • vsaj V/VI stopnja izobrazbe računalniške ali druge tehnične smeri,
  • vozniški izpit B kategorije in lasten prevoz,
  • tekoče pisno in govorno znanje slovenščine in angleščine,
  • zaželeno govorno znanje hrvaškega jezika.

Prednost imajo kandidati:

  • z delovnimi izkušnjami na podobnem delovnem mestu,
  • z izkušnjami z nadzorno ploščo cPanel,
  • z izkušnjami pri optimizaciji strežniških performans v primeru preobremenitev,
  • s formalno izobrazbo.

Zahtevane delovne izkušnje

4 - 5 let

Ponujamo

Kandidatom ponujamo:

  • zaposlitev za nedoločen čas s preizkusno dobo,
  • delo v dinamičnem in stimulativnem okolju,
  • delo z možnostjo izpopolnjevanja znanja in napredovanja,
  • možnost občasnega dela od doma,
  • nove tehnologije in zanimive projekte.

Le nekaj razlogov za prijavo:

  • super ekipa, v kateri boš pridobil/a ogromno novega znanja,
  • dobro plačilo,
  • možnost in vzpodbujanje dodatnega izobraževanja (konference, tečaji itd.),
  • super lokacija: Dunajska cesta 110
  • zagotovljeno parkirno mesto

Kaj lahko pričakuješ, ko boš prišel k nam?
Na začetku bo sledilo obdobje cca. 2-3 mesecev, ko ti bomo preko intenzivnega izobraževanja predali vse informacije in znanje, ki jih potrebuješ. Preko konkretnih primerov in s pomočjo mentorja (sodelavca) boš spoznal/a podrobnosti našega vsakdanjega dela.

Po koncu uvajanja boš pripravljen za samostojno delo. Še vedno pa boš imel na voljo sodelavce, ki vedno radi priskočijo na pomoč.

Kaj ti nudimo?
Delo se opravlja v prostorih podjetja Webtasy, d.o.o., natančneje na naslovu Dunajska cesta 110 v Ljubljani (blizu obvoznice) s parkirnim prostorom v garažni hiši.

Mesečna plača sega od 2.800 € bruto / mesec (+nadomestilo za dežurstvo: 300 do 500 € bruto / mesec), odvisno od izkušenosti ter uspešnosti (o začetnih številkah se pogovorimo na spoznavnem sestanku).

Zaposlitev je redna.

Poleg tega ti pripada regres v višini 2.600 € neto, dodatek za prehrano in dodatek za prevoz na delo po zakonu (ponavadi po kilometrih).

Poleg samih številk obstaja še vrsto drugih simpatičnih razlogov, zakaj se ti splača prijaviti.

V naši ekipi vlada pozitivna energija, s katero bo pridobivanje novega znanja še lažje. Še posebej, ker velikokrat odidemo na konference in tečaje.

Za še bolj uspešno delo bomo za tebe poskrbeli z neomejeno količino sveže kave čaja in sadja, v poletnih dneh pa je vedno na voljo zamrzovalnik poln sladoleda.

Za sproščenost in še boljše vzdušje v pisarni pa poskrbijo PIZZA petki.

Tako da …

Verjamemo, da si ob zadnjih stavkih postal/a vsaj nekoliko lačen in željan prijave na delovno mesto …

Poskusno delo

6 mesecev

title: Medewerker Buitendienst/ Wijkteams
description:
Aantal uur: 36 uur per week
Salaris: tussen €2.441,- en de €3.534,- bruto per maand o.b.v. 36 uur (schaal 5)
Contract: 1 jaar met uitzicht op vast dienstverband
Reageren vóór: 11 december

“Zichtbaar werk. Verbindend in de wijk. Trots op het resultaat.”

Bij gemeente Zuidplas zie je elke dag direct het resultaat van je werk. Met jouw energie zorg je dat de openbare ruimte schoon, veilig en prettig is voor inwoners. Je voert allround werkzaamheden uit en je hebt zelf een technische of timmer achtergrond. Je bent graag buiten, je steekt de handen uit de mouwen en je houdt van afwisselend werk. Ben jij op zoek naar die baan waar je lekker creatief aan de slag kan gaan, zelf de verantwoordelijkheid hebt voor je werkzaamheden en je jezelf ook nog eens kan ontwikkelen en doorgroeien binnen jouw vakgebied? Ga aan de slag als Medewerker Buitendienst/ Wijkteams. Samen met collega’s pak je grootse uitdagingen aan en maak je zichtbaar het verschil.

Maak het verschil bij Zuidplas!
Werken bij gemeente Zuidplas betekent werken in een omgeving waar vertrouwen, flexibiliteit en ruimte centraal staan. In onze groeiende gemeente, met dorpen als Moerkapelle, Moordrecht, Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel en Zevenhuizen én het nieuwe Cortelande, werk je aan vraagstukken die er echt toe doen. Hier denk je groots en doe je het samen.

Je krijgt de vrijheid om te experimenteren, initiatief te nemen en jouw ideeën tot leven te brengen.
Samen met betrokken collega’s werk je open, verbindend en met energie aan meerdere opgaven tegelijk. Dat vraagt om lef, eigenaarschap en de wil om te blijven groeien. Want hier maak jij het verschil – elke dag opnieuw.

Groots denken, samen doen! Maak er jouw werk van.

Over de rol
Als Medewerker buitendienst ben jij onmisbaar voor de inwoners van de gemeente Zuidplas! In deze functie zal je breed worden ingezet als operationeel beheerder van de openbare ruimtes. Geen dag is hetzelfde en samen met je team ga je zorgdragen voor het behoud en beheer van gemeente Zuidplas.

Hoe lever je samen met je team een bijdrage aan een optimale leefomgeving van de inwoners van de gemeente Zuidplas? Hoe houd je hierover goed contact met de inwoners? Als medewerker buitendienst ben je een belangrijke speler voor de gemeente! Samen met jouw collega’s mag jij jouw ideeën gaan uitvoeren naar operationele werkzaamheden.

Dit ga je doen
Je gaat werken in de buitenruimte van de gemeente Zuidplas. Samen met je collega’s zijn jullie verantwoordelijk voor het onderhoud en beheer. Je verricht onder andere technische handelingen als reparaties en onderhoud aan straatmeubilair (stoeptegels, paaltjes, borden, etc.). Dit kan aan de hand van meldingen van inwoners, maar ook omdat je zelf hebt gesignaleerd dat dit nodig is. Verder houd je je bezig met afvalinzameling. Hierbij kan je denken aan het inzamelen van plastic en grofvuil en het legen van de openbare prullenbakken.

Naast het onderhoud van de openbare ruimte ondersteun je collega’s bij de werkzaamheden van o.a. speeltoestellen, begraafplaatsen en riolering en draai je periodiek storingsdiensten en gladheidsbestrijding.

Dit breng je mee
Als medewerker van de gemeente Zuidplas ben je verbindend, open, energiek en lef. Jij bent energiek en vernieuwend en wilt meedenken aan veranderingen en verbeteringen. Je bent politiek en/of maatschappelijk betrokken en wilt jouw bijdrage leveren aan een optimale leefomgeving van de inwoners van de gemeente Zuidplas. Je toont eigenaarschap door zelf de regie en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor jouw taken en werkzaamheden en weet waar nodig bij te dragen aan oplossingen.

De volgende kwaliteiten passen dan ook goed bij jou:
  • Je bent proactief, want je houdt van aanpakken.
  • Je bent resultaatgericht en maakt dingen graag af;
  • Je bent kwaliteitsbewust want wat je doet doe je goed;
  • Samenwerken in een team is voor jou geen probleem;
  • Je bent flexibel en staat open voor weekend en storingsdiensten;
  • Je bent betrokken bij de gemeente en het woon en leefplezier van de inwoners.

Daarnaast
  • Beschik je over MBO werk -en denkniveau;
  • Je bent in bezit van rijbewijs B en BE;
  • Je bent in het bezit van een VCA-certificaat;
  • Je spreekt de Nederlandse taal en bent digitaal vaardig;
  • Daarnaast heb je ervaring met het beheer van de openbare ruimte en beschikt over vakgerichte kennis;
  • Je hebt de nodige kennis en ervaring op het gebied van straatmeubilair, water en groen, of hier ligt je interesse;
  • Je bent servicegericht en kunt zowel zelfstandig werken als goed samenwerken in teamverband;
  • Je bent in staat situaties of gegevens realistisch te analyseren voordat je met overtuiging een haalbare en praktische oplossing voorstelt;
  • Je kan goed prioriteiten stellen en hebt een goed organisatievermogen.

Extra:
Bij indiensttreding in deze functie moet je een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag kunnen overleggen. Bij deze functie hoort het periodiek draaien van weekenddiensten, gladheidsbestrijding en storingsdiensten, hier krijg je een extra vergoeding voor!

Wat je krijgt
Als je komt werken bij Zuidplas werk je samen met betrokken collega's die voor elkaar klaarstaan en ben je verzekerd van goede primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, namelijk:
  • Een uitdagende rol in een ambitieuze, groeiende, gemeente waar je werkt in een omgeving die energie geeft en ruimte biedt voor eigen initiatief om het verschil te maken;
  • Een salaris tussen de 2.441,- en € 3534,- bruto per maand o.b.v. 36 uur (schaal 5);
  • Een Individueel Keuze Budget van 17.05% van het bruto jaarsalaris dat je helemaal naar eigen wens kan inzetten. Denk hierbij aan de mogelijkheid van het laten uitbetalen of het kopen van extra vakantiedagen;
  • Een goede werk-privébalans en 5 weken vakantie bij een fulltime werkweek zodat je even goed tot rust kunt komen;
  • Onregelmatigheidstoeslage, beschikbaarheidsvergoeding en inconveniëntentoelage als je bijzondere diensten werkt met afwijkende werkuren;
  • Benieuwd naar al onze arbeidsvoorwaarden? Bekijk deze dan hier:

Jij straks ook?
Wil jij samen met ons groots denken en het ook echt doen? Solliciteer dan nu! Heb je vragen over de functie? Heb je vragen over de procedure? Bel dan gerust met onze Corporate Recruiter Marcel Bargeman, hij is bereikbaar op 0180-330300.

Wij kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten!

Bijzonderheden:
Een ontwikkelassessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure zodat wij goed kunnen inschatten of jij met onze gemeente mee kunt groeien. Wij vragen standaard een VOG aan. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze of andere vacatures wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Program Specialist - Graduate Preceptor Recruitment
description: The College of Nursing has experienced tremendous growth over the past ten years and this will continue. As we look forward, our 10-year strategic plan will emphasize the continued increased scaling of our programs as well as growing the College’s clinical enterprise to meet the critical healthcare demands across the state. The Program Specialist will work to meet the clinical education demands of the college by developing, fostering and recruiting clinical partners/preceptors for our DNP – Doctor of Nurse Practice students. This position will plan and coordinate the recruitment and retention of preceptors statewide to provide experiential clinical opportunities for graduate nursing learners. The position is essential to helping advance the CON’s mission of improving access to health care for all New Mexicans. The Program Specialist will develop and implement systems to build partnerships and preceptor relationships. This role will help ensure relationships are consistent with accrediting bodies, Board of Nursing, Federal, State, and institutional policies/guidelines. Additional duties include writing, editing, and coordinating the development of promotional materials, training manuals, and newsletters in support of program objectives. This Program Specialist will be responsible for outreach via phone, email, or in-person with new or existing clinical partners across DNP specialties. This position requires travel to clinical sites, trainings, special events, and professional conferences. The selected applicant must maintain a primary residence in the Albuquerque area (including surrounding communities such as Rio Rancho, Los Lunas, Belen, Edgewood, and Santa Fe) and be able to reliably commute to the College of Nursing in Albuquerque. College of Nursing The University Of New Mexico College of Nursing, located in Albuquerque, NM, ranks in the top 15% of nursing programs in the country. With over 1,000 enrolled students, the college offers pre- and post-licensure baccalaureate, master’s, post-master’s, and doctoral programs. Program offerings include the state’s premiere Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) and Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) programs; master’s and post-master’s programs across seven concentrations for APRNs, nurse educators, and nurse administrators; and the New Mexico Nurse Education Consortium baccalaureate curriculum. Our faculty engage in innovative teaching, research and clinical scholarship to understand and address the health care needs among our most vulnerable populations. As a College of Nursing at a research-intensive, federally designated Hispanic-serving institution situated on indigenous lands, we benefit both from the manifold opportunities and from the responsibilities we carry. Consistent with our mission, vision, and values, we strive to openly support and deeply respect our diverse students, staff, and faculty. We expect our faculty to benefit from and contribute to an inclusive environment that facilitates equity in research, scholarship, service, education, and practice. The University of New Mexico is New Mexico’s flagship R1 research intensive institution occupying nearly 800 acres near historic Route 66 in the heart of Albuquerque, a metropolitan area of more than 929,000 people. The College of Nursing is part of a vibrant HS, which includes New Mexico’s only Level-1 Trauma Center. The HSC provides and exceptional education for more than 1,500 students each year in 21 different health fields. The HSC is known for innovative research with more than $165 Million in extramural research funding. The HSC has an established Clinical Translational Science Center that provides extensive opportunities and resources to support collaborative research in a variety of interest areas. The University of New Mexico offers a competitive salary and outstanding benefits package.

On-Call: 24/7 when assigned on-call rotation

Job Summary

We are seeking a Test Engineer P&C I to support testing, troubleshooting, commissioning, and reliability of Protection & Control (P&C) systems across Georgia Power facilities.

This is a field-intensive role requiring approximately 75% outdoor work and 25% office work. The position includes statewide travel, on-call coverage, overtime, and work involving energized medium-voltage equipment.

Candidates must be comfortable working in demanding field environments and traveling on short notice for overnight, weekend, holiday, or multi-week assignments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute detailed test plans for Protection & Control systems.

  • Validate P&C system performance, safety, and reliability against specified requirements.

  • Implement testing procedures, tools, and methodologies for different operating conditions.

  • Perform testing and troubleshooting of electrical protection and control equipment.

  • Analyze test data to identify deviations, anomalies, and performance issues.

  • Prepare detailed test reports, findings, and recommendations.

  • Recommend modifications and improvements based on testing results.

  • Support troubleshooting and diagnostic activities in the field.

  • Collaborate with design engineers, technical teams, plant personnel, and vendors.

  • Maintain and calibrate test equipment and apparatus.

  • Ensure testing activities comply with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and quality procedures.

  • Maintain detailed documentation of test protocols, results, analyses, and corrective actions.

  • Participate in continuous improvement of testing methods and procedures.

  • Stay current with advancements in P&C technologies and testing practices.

  • Develop and write switching orders.

  • Perform circuit switching using appropriate hot-line tools.

  • Work on energized equipment in enclosed and below-grade environments.

  • Support medium-voltage equipment in the 4 kV to 25 kV range.

Required Qualifications

Candidates should meet the applicable education and experience requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from an accredited institution with 3–7 years of related experience, or

  • Associate degree or higher in an applicable technical discipline such as:

    • Electrical Technology

    • Mechanical Technology

    • Electromechanical Technology

    • Mechatronics

    • Industrial Systems

    • Engineering Technology

    • Related technical field

Additional requirements include:

  • Experience with electrical testing, Protection & Control, substations, or related power systems.

  • Strong electrical troubleshooting and analytical skills.

  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and testing procedures.

  • Strong documentation and report-writing skills.

  • Ability to work safely around energized electrical equipment.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to build effective relationships with plant personnel, engineers, contractors, and vendors.

Travel & On-Call Requirements

  • Must be available 24/7 during assigned on-call weeks.

  • On-call rotation is approximately one week every 10 weeks.

  • Must be available to travel on short notice.

  • Work may be performed throughout Georgia,

  • Approximately 75% field/outdoor work

  • Approximately 25% office work

  • Work may involve enclosed or below-grade spaces.

  • Position requires work around energized electrical equipment.

  • Work involves medium-voltage systems ranging from approximately 4 kV to 25 kV.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Utility or electric power industry experience.

  • Protection & Control testing experience.

  • Substation testing or commissioning experience.

  • Experience with protective relays and associated control systems.

  • Experience writing switching orders.

  • Experience performing medium-voltage switching.

  • Familiarity with electrical test equipment and calibration procedures.

  • Previous experience supporting field commissioning or maintenance activities.

Key Skills

Protection & Control | P&C | Electrical Testing | Substations | Protective Relays | Commissioning | Medium Voltage | Switching Orders | Electrical Troubleshooting | Test Plans | Test Equipment | 4kV–25kV Systems | Field Engineering | Power Systems | Utility Operations | Georgia Power

title: Maintenance Team Lead
description:
OUR CULTURE

At BGIS, our culture is built on three foundational pillars:

  1. Culture of Care: We deeply care for each other, our clients, partners, and the communities we serve.
  2. High Performing Teams: We go Above and Beyond to deliver exceptional services. INTEGRITY, OWNERSHIP, RESPONSIVENESS, INITIATION, VISIBILITY, DRIVE, and INTEGRATION are core to high performance.
  3. Unwavering Commitment to Sustainability: We conduct every action with a focus on preserving our earth.

SUMMARY

The Maintenance Team Lead is responsible for overseeing a team of Technicians in the delivery of preventative and corrective maintenance, routine and on-demand services for assigned facilities. The Maintenance Team Lead is responsible for overseeing the execution of activities performed by Technicians to ensure that work is performed in accordance to established processes and practices and is in compliant with all internal and external requirements including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, fire protection. In addition to people leadership responsibilities, the Maintenance Team Lead also performs and delivers preventative and corrective maintenance as well as routine and on-demand services.

This role will work in collaboration with all key BGIS departments to ensure full support of all activities and play a key role in our INTEGRATED approach to operating buildings.

Opportunities for Development:

At BGIS we are committed to the development of our people – offering them opportunities to learn and grow into various roles. Success in the role offers Team Members the opportunity to explore various roles – some include:

  • Account Operational Leadership,
  • Facility Management Office Roles to support accounts,
  • Project Management roles to lead and execute projects

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Safety and Regulatory Ownership:

  • Oversees and monitors the activities and performance of Technicians within assigned facility. Ensures that activities are performed in accordance to established processes as well as internal and external requirements including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, fire protection as guided by BGIS Health Safety and Environment Teams
  • Champion and enforce safety protocols, ensuring a safe work environment for all team members.
  • Conduct safety training, risk assessments, and incident investigations as needed.
  • Perform rigorous safety assessments specifically targeting building equipment and recommend technical safety enhancements.
  • Promote a safety-first culture among the team.

Technical Leader and Oversight:

  • Provide technical guidance and support to Technicians in troubleshooting and repairs.
  • Oversee the execution of maintenance tasks to maintain equipment and facilities in optimal condition as directed by BGIS Facility Management Office (FMO)
  • Coordinates and participates in facility-related projects
  • Responds to routine and on-demand service requests and performs preventative and corrective maintenance on facility mechanical equipment and other systems.
  • Ensure compliance with established maintenance processes and industry best practices.

Visibility in Sites:

  • Maintain a strong presence at assigned facilities, addressing maintenance issues promptly.
  • Foster positive relationships with clients and occupants, demonstrating a commitment to service excellence.

Inspection Management:

  • Performs work in accordance to established processes and practices.
  • Monitors assigned facility by conducting facility walkthroughs for mechanical, electrical and other equipment system monitoring and inspection.
  • Executes comprehensive technical inspections of building equipment, focusing on critical systems that directly impact tenant operations.
  • Oversee the proper application and execution of processes and practices to ensure achievement of and adherence to all requirements.
  • Oversee and performs regular facility mechanical and electrical equipment and systems monitoring and inspection, preventative and corrective maintenance to ensure facility uptime objectives are met, uninterrupted client operation and asset integrity of assigned facility are maintained. Provides observations about facility, facility mechanical and electrical equipment and systems conditions and deficiencies and provides recommendations for enhancement and repair in partnership with Asset Management Team and the BGIS Facility Management Office (FMO).
  • Oversee and monitors assigned facility by conducting facility walkthroughs, mechanical and electrical equipment and system monitoring and inspection when required
  • Conduct regular inspections to identify maintenance needs and opportunities for improvement.
  • Implement and monitor execution of inspection checklists and schedules.

Occupancy Experience:

  • Assists in enhancing tenant and customer satisfaction and maintaining positive relations through manner in which work is performed and services delivered on time and with high quality.
  • Prioritize occupant comfort and satisfaction through efficient and timely delivery service.
  • Address occupant concerns and requests in a professional manner.

Proactive Communication and Escalation:

  • Must be able and willing to work shifts, be available for on-call/standby and emergency call-outs as they arise
  • Coordinates and assists in the implementation of a preventative maintenance program. Ensures that deficiencies are identified, recorded and escalated, and that related documentation is maintained
  • Communicate effectively with team members, clients, and management regarding maintenance activities and challenges.
  • Escalate issues to the FM and BGIS CMMS Team for critical maintenance needs promptly to ensure swift resolution.

Work Order Management:

  • Oversee and maintains, troubleshoots and repairs mechanical and electrical building systems and equipment
  • Oversee and responds to routine and on-demand service requests and oversees the execution of preventative and corrective maintenance on facility mechanical and electrical equipment and systems
  • Assigns, prioritizes and monitors work progress in partnership with the BGIS CMMS Team.
  • Monitors execution of activities and performance to ensure timely completion and adherence to all requirements including but not limited to operating procedures and practices, quality, performance and contract response requirements.
  • In partnership with the Central Work Order Management Team Manage work orders efficiently, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and importance.
  • Ensure accurate documentation of work performed and maintain detailed records.

Financial Ownership (Including Quotes Management):

  • Oversees and maintains all assigned tools and arranges for repair and replacement where required. Submits all expenditures on a timely basis
  • In collaboration with BGIS FM and Regional Directors, Manage maintenance budgets and expenses effectively.
  • Prepare and review quotes for maintenance projects, ensuring cost-effectiveness.

Vendor Management:

  • Collaborate with vendors and contractors for specialized maintenance services.
  • With support of the BGIS Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Management Evaluate vendor performance when required.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • 5 years of facility operations and maintenance work experience
  • Previous people leadership experience, preferred
  • High school diploma plus trades training and certification
  • Ability to lead a team of individuals
  • Highly-advanced ability to adhere to processes and practices relating to facility operations and maintenance
  • Highly-advanced ability to maintain and repair building mechanical and electrical equipment and systems
  • Highly-advanced building mechanical and electrical equipment and system troubleshooting and resolution skills
  • Current knowledge of fire, life, safety and building codes and standards and ability to research and apply related codes and standards
  • Possesses a high level of environmental, health and safety mindset. Ability to perform work in a safe manner
  • Strong client-service orientation along with a high sense of urgency
  • Effective communication skills for the purpose of data relay, exchange, feedback, and clarification

Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation (Considered an asset)

  • Refrigeration/Electrical/Plumbing license considered an asset
  • Power Engineering 3rd Class or 4th Class an asset
  • Building Operator Certification
  • Gasfitter I or II
  • Systems Maintenance Administration Certification considered an asset

This is a regular, full-time position with an hourly range of $35 - $45 per hour. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role.

title: Program Manager II
description:
Enabling critical work and rubbing shoulders with the scientists who are contributing to the impact of our world’s health – that is what people on our Program Management team at KCAS Bio get to do every day. If that gets you excited too, then maybe working on our Program Management team is the spot for you.

When you work as a Program Manager II at KCAS, you get to further our mission by managing client programs within a business unit, serving as a primary point of contact for clients while driving program execution, communication, and overall client satisfaction. You will work closely with Laboratory Directors, laboratory managers, and Business Development to manage contracted work, anticipate client needs, and proactively address risks.

Our Program Management team partners across operations, quality, and commercial functions to ensure alignment between client expectations and laboratory execution, supporting high-quality delivery of bioanalytical services.

In this role, we will rely on you to:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, managing relationships and ensuring high levels of client satisfaction
  • Lead program oversight, ensuring alignment between client expectations, study execution, and timelines
  • Proactively identify risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure program success
  • Act as a strategic liaison between clients and internal teams, balancing priorities and driving solutions
  • Communicate program status, risks, and key updates to both clients and internal leadership
  • Independently address client questions, concerns, and escalations
  • Lead scope definition for new work from existing clients in partnership with Business Development
  • Support pricing strategy discussions and assist with quotes and change orders
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client and program data within tracking systems
  • Drive forecasting of client work and support revenue visibility
  • Mentor and provide guidance to more junior Program Managers as needed
  • Perform all aspects of the job in a way that supports company brand and supports company mission, vision, and values

To qualify specifically for this role, you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in a Contract Research Organization (CRO) environment overseeing or managing projects
  • Demonstrated experience managing client relationships and program execution
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to proactively identify risks and drive solutions
  • Ability to manage multiple complex programs simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail and execution discipline
(Please note this is a representative summary of responsibilities, not a comprehensive or exclusive list of the duties to be performed in any position. Employees must follow instructions and perform additional duties as requested.)
WHO YOU ARE
You will thrive at KCAS Bio if you enjoy a relational environment, are purpose- and values-driven, embrace constant development and supportive leadership, and enjoy being part of innovative work.
WHAT YOU’LL GET
Our benefits include, and extend beyond, the traditional package. At KCAS Bio, you will enjoy company sponsored events like food trucks, family days and spirit days. You will grow in your career with KCAS University. You will be able to connect with like-minded employees to further the KCAS Bio approach to key areas such as wellness, inclusion, and community outreach. You will engage as an owner in our stock ownership program. You will have access to the latest technology. And you will be able to invest in the community with paid time off to volunteer.
Learn more about the Benefits at KCAS Bio
WHO WE ARE
We are a fast-growing contract research organization (CRO) headquartered in Kansas City, pioneering the latest drug development in both human and animal health fields. Demand for our expertise is growing and so is our need for great people to work in nimble, empowered teams committed to one another’s growth. At KCAS Bio, we advance both great science AND great people.
