title: Senior Adviseur Veiligheid
description:
Soms komen zorg en veiligheid op een complexe manier samen. Denk aan personen met onbegrepen gedrag, persoonsgerichte casuïstiek, ernstige overlast, huiselijk geweld, radicalisering en situaties waarin mensen tussen wal en schip dreigen te vallen.

Juist op dat snijvlak is een sterke gemeentelijke regierol van belang. Als senior adviseur ben jij één van de inhoudelijke experts binnen het Team Veiligheid. Je overziet vraagstukken, ontwikkelt oplossingen en weet partners binnen en buiten de gemeentelijke organisatie in beweging te krijgen.

Dit is de functie voor een ervaren adviseur die het verschil wil maken.

Team Integrale Veiligheid

Team Veiligheid bestaat uit 14 bevlogen mensen en werkt samen hard aan een veilige en leefbare gemeente voor bijna 100.000 inwoners. Je werkt daarbij nooit alleen. Want veiligheid doe je samen. Binnen het team werk je met regisseurs, adviseurs en de teammanager. Allemaal enthousiaste professionals die elkaar uitdagen en versterken. Het is een team met veel kennis, humor en betrokkenheid. Samen zorgen we voor samenhang tussen uitvoering, beleid en bestuurlijke besluitvorming. Want veiligheid is nooit af. En dat maakt jouw werk zo enorm interessant!

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de doorontwikkeling van het gemeentelijk beleid en de aanpak op het brede terrein van zorg en veiligheid. Je opereert domein overstijgend op het terrein van openbare orde en veiligheid en het maatschappelijk domein. Je hebt ook een belangrijke rol in het verbinden van uitvoering, beleid, bestuur en externe partners.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het adviseren van bestuur, directie en management op het thema van zorg en veiligheid. Je signaleert maatschappelijke en bestuurlijke ontwikkelingen, duidt risico’s en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke keuzes en handelingsperspectieven.
  • Regie voeren op complexe casuïstiek. Op gemeente brede en soms regionale vraagstukken waarbij zorg en veiligheid samenkomen. Je brengt partijen bij elkaar, doorbreekt impasses en zorgt dat er beweging ontstaat.
  • Versterken van de gemeentelijke visie, beleidskaders en uitvoeringsaanpak op het thema zorg en veiligheid. Je zorgt daarbij voor de samenhang tussen verschillende beleidsvelden en interventies.
  • Vertegenwoordigen van de gemeente in bestuurlijke overleggen en samenwerkingsverbanden, met een scherp oog voor de belangen van de gemeente Purmerend.
  • Inhoudelijk leiderschap tonen. Je bent naast een inhoudelijk boegbeeld op het thema zorg en veiligheid een zichtbaar positieve kracht binnen het team. Je deelt kennis, verbindt en coacht collega’s verder en draagt bij aan de verdere professionalisering van het team.
  • Het 1x per 7 weken draaien van een week lang piketdienst.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je bent een ervaren en enthousiaste adviseur die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat. Je hebt een scherp analytisch vermogen, bent bestuurlijk sensitief en weet vraagstukken snel te doorgronden.
  • Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor management, bestuur en ketenpartners. Je bent de brug van strategisch inzicht naar inhoudelijke diepgang en weet zaken te vertalen naar concrete acties.
  • Je laat je niet snel uit het veld slaan door tegengestelde belangen, bestuurlijke gevoeligheden of ingewikkelde samenwerkingsvraagstukken. Je bent verbindend waar het kan en scherp waar het moet.
  • Je weet mensen op verschillende niveaus mee te nemen. Je kunt daarbij schakelen tussen strategische beleidsvorming en concrete uitvoeringsvraagstukken.
  • Je hebt een actieve rol bij het verder brengen van het team. Je weet anderen te inspireren en uit te dagen. Dit maakt jou een positieve en stimulerende kracht.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde HBO/WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in bestuurskunde, integrale veiligheid, criminologie of rechten.
  • Ruime relevante werkervaring op het gebied van zorg en veiligheid. Vanuit het veiligheids- of sociaal domein.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring in het adviseren binnen een gemeentelijke organisatie.
  • Ervaring met complexe bestuurlijke dossiers en het adviseren van bestuurders.
  • Kennis van de gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheden, wet- en regelgeving en actuele ontwikkelingen op het gebied van zorg en veiligheid.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een functie in schaal 11 of 12, afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring van maximaal 7.369,- bruto per maand bij een dienstverband van 36 uur volgens de CAO Gemeenten;
  • Een werkweek van 36 uur, waarvan een deel op het stadhuis in Purmerend.
  • Prima secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een individueel keuzebudget (IKB) van 17,05% van je salaris
  • Een uitdagende en afwisselende functie met veel bestuurlijke impact;
    - Een betrokken team dat werk aan een veilige en leefbare gemeente.

Solliciteren of meer weten?

Ben je geïnteresseerd of herken je jezelf in dit profiel? Reageer dan via onderstaande knop voor 30 november 2026. Bij een goede match nodigen wij je uit voor een gesprek.

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Tanneke van den Berg, Teammanager Veiligheid, via 0299-682126.

Het verkrijgen van een VOG is een voorwaarde om bij ons te kunnen werken.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
The Role

As a Senior AI Engineer at Bilue, you’ll design, build and ship production grade AI systems for clients across financial services, government, insurance and retail. Working in our Applied AI Practice, you’ll split your time between client delivery through our Applied AI service offering and building the reference architectures, tooling and standards that shape how we work.

This is a hands-on engineering role rather than research or prompt engineering. You’ll build agentic systems that hold up with real users and help set the bar for what production grade means at Bilue.

You’ll work directly with clients and their teams, often across more than one industry at a time. That means understanding the problem they’re really trying to solve, explaining your technical decisions in plain language, and earning their trust by delivering AI that works when it counts. You’ll sit in cross functional squads alongside designers, delivery managers and engineers, working closely with our AI Architect to keep what we build aligned to the right design, security and compliance guardrails.

Knowledge sharing is part of the job. You’ll share what you learn through documentation, tech talks, company showcases, pairing and our internal communities, so every project leaves the next one better equipped and the whole team grows with you.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and build production grade AI solutions for clients, including agentic systems, memory systems, LLM powered features and intelligent automation

  • Work directly with clients and their teams to understand the problem they’re really trying to solve, and explain your technical decisions in plain language

  • Build cloud native AI systems on AWS, Azure or GCP with solid DevOps and LLMOps pipelines for scale and reliability

  • Integrate AI into enterprise platforms such as CRM, ERP, lending and claims systems through well designed APIs and data pipelines

  • Be the go to AI engineer in cross functional squads, working alongside designers, strategists, delivery managers and our AI Architect

  • Build responsible AI in from the start, including evaluation harnesses, validation gates, red teaming, bias testing and human in the loop design, working to the security and compliance guardrails set with the AI Architect, including ISO 27001 and ISO 42001

  • Contribute to the Applied AI Practice’s reference architectures, engineering standards and reusable tooling so each project starts faster than the last

  • Take part in model evaluation, cost optimisation and architecture reviews

  • Share knowledge across Bilue through documentation, tech talks, pairing and our internal communities

  • Use AI responsibly and in line with Bilue’s AI policies, treating it as a tool to work smarter while keeping human judgement at the centre of your decisions

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Mindset & Experience

  • Real craft, with a track record of shipping AI or GenAI solutions to real users in a commercial environment rather than stopping at prototypes or demos

  • Sound judgement, with the instinct to test, challenge and validate what AI produces before it reaches real users

  • A consultative approach, comfortable working across multiple clients and industries and explaining technical concepts clearly to non technical stakeholders

  • A passion for connection, with a collaborative, low ego style that lifts the people around you

  • Generous with what you know, happy to pair, teach and share your learnings so the whole team gets sharper

  • Confident owning your technical decisions and the outcome when a call affects delivery time or budget

  • Curious by nature, with the confidence to back your view and the openness to change it when the evidence shifts

  • A systems thinker who understands why a system matters as well as how it works, and is comfortable with ambiguous, changing requirements

  • Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, insurance or government

  • A genuine fit with our values: no cure for curiosity, lend a hand and do the right thing

Technical Skills

  • Strong Python as your primary language, with TypeScript or Java a plus

  • Hands on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or CrewAI, plus RAG and vector databases

  • Production AI on AWS, Azure or GCP with proper observability, evaluation and LLMOps practices such as prompt versioning, drift detection and cost monitoring

  • Solid data and integration fundamentals, including SQL, ETL, unstructured data, RESTful APIs and microservices

  • Experience with the AWS AI stack (Bedrock, AgentCore, Strands, SageMaker) or prior consulting delivery is highly valued

Life at Bilue

People-first focus: We’re committed to delivering exceptional outcomes for our clients, but we know it starts with our people. You’ll join a values-led team that’s collaborative, curious, and genuinely cares about doing great work, together.

Connection that counts: From monthly anchor days and team lunches to our annual offsite, we create intentional moments to connect, collaborate, and celebrate. These aren’t just fun perks — they’re part of how we work and grow together.

Flexibility that works: We offer hybrid working, with 1–2 days per week in the office. It’s a balance that gives you the space to do your best work, while still creating time to connect and build strong relationships in person.

Strong internal communities: We actively foster internal communities across tech, design, delivery, and beyond, giving you plenty of chances to connect, share knowledge, and learn from your peers.

Opportunities to grow: We invest in your development with unlimited access to our LMS SuperPath's and support from our internal performance coach. Whether you want to deepen your technical skills or grow your leadership potential, we’ll back you.

Flat structure, real impact: At Bilue, everyone’s voice matters. Our leadership team is hands-on and approachable, and we operate without unnecessary layers. We keep things open and transparent, and your ideas will be heard, no matter your title.

Bilue = Big + Blue Ocean. Are you ready to set sail? Apply now!

A note on your application
Every application is read by a real person on our team. Use AI in your work, but please don’t use it to write your CV. A generated CV tells us what a model thinks we want to hear, and we’d much rather hear it from you. We want to know the person behind the projects.

When you apply, we’ll ask you about one AI system you’ve shipped: how you knew it was working, and what broke. A few honest sentences beat a polished essay.

Working rights
This is a full-time position based in Sydney, NSW. To be considered, candidates must have unrestricted working rights in Australia.

We’re only accepting applications directly from candidates, so no agencies please.

title: Portfoliomanager
description:
Wil jij overzicht brengen in de uiteenlopende programma’s en projecten van onze gemeente? Zie jij logische verbanden waar anderen losse initiatieven zien, en help jij de directie en het management om onderbouwde keuzes te maken over de inzet van mensen en middelen? Dan is deze rol jou op het lijf geschreven! Als Portfoliomanager bij de gemeente Medemblik ben jij de strategische spil die bestuurlijke en organisatorische doelstellingen vertaalt naar een doeltreffende uitvoering. Een sleutelrol waarin jij met overzicht en scherpte direct bijdraagt aan de maatschappelijke opgaven van onze 18 kernen.

Wat ga je doen
Als Portfoliomanager geef je vorm aan portfoliomanagement binnen de gemeente Medemblik en zorg je ervoor dat deze gestructureerde manier van werken verankerd raakt in onze organisatiecultuur. Je werkt vanuit het Programma- en Projectmanagementbureau (PPMB), onderdeel van de afdeling Ruimte, maar je blik is organisatiebreed. Je rapporteert aan de teamleider PPMB en werkt nauw samen met het Directie Strategisch Managementteam (DSMT), de strategisch managers en de teamleiders.

Onze gemeente voert veel projecten en programma’s tegelijk uit, zowel in het sociale en ruimtelijke domein als gericht op strategische organisatieontwikkeling. We sturen nu vooral per project. Jij brengt dat samen in één actueel overzicht en maakt zichtbaar wat de opgaven kosten aan geld en capaciteit. Daarmee help je het DSMT en de managementteams van de afdelingen scherper te kiezen, zeker nu we tegelijk ambities waarmaken en ombuigen. Je draagt bij aan het verhogen van de kwaliteit van projecten en verbetert interne processen, zodat de gemeente Medemblik efficiënter en effectiever gaat werken.

Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid voor drie portfolio’s: Ruimte, Sociaal en Organisatiebreed, elk met eigen portfoliotafels en adviesteams. Je staat er niet alleen voor: je bouwt deze nieuwe functie op samen met drie portfolio-ondersteuners (één per portfolio). Omdat een projectteam de werkwijze al zorgvuldig heeft uitgedacht, stap je in een gespreid bedje. Aan jou de taak om de uitgedachte werkwijze succesvol tot leven te brengen in de dagelijkse praktijk, passend bij de gemeente Medemblik.

Jouw taken:
  • Opbouwen en beheren van drie portfolio’s: per portfolio één actueel overzicht van alle projecten en programma’s, met doelen, status, geld en capaciteit;
  • Voorbereiden van de overleggen van de drie portfoliotafels en adviesteams. Je faciliteert besluitvorming met heldere analyses, overzicht en actuele stuurinformatie en legt de keuzes voor die gemaakt moeten worden. Je ondersteunt projectleiders en programmamanagers bij het opstellen van projectopdrachten, projectplannen en voortgangsrapportages. De Westfriese Leidraad projectmatig werken en de bijbehorende formats helpen je daarbij;
  • Doorontwikkelen van de werkwijze portfoliomanagement: afspraken, spelregels en een werkbare informatievoorziening, samen met projectleiders, teams uit de lijn en stafafdelingen;
  • Adviseren van het DSMT, de strategisch managers en teamleiders over de inzet van mensen en middelen op de opgaven van Medemblik;
  • Bijdragen aan de beweging van ad hoc naar procesgericht werken binnen de hele organisatie.

Het team
Het Programma- en Projectmanagementbureau (PPMB) is één van de zes teams van de afdeling Ruimte, naast Omgevingszaken (VTH), Beheer en Onderhoud, Vastgoed en Grondzaken, Ruimtelijk Beleid en de Buitendienst. Het PPMB levert programma- en projectmanagement voor de hele organisatie en bewaakt de kwaliteit van projectmatig werken. Je collega’s zijn programmamanagers, projectleiders en projectondersteuners die werken aan de grote opgaven van Medemblik. Het PPMB is een jong team dat zich volop ontwikkelt. Portfoliomanagement vormt daarin de volgende stap.

Wij vragen
Je houdt overzicht en brengt rust in complexiteit. Je bent analytisch sterk en vertaalt veel informatie naar een helder verhaal waarop bestuurders en managers kunnen sturen. Met jouw bestuurlijke sensitiviteit schakel je moeiteloos tussen de inhoud van een project en het grotere plaatje. Je bent verbindend: je haalt informatie op bij teams die het druk hebben en krijgt mensen mee zonder formele macht. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, toont eigenaarschap en spreekt anderen (ook het management) hier ook op aan. En je houdt vol: een nieuwe werkwijze landt niet in één kwartaal.

Verder:
  • Hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een relevante richting zoals Bestuurskunde, Bedrijfskunde of vergelijkbaar;
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met portfolio-, programma- of projectmanagement, bij voorkeur binnen een gemeente of andere overheidsorganisatie;
  • Ervaring met het opbouwen van stuurinformatie en het adviseren van directie of management;
  • Inzicht in de samenhang tussen opgaven, capaciteit en financiën;
  • Ervaring met samenwerken in een bestuurlijke en politiek gevoelige omgeving;
  • Kennis van een methodiek voor projectmatig werken en ervaring met het coachen van projectleiders en/of programmamanagers is een pré.

Ons aanbod
Een functie voor 21 uur per week. Afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring ontvang je een aanbieding gebaseerd op aanloopschaal 11 of functieschaal 12. Dat is een salaris van maximaal € 7.253,00 bruto per maand op basis van een 36-urige werkweek.

Ook mag je rekenen op een uitstekend secundair arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket zoals:
  • Een individueel keuzebudget (IKB) ter waarde van 17,05% bovenop jouw salaris. Je kunt dit naar keuze inzetten voor bijvoorbeeld: extra verlof, salaris, bedrijfsfitness of het aflossen van een studieschuld bij DUO;
  • Filevrij naar ons kantoor in Wognum en altijd plek in de parkeergarage. Ook is er genoeg plek voor (het opladen van) elektrische auto's. Kom je op de (elektrische) fiets? Dan kan je die ook overdekt stallen en eventueel opladen;
  • Ruime kilometervergoeding € 0,25 per km, maximaal 60 km enkele reis per dag;
  • Werk je een dag thuis? Dan krijg je een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 3,25 per dag;
  • Een ruime verlofregeling en (deels) doorbetaald ouderschapsverlof;
  • Je mag een laptop en telefoon uitkiezen;
  • Goede opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden;
  • Opname in het ABP pensioenfonds.

Over gemeente Medemblik
Gemeente Medemblik is volop in beweging en werkt hard aan een gezonde toekomst voor al haar inwoners. Bij deze gemeente, die veel investeert in de toekomst, krijg je de kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Met jouw werk zorg jij ervoor dat de inwoners van Medemblik prettig kunnen wonen, werken en recreëren in een mooie en landelijke omgeving.

We zijn een actieve en ondernemende landelijke Noord-Hollandse gemeente met 18 kernen en ruim 45.000 inwoners. Gezond wonen, werken en recreëren zijn voor ons belangrijke speerpunten. We werken primair vanuit mogelijkheden en ondersteunen diverse initiatieven van onze inwoners, verenigingen en bedrijven.

Samen met onze inwoners, maatschappelijke partijen, ondernemers, de raad, het college en de Westfriese regiogemeenten werken we enthousiast aan een vitale én leefbare gemeente.

Geïnteresseerd?
Klik op Solliciteer direct en stuur ons voor 1 december je cv en motivatiebrief.

Voor aanvullende informatie over deze functie kun je contact opnemen met Rob Sluiter via +31619293847.

Voor vragen over de procedure kun je terecht bij één van onze recruiters Wendy Newson via +31625697151 of Roxanne Wagemaker via +31650164664.

title: Instructor - Downtown St. Petersburg
description:
JETSET Pilates is a modern, music-driven Pilates brand redefining the boutique fitness experience. Our instructors do more than lead classes, they inspire confidence, build community, and create an environment where clients feel challenged, supported, and empowered to become stronger both physically and mentally. Through expert coaching, personalized attention, and genuine connection, JETSET instructors deliver an elevated fitness experience that keeps clients coming back.
Whether you’re an experienced fitness professional or looking to grow your coaching career, JETSET provides comprehensive instructor training, ongoing development, and opportunities to grow alongside a rapidly expanding brand.
As a JETSET Instructor, you’ll play an essential role in creating an unforgettable studio experience while helping clients build strength, confidence, and consistency through every class.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Deliver Exceptional Classes

  • Lead engaging, music-driven, 50-minute modern Pilates classes that deliver a safe, challenging, and consistent experience.

  • Provide individualized coaching, form corrections, and exercise modifications to clients of all fitness levels.

  • Inspire and motivate clients while maintaining energy, professionalism, and attention to detail throughout every class.

Create an Exceptional Member Experience

  • Build authentic relationships with clients and foster a welcoming, inclusive studio environment.

  • Learn clients’ names, celebrate milestones, and create meaningful connections that strengthen the studio community.

  • Deliver hospitality that reflects the JETSET brand before, during, and after every class.

Represent the JETSET Brand

  • Embody the values and culture of JETSET Pilates both inside and outside the studio.

  • Participate in team meetings, training sessions, studio events, and community initiatives.

  • Support local marketing and community engagement efforts as needed.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional studio environment.

Continue to Grow

  • Complete the JETSET Instructor Training Program and participate in ongoing education and development.

  • Apply feedback from leadership to continuously improve coaching effectiveness.

  • Stay current on programming updates, coaching techniques, and JETSET best practices.

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

You’ll be successful if you:

  • Bring energy, consistency, and enthusiasm to every class you lead.

  • Enjoy building genuine relationships that keep members engaged and connected to the studio.

  • Thrive in a collaborative environment and contribute positively to the broader studio team.

  • Take pride in representing the JETSET brand professionally and creating an elevated member experience.

  • Are curious, coachable, and committed to continuously improving your skills.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Passion for health, wellness, and helping others achieve their goals.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to confidently lead a fast-paced, music-driven group fitness class.

  • Ability to receive feedback, adapt quickly, and continuously improve.

  • Previous group fitness instruction experience is preferred, but not required.

  • Current CPR/AED certification (or ability to obtain prior to teaching independently).

  • Willingness to successfully complete the JETSET Instructor Training Academy Program, including a 5-day on-site training, which may be held locally or at one of our Regional Training and Support Centers.

AVAILABILITY EXPECTATIONS

  • Ability to teach a consistent number of classes per week.

  • Availability to work mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

  • Willingness and ability to attend required team meetings, continuing education sessions, and studio events.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to stand and move throughout the studio for extended periods.

  • Ability to demonstrate Pilates exercises safely and effectively.

  • Ability to lift and move equipment weighing up to 30 pounds.

  • Ability to coach in a warm, fast-paced, music-driven environment.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Competitive per-class compensation

  • Performance incentives (where applicable)

  • Complimentary or discounted JETSET Pilates classes

  • Flexible scheduling

  • Ongoing education and development

  • Career growth opportunities*

Compensation, benefits, scheduling expectations, and employment policies may vary by franchise owner.

*JETSET is committed to developing future leaders. Instructors who demonstrate exceptional performance may have opportunities to grow as the brand continues to expand.

title: Food Services Worker II (PRN, Days)
description:
Job Summary

The Food Services Worker II is responsible for preparing, assembling, and serving meals while maintaining cleanliness and food safety standards in a healthcare setting. This role ensures the timely delivery of meals to patients, staff, and visitors, following dietary guidelines and organizational policies. The Food Services Worker II may also assist with inventory management, food preparation, and maintaining compliance with health and sanitation regulations.

Essential Functions
  • Prepares, portions, and serves food items according to standardized recipes, dietary guidelines, and patient meal plans.
  • Assembles meal trays and ensures accurate food delivery to patients, following prescribed dietary restrictions.
  • Maintains food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Cleans and sanitizes food preparation areas, equipment, and dining spaces to meet health and safety standards.
  • Assists with inventory management, restocking supplies, and monitoring food quality to minimize waste.
  • Handles cash register operations or payment processing (if applicable) in retail or cafeteria settings.
  • Works collaboratively with kitchen staff, dietitians, and healthcare providers to meet patient dietary needs.
  • Ensures proper storage, labeling, and handling of food products to prevent contamination.
  • Follows infection control protocols, including the proper use of PPE and hand hygiene procedures.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
Qualifications
  • Other completion of a food service or hospitality training program preferred
  • 1-3 years of experience in food service, cafeteria, or healthcare nutrition services required
  • Experience in a hospital or long-term care facility preferred
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Knowledge of food preparation techniques, portion control, and dietary guidelines.
  • Ability to operate kitchen equipment, food service tools, and dishwashing machines.
  • Strong understanding of infection control, food safety, and sanitation standards.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills to interact with patients and staff.
  • Ability to follow oral and written instructions, including dietary restrictions and meal orders.
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy in meal preparation and service.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality and efficiency.
Licenses and Certifications
  • SAFE Serve Certification preferred
State Specific Requirements
  • Arizona: Arizona Health Department Sanitation Certificate, ServeSafe Certificate, or Arizona Food Handler Certificate required.

title: Last Mile - Senior Hub Coordinator ( Obour )
description:
About Bosta:
Launched in 2017, Bosta is an overnight delivery provider for E-commerce companies in Egypt. Leveraging technology to empower businesses is what we do best. Our goal is to disrupt the logistics industry by bringing technology and experience all together to provide a one-stop-shop for delivery solutions.
We rely on advanced technology to deliver orders to our customers in a fast way. Businesses can track and connect with couriers and follow up on their orders - all in one system.
About The Role :
Responsible for managing daily hub operations, coordinating shipments, tracking KPIs, and ensuring smooth workflow and service quality in line with Bosta’s standards.
Job Code :
New 2025 Budget (Not P&L) - Direct CostOPER-015

Job Responsibilities

  • 1. Receive the new pickups closed in bosta flyers.
  • 2. Ensure that the tracking number was written correctly on the flyer with the marker by the couriers.
  • 3. Receive the shipments(new pickups) on the system and add the tracking numbers on the “Receiving Pickups” sheet.
  • 4. Arrange day-to-day dispatch of the shipments and sort shipments based on delivery addresses.
  • 5. Add the cash collection and Refund shipments to the courier’s routes. Send the routes directly to the stars’ App.
  • 6. Receive the undelivered shipments on the system and the productivity sheet as well.
  • 7. Get the receiver’s signature and IDs# on delivered shipments with Zero Cod.
  • 8. Get hard copies of returned shipments signed by the business.
  • 9. Monitor the Stars Wallets and ensure that they are depositing the same collected CODs amount on a daily basis.
  • 10. Make a verification call on the undelivered shipments or” Canceled” shipments on a daily basis.
  • 11. Cancel the refused shipments on the system.
  • 12. Transfer the canceled orders after exceeding holding period at the hub”24 hours” to sorting facility team through” Transfer to Hub”
  • 13. Send handover mails to the sorting facility team including the total number of transferred shipments, seal number and the tracking numbers subject with the status of the shipments.
  • 14. Performs related duties as required.

Job Qualifications

  • - 6 months to 1 year of experience in logistics field, in e-commerce or shipping industry.
  • - Only graduates are eligible for this role.

title: Organizator dogodkov (m/ž)
description:
O delovnem mestu

Iščemo organizatorja dogodkov, ki dogodke razume kot poslovno naložbo. Celovito boste skrbeli za prisotnost Cosylaba na dogodkih, od predloga, kje se pojavimo, do prikaza, kaj nam je to prineslo.

Cosylab deluje na nišnih, visoko tehnoloških B2B trgih (pospeševalniki, fuzija, kvantne tehnologije, radioterapija, polprevodniki), kjer je kupcev malo in šteje vsak odnos. Konference, strokovna srečanja in dogodki, ki jih organiziramo, so prostor, kjer se gradi zaupanje s temi kupci. Vaša naloga je, da vsak dogodek prinese rezultat: da spoznamo prave ljudi, začnemo prave pogovore in jasne naslednje korake predamo našim domenskim in prodajnim ekipam.

Gre za operativno vlogo za strateški um. Dogodke boste izvajali sami, od prve ideje do izvedbe na lokaciji, pri tem pa razmišljali korak naprej o tem, kaj posamezen dogodek pomeni za naše poslovne domene, in iskali kreativne načine, kako z njim doseči naše cilje.

Delovne naloge in odgovornosti

Strategija in načrtovanje dogodkov

  • Priprava in skrbništvo letnega načrta in proračuna dogodkov, vključno z opredelitvijo poslovnih rezultatov in rezultatov na področju odnosov, ki jih pričakujemo od posameznega dogodka.

  • Skrb za strokovno predstavljanje Cosylaba (predavanja, okrogle mize, strokovne sekcije) v tesnem sodelovanju z našimi domenskimi strokovnjaki.

  • Načrtovanje in izvedba dogodkov, ki jih Cosylab organizira samostojno ali s partnerji (srečanja s strankami in partnerji, okrogle mize, spletni seminarji).

Operativna izvedba

  • Osebno vodenje in izvedba vsakega dogodka od začetka do konca, od priprav in sodelovanja s partnerji do izvedbe na lokaciji.

  • Pogajanja s prizorišči, organizatorji in dobavitelji.

  • Iskanje kreativnih načinov, kako iz vsakega dogodka iztržiti več (stranski sestanki, srečanja s strankami, nadaljnje aktivnosti).

  • Razvoj enotne izkušnje blagovne znamke Cosylab na vseh dogodkih in v vseh domenah.

Poslovni učinek

  • Povezovanje dogodkov s prodajnim lijakom v sodelovanju s poslovnim razvojem in prodajo.

  • Spremljanje strateških kazalnikov: zgrajeni odnosi, odprte priložnosti, pridobljena prepoznavnost.

  • Prenos tržnih vpogledov in informacij o konkurenci z dogodkov nazaj v domenske ekipe.

Pričakujemo

Pričakujemo

  • Vsaj 5 let izkušenj z vodenjem dogodkov, vključno z mednarodnimi konferencami in sejmi.

  • Izkušnje s skrbništvom načrta in proračuna dogodkov.

  • Strateško in poslovno razmišljanje v kombinaciji z operativnim pristopom: dogodke uporabljate za odpiranje vrat in povezovanje ljudi.

  • Izkušnje v kompleksnem B2B okolju, po možnosti tehničnem ali znanstvenem.

  • Konstruktiven pristop, usmerjen v rešitve.

  • Razumevanje kazalnikov uspešnosti dogodkov in povezovanja rezultatov dogodkov s CRM sistemom in prodajnimi cilji.

  • Jasna in strukturirana komunikacija, odlično govorno in pisno znanje angleščine ter močne pogajalske sposobnosti.

  • Pripravljenost na redna potovanja, tudi v tujino.

Zaželeno, vendar ne zahtevano

  • Izkušnje s HubSpotom ali Salesforceom in orodji za spletne seminarje.

  • Izkušnje z uporabo orodij umetne inteligence za avtomatizacijo rutinskih nalog pri dogodkih.

  • Izkušnje s trženjem, usmerjenim na ključne stranke (ABM), ali s tesnim sodelovanjem s prodajo pri ciljnih strankah.

  • Obstoječa mreža poznanstev v znanstveni, raziskovalni ali visokotehnološki skupnosti.

Nudimo

Nudimo

  • Zaposlitev za nedoločen čas s poskusno dobo 6 mesecev.

  • Fleksibilni delovni čas z možnostjo dela od doma.

  • Veliko možnosti za osebni in profesionalni razvoj s konkurenčno plačo, ki raste z odgovornostjo.

  • Zanimivo in izzivov polno delo v mednarodnem delovnem okolju.

title: Respiratory Therapy Tech
description:
Shift: PRN

Benefits:

  • Future Security: 401(k) with matching

Job Summary

The Respiratory Therapy Technician - Non-Certified provides basic respiratory care services under the direction of a licensed respiratory therapist or physician. This role involves assisting with respiratory treatments, monitoring patients, and maintaining respiratory equipment. The technician supports patient care by ensuring a clean, safe, and organized environment and follows all departmental protocols and procedures.

Essential Functions

  • Assists licensed respiratory therapists in the preparation and administration of basic respiratory treatments, including oxygen therapy, aerosol treatments, and incentive spirometry.
  • Observes and monitors patients during respiratory therapy treatments, reporting any adverse reactions or unusual observations to the supervising therapist or physician.
  • Cleans, maintains, and sets up respiratory equipment following established infection control and safety protocols.
  • Records treatment administration and patient responses in the medical record as directed.
  • Prepares necessary supplies and equipment for respiratory procedures, ensuring proper stock levels and equipment functionality.
  • Educates patients and families on basic respiratory exercises and therapies under the guidance of licensed personnel.
  • Adheres to all departmental policies, safety regulations, and infection prevention protocols to maintain a safe patient care environment.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • Completion of a Respiratory Therapy Technician training program or coursework in a related healthcare field preferred
  • 0-1 years of experience in respiratory care or a related field preferred
  • Experience in respiratory therapy, pulmonary function testing, or oxygen therapy support preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Basic understanding of respiratory therapy principles and practices.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and work under supervision.
  • Strong communication skills to interact effectively with patients, families, and healthcare team members.
  • Knowledge of infection control practices and equipment maintenance protocols.
  • Ability to manage time efficiently and prioritize tasks in a busy clinical setting.

Licenses and Certifications

  • BCLS - Basic Life Support obtained within 30 days of hire required

title: Sr. Clinical Data Manager
description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!


Job Overview

Responsible for leading, planning and execution of all data management activities for assigned projects, ensuring focus on data integrity, validity, reliability in accordance with standard processes, sponsor guidelines, industry best practices and regulatory standards. Act as coach, mentor and/or Subject Matter Expert within the department, aiding Manager in process improvements, issue escalation and training development and delivery. Support the department and company in achieving objectives and strategic goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Data Management Operations Serve as primary contact overseeing all data management activities from study start-up through database lock, including data management plan creation, CRF development, database specifications, edit check testing, and data review processes.
  • Database Development & Quality Control Coordinate database build and testing with programmers, define and validate edit checks, perform data review and query management, and process/reconcile electronic data from multiple sources (CIMS, Safety database, labs, IRT).
  • Team Leadership & Supervision Coordinate and supervise 1-7 Data Management staff members, providing training, mentorship, and conducting performance reviews while managing project resources within budget and timelines.
  • Stakeholder Communication & Project Coordination Participate in and lead internal/sponsor meetings, work directly with project managers and teams, track study progress, issue status reports, and serve as escalation point for data-related issues.
  • Training & Documentation Management Develop and deliver training programs for investigators, clinical sites, project teams and sponsors on data collection processes and tools; ensure study documentation is maintained and properly stored in trial master files.
  • Department Development & Process Improvement Contribute to continuous improvement through information sharing, coach and mentor peers, participate in or lead development of SOPs/policies, and support cross-functional working groups.
  • Strategic Support & Advocacy Act as Subject Matter Expert within the department, support manager with process improvements and issue escalation, and promote data management excellence internally and externally.
  • Compliance & Standards Ensure all activities adhere to standard processes, sponsor guidelines, industry best practices, and regulatory standards while supporting departmental and company strategic goals.

Skills & Qualifications

  • A minimum of a one-to-two-year post-secondary certification in a relevant field of study, and 4-6 years of related work experience in Clinical Data Management with ongoing training.
  • Life Sciences or Clinical Research specialty and CCDM (Certified Clinical Data Manager) certification preferred.
  • Ability to set personal pace and prioritize tasks with significant autonomy.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with patience and tact for managing regular contacts with team members, vendors, and clients

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

    • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.
Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

title: Principal Software Engineer, Core Infrastructure
description:
An engineer on the Strategic Customer Engineering team plays a critical role in aligning technical details across various service teams, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, and driving end-to-end execution of complex projects. This engineer will design, coordinate, and execute technical solutions that have huge impact to our customer experience and scalability. Understanding various cloud technologies and technical trade-offs, the ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, have a well-rounded technical background, and come with a history of leading large-scale projects end-to-end.

Qualifications

Your experience should be both deep and wide-ranging, with strengths in internetworking, cloud infrastructure, Linux system internals, workflow scalability, and organizational effectiveness.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 8+ years distributed cloud engineering experience in a software development environment
  • Development experience in Java/C++/C# as well as scripting languages. Experience in scripting and automation using tools like Ansible, Terraform, and/or Kubernetes.
  • Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration tools for managing distributed systems.
  • Strong Linux skills with hands-on experience in Oracle Linux/RHEL/CentOS, Ubuntu, and Debian distributions, including system administration, package management, shell scripting, and performance optimization.
  • Experience working with other cloud platform teams and accommodating requirements from those teams (compute, networking, storage, identity).
  • Solid understanding of networking concepts, security principles, and best practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex information in a clear, concise manner to all audiences
  • Strong documentation skills with experience documenting infrastructure designs, configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps to facilitate knowledge sharing, ensure maintainability, and enhance team collaboration.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our cloud infrastructure solutions are designed and built with the highest level of scalability in mind. You will partner with other development teams responsible for architecting, designing, and implementing solutions within a distributed computing environment that lead to the best customer experience. This is a high-impact role with high expectations. You will be expected to lead initiatives across engineering, operations, and leadership with minimal supervision.

title: Senior Manager - Web, CMS, E-commerce
description:
Who we are…

Cell Signaling Technology (CST) is a different kind of life sciences company, one founded, owned, and run by active research scientists, with the highest standards of product and service quality, technological innovation, and scientific rigor for over 20 years. We consistently provide fellow scientists around the globe with best-in-class products and services to fuel their quests for discovery.

Helping researchers find new solutions is our main mission every day, but it's not our only mission. We're also dedicated to helping identify solutions to other problems facing our world. We believe that all businesses must be responsible and work in partnership with local communities, while seeking to minimize their environmental impact. That's why we joined 1% for the Planet as its first life science member, and have committed to achieving net-zero emissions by 2029.

The role...

The Senior Manager - Web, CMS, E-commerce is the senior product owner for CST’s core content and commerce platforms: Contentstack (headless CMS) and commercetools (composable commerce). This role sets the strategic vision and direction for both platforms and is fully accountable for their roadmaps and business outcomes, shaping how CST creates, manages, and delivers scientific content and product information, and how customers discover and buy products online across CST’s global web properties.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned product leader from a catalog-oriented business (large, attribute-rich product catalogs with frequent new product introductions) who can turn business strategy into a clear, prioritized platform roadmap and partner effectively with IT, Research, and Commercial stakeholders. Experience in life sciences or another scientific industry is a plus.

This role owns Contentstack and commercetools within CST’s headless, API-first web architecture and partners with the teams that own connected enterprise systems on integration. The role manages one direct report who owns SEO/GEO/AIO, paid search (PPC), and web analytics; this role is accountable for the results of those programs and integrates them into the overall web strategy. This position reports to the Senior Director of Web and is located onsite at our Danvers, MA headquarters.

You'll have the opportunity to...

Platform Strategy & Roadmap (20%)

  • Own the strategic vision, multi-year roadmap, and business case for CST’s CMS (Contentstack) and e-commerce platform (commercetools), aligned to Marketing, Commercial, and company objectives.
  • Build and present business cases for major initiatives, including projected ROI, required resources, and defined success metrics. Be the internal expert on CST’s digital customers, competitive landscape, and market trends; synthesize research into insights that inform platform strategy.
  • Define how content, product, and commerce capabilities work together across CST’s global web properties (including .com, .cn, and .jp), balancing global consistency with regional requirements.
  • Guide the evolution of the Contentstack and commercetools architecture in partnership with Engineering and IT.
  • Partner with the teams that own connected enterprise systems (e.g., site search, digital asset management, ERP) to define web integration requirements and keep integrations reliable.
  • Contribute platform expertise to system-of-record decisions for commerce data such as pricing, availability, and product content, and implement those decisions on the CMS and e-commerce platforms.
  • Evaluate emerging capabilities (e.g., AI-driven product discovery, guided selling, personalization) and recommend where and when to invest.
  • Manage platform vendor and implementation partner relationships, including licensing, renewals, SOWs, and roadmap alignment.

CMS Product Ownership – Contentstack (20%)

  • Own the Contentstack platform strategy, content models, and authoring experience to enable fast, consistent, and compliant publishing.
  • Partner with content, design, and engineering teams to evolve the component library and page templates, prioritizing reuse and scalability.
  • Define and enforce content governance, workflows, roles and permissions, and localization processes for multi-language, multi-region sites.
  • Drive measurable improvements in time-to-publish, author efficiency, and content quality, including translation and localization tooling.

E-commerce Product Ownership – commercetools (20%)

  • Own the commercetools platform strategy and the transactional experience it powers, including cart, checkout, order history, and account features.
  • Partner with the owner of site search and product detail pages so that discovery and product pages connect seamlessly to the buying experience.
  • Partner with Product Data and Commercial teams to execute their requirements for catalog structure, product data presentation, pricing, promotions, and availability display, translating them into platform capabilities and delivery plans.
  • Shape capabilities for B2B and institutional buyers, such as account-based pricing, quotes, punchout/eProcurement, and support for direct and distributor market models.
  • Ensure the platform scales to support a high volume of new product introductions each year with accurate, timely product information.

Delivery & Agile Leadership (15%)

  • Own and prioritize the CMS and e-commerce product backlogs based on strategic goals, business impact, and technical feasibility.
  • Ensure epics and user stories have clear acceptance criteria, and work with engineering leads on capacity planning so the roadmap stays realistic and sprint-ready.
  • Oversee user acceptance testing, release readiness, launch documentation and training, and post-launch hypercare.
  • Manage platform budgets and track delivery against roadmap commitments.

Digital Performance & Accountability (15%)

  • Take full accountability for web and e-commerce KPIs (e.g., conversion rate, online revenue, organic and AI search visibility, time-to-publish, site performance), and clearly explain the reasons for both success and shortfalls.
  • Set direction for and oversee the direct report who owns SEO, generative and AI search optimization (GEO/AIO), paid search (PPC), and web analytics, including agency partners, ensuring these programs align with platform priorities.
  • Ensure a consistent measurement framework across the web properties so that platform investments, releases, and campaigns can be evaluated against business outcomes.
  • Conduct post-launch analysis comparing actual impact to projections, and feed learnings into the next iteration of the roadmap.
  • Ensure platform adherence to web accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), SEO, performance, privacy, and security standards.

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management (10%)

  • Lead, coach, and develop a direct report, delegating feature ownership and building capabilities.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for CMS and e-commerce priorities with Marketing, Commercial, Sales, Customer Service, Product Data, R&D, Operations, IT, and regional teams.
  • Communicate roadmap, status, risks, and trade-offs to stakeholders and senior leadership, and manage expectations against strategic priorities and resource constraints.

Who you are and what you bring to the team...

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5–7 years of product ownership or product management experience for web, CMS, and/or e-commerce platforms in a catalog-oriented business (e.g., large, attribute-rich product catalogs with frequent new product introductions).
  • Hands-on product ownership experience with:A headless CMS platform (Contentstack strongly preferred; Contentful, Sanity, or similar considered) A headless/composable commerce platform (commercetools strongly preferred; similar considered)
  • Demonstrated success defining and delivering a multi-year platform roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes, including building business cases with ROI and success metrics.
  • Experience managing people and/or leading cross-functional delivery teams.
  • Strong understanding of headless/composable, API-first architectures, including how CMS and commerce platforms integrate with other enterprise systems.
  • Experience with B2B e-commerce requirements (e.g., account-based pricing, quoting, punchout/eProcurement).
  • Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including backlog prioritization and management in Jira or similar tools.
  • Experience managing vendor and agency relationships, including SOWs, licensing, and budgets.
  • Working knowledge of SEO, generative and AI search optimization (GEO/AIO), paid search, and web analytics, enough to set direction and hold owners accountable for results.
  • Working knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) and site performance best practices.
  • Strong analytical skills with a data-driven approach to decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to bridge business and technical teams and influence without direct authority.

Ideally, you have...

  • Experience in life sciences, biotech, pharmaceutical, or another scientific or regulated industry.
  • Experience with product information management (PIM) and catalog data models for complex, technical products.
  • Experience with online product discovery, including AI-driven discovery or guided selling.
  • Experience supporting multi-region, multi-language, or multi-currency websites, including China.
  • Experience leading a replatforming or major website redesign.
  • Product management certification (e.g., CSPO, SAFe POPM, Pragmatic Institute).

Physical Conditions/Physical Requirements...

  • Work environment is typically quiet for independent desk work and virtual meetings.
  • The ability to perform repetitive motions with the wrists, hands, and fingers.
  • The ability to extend hands and arms in any direction to access materials, equipment, or a keyboard.
  • The ability to sit for long periods of time (often more than 70% of the workday).
  • Ability to view and read information from a computer monitor, reports, and documents.
  • Physically able to safely lift and carry 25 pounds to move, install, unpack PC equipment, office supplies, etc. as required

This position has a starting base salary range of $166,000 - $212,000 per year, which the company, in good faith, reasonably expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and internal equity.

What we offer...

At Cell Signaling Technology (CST), we recognize that people will always be our most important asset. Providing a safe, inclusive, and stimulating working environment that understands the importance of diversity, human dignity, and meaningful work is as important as establishing company policies that incorporate excellent health insurance and pay benefits. We recognize that the development of people is the key to their happiness and thus ensure every employee has impactful discussions with their manager and develops actionable performance and professional development plans. Lastly, we are committed to engaging and supporting our employees in committees and philanthropy that benefit their local communities and environment through community investment programs.

Benefits

  • Medical (BCBS) and Dental (Delta Dental) plans paid at 90%
  • Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance, Short and Long Term Disability
  • Flexible Spending accounts
  • 401(k) Plan with 6% match
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Generous PTO package
  • Parental Leave
  • Pet Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Onsite Subsidized Cafeteria
  • Free Parking

Cell Signaling Technology (CST) is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, status as a veteran or as a member of the military or status in any group protected by applicable federal or state laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

AGENCIES

All resumes submitted by search firms/employment agencies to any employee at Cell Signaling Technology (CST) via email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method will be deemed the sole property of CST unless CST engaged such search firms/employment agencies for this position and a valid agreement with CST is in place. title: Domain Lead - Business Applications Engineering
description:
Ko wai mātou – About us

Kia ora. We’re Foodies. You know New World, PAK’nSAVE and Four Square right? That’s us!

With 300+ stores and over 27,000 Foodies across Te Ika-a-Maui, our North Island Co-op has the privilege of helping New Zealanders get more out of life. Locally owned, we reflect the communities we serve, and we celebrate our people - our taonga, every day for being uniquely them.

Our Support Centre is 1,500+ people strong, which includes 500+ IT employees, who all play a vital role in ensuring the cogs of our Co-op stay turning and our systems stay ‘byte’-sized and ‘bug’-free.”.

Te Tūranga – About the role

We’re looking for an experienced Domain Lead - Business Applications Engineering to lead the engineering strategy and capability behind some of our most important enterprise platforms.

Spanning SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow and future business platforms, this is a senior leadership opportunity to define how we engineer, extend, integrate and evolve our business applications at scale.

You’ll lead through Principal Engineers, Tech Leads and Chapter Leads, creating the standards, capability and environment that allow engineering teams to move faster while maintaining quality, security, resilience and long-term platform health.

What you’ll do

  • Own and evolve the engineering strategy for business applications, aligning engineering direction with business, platform, architecture, security, data and integration strategies.
  • Set engineering standards and guardrails across SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms, creating consistency without unnecessarily slowing teams down.
  • Champion modern engineering practices, including clean core, upgrade-safe extensibility, platform-native development, API and event-driven integration, automation, CI/CD, automated testing and observability.
  • Lead through senior technical leaders, empowering Principal Engineers, Tech Leads and Chapter Leads to shape the detail while providing clear direction and accountability.
  • Build engineering capability at scale, strengthening technical leadership, career pathways, succession and expertise across multiple engineering disciplines.
  • Balance engineering excellence with business value, ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable, upgradeable and commercially sustainable.
  • Influence platform investment and technical direction, ensuring engineering decisions reduce unnecessary customisation, complexity, duplication and vendor dependency.

Ngā painga - What we offer

We’re committed to providing awesome experiences for our people, including offering a range of benefits

  • Inhouse learning and development programmes and courses, flu vaccinations, and social network groups (we call them Tribes).
  • Flexible working options, a day off on your birthday, long service leave
  • Free carparking - we’ve got over 1,000 carparks including EV plugs
  • Onsite café with subsidised meals, mini mart, 5% discount at our retail stores

He kōrero mōu - About you

  • Significant senior leadership experience across enterprise-scale software engineering, particularly within SaaS, packaged or business-critical platform environments.
  • Strong experience across enterprise platforms such as SAP, Salesforce and ServiceNow, with credible understanding of their engineering models, integration and extension approaches.
  • Proven experience leading through other engineering leaders, such as Principal Engineers, Tech Leads and Chapter Leads, rather than relying on direct delivery control.
  • A strong track record of setting engineering standards, patterns and guardrails that improve consistency, quality and security while preserving team autonomy.
  • Strong knowledge of modern engineering practices across integration, automation, DevOps, CI/CD, quality engineering, observability and production support.
  • Strong ability to operate across both strategy and technical detail, harnessing the expertise of engineers, architects and platform specialists rather than needing to personally own every technical decision.
  • Experience balancing business value, engineering quality, operational sustainability, security, risk and commercial considerations when making technology decisions.
  • Strong stakeholder leadership, with the ability to influence confidently across engineering, architecture, product, security, business leadership and executive audiences.
  • A collaborative, pragmatic leadership style with the ability to create clarity, empower autonomy and build high-performing engineering leadership teams.

Experience awesome. Achieve awesome. Be awesomely you.

We’re proud to have a focus on Diversity & Inclusion here at Foodies and welcome courageous behaviour, encourage togetherness, inspire our people to be their best selves in our Foodies whānau.

We encourage you to apply with all your awesomeness and welcome your diverse background, including any disability, additional health and mental health needs, and/or neurodiversity.

If you require accessibility support to ensure you can fairly access our recruitment process, please reach out to Recruitment.Foodstuffs@foodstuffs.co.nz. Accessibility support could include, interview location, sign language interpreter, assistive technology.

title: Juridisch beleidsadviseur belastingen
description:
Ben jij een juridisch en beleidsmatig sterke professional met interesse in gemeentelijke belastingen? Vind je het leuk om complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar praktisch beleid en heldere adviezen? En werk jij graag bij een maatschappelijke organisatie met een goede werk-privé balans waar de lijnen kort zijn en jij als juridisch adviseur een verschil kunt maken? Solliciteer nu!

Wat je doet
Als Juridisch beleidsadviseur belastingen ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen, actualiseren en uitvoeren van beleid op het gebied van gemeentelijke belastingen. Je bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor collega's, management en bestuur en zorgt ervoor dat wet- en regelgeving op een juiste manier wordt toegepast.

Een greep uit jouw takenpakket:
  • Het opstellen en actualiseren van belastingverordeningen, beleidsregels en uitvoeringsbeleid
  • Adviseren over juridische en beleidsmatige vraagstukken rondom gemeentelijke belastingen en de WOZ
  • Beoordelen en behandelen van (complexe) bezwaar- en beroepsprocedure
  • Opstellen van college- en raadsvoorstellen, adviezen en bestuurlijke stukken
  • Signaleren van ontwikkelingen in wet- en regelgeving en deze vertalen naar de gemeentelijke praktijk
  • Adviseren over de gevolgen van jurisprudentie voor beleid en uitvoering
  • Samenwerken met collega's binnen de organisatie en externe partijen, zoals belastingorganisaties en samenwerkingsverbanden
  • Vertegenwoordigen van de gemeente bij de Rechtbank inzake beroepsprocedures

Wie je bent
  • Je bent analytisch sterk. Complexe wet-en regelgeving weet je snel te doorgronden en in de praktijk toe te passen
  • Je werkt zorgvuldig en hebt een onderzoekende, zelfstandige werkhouding. Je zoekt alles tot in de puntjes uit en weet je besluit goed en in heldere taal te onderbouwen
  • Er komen veel juridische vragen op je af. Je kunt goed prioriteiten stellen, houdt overzicht en hebt een pragmatische werkhouding binnen de juridische kaders van wet- en regelgeving
  • Je zoekt actief de samenwerking. Samen sta je sterk en werk je met meer plezier
  • Je weet complexe, juridische materie te vertalen naar begrijpelijke taal
  • Je gaat een moeilijk gesprek niet uit de weg. Met jouw expertise en lef sta je sterk in je adviesrol binnen Gooise Meren en voor de Rechtbank

Wat wij van je vragen
  • Een hbo of wo werk-en denkniveau
  • Een relevante, afgeronde opleiding op het gebied van bijvoorbeeld Rechten of bestuurskunde, aangevuld met relevante werkervaring. Werkervaring binnen gemeenteland of bij een belastingorganisatie is een pré, maar geen harde vereiste
  • Brede kennis en ervaring met relevante wet-en regelgeving; zoals de Gemeentewet, Awb, de WOZ en gemeentelijke belastingen
  • Goede, stevige adviesvaardigheden en een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal
  • Nieuwe, online systemen maak jij je snel eigen
  • Een gezonde dosis lef en een ontwikkelgerichte, flexibele werkhouding

Wat wij je bieden
  • We bieden je een jaarcontract aan voor 32 tot 36 uur per week. Zijn we blij met elkaar? Dan krijg je na deze periode een vast contract
  • Afhankelijk van je opleiding en werkervaring is je salaris maximaal € 5.714 bruto per maand bij een 36-urige werkweek (schaal 10, CAO Gemeenten per 1 januari 2027)
  • Een individueel keuzebudget van 18,65% (inclusief vakantiegeld en eindejaarsuitkering) bovenop je bruto jaarsalaris. Je bepaalt zelf hoe je dit budget besteedt. Zo kun je het (maandelijks) inzetten voor bijvoorbeeld extra salaris, extra verlof, een nieuwe fiets of sportabonnement
  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals deels betaald ouderschapsverlof, een goede reiskostenvergoeding, een ziektekostenvergoeding, goed pensioen via ABP en een thuiswerkvergoeding
  • Je komt te werken bij een maatschappelijke organisatie met aandacht voor de werk-privé balans en volop ontwikkel- en opleidingsmogelijkheden. Je krijgt de kans om werken op kantoor of te wisselen met thuiswerken (gemiddeld 50% thuis, 50% vanuit kantoor)

Over het team
Als Juridisch beleidsadviseur belastingen val je onder de afdeling Financieel Beheer, bestaande uit ruim 20 professionals op het gebied van financiële administratie en belastingen.
In je dagelijkse werk schakel je veel met je collega’s van heffen, invordering en de WOZ. Samen met hen kom je regelmatig als team op kantoor samen om zaken af te stemmen en met plezier samen te werken.

Ja, ik wil solliciteren!
Ben je enthousiast geworden? Stuur uiterlijk 30 november 2026 je CV met een korte motivatiebrief naar ons via het online sollicitatieformulier.

Het opvragen van referenties en / of raadplegen van openbare bronnen kan onderdeel zijn van de selectieprocedure. Het opvragen van een VOG is een vast onderdeel van de selectieprocedure.

Heb je vragen over deze functie? Neem dan contact op met Wim Velema, manager Financieel Beheer. Telefoon: 06 24 45 51 60. Mail: w.velema@gooisemeren.nl

title: Izmenovodja za PE Novo Mesto
description:
• skrbeli boste za vodenje izmene od nabave, prodaje in vodenja kolektiva

  • delo na blagajni,

  • delo na računalniku (osnovna znanja word, excel),

Pričakujemo

  • IV.st. izobrazbe prodajalec ali V. stopnja ali več strokovne izobrazbe zaželeno v smeri trgovec ali ekonomist

  • zaželjene so delovne izkušnje iz prodaje trgovskega blaga in delo v trgovini, zanesljivost ter odgovornost pri delu , samoiniciativnost , prijaznost,

  • dobre komunikacijske sposobnosti in vodstvene sposobnosti

  • natančnost in poštenost,

  • veselja do dela z ljudmi, voljo do učenja,

  • pozitivno naravnavnost.

Nudimo

  • trajanje zaposlitve je za določen čas z možnostjo podaljšanja pogodbe o zaposlitvi za nedoločen čas,

We value every woman’s unique story and offer services ranging from adolescent gynecology and maternity to high‑risk obstetrics, infertility, and menopause support. At Eni, we are looking for a General Services Specialist to join Eni Plenitude France in Levallois-Perret. You will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of our sites and coordinating and monitoring the department’s activities, reporting directly to the Department Manager.

About Plenitude

Plenitude is an energy company that integrates the retail business and renewable generation with self-consumption and electric mobility solutions, providing energy and gas to more than 10 million homes and businesses across Europe, which offers a range of great professional opportunities for the whole team. This partnership represents a major European project integrating the renewable energy business with the retail business, which will enable us to progressively increase our offering of services, infrastructure, and green energy for our customers, providing our team with greater visibility and professional growth.

Main responsibilities:

  • Ensure compliance with company processes and procedures, particularly those related to General Services.
  • Carry out a range of activities to ensure the smooth operation of company sites.
  • Coordinate employee-related services, including events, travel, transfers and employee benefits.
  • Provide administrative and operational support, including supplier follow-up and the delivery of goods and services.
  • Manage and maintain office supply inventories.
  • Manage documentation and prepare reports.
  • Validate travel fares, monitor expenses and manage travel arrangements.
  • Support internal communications.
  • Act as an ambassador for the company’s values, both internally and externally.

Skills and experience required:

  • Qualification in Business Administration, Management or a related field.
  • Strong organisational, communication and negotiation skills.
  • Reliable, proactive, friendly and helpful, with a strong commitment to assigned tasks, the smooth running of the office and employee wellbeing.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and an ERP or similar management system.
  • Previous experience in a similar role within a multinational or large organisation.

How to apply:

  • Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
  • Please upload your CV in English.

About Eni

Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions.

Working at Eni

At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. For us, the skills and attitudes of each individual, continuous training, and diversity and inclusion are fundamental. We promote flexible ways of working with particular attention to well-being, welfare and work life-balance. Eni will evaluate applications considering plurality and diversity as sources of enrichment. If your application is assessed to be among those most in line with the required profile, you will be contacted to continue the selection process. Whatever your ambition, at Eni you can find the tools to make it happen.

title: Principal Software Engineer, Core Infrastructure
description:
About the role

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to build a new Data Processing Unit (DPU) platform spanning networking and storage. You will solve problems involving packet processing, host-to-DPU data movement, concurrency, and predictable performance under congestion and resource pressure.

You will be the technical owner of a substantial component: its architecture, interfaces, implementation, performance, and operational readiness. Starting from broad requirements, you will resolve design choices and drive delivery with partner engineers. You will propose changes that cross component boundaries and align them with subsystem owners. Deep networking expertise is essential; storage familiarity is required and substantial storage experience is especially valuable.

What you will do

  • Own component architecture and delivery. Translate broad requirements into a component design and executable milestones. Make architectural and implementation decisions within agreed subsystem boundaries and carry the work through production.
  • Design high-performance data paths. Build packet processing, network virtualization, forwarding, policy, or acceleration capabilities. Make deliberate choices about concurrency, buffering, memory ownership, and hardware interfaces.
  • Define and coordinate interfaces. Establish component contracts with networking, storage, firmware, and hardware partners. Resolve dependencies and drive integration; escalate tradeoffs that require subsystem-wide decisions.
  • Own component performance. Define representative benchmarks and performance targets. Investigate throughput, tail latency, CPU utilization, and memory efficiency, validating improvements under load and resource pressure.
  • Evaluate storage interactions. Assess how component choices affect storage I/O performance, backpressure, and failure handling. Work with storage engineers to preserve correctness and reliable recovery.
  • Deliver production readiness. Own component instrumentation, fault handling, compatibility, and upgrade behavior. Drive qualification and operational improvements, including difficult cross-layer debugging and production support.
  • Guide engineers and engineering quality. Mentor engineers, lead component design reviews, and establish useful tests and performance regression checks. Help feature owners make independent decisions within the architecture.
  • Improve responsible AI practices. Validate AI-assisted work and help the team adopt effective coding, testing, debugging, and documentation practices. Reduce repetitive work while preserving quality, accountability, and a sustainable engineering experience.

Required qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience in systems or infrastructure software, including substantial hands-on experience building high-performance networking data planes.
  • Demonstrated ownership of substantial component architecture and delivery from broad requirements through production.
  • Deep experience implementing or optimizing packet processing systems, with strong knowledge of network virtualization, forwarding, encapsulation, and traffic management.
  • Strong C or C++ proficiency and Linux systems knowledge, including concurrency, memory management, multicore processing, and performance profiling.
  • Familiarity with storage architectures and data paths, and ability to evaluate how component choices affect storage performance and failure handling.
  • Ability to diagnose complex correctness or performance issues across software layers using measurements and repeatable experiments.
  • Experience defining interfaces, coordinating technical dependencies, and owning component performance and operational readiness.
  • Clear design communication and experience mentoring engineers through reviews, implementation, and debugging.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable. Experience with every listed technology is not required.

  • Packet processing. DPDK or comparable user-space frameworks; virtual switching, connection tracking, policy enforcement, or offload implementation.
  • DPU acceleration. DPUs, SmartNICs, AMD Pensando, NVIDIA BlueField/DOCA, P4, or comparable technologies.
  • Storage. Substantial storage development experience; block storage, NVMe, NVMe over Fabrics, RDMA, or storage virtualization.
  • Hardware and production. PCIe, DMA, SR-IOV, IOMMU, zero-copy techniques, hardware co-design, staged deployments, fault injection, or upgrade compatibility.

What success looks like

You will deliver a critical component with a clear architecture, stable interfaces, and demonstrated performance and reliability. You will independently resolve component-level decisions, coordinate integration, and help engineers deliver within that architecture.

Why join us

Shape a new platform through architectural ownership of a critical component. You will make consequential software and hardware tradeoffs, partner with experienced networking and storage engineers, and carry your designs from exploration into production.
