description:
Required Qualifications (As evidenced by an attached resume)\:
Ph.D. (or foreign equivalent) in theoretical nuclear physics, particle physics, or a closely related field in hand by the start of the appointment. Detailed knowledge of analytical and numerical techniques.

Preferred Qualifications\:
Experience relevant to nuclear and strong-interaction physics, including nonperturbative QCD, hadron structure, QCD at high temperature and density, relativistic heavy-ion collisions, strongly coupled matter, lattice gauge theory, quantum field theory, and quantum information aspects of nuclear physics. Experience with theoretical developments relevant to the Electron-Ion Collider (EIC), including the quark and gluon structure of hadrons and nuclei, partonic distributions, hadronization and fragmentation, and small-x physics.

Brief Description of Duties\:
The Nuclear Theory Group and the Center for Nuclear Theory (CNT) at Stony Brook University invites applications for a Postdoctoral Associate position in theoretical nuclear physics. The Stony Brook Nuclear Theory Group provides a stimulating and collaborative research environment with close scientific interactions with the Nuclear Theory Group at Brookhaven National Laboratory (BNL). The proximity of BNL and the activities of the Center for Frontiers in Nuclear Science (CFNS) provide additional opportunities for interaction with the broader nuclear-theory and EIC communities.

Current members of the CNT include F. Ringer, E. Shuryak, S. Syritsyn, D. Teaney, J. Verbaarschot, and I. Zahed. Research at CNT is focused on QCD at finite temperature, density, and high energy; hadron and nuclear structure; many-body theory; and the interface of quantum information science and nuclear physics.

Duties\:

● Conduct research in theoretical nuclear physics within the predetermined research scope and methodology, with emphasis on QCD at finite temperature, density, and high energy; hadron and nuclear structure; many-body theory; and the interface of quantum information science.

● Carry out analytical and numerical computations.

● Work and collaborate with graduate students on research initiatives.

● Participate actively in Many-body theory discussions, group meetings, and seminars.

● Attend scientific conferences, workshops, and meetings to present research findings.

● Other duties as assigned.

The appointment is expected to begin on January 1, 2027. The initial appointment is for one year, with the possibility of renewal for a second year contingent upon the availability of funding and satisfactory performance.

The ideal candidate is an organized, service-oriented technical professional who follows defined standards, communicates clearly, documents work thoroughly, and resolves issues efficiently.

The Systems Engineer will execute the setup, deployment, and operational support of IT infrastructure for new and existing cardiology practices. Beginning during the site-build phase, this role will work from established standards and project plans to coordinate network drops; install and configure network equipment, firewalls, hardware, and endpoints; and establish secure connectivity across on-premises and cloud environments. The engineer will support VPNs, virtual desktops, servers, and application connections; troubleshoot network, endpoint, software installation, and connectivity issues onsite and remotely; collaborate closely with remote managed service providers (MSPs) and other vendors; and help transition each practice to sustainable self-service through clear playbooks, knowledge articles, and user documentation.

What you'll do:

  • Site implementation support: Participate during the site-build stage, confirm network-drop and equipment-room requirements against approved plans, track implementation dependencies, and coordinate onsite work with construction and low-voltage partners.

  • Network deployment: Install, configure, test, and document wired and wireless networks, switches, access points, firewalls, circuits, racks, power protection, and related infrastructure using CardioOne standards.

  • Hardware and endpoint setup: Coordinate approved equipment orders and image, configure, deploy, and maintain workstations, laptops, monitors, printers, scanners, and other practice devices.

  • Server and cloud connectivity: Install, configure, test, and support on-premises and cloud-hosted servers and services to enable secure data exchange and reliable application access.

  • Secure access support: Configure and support firewalls, network segmentation, VPNs, virtual desktop environments, identity and access controls, endpoint security, and secure remote access according to approved designs and policies.

  • MSP and vendor coordination: Work effectively with remote managed service providers and technology vendors to open and manage tickets, provide access and diagnostic information, coordinate work across time zones, validate completed changes, escalate unresolved issues, and maintain clear ownership through resolution.

  • Application troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve software installation, connectivity, interface, authentication, and data-transfer issues across clinical, business, and third-party applications.

  • Go-live execution: Complete assigned readiness tasks, test configurations, document issues, coordinate dependencies, and provide onsite technical support during installations and practice launches.

  • Operational support: Provide responsive onsite and remote support for network, endpoint, server, peripheral, and application issues; document troubleshooting steps and escalate complex incidents appropriately.

  • Routine administration: Maintain inventories, configurations, patching, backups, monitoring alerts, access records, and other assigned operational controls.

  • Documentation and self-service: Create and maintain build checklists, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and end-user instructions that support consistent deployments and practice self-service after the initial support period.

What you'll need:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience in systems, network, infrastructure, or IT support roles, preferably supporting multiple locations.

  • Working knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, wireless networking, network segmentation, and structured troubleshooting.

  • Hands-on experience configuring or supporting firewalls, VPNs, virtual desktop technologies, servers, cloud services, endpoint platforms, and remote-management tools.

  • Experience deploying and supporting Windows-based environments, identity and access solutions, endpoint security, patching, backup, and monitoring tools.

  • Demonstrated ability to follow technical designs and implementation standards, execute deployment checklists, test completed work, and maintain accurate documentation.

  • Experience collaborating with remote MSPs or outsourced service providers, including ticket management, troubleshooting coordination, escalation, follow-through, and validation of completed work.

  • Strong customer service, troubleshooting, documentation, organization, and communication skills.

  • Ability to manage assigned priorities, respond effectively during incidents, and travel to practice locations as needed.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting healthcare delivery organizations, physician practices, ambulatory clinics, or other regulated environments.

  • Familiarity with healthcare applications, medical devices, imaging workflows, secure interfaces, and data exchange between clinical systems.

  • Working knowledge of HIPAA-aligned security practices, risk management, least-privilege access, auditability, and protection of sensitive health information.

  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, virtualization platforms, and common enterprise networking and security technologies.

  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, Cisco, Fortinet, CompTIA, VMware, or equivalent.

What Success Looks Like

  • Assigned site-readiness and deployment tasks are completed accurately and on schedule.

  • Installations follow approved standards, checklists, and security requirements.

  • Network, endpoint, and application issues are documented, resolved promptly, or escalated with complete diagnostic information.

  • Remote MSPs and vendors receive clear information, remain accountable for assigned work, and complete changes that are tested and validated.

  • Practice teams have current instructions and clear escalation paths following go-live.

Work Expectations

This role requires a combination of remote engineering and onsite implementation and support. Travel to CardioOne practice locations and occasional work outside standard business hours may be required for site launches, maintenance windows, or critical incidents. Office locations are located in the Detroit Metro area.

Additional Information
This is a full time position with a salary range of $95,000–$115,000 annually, plus a comprehensive benefits package (12 days paid time off, 8 paid federal holidays) that includes health insurance and a matching 401K.

title: Wi-Fi Dev Test Engineer
description:
About InnoPhase IoT

If you are keen to work with a bunch of brilliant people with various backgrounds, if you share the same value of working smart and celebrating successes, if you have enthusiasm for big technology in a small company, if your goals are to learn and experience different aspects of work--not just singing the same song every day, you’ll find your playground at Innophase IoT.

We are looking for people seeking AWESOMENESS! If you’re good at what you do, you can work anywhere. If you’re the best at what you do, come work at Innophase IoT!

We are seeking a Wi-Fi Test Engineer to validate the performance, stability, and interoperability of our Wi-Fi IoT chipsets. This role focuses on hands-on chipset testing, automated test development, performance analysis, and close collaboration with firmware and hardware teams to improve product quality and reliability.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform Wi-Fi chipset functional, performance, and stability testing on evaluation boards and embedded platforms.
  • Design and execute Rate vs. Range (RvR), TCP/UDP throughput, receiver sensitivity, and long-duration stability tests under different RF and network conditions.
  • Conduct interoperability testing with access points, routers, and client devices from multiple vendors.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize Python test scripts and automated regression frameworks.
  • Set up and maintain test benches with programmable attenuators, RF instruments, access points, and other equipment.
  • Analyze logs, packet captures, and performance metrics; identify regressions, reproduce failures, and support root-cause analysis.
  • Summarize test results, track performance trends, and deliver clear technical reports and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with firmware, PHY/MAC, and RF engineers to validate new features, verify fixes, and support releases.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of Wi-Fi chipset, module, embedded-system, or wireless-product testing experience.
  • Good understanding of IEEE 802.11n/ac/ax; familiarity with 802.11be is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with Wi-Fi RvR, throughput, stability, and interoperability testing.
  • Strong Python scripting skills and experience with automated testing frameworks.
  • Familiarity with iperf/iperf3, Wireshark, programmable RF attenuators, and RF test equipment.
  • Ability to analyze test data, diagnose failures, and produce organized technical reports.
  • Familiarity with Linux command-line tools and embedded-system debugging.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Strong Plus

  • Experience with Espressif ESP32 / ESP-IDF Wi-Fi development, testing, or debugging.
  • Experience with Wi-Fi Alliance (WFA) certification and associated test tools.
  • Experience using CMW500, IQxel, spectrum analyzers, or signal generators.
  • Knowledge of MIMO, OFDMA, beamforming, power save, and rate adaptation.
  • Experience with Bluetooth/BLE and Wi-Fi/Bluetooth coexistence testing.
  • Experience building automated RvR test benches or CI-based hardware regression systems.

It is key to unleash the potential in every employee, every team, every leader, and the company herself. We know employees perform best when motivated, appreciated and recognized, and can be themselves. We are committed to building a culture where every voice can be heard, everyone has room for growth and can make meaningful contributions. At the end of the day, we want success not just for the company, but also for everyone who believes in the company, the vision, and the future.

title: Head of Customer Engagement and Delivery
description:
The Head of Customer Engagement and Delivery leads how Bilue engages, delights and grows its customers through the delivery of outstanding work. The role owns the customer engagement and delivery function end to end - from the shape of a proposal, through delivery, to the health and growth of the relationship - and is accountable for the experience customers have of Bilue and the commercial outcomes that experience produces.

This is a methodology-agnostic leader. They are open to and fluent in different styles of project and delivery management, and tool, platform and vendor choices, and match the approach to the customer and the work rather than to a fixed playbook. They are commercially minded and strategic in how they communicate with customers, and technology- and AI-literate enough to partner the Head of Engineering on technical project management, keep escalations to a minimum, and lead Bilue forward in the AI delivery space.

As a member of Bilue's Senior Leadership Team (SLT), the Head of Customer Engagement and Delivery leads as part of the team first, ahead of their own function. The expectation is to show up as an engaged, accountable leader who owns the health of the whole business, not only their department.

Day to day you'll be:

  • Leading strategic, senior customer relationships and be the escalation point customers trust
  • Shaping pursuits with Sales, from proposal reviews and SOWs through to resource plans
  • Partnering with Engineering on technical project management and keeping escalations low
  • Building and mentoring a high performing delivery team
  • Leading Bilue's AI enabled ways of delivering for our customers
  • Owning margin, chargeability and bench utilisation with Finance
  • Setting the standard for strategic customer communication, framed around outcomes and value
  • Defining a delivery governance framework that flexes across delivery styles
  • Building Delivery Managers who create cross-functional teams from build through support, maintenance and managed services
  • Developing and approving SOWs and resource plans so every engagement is feasible and commercially sound
  • Growing existing customers through delivery excellence, renewals and the expansion opportunities delivery surfaces
  • Driving continuous improvement across our Business Analysis, Project Management and QA practices
  • Leading hiring decisions for the function and building a community of practice across our delivery specialists
  • Contributing to the Senior Leadership Team and the health of the wider business

About you:

  • A senior, customer facing delivery leader with at least 10+ years in technical engagements with enterprise clients
  • Methodology agnostic, fluent across agile, traditional and hybrid delivery
  • Commercially astute, comfortable with SOWs, estimates and margin
  • Technology and AI literate, curious about shaping new ways of delivering software
  • A strong communicator who builds trust with executives
  • A strong analytical and problem solving mind, with a clear ability to identify and manage risk
  • Experience in portfolio management, consulting or pre-sales is highly regarded
  • Curious and hands on, with a genuine interest in how AI can help us deliver better for customers
  • Bachelor's degree in business, IT, engineering or equivalent. PMI, PMP, Scrum or SAFe qualifications are viewed favourably

Life at Bilue

Connection that counts
From monthly Anchor Days and team lunches to our annual offsite, we create intentional moments to connect, collaborate, and celebrate. These are not just fun perks. They are part of how we work and grow together.

Flexibility that works
We offer hybrid working, with a mix of days in the office and at home. This gives you the space to do your best work, while still creating time to connect and build strong relationships in person.

Strong internal communities
We actively foster internal communities across tech, design, delivery, AI and beyond, giving you plenty of chances to connect, share knowledge, and learn from your peers.

Opportunities to grow
We invest in your development with unlimited access to our learning library, partnership networks and certification pathways, plus support from our internal performance coach. Whether you want to deepen your technical skills or grow your leadership potential, we will back you.

Flat structure, real impact
At Bilue, everyone's voice matters. Our leadership team is hands-on and approachable, and we operate without unnecessary layers. We keep things open and transparent, and your ideas will be heard, no matter your title.

Bilue = Big + Blue Ocean. Are you ready to set sail? Apply now!

NB. This is a full-time position based in Sydney. To be considered, candidates must have unrestricted working rights in Australia.

This position description illustrates the scope and responsibilities of the role and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. You will be expected to perform other related tasks as requested and as the role and the business develop.

We believe that having balanced teams is fundamental to our success. We will not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or marital, or disability status.

title: Tehnik v orodjarni
description:

  • Izločanje poškodovanega, neustreznega ali nekalibriranega orodja iz uporabe.

  • Uporaba računalniških programov za upravljanje in evidentiranje orodja ter opreme.

  • Sodelovanje pri inventurah in pripravi orodja za načrtovana vzdrževalna dela.

  • Sodelovanje z vzdrževalnimi ekipami in zagotavljanje ustrezne podpore pri njihovem delu.

  • Skrb za dosledno upoštevanje varnostnih in organizacijskih postopkov.

Pričakujemo

  • Zaželena je tehnična izobrazba oziroma osnovno tehnično znanje.

  • Osnovno poznavanje računalniških orodij MS Office (predvsem Excel, Word in Outlook).

  • Računalniško pismenost ter sposobnost hitrega učenja in samostojne uporabe novih računalniških programov in informacijskih sistemov.

Zaželena dodatna znanja in izkušnje:

  • Osnovno znanje angleškega jezika, predvsem za razumevanje tehničnih navodil, oznak na orodju in uporabo računalniških programov.

Predhodne izkušnje v letalstvu niso pogoj za prijavo. Prednost pri izbiri bodo imeli kandidati z ustreznimi praktičnimi izkušnjami in tehničnim znanjem.

  • Takojšen začetek dela oziroma po dogovoru.

  • Delo v zanimivem in dinamičnem letalskem okolju na Brniku.

  • Uvajanje v delovne postopke ter uporabo specializiranih računalniških sistemov.

  • Priložnost za pridobivanje strokovnih znanj in izkušenj na področju letalskega vzdrževanja.

  • nadzor nad izvedbo kakovosti izobraževanja na temo uporabe logistične aplikacije za obdelavo prejetih in odpremnih pošiljk (interna uporaba in uporaba zunanjih partnerjev in dobaviteljev);

  • organizacija, nadzor in usklajevanje dela službe za logistično podporo (interno in zunanje) in službe za reklamacije in vračila ter podajanje predlogo za optimizacijo delovnega procesa;

  • sodelovanje s kurirskimi službami z namenom optimizacije ključnih operacij oddelka skladno z zastavljenimi poslovnimi cilji;

  • obravnava telefonskih klicev potencialnih strank

  • obravnavanje zahtev strank in oddajanje naročil;

  • informiranje strank o karakteristikah artikla, cenah in odgovarjanje na dodatna vprašanja;

  • izboljšanje uporabniške izkušnje strank

  • prepoznava in ocena potreb strank z namenom zadovoljstva s storitvijo;

  • spremljanje postopka komunikacije, smernic in politike podjetja;

  • sprejem reklamacij in njihovo reševanje s pristojnim oddelkom;

  • druge delovne naloge po navodilih nadrejenega, ki sodijo v okvir zgoraj navedenih nalog oziroma so nujen pogoj za njihovo uresničitev.

Pričakujemo

Pričakujemo

  • Obvezno znanje SLOVENSKEGA jezika;

  • veselje do komunikacije s strankami;

  • profesionalen odnos do strank;

  • dobro poznavanje dela z računalnikom (uporaba spletne pošte, paket Microsoft Office - zlasti Excel) in razumevanje spleta;

  • tehnično znanje, zanimanje za sodobne trende in tehnologijo;

  • natančno, dosledno, vztrajno in organizirano osebo;

  • samoiniciativnost, komunikativnost ter timsko naravnanost;

  • osebo, ki ne išče zgolj službe, ampak delo, znanje ter priložnost.

  • Naše delo te mora zanimati in motivirati vsak dan.

  • Izobrazba: vsaj V. stopnja ekonomske ali druge smeri.

Nudimo

Nudimo

  • Oblika zaposlitve: redno delo, nedoločen čas (6-mesečna poskusna doba).

    Regija: osrednjeslovenska, delovno mesto v Ljubljani (Črnuče).

  • Delo v ambicioznem in pozitivno mislečem kolektivu;

  • prijetno, urejeno in stabilno delovno okolje;

  • postopno uvajanje v delo preko spoznavanja prodajnih, poprodajnih in ostalih procesov;

  • možnost strokovnega usposabljanja in osebnega razvoja;

  • možnost soustvarjanja ene od največjih spletnih trgovin v širši regiji;

  • brezplačno parkirišče,

  • napitki, prigrizki za zaposlene.

O podjetju

Shoppster d.o.o. je sodobna in hitro rastoča slovenska spletna trgovina, ki kupcem ponuja izjemno široko paleto izdelkov – več kot 300.000 artiklov in več tisoč priznanih blagovnih znamk iz različnih kategorij. Podjetje ima sedež v Ljubljani in deluje kot del mednarodne skupine, kar mu omogoča stabilno logistično podporo, visoko raven profesionalnosti in napredne tehnološke rešitve. Shoppster je zasnovan z namenom poenostavitve spletnega nakupovanja, saj združuje preglednost, enostavnost in bogato ponudbo na enem mestu.

title: Postdoctoral Associate / Senior Postdoctoral Associate
description:
Postdoctoral Associate

Required Qualifications (as evidenced by an attached resume)\:

● Doctoral degree (or foreign equivalent) in Mechanical, Aerospace, Chemical, or Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field in hand by the start of the appointment.

● Hands-on experimental research with engines or combustion systems, including gaseous emissions measurement.

● Experience with data acquisition and analysis.

● A valid U.S. Driver's License.

Preferred Qualifications\:

● Peer-reviewed publications and strong technical writing.

● Experience with hydrogen or ammonia combustion in research engine applications.

● Experience with control and integration systems, load banks, or electrical power measurement.

● Skilled in machining, fabrication, and wiring.



Brief Description of Duties\:

The Postdoctoral Associate will conduct experimental research in the Advanced Combustion & Energy Systems Laboratory (ACES Lab) under the direction of Dr. Dimitris Assanis in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. The ACES Lab is an active engines laboratory operating highly instrumented single-cylinder research engines (Spark-Ignition CFR, Compression-Ignition Hydra, Fully Flexible Valvetrain Actuation Hydra, and Optical engine) on fuels including hydrogen, ammonia, and alcohols, with ignition systems ranging from laser ignition to pre-chambers, along with a 125 kW natural-gas engine genset.

The candidate will also lead the lab’s new mobile Performance & Emissions Validation Laboratory, the command center for independent validation of a 250 kW Mainspring Energy linear generator running on 100% hydrogen at National Grid’s Northport Power Plant. This NYSERDA-sponsored, multi-million-dollar, 12-month pilot with National Grid Ventures and the Long Island Power Authority (LIPA) is the first of its kind in New York State. This unique, high-visibility position, spanning early-TRL optical work through a late-TRL power-plant demonstration, lets one researcher lead a utility-scale demonstration while enabling publication of fundamental engine research in the same appointment.

The successful candidate will be self-sufficient, meticulous, and reliable, take pride in their work, and exercise strong organizational and time-management skills with an exceptional attention to detail. Essential for this role is the adeptness to work independently as well as part of a team, including extended test days and occasional overnight runs during field campaigns.

Duties\:

Research\:

● Conduct experiments on single-cylinder research engines fueled with hydrogen, ammonia, and alcohols, including novel ignition systems (laser ignition, pre-chambers).

● Participate/assist in manuscript writing for publication in scientific journals and conference papers from laboratory pilot results and/or make presentations at ASME, SAE, and Combustion Institute meetings.

● Contribute to proposals that build the laboratory’s next funded projects; mentor graduate and undergraduate researchers.

Technical\:

● Commission the mobile command center on the laboratory engines through heated sample lines before it deploys and whenever it is required to return to campus; support its deployment to the Northport pilot and its subsequent redeployment to the HyPower renewable-hydrogen R&D testbed and other sponsored projects.

● Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot the analyzer suite\: FTIR, chemiluminescence NOx (including a low-range ppb analyzer), FID for hydrocarbons, NDIR CO/CO₂, paramagnetic O₂, and a hydrogen analyzer (HORIBA HyEVO) or equivalent. Run zero/span calibrations, purges, leak checks, and drift checks; manage calibration-gas inventory and certificates.

● Maintain the heated sample system (heated probes, filters, and lines; pumps; switching valves for pre- and post-catalyst sampling) and apply standardized emissions measurement protocols and practices, documenting quality assurance for every test.

● Operate the control and integration systems that commands the linear generator and load bank to run defined load profiles (step functions, transients, cold and hot starts); logging data such as electrical outputs, fuel flow, and ambient conditions to calculate efficiency and response time, among a suite of other key performance metrics.

● Operate and maintain the National Instruments CompactDAQ and LabVIEW system, including analyzer communications over Modbus TCP/IP, valve control, acoustic channels, and the weather station; maintain networks, time synchronization, data backup, and chain of custody for all data.

● Execute approximately 12 test events over the 12-month pilot, each with about 2–3 weeks of preparation, a 24-hour full-load run or about 5 days of part-load testing, and 1–2 weeks of post-test calibration and data reduction.

● Follow and help write technical documentation, such as hydrogen and compressed-gas safety procedures for the command center, laboratory, and host site; coordinate the students and plant staff who support each field campaign.

Administrative\:

● Reduce and analyze campaign data (emission indices, efficiency, transient behavior, seasonal trends); write technical reports for National Grid and NYSERDA; lead SBU’s sections of the final independent validation report; present at sponsor meetings.

● Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications (as evidenced by an attached resume)\:

● Doctoral degree (or foreign equivalent) in Mechanical, Aerospace, Chemical, or Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field in hand by the start of the appointment.

● Three or more years of relevant research experience.

● License to drive in the US.

● Skilled in machining, fabrication, and wiring.

title: Business Unit Director
description:
Direct and coordinates the activities of key business unit functions including Human Resources, Engineering, Finance, Manufacturing Operations, Quality, and Continuous Improvement. Responsible for translating business strategy into operational execution and achieving business objectives related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, employee engagement, and profitability.

Essential Functions:

  • Translate business objectives into actionable operating plans to achieve performance, profitability, and growth targets.
  • Monitor key business metrics and implement corrective actions where performance gaps exist.
  • Participate in capital planning, resource allocation, and business investment decision.
  • Establish and maintain appropriate systems for measuring all key areas of the business.
  • Develop and implement annual business and financial plans with specific actions to accomplish the objectives of the business.
  • Develop long-range business plans and strategies to achieve top line growth expectations of the organization.
  • Plan and manage performance of the business unit to achieve stated objectives, timelines, and budgets.
  • Prepare and present quarterly progress reports to upper management.
  • Evaluate plan and develop and implement strategy for the effective management of the business unit.
  • Maintain and develop organizational culture to maximize market and product focus.
  • Continuously champion the use of effective tools to simplify the business, reduce complexity, eliminate non-value-added activities, and increase bottom-line earnings.
  • Establish and implement necessary strategies for the improvement and awareness of key performance indicators across relevant functional areas.
  • Promote a culture where safety is a core business value.
  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Education and Training

    • Bachelor’s degree required; technology degree and/or advanced degree preferred.

    Minimum Qualifications

    • Advanced ability to perform complex work in one functional area and general knowledge of others.
    • Strength in innovative thinking from a product development focus and understanding of technical concepts.
    • Strong financial acumen with working understanding of income statements, expense budgeting, and financial analysis and decision-making tools.
    • Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, planning, and logistics.
    • Fluent computer skills and knowledge of technology applications.

    • Frequent sitting and working at computer for extended periods of time.
    • Ability to travel as required.

title: Asiakashankkija - Helposti räätälöitävissä opintojen oheen
description:
Haetko joustavaa työtä elämäntilanteeseesi? Etsimme myynnin innoittamia vahvan kehittymishalun omaavia henkilöitä edustamaan yhteistyökumppaneitamme asiakashankinnassa. Tarjoamme laadukkaan koulutuksen ja jatkuvan valmennuksen, jotta onnistut työssäsi. Asiakashankkijan työ on rakennettu selkeäksi, jotta työ on mielekästä.

Asiakashankkijana keskityt tarkasti valittujen yhteistyökumppaneidemme uusiin sekä aiempiin asiakkaisiin. Toimit edustettavan yrityksen brändin äänenä uusasiakashankinnassa ja huomioit aiemmat asiakkaat heille räätälöidyillä kampanjaeduilla. Asiakasrekisterit ovat kohdistettuja eli asiakashankkijana tiedät aina, kenelle soitat ja miksi. Työlläsi olet merkittävässä roolissa kasvattamassa tunnettujen yritysten liiketoimintaa.

Työn tavoitteet nousevat oppimisesi mukaan. Tärkeintä meille on, että olet hyvän asenteen ja sisukkuuden omaava henkilö, jolla riittää intoa ja motivaatiota kehittyä. Arvostamme asiakaspalvelu-/myyntitaustaa. Tietokoneen peruskäyttö tulee olla sinulle luontevaa, ja edellytämme sinulta sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä nopeaa uuden omaksumista.

Työpäivämme ovat normaalisti arkisin 8:45-16 sisältäen 30 min ruokatauon ja 3 kahvitaukoa. Osa-aikaisena räätälöimme työaikasi ja -vuorosi erittäin joustavasti. Toimistomme sijaitsee ydinkeskustassa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien äärellä.

Takuupalkka toimii turvanasi työn aloituksessa. Kehityksesi kautta voit kuitenkin odottaa palkkakertymäsi nousevan yli takuupalkan. Maksamamme provisiot ja bonukset ovat erittäin hyvät. Lisäksi meillä on jatkuvasti kisoja mm. ulkomaanmatkoista tapahtumista, bonuksista ja lahjakorteista. Palkkakertymän opit laskemaan onnistumisista itse, mutta tarkastelemme sitä viikoittain myös yhdessä.

Tiimimme on varustettu hyvällä energialla ja samanhenkisyydellä. Avoimuus, joustaminen ja toisten ymmärtäminen on arkipäivää toimistoillamme. Esihenkilöt ovat tiiviisti arjessa mukana. Meille on tärkeää tuntea työntekijämme, jotta voimme valmentaa ja palkita jokaisen yksilöllisesti.

Työt on aina saanut sovitettua muuhun arkeen, oli sitten kyse opinnoista tai muista omista menoista. Äkillisimmissä menoissa on saanut muutettua jo olemassa olevia työvuoroja. -Asiakashankkija, M&J Dynastia

Työ alkaa sovitusti heti/loppuvuoden aikana.

Olemme Vastuullinen Työnantaja -sertifioitu yritys ja noudatamme näitä periaatteita päivittäisessä toiminnassamme. Olemme myös Jamk:in virallinen kumppaniyritys.

Tutustu meihin ja jätä hakemuksesi! https://www.mjdynastia.fi/rekry

Kerromme työstä mielellämme lisää: Janiina Kekkonen, 0445264462, janiina.kekkonen@mjdynastia.fi

Tsekkaa somet: https://linktr.ee/mjdynastia

title: Gegevensbeheerder/recordmanager
description:
Werk bij Haarlem en Zandvoort is werk dat ertoe doet, met resultaten die je ziet als je door de stad of het dorp loopt. Met een goede werk-privébalans en met mooie secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Ook bij de afdeling I-Beheer maken we impact.

Onze afdeling levert gebruikersvriendelijke, betrouwbare en veilige i-diensten, zodat inwoners, bedrijven, bestuur, medewerkers en (keten)partners goed ondersteund worden. De afdeling wil het digitale (werk)leven makkelijk maken voor alle gebruikers. Dit doen we met een gedreven, gezellig, hecht en divers team aan mensen met verschillende nationaliteiten en achtergronden.

Je gaat binnen de afdeling I-Beheer werken bij het Team Customer Support. Wij zijn het visitekaartje van de afdeling I-Beheer. Ons kleine, gezellige subteam gegevensbeheerders bestaat uit 4 collega's.



Functiebeschrijving
  • Je ziet toe op het juist en consequent gebruik van de gebruikte informatiesystemen en voert kwaliteitscontroles uit op de registraties van de afdelingen.
  • Je draagt actief bij aan de ontwikkeling van het informatie- en recordmanagement in de organisatie, onder andere door hierover praktische adviezen te geven aan afdelingen en directe collega's.
  • Je voert werkzaamheden uit rond de selectie, vernietiging en overdracht van digitale archiefgegevens.
  • Je draagt bij aan het beheer en de inrichting van de digitale gegevenstabellen, bijvoorbeeld de zaaktypecatalogus en het metadataschema.

Een werkdag is divers. Je start bijvoorbeeld met de verwijderverzoeken of zaken die overgeboekt moeten worden op een andere behandelaar in het DMS. Daarnaast voer je de kwaliteitscontrole van afgehandelde zaken af. In de middag zie je een e-mail binnen komen van een afdeling over een vernietigingslijst. Een 5-tal zaken kan nog niet worden vernietigd, verder is de afdeling akkoord met de vernietiging. Je verwerkt de reactie op de vernietigingslijst en slaat de reactie op in het DMS. Je gaat verder met het opstellen van de verklaring van vernietiging en begint met een geanonimiseerde versie van de vernietigingslijst voor de archiefinspecteurs op te stellen. Later die middag zit je bij een overleg met de Griffie en het Noord-Hollands Archief over de overdracht van gegevens uit de applicatie van de Griffie. Hierin worden de voortgang, problemen en vervolgstappen besproken om de raadsvergaderingen over te dragen. Om de dag af te sluiten voer je nog wat controles uit om te zien of er ligplaatsvergunningen zijn waarvan de bewaartermijn inmiddels kan gaan lopen.



Functie-eisen
  • Je hebt HBO werk- en denkniveau (bijvoorbeeld LARM/LIS of vergelijkbaar).
  • Je hebt 3 jaar werkervaring met digitale systemen in een functie als DIV-medewerker, informatiespecialist, recordmedewerker, recordmanager of vergelijkbare functie.
  • Je hebt een passie voor het vak, hecht waarde aan de kwaliteit van gegevens. Duurzaam, toegankelijk en betrouwbaar houden van digitale informatie staan daarbij centraal.
  • Je hebt kennis van de Selectielijst en ervaring met het beoordelen van archiefbestanden op bewaren en vernietigen.
  • Kennis van het DMS Verseon en/of iNavigator is een pre.
  • Je kunt rapportages ontwikkelen en analyseren voor het informatiebeheer.
  • Je vindt het leuk om het belang van goed informatiebeheer onder de aandacht te brengen van afdelingen en collega's te helpen bij vragen over het gebruik of problemen met het DMS.


Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Wij waarderen, omarmen en benutten de verschillen en talenten van mensen. Wij bieden een plek waar iedereen zich thuis kan voelen en zichzelf mag zijn. Daar maken wij ons hard voor. Dat is goed voor onze medewerkers én leidt tot de beste resultaten voor de stad en het dorp.

  • Voor jouw persoonlijke groei en vitaliteit bieden wij tal van mogelijkheden. Denk aan het volgen van opleidingen, certificeringen, cursussen via onze ‘Academie Haarlem' en ook een fietsregeling en een tegemoetkoming in je sportabonnement.
  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 32 - 36 uur per week. Je start met een jaarcontract dat we bij goed functioneren graag omzetten in een vast contract.
  • Het salaris is afhankelijk van ervaring en opleiding en bedraagt maximaal € 5.096 bruto per maand (schaal 9) bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur per week. Daarbovenop krijg je 17,05% Individueel Keuze Budget over je bruto salaris, waarmee je zelf je eigen arbeidsvoorwaarden samenstelt.
  • Hybride werken is bij onze gemeente aan de orde van de dag. De ene dag ben je op kantoor, een ander moment kies je voor thuiswerken. Wij faciliteren je daarbij. Waar je ook werkt, je bent altijd in verbinding met je collega's.
  • Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals vergoeding OV-reiskosten, gedeeltelijk betaald ouderschapsverlof en een goede pensioenregeling bij het ABP. Bekijk de arbeidsvoorwaarden van de Cao Gemeenten

Onze organisatiewaarden zijn open, gedreven en betrokken.

title: Maiņas vadītājs/-a Spilva ražotnē
description:
Šī ir Tava iespēja:

  • Kļūt par daļu no leģendāru vietējo zīmolu stāsta.
  • Dinamisku un interesantu darbu profesionālā, dzīvespriecīgā komandā ar pieredzi un atbalstu.
  • Iegūt jaunas zināšanas un pilnveidoties profesionāli starptautiskā uzņēmumā.
  • Saņemt veselības apdrošināšanu un nelaimes gadījumu apdrošināšanu pēc nostrādātiem trīs mēnešiem.
  • Saņemt atalgojumu 1575 - 1900 EUR apmērā pirms nodokļiem.
  • Apmaksātas mobilā telefona sarunas, siltas pusdienas darba vietā, papildu brīvdienas, atlaides mūsu produkcijai un materiālu atbalstu īpašos dzīves notikumos.

Mēs Tev uzticēsim:

  • Organizēt un vadīt ražošanas darbu maiņas laikā atbilstoši ražošanas plānam.
  • Nodrošināt ražošanas apjomu, kvalitātes, pārtikas drošības un darba drošības prasību izpildi.
  • Vadīt, atbalstīt un attīstīt ražošanas komandu, veicinot efektīvu sadarbību un augstu darba sniegumu.
  • Uzraudzīt ražošanas procesu norisi un operatīvi risināt nestandarta situācijas.
  • Sekot līdzi ražošanas efektivitātes rādītājiem, analizēt novirzes un īstenot uzlabojumus.
  • Nodrošināt precīzu informācijas apriti starp maiņām un iesaistītajām struktūrvienībām.
  • Uzraudzīt kārtības, sanitārijas un 5S principu ievērošanu ražošanā.
  • Veikt darbinieku apmācību un jauno kolēģu ievadīšanu darbā.

title: Staff Engineer, Reliability (R6517)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

As a Hardware Reliability Engineer at Shield AI, you will be responsible for ensuring the robustness and long-term performance of our VBAT flight hardware. You’ll work closely with design, manufacturing, and supplier chain to implement design-for-reliability best practices and perform reliability verification from concept through production. You will lead environmental and stress testing efforts, including temperature cycling, vibration, HALT, and HASS, conduct failure analysis and materials characterization, and analyze root cause investigations for manufacturing non-conformances and field returns. You’ll participate in design reviews and FMEA activities, shape material selection and manufacturing requirements, analyze test and field data using reliability modeling tools, and help develop corrective actions and process improvements that elevate hardware reliability across the program.

What you'll do:

  • You will be responsible for developing and implementing design-for-reliability best practices, conducting rigorous testing, shaping manufacturing requirements, selecting materials, and analyzing field data to enhance the robustness of VBAT hardware.
  • Perform stress screening, environmental testing, and drive failure analysis to ensure flight hardware meets reliability and performance targets.
  • Analyze designs and test results to identify potential failure modes and mitigations.
  • Collaborate with design engineers to implement design for reliability best practices early in design.
  • Act as a key stakeholder in reviewing and approving designs for release.
  • Participate in design reviews and failure mode effects analysis (FMEA) to assess potential reliability issues.
  • Investigate manufacturing non-conformances and field hardware failures to determine root cause.
  • Travel as needed to perform deep dives into supplier processes.
  • Develop and recommend corrective actions to address identified reliability issues.
  • Utilize reliability modeling and simulation tools to predict system performance and lifespan.
  • Stay current with industry trends, advancements, and best practices in hardware reliability engineering.
  • Propose and implement process improvements to drive improvements in reliability across the program.

Required qualifications:

  • Technical background in materials science, electronics manufacturing processes (PCB fabrication and assembly), hardware reliability concepts, and environmental test practices.
  • Candidate must be self-starting and come with a growth mindset, with excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Bachelor's degree in Materials Engineering preferred. Degrees in Mechanical OR Reliability Engineering also are acceptable.
  • Familiarity with electronics (PCBs, PCBAs, electronic components) and moving mechanical assemblies.
  • Team-player with clear and concise written and oral communication skills.
  • Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production.
  • Experience with the project management of technical projects.
  • Proficiency in Python, including NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Plotly, and Matplotlib.
  • Familiarity with relevant industry standards, including IPC, JEDEC, AIAA, AEC, MIL, and SMC standards.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Materials Engineering preferred. Degrees in Mechanical OR Reliability Engineering also are acceptable.
  • 3+ years of experience in hardware reliability engineering, preferably with a focus on aerospace or automotive applications.
  • Proficiency in failure analysis techniques and materials characterization methods
  • Experience with environmental testing, including temperature cycling, vibration, highly accelerated limit testing (HALT), and highly-accelerated stress screening (HASS).
  • Familiarity with PCB fabrication, SMT, and polymerics application manufacturing processes
  • Significant knowledge of reliability engineering principles, methods, and tools

description:

Company Description

We are building infrastructure that helps teams developing autonomous AI agents understand, monitor, and improve how their systems behave in production.

As AI agents become more capable and are deployed across increasingly complex workflows, understanding their behavior and identifying why they fail becomes critical. Our platform helps engineering teams investigate agent interactions, identify behavioral patterns, debug failures, and improve reliability through structured evaluations and verification workflows.

The engineering team is small, fast-moving, and focused on building tools that solve challenging problems for developers working with production AI systems. Engineers have significant ownership over product development, from understanding customer problems and defining solutions to building and iterating on the product.

We are looking for a backend-leaning Full Stack Engineer who enjoys building great software, working through ambiguity, and taking ownership of problems end-to-end. The role offers the opportunity to work across APIs, data models, internal systems, and polished product experiences while building tools that AI engineering teams rely on.

What You Will Do

1. Build Core Product Experiences

  • Build core product experiences across investigation interfaces, evaluation workflows, debugging tools, verification, and replay systems.

  • Develop interfaces that help engineers understand complex agent behavior, investigate failures, and identify patterns across production interactions.

  • Build intuitive product surfaces that make complex technical workflows easier to understand and use.

  • Contribute to the development of tools that help AI teams improve the reliability of their production agents.

2. Own Problems End-to-End

  • Talk directly with customers to understand where their agents fail and what problems they need to solve.

  • Define product requirements, identify solutions, build features, and iterate based on customer feedback.

  • Take ownership of projects from problem discovery through implementation and delivery.

  • Work through ambiguous problems independently and turn them into practical product solutions.

3. Build Across the Full Stack

  • Ship across the full stack, with a stronger emphasis on backend engineering.

  • Design and implement APIs, data models, internal systems, and product interfaces.

  • Build platform infrastructure including workspaces, permissions, billing, usage systems, and SDKs.

  • Contribute to terminal-first developer experiences and integrations.

  • Build scalable, maintainable systems that support complex agent investigation workflows.

4. Build AI-Powered Investigation Systems

  • Contribute to the development of an agent that runs large-scale investigations across production traces.

  • Build systems that help investigate agent failures, tool errors, behavioral regressions, instruction drift, and edge cases.

  • Work with production agent traces and turn complex interaction data into actionable insights.

  • Collaborate with AI teams to understand agent behavior and translate their challenges into product improvements.

5. Work Directly with AI Engineering Teams

  • Work closely with teams building and deploying production AI agents.

  • Understand how their agents behave, where they fail, and what makes them unreliable.

  • Translate real-world customer problems into product and engineering decisions.

  • Help build tools that allow developers to debug, evaluate, and improve their agents.

Ideal Candidate Background

  • 5–8 years of experience in full-stack product engineering, with a backend-leaning profile. Confirm experience range with the hiring team, as the initial role description also states 2–5 years.

  • Has shipped production products end-to-end.

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience building APIs, data models, and internal systems.

  • Comfortable working across the full stack, including frontend product interfaces.

  • Experience building high-quality software at reputable technology companies or Series B+ startups.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to take projects from customer discovery through implementation and iteration.

  • Enjoys building developer-facing products and solving complex engineering problems.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with AI agents or agentic systems.

  • Experience building developer tools.

  • Experience with observability, monitoring, or debugging products.

  • Experience working with production AI systems and agent traces.

  • Familiarity with evaluation, verification, and replay workflows.

Technical Requirements

Core Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React

  • Next.js

  • Python

  • Node.js

  • PostgreSQL

Engineering Requirements

  • Strong full-stack product engineering experience.

  • Backend-leaning engineering capabilities.

  • Experience building APIs and data models.

  • Experience developing complex product interfaces.

  • Ability to work across frontend, backend, and platform systems.

  • Experience shipping production software end-to-end.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals and ability to work independently.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $230K–$300K.

  • Equity: Competitive equity.

  • Visa: Open to visa transfers, including OPT and H-1B transfers. Additional sponsorship reviewed case-by-case for exceptional candidates.

title: Cell Test Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Factorial Energy is a pioneering U.S.-based solid-state battery company driving the future of energy storage and electrification. Partnered with global leaders including Mercedes-Benz, Stellantis, Hyundai, and Kia, Factorial is at the forefront of developing next-generation e-mobility platforms for commercial, defense, and consumer applications—spanning electric vehicles (EVs), drones, eVTOL aircraft, power tools, marine systems, robotics, and more. The company has achieved multiple industry firsts, including being the first to power a demonstration vehicle with a global OEM (Mercedes- Benz), which achieved over 1,200 km (749 mi) of range, and the first to earn UN 38.3 certification for automotive-sized lithium-metal solid-state cells, and the first to deliver B-samples of automotive-sized solid-state batteries to major OEMs.

The Opportunity:

Factorial Energy is seeking a Cell Test Engineer to join our team in Cheonan, South Korea. This is an entry-level, hands-on role responsible for keeping our internal cell test lab running day to day: operating and maintaining test equipment, putting cells on test, and translating cell owners' requirements into test protocols. It is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate to build a foundation in lithium-metal and solid-state battery testing alongside an experienced development team.

In this role, you will:

  • Operate the internal cell test lab day to day, including loading and unloading cells, setting up fixtures, and starting, monitoring, and closing out tests
  • Perform routine checks, calibration, and basic maintenance of test equipment (cyclers, environmental chambers, EIS, etc.), troubleshoot issues, and coordinate repairs with vendors
  • Write test protocols and cycler schedules based on requirements from cell owners, and confirm test conditions before launch
  • Track test status, channel and chamber utilization, and schedules, and promptly communicate progress and anomalies to cell owners
  • Maintain accurate test records and sample tracking, and ensure test data is uploaded to the cell database
  • Follow and help enforce lab safety procedures, including handling of lithium-metal cells, response to abnormal cells, and hazardous waste disposal
  • Coordinate with external test labs for UN 38.3 and safety/abuse testing, including sample preparation, shipping documentation, scheduling, and report follow-up
  • Support basic data processing and test summary reports as needed

We are looking for people who:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Chemical, Mechanical, or Materials Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field
  • 0–2 years of experience; internship or academic lab experience with batteries or electrochemical testing is a plus
  • Basic understanding of how lithium batteries work (charge/discharge, capacity, C-rate, SOC)
  • Hands-on and detail-oriented, comfortable with routine lab work and test equipment
  • Strong safety awareness and discipline in following procedures
  • Proficient in Excel; familiarity with battery cyclers (e.g., Neware, Maccor, Arbin) or Python is a plus
  • Good communication and teamwork skills, able to work effectively with cell owners and external labs
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken), basic Chinese communication capability is preferred.

Work Location:

Cheonan, South Korea

Factorial Energy is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.

title: Crew Lead, BAS (Building Automation Specialist)
description:
SUMMARY

The Crew Lead - BAS is responsible for overseeing a team of BAS Technicians in the delivery of preventative and corrective maintenance, routine and on-demand services on facility BAS equipment and systems for multiple facilities. The Crew Lead - BAS is responsible for overseeing the execution of activities performed by BAS Technicians to ensure that work is performed in accordance with established processes and practices and is in compliant with all internal and external requirements including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, fire protection. In addition to people leadership responsibilities, the Crew Lead - BAS also performs and delivers preventative and corrective maintenance as well as routine and on-demand services.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

People Leadership

  • Leads a team of individual contributors
  • Assigns, prioritizes and monitors work progress to ensure completion and adherence to timeliness, quality standards and all other related requirements
  • Reviews work for completeness and accuracy. Ensures quality adherence is maintained
  • Guides, coaches and trains direct reports
  • Provides input for performance review

Leads the delivery of as well as performs the following subject to legislative licensing requirements:

  • Ensure zero safety incidents by adhering to safety protocols, completing required training, conducting Job Hazard Risk Assessments (JHRA), and maintaining PPE and tool inspections.
  • Oversees and monitors BAS Technicians' activities and performance, acting as a subject matter expert (SME) to guide, mentor, and support team members. Lead safety and operational meetings, provide training, and foster continuous learning.
  • Perform and supervise facility walkthroughs, BAS system inspections, preventative maintenance, and corrective repairs to meet uptime objectives and maintain asset integrity.
  • Regularly inspect and monitor facility, BAS systems, and equipment conditions, providing recommendations for enhancements and repairs.

  • Oversee work order records, ensuring timely completion, closure, and zero aging.
  • Collaborate with Electricians, HVAC mechanics, external vendors, and various teams (Energy, Smart Buildings, Remote Command Centre) to drive cost savings, improve operational efficiency, and ensure uninterrupted operations.
  • Foster positive client relationships by addressing escalations swiftly, delivering high-quality solutions, and ensuring occupant comfort and satisfaction. Provide accurate repair cost and time estimates and oversee repair execution.
  • Oversees the maintenance of as well as maintains work order records within service management maintenance database. Initiates documents to obtain formal approval of work required
  • Coordinates and assists in the implementation of preventative maintenance program. Ensures that deficiencies are identified, recorded and escalated, and that related documentations are maintained
  • Coordinates and participates in facility-related projects
  • Oversees and maintains all assigned tools and arranges for repair and replacement where required. Submits all expenditures on a timely basis
  • Provides, participates and supports training, safety meetings, operational meetings, toolbox talks, etc.
  • Must be able and willing to work shifts, be available for on-call/standby and emergency callouts as they arise
  • Assists in enhancing tenant and customer satisfaction and maintaining positive relations through manner in which work is performed and services delivered
  • Other duties as assigned

Work Requirements

  • Must be able to work shifts, be on-call and be available to respond to emergencies
  • Must be willing to wear personal protective equipment
  • Must be able and willing to drive to and perform work at multiple sites

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • More than 5 years of facility operations and maintenance work experience
  • Previous people leadership experience, preferred
  • High school diploma plus trades training and certification
  • Ability to lead a team of individuals
  • Highly-advanced ability to adhere to processes and practices relating to facility operations and maintenance
  • Highly advanced ability to maintain and repair BAS equipment and systems
  • Highly advanced BAS equipment and system troubleshooting and resolution skills
  • Current knowledge of fire, life, safety and building codes and standards and ability to research and apply related codes and standards
  • Possesses a high level of environmental, health and safety mindset. Ability to perform work in a safe manner
  • Strong client-service orientation along with a high sense of urgency
  • Effective communication skills for the purpose of data relay, exchange, feedback, and clarification

Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation

  • Niagara N4 Certification
  • Must meet enhanced security clearance requirements
  • Valid drivers’ license

This is a regular, full-time position with an hourly range of $53.81 - $63.30. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role.

title: Care Transition Liaison
description:
JOB SPECIFICATIONS:

Title: Care Transition Liaison

Location: Greater Manchester / Bedford area

Schedule: Monday-Friday | 8AM-4:30PM

Salary: $75,000 - $85,000 / year



At Granite VNA, New Hampshire’s largest home health and hospice provider, we believe in care that helps our patients return to living the life they desire. The care we provide is personal and meaningful.


Transitions can feel overwhelming - your compassion can make all the difference. As a Care Transition Liaison at Granite VNA, you'll be there to listen, guide, and connect patients with the care they need to feel safe and supported at home.


Position Overview


Reporting to the Business Development Manager, the Care Transition Liaison works collaboratively with assigned referral sources to facilitate a smooth transition to wherever they call home with Granite VNA services. The Care Transition Liaison will be an ambassador for all Granite VNA services by providing education, in-services, and will provide guidance on how patients can access their home care and hospice benefit. This versatile position will cultivate relationships with a variety of professionals, peers, patients, and caregivers.


Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Works with Director of Business Development to develop a business plan that is focused on maintaining strong relationships and promoting growth opportunities for lower performing accounts.
  • Achieves monthly referral and admission goals as established in business plan.
  • Works with assigned account(s) to coordinate and collect information for patient referrals to ensure smooth transitions of care from facility to home with Granite VNA services.
  • Actively collaborates with patients and families; provides education and resources to PT/OT/SLP so that they are successful in their discharge plan, ensures that they are aware of our services and given an opportunity to ask questions and provide input.
  • Serves as an ambassador for all Granite VNA programs and services and is skilled in using value propositions to set us apart from competitors.
  • Utilizes professional knowledge and critical thinking skills to support referral needs while communicating with providers in various healthcare settings.
  • Monitors level of satisfaction of current clients and referral source contracts. Works with Director of Business Development to enhance relationships as needed.
  • Utilizes problem solving skills in providing solutions to challenging referrals.
  • Develops and maintains a working knowledge of the Agency's referral process.
  • Works directly with the Director of Business Development on coordination of care for complex patients, and any non-medical patient needs.
  • Completes appropriate documentation in a timely manner in liaison log, referral forms, and Electronic Medical Record (EMR).

Other Job Functions

  • Actively participates in team planning meetings and offers constructive input.
  • Cross trains to learn coverage and support of team member accounts.
  • Travel to assigned accounts is expected to be no less than 80% of time.
  • Adheres to work schedules and attendance according to agency standard.

Comprehensive Benefits

  • Competitive compensation
  • Mileage reimbursement at the federal rate
  • Health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • Earned Time Off
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Continuing education and career advancement opportunities
  • AI-powered documentation tools designed to reduce paperwork
  • Granite VNA apparel stipend


Expected Hours of Work

The employee will be scheduled to work based on the needs of the Agency. Work hours generally are scheduled between Monday – Friday during the hours of 8am – 4:30 pm. Will rotate coverage for one minor holiday per year.

We are seeking a Data & BI Manager to drive the vision, roadmap and cross-functional delivery of enterprise data and business intelligence solutions that empower stakeholders with trusted data, actionable insights and self-service capabilities. The role serves as the primary bridge between product owners, business stakeholders, BI, data engineering, data governance and application development teams, ensuring platform initiatives are well planned, prioritized and executed. The ideal candidate combines product thinking, BI expertise, stakeholder management and program leadership to deliver scalable data products, integrated reporting experiences and roadmap-driven enhancements aligned to organizational objectives.

  • Own and maintain the strategic roadmap for the data and BI platform, defining short- and long-term goals and success metrics, and prioritizing initiatives based on business value, stakeholder needs, technical dependencies and resource capacity

  • Proactively identify risks, blockers and competing priorities and drive them to resolution
  • Partner with BI Managers and Analytics teams to define reporting and dashboard strategy, and prioritize KPI reporting, executive dashboards, self-service analytics and business insights capabilities that are scalable, consistent and aligned to business objectives
  • Promote adoption of BI tools, analytics best practices and data-driven decision making across the organization
  • Collaborate with Data Governance teams to uphold data standards, policies and stewardship practices, supporting data quality, metadata management, access controls and compliance requirements
  • Drive governance reviews for new data products and reporting use cases, championing trusted and reliable data across all platform experiences
  • Serve as the primary liaison between business users and technical delivery teams, gathering, validating and prioritizing business requirements and building strong partnerships across business and technology functions
  • Translate business requirements into actionable delivery plans with development and analytics teams, overseeing release planning, backlog management and feature prioritization for enhancements, integrations, reports, dashboards and platform capabilities
  • Communicate roadmap progress, platform performance and upcoming releases to leadership and stakeholders, and monitor adoption, usage trends and business outcomes to continuously improve the platform

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Business or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in Data, Analytics, Business Intelligence, Product Management or Program Management roles
  • Experience working with BI and analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar technologies
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing, reporting, analytics and data engineering concepts
  • Proven experience managing cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholder groups
  • Experience translating business requirements into prioritized roadmaps and delivery plans
  • Strong communication, facilitation and executive presentation skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with enterprise data and analytics platforms supporting reporting, insights, and decision-making.
  • Familiarity with data governance, privacy, compliance, and data stewardship practices.
  • Experience working in Agile environments using Jira, AWS, or similar tools.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, KPI development, and business reporting frameworks.
  • Experience developing dashboards, scorecards, and self-service analytics solutions.
  • Relevant certifications in Agile, Project Management, Data Analytics, Cloud, or Business Intelligence platforms

title: Design Director - Google Store
description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

We are looking for a Director, Visual Design who is part visionary, part practitioner, and entirely uncompromising when it comes to quality. This is an embedded, high-impact role with an operational split of hands-on visual craft and team leadership. You will act as an autonomous "player-coach" who leads by doing—defining the work directly in working files, setting the bar for excellence, and solving complex design challenges in real time. Your experience and hands on skill will play a crucial role in leading craft teams to world-class work as well as guiding clients and partners toward successful outcomes. Your fluency in the world of design across brand, motion, and digital helps you lead large scale, integrated teams towards successful outcomes.

You will fully own major digital workstreams, product detail pages (PDPs), and large-scale interactive launches. Operating comfortably within established, robust design systems, you will translate high-level narratives and brand strategy into compelling, innovative web experiences. You are a tastemaker and strategic problem solver capable of navigating ambiguity, prioritizing deadlines, and fostering deep creative trust.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own Hands-On Craft: Lead from the front by sketching, designing, prototyping, and polishing in Figma. Define industry-leading visual standards, typography, narrative storytelling, and interaction design for high-traffic web pages and product launches.
  • Lead Within Design Systems: Creatively push boundaries while maintaining strict consistency and rigor within complex, multi-tiered design systems and digital component libraries.
  • Drive Embedded Client Collaboration: Flourish in a highly embedded, fast-paced environment. Collaborate directly and transparently with client creative leads through live co-creation, sprint-based ideation, shared working files, and regular standups.
  • Navigate Ambiguity & Prioritize: Operate with high autonomy, translating high-level, ambiguous briefs into clear, phased deliverables under strict launch timelines.
  • Team Guidance & Mentorship: Provide creative direction and support to the team. Elevate junior and mid-level talent through actionable feedback, design critiques, and structured mentorship.
  • Manage Deadlines & Production: Partner with project and client leadership to ensure workstreams exceed aesthetic standards while delivering strictly on schedule.

WHAT YOU BRING:

  • 8+ years of proven experience in digital visual design, web design, and interactive work for world-class brands, including 2+ years in a design leadership or lead practitioner capacity.
  • Exceptional Portfolio: A proven track record demonstrating world-class digital craft, narrative web design, PDPs/e-commerce experiences, interactive storytelling, and sophisticated typographic hierarchy.
  • Design Systems Mastery: Deep expertise designing within and scaling robust, multi-brand digital design systems in Figma (auto-layout, nested components, design tokens, responsive variants).
  • Embedded Client Fluency: Extensive experience presenting work and working directly with enterprise client creative leads and cross-functional partners.
  • Agility & Autonomous Ownership: High comfort level working in rapid sprint cycles, live collaborative files, and fast-moving launch cadences.
  • Time Zone Flexibility: Ability to work core hours aligned with Pacific Time (PT) (candidates located across US time zones welcome, provided they can flex to PT hours when needed).
  • Tools: Mastery of Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; familiarity with modern collaboration tools (Slack, Google Workspace).



WHAT DO WE OFFER?

  • Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • 401K plan, plus matching
  • PTO
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Parental Leave

title: Adviseur leren en ontwikkelen
description:
Als adviseur Leren en Ontwikkelen geef je richting aan leren binnen Gemeente Edam-Volendam. Je verbindt de ontwikkeling van medewerkers en teams aan onze ambities voor de toekomst en helpt zo onze organisatie en dienstverlening verder vooruit. Is dit jouw volgende stap?

Over de functie
Gemeente Edam-Volendam wil zich ontwikkelen tot een lerende organisatie. Een organisatie waarin leren een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel is van het dagelijkse werk. Waarin medewerkers verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor hun ontwikkeling en leidinggevenden en teams actief bijdragen aan groei. Leren en ontwikkelen is daarbij geen doel op zichzelf, maar een middel om onze organisatie verder te ontwikkelen en onze dienstverlening toekomstbestendig te houden.

Als adviseur Leren en ontwikkelen help je deze ambitie vorm te geven. Je zorgt voor een visie hierop en geeft hier invulling aan. Daarbij verbind je leer- en ontwikkelvragen aan de Toekomstvisie 2050 en aan wat de organisatie nodig heeft om haar doelen te realiseren.

Wat ga je doen
  • Je zorgt voor een duidelijke en uitvoerbare visie op leren en ontwikkelen die aansluit bij de organisatieontwikkeling.
  • Je brengt de leer- en ontwikkelbehoeften van medewerkers, teams en leidinggevenden in kaart.
  • Je adviseert leidinggevenden over passende leerinterventies en ontwikkeltrajecten en helpt deze vorm te geven.
  • Je begeleidt medewerkers bij hun loopbaan- en/of ontwikkelvragen.
  • Je beheert en ontwikkelt ons leerplatform Learn365.
  • Je evalueert leeractiviteiten aan de hand van resultaten en feedback en gebruikt de inzichten om het aanbod verder te verbeteren.
  • Je ontwikkelt leerpaden voor verschillende vakgebieden op ons onboardingssysteem Appical.
  • Je voert de regie op externe opleiders en coaches (uit onze coachpool).
  • Je geeft onze talentenpool nieuwe impulsen en onderzoekt het werken met trainees.
  • Je adviseert over de beschikbare en benodigde budgetten voor leren en ontwikkelen, bewaakt de inzet ervan en rapporteert hierover. Je zorgt voor een doelmatige en zorgvuldige besteding van de beschikbare middelen.

Wat bieden wij jou?
Wij bieden een uitdagende functie van 24 uur per week, met een salaris tot maximaal €5.624,- bruto per maand bij een 36-urige werkweek (salarisschaal 10) afhankelijk van kennis, opleiding en ervaring. Hiernaast kun je rekenen op een aantrekkelijk secundair arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket, waaronder:
  • Een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) van 17,05% van je brutosalaris, dat je onder andere kunt inzetten voor uitbetaling, extra verlof of scholing.
  • Een maandelijkse tegemoetkoming in de contributie van je sportvereniging of -school.
  • Een vergoeding van € 168 per jaar voor de kosten van je zorgverzekering.
  • Een reiskostenvergoeding woon-werkverkeer van €0,23 per kilometer, vanaf vijf kilometer enkele reis, of een thuiswerkvergoeding van €3,25 per dag.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling bij ABP.
  • 100% vergoeding van OV-reiskosten wanneer je met het openbaar vervoer reist.
  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging.
  • Loyale en bevlogen collega’s die van doorpakken weten.
  • Een informele en collegiale sfeer met veel humor, waar je je snel thuis voelt.

Wat breng jij mee?
  • Je beschikt over een afgeronde opleiding op minimaal hbo-niveau, bij voorkeur in leren en ontwikkelen, opleidingskunde, onderwijskunde, HR of een vergelijkbare richting.
  • Ervaring met leren en ontwikkelen, talentontwikkeling of organisatieontwikkeling.
  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en organiseren van leerprogramma's of opleidingsactiviteiten.
  • Je kunt goed meedenken en adviseren over passende maatregelen, regelingen en mogelijkheden.

Over het team
Je maakt deel uit van het P&O-team en bent daarbinnen verantwoordelijk voor het aandachtsgebied leren en ontwikkelen. Je werkt nauw samen met drie HR-adviseurs, drie P&O-ondersteuners, de adviseur Werving en Selectie, de adviseur Arbo en Vitaliteit en de teamleider. Samen verbind je Leren en ontwikkelen met de vragen en ontwikkelingen die binnen de organisatie spelen.

Het is een hecht en betrokken team waar hard wordt gewerkt, maar waar ook ruimte is voor humor, luchtige gesprekken en een goed gesprek tussendoor. De sfeer is informeel en gezellig, met onderwerpen die net zo goed over het werk gaan als over voetbal, auto’s of het dagelijkse leven. Juist die combinatie van professionaliteit, betrokkenheid en plezier maakt het een fijne plek om te werken.

Waarom werken bij de gemeente Edam Volendam
Werken bij Edam-Volendam is nooit saai. We hebben alles: stad, dorp, platteland, betaald voetbal, dubbele vergrijzing, boeren, toerisme, horeca, muziek en cultuur. We zijn een grote kleine ontwikkelgemeente. Onze projecten zijn groter dan je van een gemeente van onze omvang verwacht.

De gemeentelijke organisatie is een afspiegeling van de dynamiek van de samenleving. Een mix van gedreven collega’s die er al lang werken, loyaal zijn en vol zitten met kennis. En nieuwe collega’s die zaken met een frisse open blik benaderen. We streven naar een gewoon goede dienstverlening. Wij zorgen dat de juiste mensen op de juiste plek zitten. Daarom heb je bij ons de mogelijkheid om opleidingen te volgen en door te ontwikkelen. Wij zorgen voor een goede interne mobiliteit en doorgroeimogelijkheden. Thuiswerken mag, maar we hebben geen thuiswerkcultuur. We werken het liefst samen op een van onze locaties. En we streven naar een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Een voordeel, vanuit alle kanten is er richting onze gemeente vrijwel nooit file. Het gaat in onze gemeente om mensen. Wij staan voor onze mensen. Want mensen maken Edam-Volendam.

Kom jij ons team versterken?
Je reactie met cv en motivatiebrief kun je tot en met 23 november uploaden via het sollicitatieformulier.

Goed om te weten: de sollicitatiegesprekken staan gepland op dinsdag 1 december in de ochtend.

Meer weten over deze vacature?
Dan kun je contact opnemen met Patrick Bonte, teamleider P&O. Voor informatie over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met Esther van Eijk, adviseur Werving en Selectie. Beiden zijn bereikbaar via (0299) 398 398.
