title: Environmental Surveys Project Manager
description:
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

A little more about the role...

You will play a central role in the safe, coordinated delivery of environmental surveys, helping multidisciplinary teams turn survey plans into successful fieldwork and reliable project information. You will connect technical specialists, survey teams, health and safety colleagues, land and site access teams, GIS professionals and project leaders, making sure everyone has clear information at the right time.

This is a process- and programme-focused role rather than a technical or health and safety approval position. You will have the opportunity to improve how surveys are planned and delivered, strengthen collaboration across teams and help resolve risks before they affect mobilisation, budgets or programme commitments.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and maintain an integrated survey programme, aligning scope, access permissions, health and safety preparation, digital tools, seasonal constraints and commercial requirements.
  • Develop practical scheduling and mobilisation processes and communicate clear expectations to technical leads and survey teams.
  • Coordinate survey readiness, including access, briefings, tested proformas, data-quality arrangements and escalation routes.
  • Work with health and safety colleagues to establish effective survey processes, including risk assessments, briefings, incident reporting and training requirements.
  • Partner with GIS and technical teams so digital tools, survey proformas and data-capture requirements are practical and ready for use.
  • Agree data quality, checking, sign-off, storage, version control and handover arrangements with technical leads.
  • Maintain a live record of risks, assumptions, issues and decisions, escalating emerging concerns and proposing practical mitigations.
  • Monitor programme logic, critical-path impacts, budgets, forecasts and change, including support for early warnings where required.
  • Act as a single point of coordination during survey delivery, supporting a safe, inclusive environment in which team members can raise concerns and contribute ideas.

Success will mean surveys mobilise safely and on time, teams receive clear and consistent instructions, dependencies and decisions remain visible, and outputs meet programme needs with minimal avoidable rework.

What we are looking for you to demonstrate...

  • Experience coordinating complex programmes, projects or field-based activities involving several teams and dependencies.
  • A strong commitment to health and safety, wellbeing and inclusive ways of working, with the confidence to escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Clear communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to bring technical and non-technical colleagues together.
  • Strong planning and organisational skills, including the ability to manage changing priorities, risks, assumptions and decisions.
  • Experience monitoring programme progress and budgets, forecasting impacts and supporting change management.
  • An understanding of data-quality processes and confidence working with digital tools or GIS colleagues; specialist GIS expertise is not required.
  • A proactive, practical approach to solving problems and improving processes.

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

title: Principal Transformation Consultant
description:
About Valiantys

Valiantys is a global leader in consulting and services for the Atlassian ecosystem, helping businesses transform their IT operations and business processes. With a focus on driving operational excellence, innovation, and agility, we empower organizations to achieve their goals through tailored solutions for Atlassian tools and adjacent technologies.
Joining Valiantys means becoming part of a growing company driven by a culture of innovation, collaboration, and respect for individuals, where every contribution helps shape the digital future of businesses.

Job summary

As a Principal Transformation Consultant, you will be responsible for managing key client relationships, ensuring the successful delivery of consulting engagements, and driving business growth. You will act as a strategic partner to senior client stakeholders, helping them navigate complex transformation initiatives, including large-scale cloud migrations and technology modernisation programmes, while expanding the firm’s footprint within the accounts you manage.

A core aspect of the role is consultative-led selling: identifying client needs through deep discovery, shaping compelling value propositions, and converting those into tangible engagements. You will blend strategic advisory with commercial acumen, playing a leading role in both winning and delivering transformation work. You will report to the Transformation Consulting Director

Things you will be working on

Client partnership & engagement delivery

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for client stakeholders across transformation initiatives, building trusted advisor relationships at C-level and programme director level.
  • Understand clients’ business goals, technology landscape, and transformation drivers, aligning solutions based on the Atlassian stack and related technologies.
  • Lead and support delivery teams to ensure smooth execution, quality outcomes, and client satisfaction across complex, multi-workstream programmes.
  • Contribute to the coordination and success of transformation projects—including cloud migrations, platform consolidation, and enterprise toolchain modernisation—focusing on measurable business value.

Technology & Transformation

  • Bring experience of enterprise technology environments, with a strong understanding of cloud platforms, migration methodologies, and the technical and organisational challenges of moving from on-premise to cloud at scale.
  • Guide clients through migration readiness assessments, architecture considerations, and transition planning for digital platforms.
  • Stay current with evolving Atlassian capabilities, cloud-native tooling, and wider enterprise technology trends to ensure our advisory is credible, differentiated, and forward-looking.
  • Bridge the gap between technical delivery teams and business stakeholders, translating complex technology decisions into clear strategic narratives.
  • Knowledge of AI solutions and use cases.

Consultative-Led Selling & Business Development

  • Lead consultative selling efforts: conduct structured discovery with clients, identify pain points and opportunities, and shape proposals that connect directly to business outcomes.
  • Own and drive account growth strategies for assigned accounts, identifying upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities through ongoing client engagement.
  • Collaborate closely with the sales team using MEDDPICC-aligned qualification to progress opportunities from identification through to close.
  • Develop compelling Statements of Work, business cases, and go-to-market assets that position Valiantys’s transformation capabilities clearly and credibly.
  • Support strategic planning and proposal efforts, contributing commercial and technical insight to pricing, scoping, and risk assessment.

Solution Design & Value Creation

  • Co-develop transformation offerings in collaboration with internal practices (e.g. AI, Cloud, ITSM, Agile at Scale).
  • Translate business and IT requirements into clear value propositions, project scopes, and transformation roadmaps.
  • Contribute to building reusable approaches, templates, and frameworks (e.g. for ITSM transformation, AI, cloud migration, PPPM maturity) that codify Valiantys’s methodology.

Team Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Act as a mentor and sparring partner for consultants at all levels, contributing to knowledge growth, capability development, and team performance.
  • Share market intelligence, client insights, and delivery learnings internally to enhance offering development and delivery practices.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement, professional rigour, and client-centricity across the UKI consulting team.

Do you have what it takes to be a Transformation Principal?

Essential Experience & Skills

  • A minimum of 10 years’ experience in consulting, professional services, or transformation delivery roles, with significant exposure to business and IT transformation programmes.
  • Proven experience leading or playing a senior role in enterprise cloud migration or technology modernisation initiatives.
  • Demonstrable track record in consultative selling, shaping opportunities through discovery, building client business cases, and converting advisory engagements into revenue.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise technology landscapes, including cloud platforms (Atlassian Cloud, AWS), DevOps toolchains, and ITSM/PPPM disciplines.
  • Proven ability to build and sustain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders (Director, VP, C-level) and to influence decision-making at that level.
  • Experience managing and growing client accounts with a clear contribution to revenue targets.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, comfortable leading workshops, steering committees, and executive briefings.
  • Adaptable and proactive, thriving in dynamic environments where you balance strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving.

Desirable

  • Experience working within or alongside the Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management) or comparable enterprise platforms.
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or similar structured sales qualification methodologies.
  • Experience with Agile at Scale frameworks (SAFe, LeSS, or bespoke) and their application in large enterprise settings.
  • Exposure to managed services or Total Care-style ongoing client engagements.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Atlassian, ITIL, PMP, SAFe, cloud platform certifications).
  • Ability to shape Valiantys AI Strategy based on actual Customer Outcomes and Use Cases.
Location & Working Arrangements

This role is based in the United Kingdom. We are opened to remote working across the UK with regular travel to client sites and the London office as required.

Some travel within the wider EMEA region may be expected.

Why Join Valiantys?

Join a fast-growing, innovation-driven organization where transformation is at the heart of everything we do. As part of our team, you’ll help shape the future of Developer Experience transformation by working with global enterprises to optimize software delivery. You'll collaborate closely with top-tier experts in IT consulting, business transformation, and DevEx, all within a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment that values impact, creativity, and continuous improvement.

Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to personal background, identity, or beliefs.

title: Interrelated-Sr High (2027-2028 School
description:
Job Title\: Special Education Teacher- Interrelated Secondary High School

Position Function\: This position plans, leads, facilitates and provides instruction for maximum student learning in the Interrelated Classroom providing appropriate curriculum to identified special education students. Meets established outcomes based on student's individual education plan (IEP) and capacity to master learning objectives. Provides activities designed to create interest and enthusiasm for personal grasp of knowledge.

Essential Performance Responsibilities\:

  • Participates on pre-assessment teams to determine necessity for comprehensive student evaluation; initiates, schedules and attends IEP meetings' works with multi-disciplinary team to diagnose need; structures/implements IEP for each student identified
  • Defines, structures, and communicates daily expectations according to IEP including but not limited to course goals, objectives, learning methods and activities
  • Communicates with regular education staff members on course instructional and meditative strategies and objectives, students' grasp of material and their outcomes and perspectives for applications of materials learned
  • Receives and reports grades, in-puts student data via computer, negotiates schedules and communicates with all pertinent participants-- administration, parents, staff, students, etc.
  • Controls classroom and individual behavior; adapts and adjusts course content and reading levels to specify skills to be taught; discerns means of building memory and study skills; and assists individual students in achieving academic, daily living and social skills, learning objectives by working with them individually and in small groups
  • Presents various listening and learning opportunities appropriate to each student's IEP including by not limited to lecture, VCR, TV, support of regular classroom teachers and other presentations and/or opportunities inside or outside
  • Prepares, displays events and reinforcement activities which encourage participation.
  • Evaluates and Communicates
  • Plans assessments for evaluation to include but not limited to various diagnostic techniques-- standardized survey and criterion-referenced test; teacher developed oral and written tests; student personal indices (effort, potential, interests, memory)
  • Designs subject-based reinforcement to follow assessments and student's learning objectives (computer, lab activities, working independently or on group projects, field/community reinforcement.)
  • Designs a grading system which encourages motivation and participation; collects and enters student data in computer from charts and observations and reports progress in growth and development regularly as required
  • Designs classroom rules for student interaction (courtesy and respect for belongings, space and ideas), self control, working independently, appropriately gaining the floor, and accepting reminders from teacher; designs systems for handling all behavior (from simple infractions to severe behavior)
  • Prepares physical condition of classroom to reflect seasons and subject matter to facilitate student learning
  • Keeps daily records on but not limited to student attendance, learning and social needs, assignments, assessments and discipline; supervises paraprofessional(s)
  • Manages all job duties with the mobility, agility, dexterity and focused observation necessary to adequately perform the essential duties, as described above

Additional Duties\: Assists with additional duties as assigned by supervisor.

Equipment\: This position may require the ability to use SMART boards and iPads in addition to basic office equipment such as computers, copiers, scanners, and fax machine. Must always comply with WPS guidelines for equipment use.

Travel\: Limited travel between schools and central offices may be required.

Physical and Mental Demands\:

  • Occasional lifting up to 20 lbs.
  • Occasional carrying up to 20 lbs.
  • Pushing/pulling up to 20 lbs. for distances of up to more than 100 feet
  • Frequent reaching below waist, occasional reaching waist to shoulder, and limited overhead reaching
  • Frequent sitting
  • Frequent standing/walking

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities\:

  • Ability to communicate both verbally and written in order to communicate with others inside and outside of the organization for the purpose of giving and obtaining information
  • Ability to communicate effectively with a Supervisor when their discretion is needed
  • Ability to perform as an effective team player
  • Ability to plan, organize, make decisions and prioritize work to meet the daily demands of the building
  • Exhibit a professional manner and a positive attitude
  • Use good judgment to make decisions on recurring assignments
  • Display a significant degree of professionalism and confidentiality
  • Ability to conform to proper standards of professional dress and appearance
  • Knowledge of company's mission, purpose, goals and the role of every employee in achieving each of them

title: Senior Engineer, Component (R6605)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

Shield AI is redefining autonomous aviation with cutting-edge AI and GPS/RF-denied navigation technologies. Now, we’re building our next-generation aircraft, XBAT, that will push the boundaries of innovation and performance.

As one of the first Component Engineers at Shield AI, you'll be a foundational hire building the function from the ground up — defining process, tooling, and standards, not just executing an existing playbook. You'll guide component selection and own the qualification and lifecycle management of piece-part Electrical, Electronic, and Electromechanical (EEE) components across our aircraft PCBAs — driving decisions that reduce risk, control cost, and ensure long-term product reliability and survivability. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, supply chain and reliability.

What you'll do:

  • Establish and scale Component Engineering processes, tools, and standards as one of the function's first dedicated hires
  • Define baseline quality and certification requirements for EEE components across the XBAT aircraft
  • Qualify and up-screen EEE components for use in aerospace applications, driving environmental and bench-top testing.
  • Own component data and governance in PLM and the ECAD part library, including lifecycle status and approved vendor list
  • Contribute to component failure analysis and root cause efforts
  • Monitor and assess PCNs and lifecycle changes (NRND/EOL), and drive mitigation actions
  • Support supply chain with alternate part evaluations and second-sourcing strategies
  • Engage directly with suppliers to resolve technical questions

Required qualifications:

  • B.S. in an engineering, physics or materials science
  • 5+ years of relevant experience
  • Deep knowledge of EEE components
  • Understanding of Product Lifecycle Management, ECAD tools and structured component libraries
  • Strong judgment in balancing performance, cost and supply chain risk
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical discussions and influence design decisions across engineering, supply chain, and program teams — including in ambiguous, fast-moving environments without an established playbook

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience building or scaling a component engineering function in a startup or fast-growth environment
  • Familiar with industry-standard component qualification process (AEC-Q, NASA, JEDEC, MIL, etc)
  • Knowledge of electrical component manufacturing processes and common failure modes
  • Experience writing specifications/standards for internal company distribution

title: Consultant | Public Advisory
description:
Join Civitta - an international company with 750+ colleagues across 20+ countries. We focus on management consulting, funding, and digital solutions. Originating from Central and Eastern Europe, we also deliver projects across Central Asia, the Middle East, and the United States.
Deliver projects funded by international donors such as the EU, World Bank, EBRD, and others. We support governments worldwide in economic development and institutional strengthening.

You’ll work in cross-border teams on diverse assignments across regions and sectors, and gain hands-on experience to make a tangible difference in the communities and economies we live.
Are you passionate about solving complex business challenges and driving impactful change? We are seeking a Consultant in Jordan to join our advisory team, where you will have the opportunity to work across diverse sectors and practices.

You will:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement consulting projects effectively;
  • Assist in preparing technical proposals to respond to requests for proposals and expressions of interest for public tenders;
  • Conduct industry, competitor, and client-related research to provide actionable insights;
  • Track donor-funded projects in Jordan;
  • Develop training materials and presentations for clients;
  • Coordinate with other consultants to ensure project delivery within timelines and budgets;
  • Maintain regular communication with clients to provide updates and address inquiries;
  • Ensure adherence to company policies and procedures, recommending improvements where needed.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, such as business, economics, finance, or social sciences (Master’s degree is a plus);

  • Proven experience in writing and/or implementing projects;

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts;

  • Excellent organizational skills to track progress and manage multiple projects;

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multicultural environment;

  • Fluency in English and Arabic language (additional languages are a plus);

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data and provide actionable recommendations;

  • Critical thinking skills to identify challenges and propose solutions;

  • Prior experience in a consulting company is considered a plus;

  • Self-motivation and commitment to exceeding expectations;

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).

Benefits:

  • Professional Growth – We support rapid career development, offering performance and salary reviews twice a year to ensure your progress is recognized and rewarded;
  • Flexible Working Hours – manage your workday with flexibility and the option to work from home twice a week;
  • Culture & Connection – From team bonding activities like Christmas parties and summer events to spontaneous celebrations, monthly breakfasts, or team lunches, we celebrate wins—big or small—together;
  • Gifts Programme – Welcome boxes, birthday surprises, and holiday cheer ensure your special moments are always recognized;
  • Continuous Learning – From expert-led trainings to personal development budgets, your growth is our priority.

title: Interior Architect / Interior Designer
description:
LRK is a nationally recognized design firm built around a team of architects, urban designers, planners, and interior designers. We believe that great places are created through successful collaboration and careful consideration of how these disciplines impact and respect the surrounding community.

LRK is seeking a creative, curious, and design-driven Interior Architect/Designer to join our Memphis studio. This is an opportunity to contribute to a diverse range of projects—from dynamic community centers and boutique restaurants to large-scale multifamily, mixed-use, and commercial developments.

Working alongside a collaborative team of architects and designers, you'll have the opportunity to shape thoughtful, engaging environments while expanding your skills across the full design process—from initial vision and concept development through documentation and implementation.

What You'll Do

As part of an integrated design team, you will:

  • Contribute creative ideas to concept development, design storytelling, and collaborative design charrettes.
  • Help shape thoughtful, well-crafted interior environments that respond to the people and places they serve.
  • Research and select materials, finishes, furnishings, and fixtures that support the overall design vision.
  • Develop construction documents and coordinate design details with architects, consultants, and project teams.
  • Apply building codes, accessibility requirements, and technical detailing throughout the design process.
  • Participate in design reviews, share ideas, and contribute to a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and design excellence.
  • Engage in projects of varying scales and complexities, gaining experience and increasing responsibility throughout the design process.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Passionate about design, naturally curious, and eager to learn and grow.
  • Energized by collaboration and working across disciplines.
  • Thoughtful about how materials, space, light, and details shape the human experience.
  • Creative and conceptually driven, with an appreciation for technical excellence.
  • Comfortable communicating ideas visually and verbally.
  • Motivated to take initiative, contribute ideas, and grow as a design professional.

Qualifications

  • 2–6 years of professional interior design or interior architecture experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, Architecture, or a related field required.
  • Experience or interest in multifamily residential, mixed-use, commercial, hospitality, or educational environments preferred.
  • Working knowledge of concept development, construction documentation, and specifications.
  • Familiarity with building codes, accessibility requirements, and technical detailing.
  • Proficiency in Revit required; experience with AutoCAD, Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign and Photoshop), and Microsoft Office preferred.
  • NCIDQ certification and/or LEED accreditation a plus.

Why LRK?

At LRK, we believe great design begins with curiosity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We value fresh perspectives, thoughtful exploration, and the opportunity to create places that inspire connection. If you're excited to grow your career while contributing to a team that values both design excellence and the people behind it, we'd love to hear from you.

For more information on LRK, please visit .

Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Consulent Inkomen
description:
Pak de ruimte in Maashorst als Consulent Inkomen

Uden | 24-36 uur | Vast | Schaal 9

’n Goeie baan barstensvol:
  • Impact: jij zorgt ervoor dat inwoners krijgen waar ze recht op hebben en financieel ondersteund worden wanneer dat nodig is.
  • Afwisseling: je behandelt uiteenlopende aanvragen en verdiept je in de persoonlijke situatie van inwoners. Geen casus is hetzelfde.
  • Samenwerking: je werkt samen met collega’s en externe partners om inwoners zo goed mogelijk te helpen en te zorgen voor een rechtmatige verstrekking van uitkeringen.

Dit ga je doen
Als inkomensconsulent help je inwoners die inkomensondersteuning nodig hebben. Je onderzoekt of zij recht hebben op een uitkering en beoordeelt aanvragen zorgvuldig aan de hand van de geldende wet- en regelgeving. Je voert verdiepende intakegesprekken om de persoonlijke situatie van inwoners in kaart te brengen en onderzoekt of er andere voorzieningen zijn waarop zij aanspraak kunnen maken. Je behandelt zelfstandig aanvragen voor onder andere de Participatiewet, IOAW, bijzondere bijstand en individuele inkomenstoeslag. Ook verstrek je waar nodig voorschotten en zorg je voor een correcte verrekening of terugvordering van uitkeringen. Je informeert inwoners over hun rechten en plichten en geeft uitleg over de mogelijkheden die de Participatiewet biedt.

Daarnaast houd je regie op je eigen caseload. Je analyseert gegevens, onderzoekt signalen die van invloed kunnen zijn op het recht op een uitkering en legt je bevindingen vast in rapportages en de daarvoor bestemde systemen. Je onderhoudt contact met inwoners over hun inkomens-, woon- en vermogenssituatie, de voortgang van hun aanvraag en eventuele wijzigingen in hun uitkering. Waar nodig voer je huisbezoeken uit, werk je samen met partners in de keten en verwijs je inwoners door naar passende voorzieningen of instanties. Zo zorg je ervoor dat inwoners krijgen waar ze recht op hebben en dat uitkeringen rechtmatig worden verstrekt.

Je doet het samen met …
Je komt te werken in het team Inkomen, Participatie en Inburgering. Binnen dit team werk je nauw samen met consulenten inkomen, participatie en inburgering. Ook werk je samen met medewerkers schuldhulpverlening en handhaving. Samen zorgen jullie voor een goede uitvoering van de Participatiewet, en werken jullie aan het verbeteren van onze gemeentelijke dienstverlening. Binnen jouw rol draag je bij aan een zorgvuldige beoordeling van aanvragen en een rechtmatige verstrekking van uitkeringen. Werkplezier vinden we belangrijk: we zoeken elkaar graag op, delen kennis en zijn oprecht geïnteresseerd in elkaar.

Dit zijn wijEven voorstellen. Wij zijn Maashorst. Een jonge gemeente die volop in beweging is. Bij ons vind je het beste van twee werelden: de levendigheid van Uden en de karaktervolle charme van onze kernen, elk met een eigen actief dorpsleven. Omgeven en geïnspireerd door natuur zoals je die nergens anders tegenkomt, pakken wij de ruimte om het anders te doen. Als gemeente weten we waar we heen willen. Maar eerlijk is eerlijk: we hebben nog wat stappen te zetten voordat we daar zijn. Boeiend? Zeker weten! Want er liggen bij ons volop kansen. En dat geeft jou de ruimte om vanaf dag één je mouwen op te stropen en echt impact te maken.

Over impact gesproken: Maashorst barst van de ambities. Met onze visie Maashorst2050 kijken we vooruit naar de gemeente die we willen zijn: een plek waar het ook in 2050 goed wonen, werken en samenleven is. Vanuit ons Samenwerkingsakkoord 2026–2030 ‘Trots op vandaag, werken aan morgen’ zetten we concrete stappen om die toekomst dichterbij te brengen.

Dat doen we graag met een stel vrijzinnige pioniers die zin hebben in een oer-Brabants avontuur. Met jou aan boord willen wij een gemeente zijn die durft én doet en ook ingewikkelde problemen vol vertrouwen aanpakt. Zie jij het al voor je? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Je bent van harte welkom in ons gemeentehuis in het levendige hart van Uden. Tot snel!

En dit helpt jou om ruimte te pakken
  • Een individueel keuzebudget (17,05% van je salaris) waarmee jij de keuzes maakt die bij jou passen. Laat bijvoorbeeld een deel van je maandinkomen uitbetalen of zet dit om in extra verlof of een fietsvergoeding.
  • Zicht op een vast contract
  • Duurzaam reizen loont, ontvang € 0,25 per kilometer als je fietst of loopt, óf 100% vergoeding voor het openbaar vervoer. Reis je minimaal 90% duurzaam? Dan ontvang je bovendien een duurzaamheidsbonus tot € 500 per jaar.
  • Reis je met de auto? Dan ontvang je € 0,15 per kilometer van 9,5 tot 40 km enkele reis, fiscaal aan te vullen tot € 0,25 via het IKB. (onder 9,5 km en boven 40 km kun je € 0,25 via het IKB uitruilen).
  • 28 vakantiedagen bij een 36-urige werkweek.
  • Blijf fit met een korting op je sportabonnement, je ontvangt tot €20 per maand.
  • Je bouwt pensioen op bij het ABP. Wij betalen als werkgever 70% van de premie.
  • Betrokken collega’s en veel gezelligheid (onder meer door de actieve personeelsvereniging.
  • Kansen om je te ontwikkelen, op zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk gebied.

Passen we bij elkaar?
Werken in Maashorst past bij jou als je het leuk vindt om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van onze jonge gemeente en ertegen kunt dat dit soms gepaard gaat met wat turbulentie. Het belangrijkste? Dat je eigenaarschap toont en energie toevoegt aan ons team. Om succesvol te zijn in deze functie breng je daarnaast het volgende mee:
  • Je beschikt over HBO werk- en denkniveau;
  • Werkervaring in de functie van inkomensconsulent is een pre
  • Je hebt aantoonbare kennis op het gebied van de participatiewet en je bent juridisch onderlegd;
  • Een inkomensconsulent dient zowel administratief, financieel als communicatief goed onderlegd te zijn en daarnaast zeer accuraat en computervaardig te zijn.

Kies jij voor Maashorst?
We zijn benieuwd naar jou! Upload uiterlijk 29 november 2026 je motivatie en cv via het sollicitatieformulier hieronder. Na de sluitingsdatum hoor je zo snel mogelijk of je wordt uitgenodigd voor een gesprek.
  • VOG-verklaring is verplicht en dient voor indiensttreding te worden overlegd.

title: Assistant Director of Administration
description:
Temple University's College of Public Health is searching for an Assistant Director of Administration!

Become a part of the Temple family and you will have access to the following\:
A hybrid work schedule
Full medical, dental, vision coverage
Paid time off
11 Paid Holidays
Tuition remission - eligible employees and their dependents can obtain a degree TUITION FREE
A generous retirement plan and so much more!

SALARY RANGE\: $62,000 to $67,000 annually
A variety of important factors are reviewed by HR when considering salary, including job duties, the applicant’s education and experience, all relevant internal equity considerations, department budget, and funding source.

Position Summary\:
The Assistant Director of Administration for the Department of Communication Sciences & Disorders in the College of Public Health serves as a key partner to the Department Chair in advancing the department's administrative, operational, financial, and academic priorities. This position provides oversight of day-to-day departmental operations, including budget management, course scheduling, faculty/staff hiring and onboarding, and administrative processes that support the department's teaching, research, and service missions. The Assistant Director collaborates closely with faculty, staff, students, alumni, Deans Office, and central University partners to address complex issues, facilitate effective communication, ensure timely follow-up, and promote efficient, customer-focused operations that support departmental and institutional goals. The Assistant Director supervises the Department Coordinator and Student Services Coordinator. Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience\:
Bachelor's Degree and at least four years of directly related experience providing administrative support to senior management/executive administration. Must have experience managing departmental budgets.
An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Required Skills and Abilities\:
*Experience supervising full-time employees.
*Experience with academic and financial administration.
*Experience supporting a department head.
*Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
*Strong customer service and interpersonal skills, along with the ability to interact effectively with a diverse constituent population.
*Demonstrated computer skills, and proficiency with Excel and Microsoft Office software.
*Demonstrated critical thinking skills, along with the ability to make sound business decisions.
*Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
*Strong organizational and time management skills, along with the ability to prioritize, work well and focus on simultaneous completion of multiple tasks in a fast-paced work setting.
*Ability to handle confidential information with sensitivity and tact.
*Demonstrated supervisory skills.
*Strong attention to detail.

Preferred Skills and Abilities\:
*Demonstrated computer skills, and proficiency with university programs such as Cognos and Exxat.
*Experience supporting a Chair or faculty/staff in an academic department.

Essential duties\:
Department Administration & Operations
*Oversee administrative operations for the department
*Track projects and due dates for the Chair and the department (i.e. accreditation coordination, advisory board planning, application processes for externships and undergraduate volunteers)
*Oversee coordination of meeting scheduling, seminars, meeting agendas and meeting minutes
*Supervise Department Coordinator with assisting faculty, visitors and other parties to make travel arrangements as needed
*Participate in the development of departmental policies and procedures
Finance & Budgeting
*Ensure accurate budgeting
*Supervise purchasing and reconciliation of department expenses
Course Scheduling & Student Support
*Responsible for course scheduling in collaboration with the Chair, Program Directors, and CPH Academic Affairs office
*Serve as back up for onboarding clinical students including getting them set up in systems and monitoring clearances
Supervision & Human Resources
*Supervise department staff, including timekeeping, purchasing, facilities requests, and adjunct hiring
*Manage onboarding and offboarding employees
*Work with Program Directors to coordinate adjunct hiring spreadsheets, summer pay, and overloads, and oversees processing with HR
*Coordinate and participate in college-wide and department events
*Prepare and format formal correspondence, presentations and reports, on behalf of the department
Communications, Marketing & Recruitment
*Oversee department’s website and social media presence in collaboration with the CPH Marketing and Communications department

*Performs other related duties as assigned


This position is assigned a hybrid work arrangement (on-campus and remote), the duration of this hybrid work arrangement is at the discretion of Temple University and the Department.


Temple University is committed to a policy of equal opportunity for all in every aspect of its operations, including employment, service, and educational programs. The University has pledged not to discriminate on the basis of age, color, disability, marital status, national origin or ethnic origin, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information or veteran status.

Compliance Statement\: In the performance of their functions as detailed in the position description employees have an obligation to avoid ethical, legal, financial and other conflicts of interest to ensure that their actions and outside activities do not conflict with their primary employment responsibilities at the institution. Employees are also expected to understand and be in compliance with applicable laws, University and employment policies and regulations, including NCAA regulations for areas and departments which their essential functions cause them to interact.

Temple University's Annual Security and Fire Safety Report contains statistics, policies, and procedures related to campus safety. Go here to review\: https\://safety.temple.edu/reports-logs/annualsecurity-report

You may request a copy of the report by calling Temple University’s Department of Public Safety at 215- 204-7900.

title: Medewerkers Receptie & Klantcontact
description:
Wij zijn op zoek naar twee

Medewerkers Receptie & Klantcontact

(24 – 28 uur per week)
Ben jij iemand die energie krijgt van contact met mensen en ervoor zorgt dat iedereen zich welkom voelt? Of je nu een inwoner aan de telefoon hebt, een bezoeker ontvangt aan de receptie of iemand verder helpt met een vraag: jij maakt het verschil in het eerste contact met Gemeente Leusden. Met jouw gastvrijheid, enthousiasme en servicegerichte houding zorg je ervoor dat mensen zich gehoord en geholpen voelen. Lijkt het je leuk om hét gezicht en de stem van onze gemeente te zijn? Dan zoeken we jou!

Wat ga je doen?
Als Medewerker Receptie & Klantcontact ben jij een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor inwoners, ondernemers, bezoekers en collega’s. Je bent zowel achter de receptie als binnen het klantcontactcentrum (KCC) actief. Geen dag is hetzelfde: je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende vragen en werkzaamheden en zorgt ervoor dat iedereen op een prettige en professionele manier wordt geholpen.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:
  • Je ontvangt bezoekers aan de receptie, heet hen welkom en zorgt dat zij bij de juiste persoon terechtkomen;
  • Je beantwoordt inkomende telefoontjes en helpt inwoners en ondernemers verder met hun vragen;
  • Je verstrekt informatie over gemeentelijke producten, diensten en procedures of verwijst door naar de juiste collega;
  • Je verwerkt vragen en meldingen en zorgt voor een goede opvolging;
  • Je ondersteunt bij administratieve en facilitaire werkzaamheden rondom de receptie;
  • Je houdt overzicht, ook wanneer er meerdere vragen tegelijk binnenkomen.

Met jouw gastvrije houding en klantgerichte aanpak zorg je ervoor dat inwoners en bezoekers met een goed gevoel contact hebben met Gemeente Leusden

Waar kom je te werken?
Je maakt deel uit van het team Publieksdienstverlening. Binnen dit team werken het klantcontactcentrum (KCC) en de receptie nauw samen. Het KCC is telefonisch het eerste aanspreekpunt voor inwoners en helpt hen met uiteenlopende vragen. De receptie zorgt voor een persoonlijk welkom aan bezoekers in het Huis van Leusden.

Wat bieden wij?
Naast leuke collega’s, de gelegenheid voor eigen initiatief en de ruimte om te groeien bieden we jou:
  • Een uitdagende en veelzijdige functie met maatschappelijke impact;
  • Een collegiaal en enthousiast team;
  • Een jaarcontract, dat bij goed functioneren wordt omgezet in een vast dienstverband;
  • Een salaris tussen de € 2.637,- en € 3.802,- per maand bij een 36-urige werkweek (schaal 6 CAO Gemeenten, per 1 januari 2027), afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring;
  • Een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) van 17,05% van je salaris, naar eigen wens in te zetten voor bijvoorbeeld extra verlof of salaris en een extra netto toelage;
  • Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP;
  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging;
  • Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken voor een goede werk-privébalans;
  • Een laptop van de gemeente en telefoonvergoeding;
  • We stimuleren duurzaam reizen. Daarom vergoeden we OV-kosten (2e klas) volledig of ontvang je bij een woon-werkafstand tot 10 kilometer een fietsvergoeding. Woon je verder weg, dan krijg je een reiskostenvergoeding tot maximaal 50 km enkele reis. Daarnaast ontvang je een thuiswerkvergoeding voor de dagen waarop je vanuit huis werkt.

Wat vragen we?
Je vindt het leuk om contact te hebben met mensen en krijgt energie van het helpen van anderen. Je bent gastvrij, denkt in oplossingen en weet ook op drukke momenten het overzicht te bewaren. Je begrijpt dat je met jouw houding en manier van communiceren het verschil maakt in de ervaring van onze inwoners en bezoekers.

Daarnaast breng je mee:
  • Mbo-werk- en denkniveau;
  • Ervaring in een klantgerichte functie, bijvoorbeeld binnen een receptie, klantenservice of frontoffice;
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een prettige, duidelijke manier van communiceren;
  • Een servicegerichte instelling en het vermogen om je gemakkelijk in te leven in verschillende mensen en situaties;
  • Digitale vaardigheden en het vermogen om snel nieuwe systemen en informatie eigen te maken;
  • Een flexibele instelling: je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen telefonische vragen, bezoekers aan de receptie en verschillende werkzaamheden.

Je bent iemand die graag samenwerkt, initiatief toont en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor een goede dienstverlening.

Wie zijn wij?
Je gaat werken voor de gemeente Leusden: een gemeente met meer dan 30.000 inwoners in het midden van het land. Leusden is een organisatie met korte lijnen en een informele werksfeer. Samen met circa 250 collega’s werk je vanuit een modern, duurzaam en gezellig kantoor: het Huis van Leusden.

Wij zijn een ambitieuze en lerende organisatie die de samenleving vooropstelt. We geloven in de veranderkracht van onze gemeenschap en werken graag mee aan initiatieven waar draagvlak en draagkracht voor is, om zo samen een mooi resultaat neer te zetten.

Onze kernwaarden persoonlijk, eerlijk, eenvoudig en professioneel vormen de basis voor een Leusden waarin iedereen zich welkom voelt en gehoord wordt. Als gemeente met een rijke historie en een moderne samenleving streven we ernaar om de warme, dorpsgerichte benadering te behouden, terwijl we tegelijkertijd professionele en toegankelijke ondersteuning bieden die past bij een groeiende gemeenschap.

Onze dienstverlening is de belangrijkste verbindende schakel tussen de organisatie, het college van burgemeester en wethouders, de gemeenteraad, de inwoners, de ondernemers en de organisaties in Leusden.

Ben je enthousiast geworden?
Solliciteer dan voor 1 december. We zijn benieuwd naar wie jij bent, want naast je ervaring en kwaliteiten vinden we het belangrijk om de persoon achter het cv te leren kennen.

Je ontvangt na de sluitingsdatum binnen vijf werkdagen een terugkoppeling van ons. Geschikte kandidaten worden zo snel mogelijk benaderd. Bij aanstelling gaat de vacature direct offline. De sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats op woensdag 9 december en vrijdag 11 december. Fijn als je deze data alvast vrij kunt houden in je agenda!

Wij vragen van iedere nieuwe medewerker een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). Integriteit komt terug in het sollicitatiegesprek.

Voor inhoudelijke vragen neem gerust contact op met Ronald jager, manager bedrijfsvoering via telefoonnummer 14 033.

Voor informatie over het sollicitatieproces neem je contact op met Rosanna Ibrahim, Corporate Recruiter gemeente Leusden, telefoonnummer 0639244265.

Deze vacature wordt tegelijkertijd intern en extern opengesteld. Bij gelijke geschiktheid wordt voorrang gegeven aan de interne kandidaat.

We heten je graag van harte welkom binnen onze gemeente en binnen ons team!

Acquisitie n.a.v. deze vacature stellen wij niet op prijs!

title: Golf Club Technician
description:
Position: Golf Club Technician

Department: Operations

Reports To: Build Team Manager

Employment Status: Full-Time, Non-Exempt

Office Location: Scottsdale, AZ (On-Site)

Full-Time | Hourly + Productivity-Based Commission | Scottsdale, AZ

Job Summary:

True Spec Golf is seeking a Golf Club Technician to join our Headquarters team in Scottsdale, Arizona. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, motivated, mechanically inclined, and passionate about golf. In this role, you will handle the final stages of golf club assembly and perform quality assurance to ensure every club meets True Spec’s elite performance standards. This is a full-time position with benefits, offering $18–$19 per hour plus the opportunity to earn commission based on productivity.

title: Tactical Data link (TDL) Test & Evaluation Analyst - Senior
description:
About Agile Defense
At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.
Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.

Requisition #: 1609
Job Title: Tactical Data link (TDL) Test & Evaluation Analyst - Senior
Location: Fort Huachuca, AZ
Clearance Level: Secret, Must Have Clearance to Start
Required Certification(s): Requires at least 1 certification in area of specialization. Examples include Sec+/SecX, Certified Scrum Master, ITIL4/ITIL5, CTEP.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Joint Interoperability Test Command (JITC) Test Evaluation and Certification II Services (TEC II) contract provides technical solutions for the DOD in support of Test and Evaluation (T&E) services and T&E enabling services. TEC Services are provided to DoD Combatant Commanders/Services/Agencies, federal and state agencies, coalition partners, and commercial entities to aid in the design, development, acquisition, integration, deployment, operational use, and sustainment of new and enhanced Information Technology/National Security System capabilities.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

JITC’s Tactical Data Link (TDL) specialists test TDL interfaces for message set standards compliance and interoperability certification. The selected candidate will utilize applicable Military Standards (MIL-STD) and North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) Standardization Agreements (STANAG) to update Master Test Procedures (MTPs) in the execution, analysis, and reporting of standards compliance and interoperability test events. TDL MIL-STDs and STANAGs include: 3011 Joint Range Extension, 6011/5511 Link 11, 6016/5516 Link 16, 6017 Variable Message Format, 6018 Integrated Broadcast Service Common Message Format, 6020 Data Forwarding, 6022/5522 Link 22, 6040 US Message Text Format, 6090 Cursor on Target, and 5602 Standard Interface for Multiple Platform Link Evaluation.

Duties include:

  • Review MIL-STD Interface Change Proposals (ICPs)
  • Update Master Test Procedures (MTP) to include previous ICP approved changes.
  • Research systems under test (SUT) data link bit level implementation and determine the MIL-STD functional areas that need to be tested.
  • Develop standards conformance test procedures using system implementation(s) to evaluate the system requirements.
  • Develop interoperability test procedures using the TDL MTP to evaluate information exchange requirements derived from system Net Ready Key Performance Parameters and traceability matrix.
  • Conduct Standards Conformance and interoperability tests and post-test analysis as required using analysis tools such as industry standard test tools.
  • Write preliminary trouble reports in accordance with approved templates.
  • Prepare and deliver test reports in accordance with approved templates.

EDUCATION & BACKGROUND

  • Requires a Master’s degree; or a Bachelor’s degree with at least 6 years of experience; or 10 years of experience.
  • One year of experience can be substituted by 15 semester hours completed towards a Master’s degree. The degree must be in a relevant technical curriculum and experience must be related to the job duties.
  • Additional certifications in the area of specialization may be substituted for experience but varies by certification.

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Demonstrated experience executing TDL standards conformance test events to include but not limited to MIL-STDs 6011, 6016, 6020, and 6022 from initial test planning through delivery of the final test report.
  • Excellent communications skills, including verbal, written and presentation skills with the ability to write complex software developer-level issues in a clear, concise, and easily understood manner.
  • Familiar with Department of War (DoW) operations and environment, and comfortable with RF/IT systems and software.
  • Familiar with and actively using the Microsoft Office suite.

PREFERRED SKILLS

  • Prior Joint Interface Control Officer (JICO) qualification is desired.
  • Experience with DoW acquisition developmental/operational testing is desired.
  • Experience with test tools and operational systems such as Joint Analysis Net-centric Evaluation Testing Toolkit (JANETT), Tactical Data Link Integration Exerciser (TIGER), Air Defense Systems Integrator (ADSI), Battlefield Operations Support System (BOSS), Network, System Integration and Test Environment (NSITE), Automated Test Case Generator (ATC-Gen), and Small Tactical Terminal (STT).
  • Attention to detail creating, reviewing and editing requirements, specifications, and recommendations related to proposed solutions.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with senior management, cross-functional teams, internal/external customers, and end-users.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Environmental Conditions
  • Contractor site with 0%-10% travel possible. Possible off-hours work to support releases and outages. General office environment. Work is generally sedentary in nature but may require standing and walking for up to 10% of the time. The working environment is generally favorable. Work is generally performed within an office environment, with standard office equipment available.

Strength Demands

  • Sedentary – 10 lbs. Maximum lifting, occasional lift/carry of small articles. Some occasional walking or standing may be required. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.

Physical Requirements

  • Stand or Sit; Walk; Repetitive Motion; Use Hands / Fingers to Handle or Feel; Stoop, Kneel, Crouch, or Crawl; See; Push or Pull; Climb (stairs, ladders) or Balance (ascend / descend, work atop, traverse).
Our Core Values
Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.
What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. It's who we are.
  • Happy - Be Infectious. Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do.
  • Helpful - Be Supportive. Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated.
  • Honest - Be Trustworthy. Honesty serves as our compass, ensuring transparent communication and ethical conduct, essential to who we are and the complex domains we support.
  • Humble - Be Grounded. Success is not achieved alone, humility ensures a culture of mutual respect, encouraging open communication, and a willingness to learn from one another and take on any task.
  • Hungry - Be Eager. Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges.
  • Hustle - Be Driven. Hustle is reflected in our relentless work ethic, where we are each committed to going above and beyond to advance the mission and achieve success.

Job Title\: Special Education Teacher- Interrelated Secondary High School

Position Function\: This position plans, leads, facilitates and provides instruction for maximum student learning in the Interrelated Classroom providing appropriate curriculum to identified special education students. Provides activities designed to create interest and enthusiasm for personal grasp of knowledge.

  • Defines, structures, and communicates daily expectations according to IEP including but not limited to course goals, objectives, learning methods and activities

  • Prepares, displays events and reinforcement activities which encourage participation.
  • Evaluates and Communicates
  • Plans assessments for evaluation to include but not limited to various diagnostic techniques-- standardized survey and criterion-referenced test; teacher developed oral and written tests; student personal indices (effort, potential, interests, memory)

  • Designs a grading system which encourages motivation and participation; collects and enters student data in computer from charts and observations and reports progress in growth and development regularly as required
  • Designs classroom rules for student interaction (courtesy and respect for belongings, space and ideas), self control, working independently, appropriately gaining the floor, and accepting reminders from teacher; designs systems for handling all behavior (from simple infractions to severe behavior)

title: Assistant Dean, Finance and Administration
description:
Temple University's School of Pharmacy is searching for an Assistant Dean, Finance and Administration!

Salary Range\: $115,000 - $125,000
A variety of important factors are reviewed by HR when considering salary, including job duties, the applicant’s education and experience, all relevant internal equity considerations, department budget, and funding source.

Become a part of the Temple family and you will have access to the following\:
Full medical, dental, vision coverage
Paid time off
9 Federally Observed Paid Holidays
3 Personal Days
Tuition remission - eligible employees and their dependents can obtain a degree TUITION FREE
A generous retirement plan and so much more!

Position Summary\:
Reporting directly to the Dean, the Assistant Dean, Finance and Administration serves as the School of Pharmacy’s senior financial and administrative officer and a member of the Dean’s leadership team. The position provides strategic leadership, direction, and accountability for the School’s financial management, business affairs, administrative operations, personnel administration, facilities, and resource planning in support of its educational, research, and service missions. They also direct daily operations and lead the planning, analysis, reporting, policy development and continuous, strategic improvement for finance, budgets, accounting, facilities, and operations.

The Assistant Dean translates the Dean’s strategic priorities into financial and operational plans; directs the allocation and effective use of financial, personnel, and physical resources; establishes administrative processes and internal controls; and evaluates operational performance across the School. The position advises the Dean on organizational effectiveness, financial sustainability, staffing, capital investments, operational risks, and leads implementation of approved initiatives.

Responsibilities include\: advising the Dean and senior staff for the School on all financial matters related to day-to-day operations; with detailed oversight of developing, implementing, maintaining and ensuring compliance with financial policies and procedures; establishing budget projections and financial strategic planning and documentation for the Provost’s Office; advising and providing strategic guidance and recommendations for the Dean and senior staff on resource allocation; and presenting quarterly budget reports. The Assistant Dean will oversee the budgets and carry-over funds as well as development funds, and scholarship activity. Acts in a management capacity to directly supervise the school’s recruitment, retention, and development/training for all non-faculty staff. Actively engage in the management and administrative issues surrounding new faculty and/or staff, and post-doctoral hires. Acts in a management capacity to report on fiscal operations, planning and budget, and operations. Shared responsibility with Associate Dean of Research for research procurements and pre and post grant management. Serves as the Schools’ liaison to central administrative departments including the Provost, Budget Office, General Accounting, purchasing and others in the execution of this role.

Job Details\:
* This position requires the following background checks\: criminal history review

Required Education and Experience\:
* Master of Business Administration and at least five years of recent relevant experience, including financial reporting.
* Experience making presentations to various size groups.
* Demonstrated supervisory/leadership experience.
* Experience building collaborative partnerships.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Preferred Education and Experience\:
* Experience in managing the finances of a school or college.
* Experience in an academic institution

Required Skills and Abilities\:
* Strong attention to detail.
* Demonstrated computer skills, and proficiency with MS Office Suite software programs (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Outlook).
* Familiarity with software applications with the proven ability to quickly learn and utilize new applications.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills along with the ability to effectively interact with a diverse group of individuals.
* Demonstrated interpersonal and collaborative skills, with the ability to work well with all levels of university personnel. Actively contributes to the development and leadership of finance personnel as a subject matter expert.
* Ability to present financial materials to the TUSP executive team and/or University Administration.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality and handle challenging situations with emotional intelligence and high degree of awareness of impact.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct needs analyses and assessments and to make appropriate recommendations.

Essential Duties\:
* School-wide administrative leadership\: Directs and integrates the School’s business and administrative operations, establishing priorities, service expectations, accountability measures, and procedures that support academic, research, and service activities. Resolves complex operational issues spanning departments and administrative functions.
* Strategic and operational planning\: Leads the development and execution of administrative and financial plans supporting the School’s strategic priorities. Converts approved initiatives into defined budgets, staffing requirements, implementation schedules, and measurable outcomes; monitors progress and directs corrective action.
* Integrated resource allocation\: Leads school-wide planning for the allocation of financial, personnel, and physical resources. Evaluates competing departmental requests, assesses operational and financial implications, and recommends priorities to the Dean based on institutional objectives, available resources, and long-term sustainability. Oversees and reviews all proposals and contracts to ensure associated activities adhere to both departmental and University policies relative to financial commitments and personnel requirements.
* Organizational effectiveness and workforce planning\: In partnership with department leadership and University Human Resources, assesses organizational structures, staffing levels, workload distribution, and administrative service needs. Acts in a management capacity to directly supervise all non-faculty staff. Actively engage in the management and administrative issues surrounding new faculty and/or staff and post-doctoral hires. Develops recommendations for position creation, restructuring, reassignment of responsibilities, and succession planning to improve organizational effectiveness and service delivery.
* Personnel administration\: Directs the School’s administrative processes for recruitment, onboarding, compensation actions, position reviews, payroll changes, and staff performance management. Ensures appropriate approvals, documentation, funding, and consistent implementation of University policies in collaboration with Human Resources and Faculty Affairs, as applicable.
* Facilities, space, and capital planning\: Leads planning and prioritization of the School’s facilities, space utilization, renovations, equipment replacements, and capital needs. Develops project scopes, funding plans, and implementation priorities in consultation with academic and research leaders and University Facilities; monitors budgets, schedules, and operational impacts.
* Administrative policy and internal controls\: Develops, implements, and evaluates school-level administrative procedures consistent with University policies. Establishes internal controls, approval processes, and accountability standards for purchasing, payroll, expenditures, asset stewardship, and personnel transactions; addresses deficiencies and oversees corrective actions.
* Financial sustainability and business planning\: Prepare budget status reports and advise the Dean of favorable and unfavorable variances. Leads financial modeling, forecasting, and business case development for proposed programs, partnerships, service activities, and other strategic investments. Evaluates enrollment trends, revenue assumptions, staffing commitments, operating costs, and financial risks; advises the Dean on feasibility, resource requirements, and ongoing sustainability.
* Research administration partnership\: In collaboration with the Associate Dean for Research and central research administration offices, directs the School’s financial and administrative support for sponsored projects. Management of the School’s grant portfolio from pre-award to post-award. Oversees budget planning, personnel funding allocations, procurement, expenditure monitoring, and award closeout activities within the School’s assigned responsibilities.
* Operational performance and continuous improvement\: Establishes and monitors measures of administrative effectiveness, including service timeliness, transaction accuracy, budget performance, staffing utilization, and project completion. Uses data and stakeholder feedback to redesign workflows, strengthen coordination, and improve administrative services across the School.
* Leadership of administrative initiatives\: Leads cross-functional projects and organizational changes affecting the School’s operations. Defines responsibilities, coordinates stakeholders, resolves implementation barriers, and holds assigned staff and project participants accountable for deliverables and outcomes.
* Representation and delegated decision-making\: Represents the Dean and School in financial and administrative discussions with University offices, committees, and external partners as designated. Resolves matters within delegated authority, communicates School priorities, and elevates issues requiring executive decisions or additional University approval.
* Staff leadership and development\: Directs assigned financial and administrative personnel, establishes performance expectations, and evaluates results. Develops staff capabilities through coaching, training, cross-training, and succession planning; aligns individual responsibilities with the School’s operational priorities.
* Delegated authority and representation\: Represents the Dean in designated financial and administrative matters and resolves operational issues within formally delegated authority. Coordinates decisions with appropriate University offices and refers matters exceeding that authority to the Dean or responsible University leadership.
* Performs other duties as assigned

title: Postdoctoral Associate
description:
Required Qualifications\: (as evidenced by an attached resume)
Doctoral Degree (or foreign equivalent) in Immunology or a closely related field in hand by time of appointment. First author publication in revision, in press, accepted or published in a reputable journal is required.

Preferred Qualifications\:
Interest or experience in studying adaptive immunity during respiratory infections. Experience in Techniques\: Mouse handling (i.v., i.p. injections), Mouse dissection & tissue processing, Flow Cytometry. Preferred but can be learned\: PCR, RT-PCR, viral plaque assays, scRNAseq, in-vitro cell culture assays, ELISA, ELISPOT, Immunohistochemistry.

Brief Description of Duties\:
The Postdoctoral Associate will assist the Principal Investigator Dr. Priyadharshini Devarajan in the department of Microbiology and Immunology. Please visit the Devarajan Lab to learn more about our department/research. The incumbent will conduct research and ensure that all experiments are appropriately conducted following the policies and procedures of Stony Brook University. We are looking for someone with critical thinking skills, interest in studying adaptive immunity during respiratory infections, enthusiasm for scientific discovery, and a keen eagerness to grow as a scientist.

● Within the predetermined research scope and methodology, conduct research experiments in the field of Lung and Nasal Immunity Against Respiratory Viruses, T Cell Memory, Aged Immune Responses.

● Collect and analyze data, including periodical/literature search and utilizing specialized skills in related fields to analyze the collected data.

● Participate/assist in manuscript writing for publication in scientific journals and/or presentations. May also assist in grant writing.

● Lab maintenance, including equipment maintenance and ordering of supplies as needed.

● Other duties as assigned, which may include attending Scientific Conferences and Meetings.

title: Adviseur Planning en Control
description:
Ben jij een stevige adviseur met een passie voor vastgoed? Zit financieel én inhoudelijk adviseren in jouw bloed? Dan zorg jij ervoor dat Gemeente Tilburg vastgoedkeuzes maakt die financieel verantwoord, strategisch én toekomstbestendig zijn.

Informatie
Tilburg groeit en ontwikkelt. Dat vraagt om slimme investeringen, gezonde exploitaties en financieel duurzame keuzes rondom maatschappelijk vastgoed. Als Financieel Adviseur Vastgoed speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol. Je adviseert over financiële vraagstukken binnen de vastgoedportefeuille, gebouwen- en grondexploitaties en helpt bestuur, management en collega's bij het maken van goed onderbouwde keuzes. Met jouw financiële expertise én gevoel voor de bestuurlijke context draag je direct bij aan de ontwikkeling van Tilburg.

Hoe ga jij ‘t anders doen?
Jij bent de financiële sparringpartner vanuit de afdeling Planning en Control voor de afdeling Vastgoedbedrijf specifiek voor de gebouwenexploitatie en een deel van de grondexploitatie. Je kijkt verder dan de cijfers alleen en brengt financiële risico's, kansen en ontwikkelingen tijdig in beeld. Zo help je om grip te houden op complexe vastgoedvraagstukken en duurzame keuzes te maken.
  • Je adviseert over financiële vraagstukken binnen het vastgoeddomein. Je ondersteunt de afdeling bij zowel lopende dossiers, ontwikkelingen, projecten en reguliere exploitatie en bedrijfsvoering.
  • Je analyseert en beoordeelt voorstellen op bedrijfseconomische haalbaarheid, wet en regelgeving, financiële risico's en bijdrage aan bestuurlijke doelen.
  • Je signaleert ontwikkelingen en vertaalt deze naar financiële effecten, stuurinformatie en concrete adviezen. Met jouw analyses maak je geldstromen inzichtelijk, uitlegbaar en navolgbaar, zodat weloverwogen keuzes gemaakt kunnen worden.
  • Je stelt periodieke dashboards op waarmee de afdeling inzicht krijgt in relevante sturingsinformatie en begeleid je projecten in verschillende fasen, van voorbereiding tot afronding.

Waar maak jij 't verschil?
Je komt terecht binnen de afdeling Planning & Control. Binnen deze afdeling werken drie adviesteams die ieder een eigen domein ondersteunen. Jij versterkt adviesteam Vestigingsklimaat. Dit team ondersteunt onder andere de afdelingen Ruimte, Vastgoedbedrijf, Economie en Arbeidsmarkt, projecten Stedelijke Ontwikkeling en de concernopgave Energietransitie.

Je werkt samen met circa 22 collega's, waaronder bedrijfseconomisch medewerkers, adviseurs en (project)controllers. De sfeer is professioneel, betrokken en collegiaal. Er is veel ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid en tegelijkertijd staat samenwerken centraal.

Je verdeelt je werktijd flexibel tussen kantoor en thuis. Ongeveer de helft van de tijd werk je op kantoor. Iedere donderdag is de gezamenlijke teamdag en daarnaast zijn er regelmatig koffiemomenten, een borrel en andere informele activiteiten.

Wat is jouw inbreng?
Jij bent een stevige financieel adviseur die verder kijkt dan cijfers alleen. Je begrijpt de inhoudelijke opgaven van de gemeente en weet financiële risico's en kansen vroegtijdig te signaleren. Met jouw analytisch vermogen doorgrond je complexe vraagstukken snel en vertaal je deze naar heldere adviezen en zorg je samen met je collega’s dat de P&C producten verantwoord worden en geborgd zijn. Je bent verbindend in de samenwerking, daadkrachtig in je aanpak en vernieuwend in het verbeteren van processen en werkwijzen. Daarbij voel je je thuis in een bestuurlijke omgeving en ben je een volwaardige gesprekspartner voor management en collega's.

Je neemt eigenaarschap, houdt overzicht wanneer verschillende belangen samenkomen en weet met overtuigingskracht resultaten te bereiken. Dankzij jouw adviezen blijft de organisatie financieel in control en kunnen besluiten worden genomen op basis van betrouwbare en actuele informatie.

In deze rol maak jij het verschil met de volgende competenties: analytisch vermogen, visie, inlevingsvermogen, overtuigingskracht, initiatief.
  • Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van Bedrijfseconomie, Finance & Control of vergelijkbaar.
  • Je hebt meerdere jaren relevante werkervaring binnen de overheid, bij voorkeur in een adviseursrol bij een gemeente.
  • Je hebt ervaring of affiniteit met het fysieke domein, bij voorkeur vastgoed.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met financiële processen, administraties en financiële analyses.
  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 32 tot 36 uur (voorkeur) per week.

Werken bij Gemeente Tilburg betekent bijdragen aan een stad waarin vertrouwen centraal staat. Daarom vragen we je tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure een geldige Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) aan te leveren. Zo bouwen we samen aan een veilige en betrouwbare organisatie.

Wat levert 't je op?
Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om je werk op jouw manier te doen. En daar hoort een goede beloning bij.

Salaris
Deze functie is ingeschaald in schaal 11 met aanloopschaal 10. Bij een fulltime dienstverband verdien je minimaal € 3.824,- en maximaal € 6.422,- bruto per maand. Het salaris dat we noemen, is een richtlijn. Jouw definitieve inschaling bepalen we op basis van je kennis, ervaring en de geldende arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Vrije tijd
Je krijgt 201,6 verlofuren per jaar op basis van fulltime.

Individueel keuzebudget (IKB)
Boven op je salaris ontvang je 17,05% IKB. Dat zet je flexibel in: extra verlof, een extra uitbetaling, een opleiding, vakantiegeld of bijvoorbeeld een elektrische fiets. Jij kiest wat bij je past.

Je bouwt een uitstekend pensioen op bij ABP. Wij betalen 70% van de premie. Ook ben je goed verzekerd bij overlijden en arbeidsongeschiktheid.

Extra zekerheid
Je krijgt een werkgeversbijdrage voor je zorgverzekering en korting op een arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering via Loyalis.

Contractvorm
Bij goed functioneren krijg je in principe na één jaar een vast contract.

Werk en privé in balans
Je werkt maximaal 36 uur per week, met flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken.

Goede werkplek
Thuis en op kantoor werk je prettig. Je krijgt een sta/zit-bureau, bureaustoel en alles wat je nodig hebt om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

Vergoedingen en faciliteiten
€ 3,25 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.
Laptop en mobiele telefoon.
Reis je met het openbaar vervoer? Dan vergoeden wij je reiskosten volledig, 2e klas.

We bieden volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden via ons uitgebreide aanbod aan trainingen via het Tilburgs Leerhuis.
