title: Kvantitativni analitik za dinamično upravljanje z energijo – junior ali senior
description:
• Optimizacijski modeli na platformi OPTIMA: modeliranje in optimizacija energetskih in finančnih tokov v energetsko intenzivni industriji, daljinskih sistemih ogrevanja in energetskih podjetjih ter za kombinacije baterijskih hranilnikov, sončnih elektrarn, polnilnic za električna vozila, odjema in mikro omrežij; upoštevanje tehničnih, obratovalnih in varnostnih omejitev, omrežnine in konične moči ter optimizacija voznih redov za dan vnaprej in znotraj dneva,

  • analize energetskih postrojev: modeliranje in vrednotenje postrojev (npr. baterijski hranilnik + sončna elektrarna + polnilnice + odjem), dimenzioniranje enot, izračun prihrankov in prihodkov na trgih, ocena ekonomičnosti elektrolizerja na energetskem trgu in v industriji, scenariji cen in analize občutljivosti,

  • strategije na energetskih trgih: zasnova, backtest in parametrizacija strategij avtomatskega zapiranja pozicij in trgovanja na trgu znotraj dneva ter vključevanje prožnih enot na trg za dan vnaprej, izravnalni trg in trg sistemskih storitev,

  • napovedi za optimizacijo: napovedi odjema naprav in lokacij, proizvodnje sončnih elektrarn, cen ter prožnosti (npr. polnjenja električnih vozil),

  • razvoj novih rešitev, storitev in poslovnih modelov: samozadostna vozlišča, upravljanje z energijo in viri prožnosti, trg prožnosti, obnovljivi viri energije, energetske skupnosti, mikro omrežja, virtualna elektrarna, e-mobilnost, vodik in drugo,

  • medsektorsko povezovanje: skupna optimizacija elektrike, toplote, pare, plina, vodika, e-mobilnosti in biomase,

  • analitična podpora strateškim storitvam: strategije prehoda v brezogljičnost, strategije nabave energije, cenovni trendi, dobava zelene energije in projekti za programe financiranja EU,

  • delo s partnerji: zajem tehničnih omejitev in poslovnih ciljev na delavnicah, priprava analiz za ponudbe ter predstavitev rezultatov in ekonomskih učinkov,

  • produkcija in razvoj z orodji umetne inteligence: uvedba modelov v produkcijo s spremljanjem in alarmi, dokumentacija ter uporaba AI orodij za programiranje (Claude Code) pri razvoju, analizah in testiranju.

Pričakujemo

  • Najmanj VI. stopnjo izobrazbe tehnične (FE, FS, FRI …), naravoslovne (FMF …) ali ekonomske (EF …) smeri,

  • znanje matematičnega modeliranja in optimizacije (linearno in mešano celoštevilsko programiranje),

  • aktivno znanje angleškega jezika,

  • znanje programskega jezika Python in jezika SQL,

  • razumevanje delovanja energetskih sistemov in naprav (elektrika, toplota, plin) ter osnov energetskih trgov,

  • analitično in kritično razmišljanje - rezultat preverite, preden mu zaupate,

  • sposobnost jasno predstaviti rezultate tehničnim in poslovnim sogovornikom, tudi pri partnerjih,

  • odgovornost, natančnost in samoiniciativnost.

Za raven junior:

  • Zaključen študij ali do 2 leti izkušenj; primer projekta, naloge ali diplome z optimizacijo ali modeliranjem energetskih sistemov,

  • interes za energetske trge in nove energetske tehnologije ter pripravljenost, da se jih hitro naučite.

Za raven senior dodatno:

  • Vsaj 4 leta izkušenj z optimizacijskimi modeli ali tehnično-ekonomskimi analizami v energetiki ali industriji,

  • izkušnje s samostojnim vodenjem modeliranja od zajema zahtev do uvedbe v produkcijo,

  • poznavanje energetskih trgov (dan vnaprej, znotraj dneva, izravnalni trg, sistemske storitve) in omrežnine,

  • pripravljenost za mentorstvo in pregled kode mlajših sodelavcev.

Prednost (ne pa pogoj) predstavljajo:

  • Izkušnje z orodji za optimizacijo (Pyomo, PuLP, OR-Tools, Gurobi, CPLEX ali podobno),

  • izkušnje s platformami za optimizacijo ali algoritmično trgovanje v energetiki,

  • poznavanje tehnologij: baterijski hranilniki, toplotne črpalke, SPTE, elektrolizerji, polnilnice za električna vozila,

  • izkušnje s stohastično optimizacijo, modelnim prediktivnim vodenjem (MPC) ali napovednimi modeli,

  • znanje investicijskih analiz (NPV, IRR, LCOE, LCOH) in razvoja poslovnih modelov,

  • izkušnje s projekti, financiranimi iz programov EU,

  • izkušnje z Git, Docker, CI/CD in oblakom (Azure),

  • izkušnje z AI orodji za programiranje (Claude Code, Copilot ali podobno),

  • če imate javno dostopen projekt (npr. GitHub), ki prikazuje vaše delo, nam pošljite povezavo.

Nudimo

  • Delovno razmerje za nedoločen čas s šest mesečnim poskusnim delom,

  • delo na področju, ki bo v naslednjih letih oblikovalo energetske trge (prožnost, baterijski sistemi, vodik, e-mobilnost, digitalizacija),

  • raznoliki projekti v industriji, daljinskem ogrevanju in energetiki z neposrednim vplivom na rezultat partnerjev,

  • razvoj lastne platforme in sodobna razvojna orodja, vključno z AI orodji za programiranje,

  • močan razvoj znanj (mentorstvo, uvajanje, izobraževanja),

  • dinamično okolje, kjer se dobre ideje hitro uresničijo.

  • stimulativno plačilo (fiksni + variabilni del) in paket ugodnosti.

  • fleksibilen delovni čas in možnost dela od doma (2 dni tedensko).

Podjetje vsem svojim zaposlenim financira:

  • dodatno pokojninsko zavarovanje;

  • zavarovanje za primer operacije ali bolezni;

title: Kokenut ohjelmistosuunnittelija
description: Oletko jo kokeneempi ohjelmistokehittäjä valmiina uusiin haasteisiin? Tavoitteenamme on luoda ihmisille parempia elinympäristöjä kehittämällä tulevaisuuden infrasta entistä älykkäämpää. Olemme yksi toimialamme johtavista teknologiaosaajista. Ydinosaamistamme ovat ohjelmistokehitys ja IoT-ratkaisut sekä tietoliikenne-, automaatio-, sähkö- ja valaistussuunnittelu.**Ohjelmistosuunnittelijamme** työskentelevät asiakasprojekteissa sekä Nodeonin omassa tuote- ja palvelukehityksessä. Kehitämme älykkään liikenteen, kaupunkien ja infrastruktuurin teknologiaratkaisuja, jotka parantavat arjen sujuvuutta, turvallisuutta ja elinympäristöjen toimivuutta. Asiakkaitamme ja yhteistyökumppaneitamme ovat muun muassa Fintraffic, muut alan valtakunnalliset julkiset toimijat ja Suomen suurimmat kaupungit sekä laaja joukko alan yrityksiä urakoitsijoista teknologia- ja järjestelmätoimittajiin sekä suunnittelu- ja konsulttiyrityksiin.Oman tuotekehityksemme keskiössä on **Asgard-ratkaisukokonaisuus**, joka kattaa liikenteenhallinnan ja opastusjärjestelmät, liikennetiedon hallinnan ja reaaliaikaiset tilannekuvaratkaisut sekä liikenteen mittauspalvelut.**Lue lisää ohjelmistosuunnittelustamme täältä: /****Lue Asgard-ratkaisuistamme täältä: /**Tule kanssamme kehittämään infran ohjelmistoratkaisuja ja samalla toimivampia ja turvallisempia elinympäristöjä!**Mitä työsi pitää sisällään**Suunnittelet ja toteutat monipuolisia ohjelmistoratkaisuja taustajärjestelmistä ja selainpohjaisista käyttöliittymistä rajapintoihin, integraatioihin ja laiteläheisiin tiedonkeruuratkaisuihin. Kehittämämme järjestelmät liittyvät usein fyysisen ympäristön ohjaukseen, valvontaan ja tiedonkeruuseen. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä eri alojen suunnittelu- ja kehitystiimien kanssa.**Ajattelutapa, jota arvostamme:** Arvostamme asiantuntijaa, jonka ammattiylpeys näkyy haluna oppia uutta, tarttua teknologisiin haasteisiin ja olla ylpeä työnsä jäljestä. Teknisen arkkitehtuurin ja integraatioiden lisäksi kiinnostuksen tulee ulottua siihen, miksi ja mihin tarkoitukseen järjestelmiä rakennetaan. Tekoälyn aikakaudella korostuvat kokonaisuuksien hahmottaminen, syvällinen ymmärrys ja kyky ilmaista ajatukset täsmällisesti myös kirjallisesti. Arvostamme itsenäistä työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja rohkeutta tuoda omat ideat esiin.**Tässä tehtävässä menestyt, kun sinulla on...**- Vahvaa kokemusta ohjelmistojen ja niiden arkkitehtuurien suunnittelusta sekä kokonaisuuksien viemisestä tuotantoon - Kokemusta tekoälyavusteisesta ohjelmistokehityksestä ja AI-työkalujen orkestroinnista, kykyä jakaa monimutkaiset ongelmat hallittaviin kokonaisuuksiin sekä ottaa vastuu syntyvien ratkaisujen toimivuudesta, laadusta, tietoturvasta ja ylläpidettävyydestä - Kokemusta nykyaikaisista web- ja pilviratkaisuista, taustajärjestelmistä sekä rajapintojen ja integraatioiden toteutuksesta - Valmiutta toimia vastuusuunnittelijana, itsenäinen ja luotettava työote, rohkeutta tarttua uusiin teknologioihin sekä kykyä toimia luontevasti asiakasrajapinnassa ja sidosryhmäyhteistyössä **Plussaksi laskemme:**- Aidon kiinnostuksen ja harrastuneisuuden ohjelmistoihin ja teknologisiin ratkaisuihin myös työtehtävien ulkopuolella - Toimialatuntemuksen älykkään liikenteen, älykkäiden kaupunkien tai infrastruktuurin järjestelmistä - Osaamisen backend-kehityksestä C#/.NET-ympäristössä ja frontend-kehityksestä Reactilla - Kokemuksen konttiteknologioista, tietovarastoista, laiteläheisestä ohjelmoinnista ja tiedonkeruuratkaisuista **Mitä saat meiltä:**- **Merkityksellisiä ja monipuolisia projekteja**, joissa työsi näkyy konkreettisesti kaupunki- ja liikenneympäristöjen turvallisuudessa ja toimivuudessa - **Uniikin yrityskulttuurin ja vahvan tiimihengen**. Löydämme aina syytä juhlaan esim. joulu- ja kevätpäivien, legendaksi muodostuneiden lanien ja muiden ajanviettojen merkeissä - **Tilaa kasvaa ja kehittyä**. Pääset laajentamaan osaamistasi kiinnostuksesi mukaan uusissa tehtävissä ja projekteissa, osaavan ja monialaisen tiimin tukemana. Tuemme kehittymistäsi myös tarvittaessa koulutuksilla - **Matalan hierarkian ja jaetun johtamisen mallin**, jossa työyhteisömme jäseniä osallistetaan laajasti päätöksentekoon ja toimintamme kehittämiseen - **Monipuoliset edut,** kuten Epassin lounas- ja Flex-edut sekä puhelin- ja polkupyöräedut. - **Joustavan tavan tehdä työtä.** Etätyöskentelymahdollisuuksien lisäksi käytössäsi on toimisto todellisella näköalapaikalla Jyväskylän Lutakossa

title: Pomočnik vodje poslovne enote (m/ž) Lucija
description:
Smo podjetje, ki verjame v potencial vsakega sodelavca in gradi zgodbo ekipe, ki želi rasti. Cenimo odgovornost in sodelovanje, da smo na pravi poti, pa dokazuje visoka stopnja zadovoljstva naših sodelavcev in pridobljena certifikata Družini prijazno podjetje ter Top zaposlovalec leta 2026.

Tvoje naloge

  • dosledno opravljanje dela v skladu s prodajnimi načeli,

  • upoštevanje vrstnega reda zlaganja blaga in načel ureditve prodajnega prostora za celotno prodajno ponudbo, zalaganje polic s prehrambnimi in neprehrambnimi izdelki,

  • delo na blagajni, vodenje osebne blagajne, redni in pravilni obračuni po opravljenem blagajniškem delu,

  • zagotavljanje stroškovno ugodne izvedbe Lidlovega koncepta poslovanja v konkurenčnem okolju ob upoštevanju zakonskih določil, standardov in načel podjetja,

  • zagotavljanje uspešne in stimulativne delovne klime.

Navdušuje nas

  • znanje slovenskega jezika,

  • dinamičnost in veselje do dela s kupci,

  • dobre komunikacijske in organizacijske sposobnosti ter izkušnje pri tem,

  • samozavesten nastop in usmerjenost k ciljem,

  • prilagodljivost in zmožnost timskega dela,

  • potrdilo o nekaznovanosti.

Ponujamo

  • redno mesečno plačilo za polni delovni čas 40 ur tedensko, ki je nad slovenskim povprečjem v trgovinski dejavnosti:

  • v 1. letu zaposlitve bruto plača znaša 1.950 EUR bruto/mesec z vključenim stalnim dodatkom,

  • vsako nadaljnje leto zaposlitve se plača samodejno zviša vse do zadnje stopnje, kjer plačilo znaša 2.360 EUR bruto/mesec z vključenim stalnim dodatkom,

  • nadpovprečno izplačilo letnega regresa (2.000 EUR) in izplačilo zimskega regresa,

  • vplačilo v 2. pokojninski steber po 6 mesecih zaposlitve (480 EUR letno) in vključitev v dodatno kolektivno zdravstveno zavarovanje,

  • pogodbo o zaposlitvi za nedoločen čas s poskusno dobo 6 mesecev,

  • 7,96 EUR povračila stroškov prehrane na delovni dan in povračilo stroškov prevoza na delo v skladu s KP dejavnosti trgovine Slovenije,

  • neenakomerno razporejen delovni čas (dela se 5 dni na teden, 2 dneva sta prosta),

  • stalni razvoj in osebnostno rast z jasnimi možnostmi kariernega napredovanja,

  • skrb za dobro počutje sodelavcev (zdravje na delovnem mestu, uravnoteženi obroki – sadni dan, zdravi zajtrki …, brezplačna psihološka, finančna in pravna pomoč, službeni odklop)

  • družabne aktivnosti in ugodnosti za sodelavce (kartica ugodnosti, letni piknik zaposlenih, novoletna zabava, brezplačno letovanje za otroke, prijavnine za razne športne dogodke).

Verjamemo vate, zato se prijavi in pokaži svoj karierni potencial.

O podjetju

Lidl Slovenija, ki na slovenskem trgu posluje od leta 2007, ima danes 69 trgovin in več kot 2.000 zaposlenih. Smo zanesljiv partner za preprost nakup, kjer na enem mestu najdete vse, kar potrebujete za vsakodnevno uporabo.

Če razmišljate o novi službi in vas zanima delo v podjetju, ki daje velik poudarek skrbi za zaposlene, potem ste na pravem mestu.

Omenjena prizadevanja podjetja med drugim potrjujejo številna priznanja neodvisnih ustanov. Lidl Slovenija je letos že sedmič zapored prejel certifikat Top Employer Slovenija in certifikat Top Employer Europe 2026, naziv, ki ga najboljšim delodajalcem po svetu podeljuje mednarodna organizacija Top Employers Institute. Po zaslugi mnogih ukrepov, uvedenih s ciljem lažjega usklajevanja delovnih in zasebnih obveznosti, pa smo že vrsto let tudi nosilci polnega certifikata Družini prijazno podjetje.

Za iskalce zaposlitve so takšna priznanja lahko dobro znamenje, da podjetje resno vlaga v zaposlene.

title: Buukkaaja/Ajanvaraaja - Helposti räätälöitävissä opintojen oheen
description:
Haetko joustavaa työtä elämäntilanteeseesi? Etsimme myynnin innoittamia vahvan kehittymishalun omaavia henkilöitä edustamaan yhteistyökumppaneitamme buukkauksessa. Tarjoamme laadukkaan koulutuksen ja jatkuvan valmennuksen, jotta onnistut työssäsi. Buukkaajan työssä on huomioitu asiakkaiden kiinnostus ja kysyntä, jotta työ on mielekästä.

Työssä varaat tapaamisaikoja kuluttaja-asiakkaille yhteistyökumppaniemme asiantuntijoille ja myyjille. Hyvin tehdyllä työlläsi varmistat laadukkaat asiakaskohtaamiset sekä tuet edustamiemme yritysten liiketoimintaa ja brändimielikuvaa.

Työn tavoitteet nousevat oppimisesi mukaan. Tärkeintä meille on, että olet hyvän asenteen ja sisukkuuden omaava henkilö, jolla riittää intoa ja motivaatiota kehittyä, jopa vastuutehtäviin asti. Arvostamme asiakaspalvelu-/myyntitaustaa. Tietokoneen peruskäyttö tulee olla sinulle luontevaa, ja edellytämme sinulta sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä nopeaa uuden omaksumista.

Työpäivämme ovat normaalisti arkisin 8:45-16 sisältäen 30 min ruokatauon ja 3 kahvitaukoa. Osa-aikaisena räätälöimme työaikasi ja -vuorosi erittäin joustavasti. Toimistomme sijaitsee Savilahdessa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien äärellä ja korkeakoulujen läheisyydessä.

Takuupalkka toimii turvanasi työn aloituksessa. Kehityksesi kautta voit kuitenkin odottaa palkkakertymäsi nousevan yli takuupalkan. Maksamamme provisiot ja bonukset ovat erittäin hyvät. Parhaimmillaan buukista voit saada 130 €/kpl. Lisäksi meillä on jatkuvasti kisoja mm. ulkomaanmatkoista tapahtumista, bonuksista ja lahjakorteista. Palkkakertymän opit laskemaan onnistumisista itse, mutta tarkastelemme sitä viikoittain myös yhdessä.

Tiimimme on varustettu hyvällä energialla ja samanhenkisyydellä. Avoimuus, joustaminen ja toisten ymmärtäminen on arkipäivää toimistollamme. Esihenkilöt ovat tiiviisti arjessa mukana. Meille on tärkeää tuntea työntekijämme, jotta voimme valmentaa ja palkita jokaisen yksilöllisesti.

Työt on aina saanut sovitettua muuhun arkeen, oli sitten kyse opinnoista tai muista omista menoista. Äkillisimmissä menoissa on saanut muutettua jo olemassa olevia työvuoroja. -Buukkaaja, M&J Dynastia

Työ alkaa sovitusti heti/loppuvuoden aikana.

Olemme Vastuullinen Työnantaja -sertifioitu yritys ja noudatamme näitä periaatteita päivittäisessä toiminnassamme. Olemme myös Savonia-amk:n virallinen kumppaniyritys.

title: Senior Mechanical / Layout Designer (Sudbury)
description:
What if you could redefine what's possible?

With us, you can. You want Purpose. Growth. Opportunity. People who get it.

With an unmatched breadth and depth of engineering, advisory and science-based expertise, our global minds unite to power local solutions.

Innovate and Lead — In this role, you will be at the forefront of innovation, collaborating on transformative projects that push the boundaries of what is possible. If you are looking for a challenge that offers both career growth and the chance to make an impact, this is the opportunity for you.

Turn complex process requirements into buildable plant layouts.

As a Senior Mechanical / Layout Designer based in Sudbury, Ontario, you will lead mechanical layout and 3D model development for mining and mineral processing facilities. You will connect process intent, equipment data, structural constraints, access, and maintainability into coordinated designs that teams can build and operate.

You will strengthen WSP’s local delivery capability while connecting with multidisciplinary mining specialists across Canada and around the world. This is an opportunity to contribute to long-term programs across multiple clients and project stages while helping shape a growing Northern Ontario team.

#CASudburyMiningJobs #GlobalMining

Your Impact

  • Develop equipment arrangements, general arrangements, plans, sections, details, and material take-offs that support safe and efficient delivery.

  • Integrate process flow diagrams, piping and instrumentation diagrams, vendor models, equipment data, survey information, and interdisciplinary requirements into coordinated models.

  • Plan layout work, estimate effort, assign tasks, monitor progress, and check and back-check models and drawings for accuracy, completeness, standards compliance, and constructability.

  • Facilitate model reviews and resolve interfaces with process, mechanical, piping, structural, electrical, and civil teams while incorporating access, lifting, maintenance, operability, safety, and construction sequencing.

  • Support field verification, brownfield tie-ins, and construction-driven updates while mentoring designers and strengthening local design practices.

The Skills That Set You Apart

  • A college diploma or technical credential in mechanical engineering technology, design and drafting, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Substantial mechanical layout and 3D plant design experience in mining, mineral processing, or heavy industrial facilities.

  • Advanced proficiency with relevant plant design, CAD, and 3D modelling tools.

  • Strong understanding of material handling equipment, plant layouts, general arrangements, multidisciplinary interfaces, and constructability.

  • Experience leading design packages, planning and coordinating models, estimating effort, assigning work, monitoring progress, and checking deliverables.

  • Practical field awareness and strong communication, prioritization, technical problem-solving, and mentoring skills.

  • Experience with conveyors, crushers, bins, hoppers, chutes, tanks, pumps, and underground or surface ore handling systems is preferred.

  • Experience using laser scans or point-cloud information for brownfield design is preferred.

Why Choose WSP?

We exist to shape communities to advance humanity. The brightest engineers, advisors and scientists from across the globe call WSP home.

  • Proudly Canadian – we are a Top 100 Employer in Canada for 2026

  • A global community of brilliant minds – your next idea, mentor, or opportunity is always within reach.

  • Flexible work, real balance – we recognize the importance of balance in our lives and encourage you to prioritize the balance in yours.

#WeAreWSP

The wage range provided in this job posting may be subject to change for business purposes.

Make every layout work in the real world

Turn process intent, equipment data, and field constraints into coordinated plant designs that teams can build, maintain, and operate. Shape the layouts—and the local capability—that keep Northern Ontario moving.

title: Program Coordinator
description: The Program Coordinator will assist in the planning and coordination of the day-to-day fiscal, administrative, and operational activities of a University of New Mexico grant program sponsored by the Department of Labor. The New Mexico Open Educational Resources Consortium Phase II Program will continue and expand an Open Textbooks Pilot Program with several New Mexico colleges, as they work together to support the integration of Open Educational Resources (OER) into higher education classrooms. To help administer a program of this size, the Learning, Research, and Engagement unit in the UNM University Libraries will need additional support with reporting on our outcomes on the grant, udgeting the activities, and collaborating with stakeholders, and this program coordinator will fill that role. The program coordinator will provide administrative support for the day-to-day fiscal, administrative, and operational activities related to a program of this size. This individual’s primary responsibilities for the project will be to assist the program director with grant implementation and compliance with the guidelines for a grant. The ideal candidate for this position will have grant management experience as well as a compelling interest in data collection, outcomes assessment, OER advocacy, and student success. Additional duties will include assisting with grant planning and administration, fiscal, budgetary, and/or other associated transactions, program implementation and administration, internal and external operational/administrative liaison, program marketing, and reporting. This is a full-time term position with an initial term end date of one year from date of hire. The grant funding period currently runs through September 2028 and with new funding this position may be extended beyond the initial grant period. This position will report administratively to the University of New Mexico, but supports a grant-funded program accountable to New Mexico's Higher Education Department and the Department of Labor. UNM is a Tier I Research Institution. To support UNM’s campus constituents and colleagues, the College of University Libraries Learning Sciences (CULLS) affirms its commitment to honor diversity, ensure fairness and access, and create an environment where all employees are treated respectfully. CULLS Includes the Organization, Information and Learning Sciences (OILS) academic program, and the UNM Press. University Libraries is a member of the Association of Research Libraries, the Greater Western Library Alliance, and the New Mexico Consortium of Academic Libraries. University Libraries contains over 3 million volumes and includes three central campus libraries: Centennial Science Engineering Library, Fine Arts Design Library, and Zimmerman Library (humanities, social sciences, and education). Founded in 1889, the University of New Mexico sits on the traditional homelands of the Pueblo of Sandia. The original peoples of New Mexico – Pueblo, Navajo, and Apache – since time immemorial, have deep connections to the land and have made significant contributions to the broader community statewide. We honor the land itself and those who remain stewards of this land throughout the generations and acknowledge our committed relationship to Indigenous peoples. We gratefully recognize our history.

title: Enterprise Sales Engineer
description:
Everbridge is seeking an experienced Enterprise Sales Engineer to support strategic utility customers and prospects. As the primary technical presales partner to Strategic Account Executives, you’ll help customers evaluate Everbridge Critical Event Management (CEM) and Emergency Event Management (EEM), turning operational challenges into practical solutions and measurable outcomes.

EEM connects Everbridge CEM with the ServiceNow AI Platform and partner technologies to help utilities identify risks, coordinate response and crews, and communicate during storms, wildfires, outages, and other disruptive events.

What You'll Do:

  • Partner with three to four Strategic Account Executives throughout the sales process, from opportunity qualification and discovery through solution design, evaluation, proposals, and handoff to delivery.
  • Lead discovery with utility stakeholders to understand their operations, response processes, systems, data, and desired outcomes. Recommend solutions that build support across executive, business, operations, and technical teams.
  • Design and deliver tailored demonstrations, workshops, and evaluations that show how EEM can improve preparedness, coordination, response, and restoration.
  • Apply your understanding of electric, gas, and water utilities to scenarios such as severe weather, wildfires, asset impacts, outages, crew mobilization, field safety, and customer communications.
  • Discuss integration requirements involving ServiceNow and utility systems such as SCADA, AMI, GIS, outage or work management platforms, and IoT. Document assumptions, dependencies, and customer responsibilities.
  • Work with Product, Services, partner, and account teams to confirm solution feasibility, manage expectations, and share customer feedback.
  • Develop high-level solution designs and handoff materials for Everbridge Professional Services and partners. Position their support with clear scope, outcomes, and responsibilities.
  • Prepare technical and functional responses for RFIs, RFPs, and security questionnaires; demonstrate platform capabilities and address questions about APIs, architecture, availability, security, networking, telephony, and data flows.
  • Use approved AI tools to support research, discovery planning, meeting summaries, requirements analysis, demonstrations, proposals, and follow-up. Verify outputs and follow company policies to protect sensitive information.
  • Share product knowledge and reusable materials with sales colleagues, represent Everbridge at customer events and industry forums, and participate in a targeted number of Professional Services delivery days each quarter, as defined in the annual compensation plan.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years of customer-facing experience in enterprise software sales, consulting, services, or solution engineering, ideally in presales.
  • Experience with utilities or critical infrastructure and a working understanding of utility operations, emergency management, incident or outage response, restoration, and field coordination.
  • Hands-on ServiceNow experience, such as platform use, workflow configuration, IT service management, integrations, or customer solution design.
  • Strong discovery, consultative selling, and solution design skills, including the ability to engage executives, operational teams, business stakeholders, and technical practitioners.
  • Technical knowledge of SaaS, highly available architectures, cybersecurity, networking, telephony, relational data, middleware, XML/SOAP, and REST APIs.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience preparing technical materials and responding to RFPs and security questionnaires.
  • Strong organization and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities and commitments.
  • Sound judgment when using approved AI tools, including validating outputs and protecting sensitive information.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Salesforce, and web-based business applications.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience, and willingness to travel up to 50%.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Everbridge, emergency notification, critical event management, business continuity, or public safety solutions.
  • Experience integrating utility systems such as SCADA, AMI, GIS, outage management, asset management, or field workforce platforms.
  • Experience designing or evaluating ServiceNow integrations and cross-platform workflows.
The reasonably estimated salary for this role at Everbridge ranges from $139,000 - $180,000 and may also include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Everbridge offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, disability income benefits, life and AD&D insurance, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, and fitness reimbursements.
Fair Chance Statement US & Canada
We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in compliance with all applicable Federal, Provincial/State and Local laws, including the California Fair Chance Act and any local County Fair Chance Ordinance (or local equivalent). Pursuant to these and other relevant regulations, we consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the law.

We evaluate each applicant's criminal history individually, considering its nature, timing, and relevance to the specific job duties, while maintaining our commitment to fair hiring practices and promoting workplace equity.

Everbridge empowers enterprises and government organizations to anticipate, mitigate, respond to, and recover from critical events. In an unpredictable world, resilient organizations protect their people and operations, adapt under pressure, and return to productivity faster. Our Critical Event Management (CEM) technology combines intelligent automation with comprehensive risk intelligence to help organizations strengthen resilience, keep people safe, and maintain operations.

title: Mgr,Administrative Opns
description: The University of New Mexico’s (UNM) Office for Academic Personnel (OAP) seeks a collaborative, service-oriented manager to lead academic human resources operations supporting faculty and graduate assistantship holders across UNM’s main and branch campuses. Reporting to the Senior Vice Provost, OAP provides guidance and support to academic leaders, administrators, faculty, and graduate assistantship holders on academic employment matters. The office works closely with the Provost and the Provost’s Leadership team, school/college deans, branch campus deans and chancellors, Academic Operations Officers, and HR staff, and labor relations partners to resolve complex issues and provide timely, accurate, and consistent support to the University. The manager leads a team of human resources and support professionals, establishes clear priorities and supports staff development and accountability. The position supports consultative guidance on academic employment contracts, personnel policies and procedures, and operational processes. Success in this role requires sound judgment, discretion, strong working relationships, and a commitment to responsive service and continuous improvement. Duties and responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following: Oversees the functions of the Office for Academic Personnel (OAP) for academic personnel for main and branch campuses to ensure compliance with university, local, state, and federal policies and regulations as well as collective bargaining agreements in collaboration with the Labor Relations Officer Supervises and develop OAP staff through hiring recommendation, performance evaluations, training, work allocation, and problem resolution Collaborates with the SVP and Labor Relations Officer to develop and implement processes that are aligned with local, state, and federal employment regulations Provides clear and consistent guidance and policy interpretation to administrators, school/college and department staff, faculty, and graduate assistantship holders on matters pertaining to academic personnel Facilitates and maintains effective communication with campus partners to inform the University community of relevant policies and procedures and to receive feedback from the University community to inform OAP of process improvements Responds to inquiries and independently investigates and resolves problems related to academic personnel Coordinates and manages data collection and analysis systems to monitor personnel actions, processing efficiency, and ensure data accuracy Provides excellent customer service and effectively monitors personnel systems and applications to ensure efficient completion of academic personnel actions Assists with the development and implementation of standard operating procedures to support academic personnel actions Recommends and implements process improvements to enhance transparency and accuracy of personnel processes and information

title: Senior Finance Business Partner
description:
What you’ll be doing

  • Trusted Advisor: Partner with senior leaders across the Australian business, providing financial insight, constructively challenging assumptions and shaping key commercial and operational decisions.
  • Planning & Forecasting: Own the budget, quarterly forecasts and long-range plan for your portfolio, aligning financial outcomes with business strategy and presenting them to senior leadership.
  • Performance Insight: Oversee month-end performance reporting, delivering variance analysis and forward-looking commentary that drives action.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility with financially and non-financially minded stakeholders.
  • The confidence to challenge assumptions, hold a view and clearly explain financial implications, trade-offs and recommended courses of action.
  • Strong financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting and performance reporting capability.
  • Experience leading business cases and decision support, from building the model through to the recommendation.
  • Curiosity and a proactive approach, including demonstrated use of AI tools to automate finance processes and generate faster, deeper insights.

title: Interrelated-Middle (2027-2028 School Year)
description:
Job Title\: Special Education Teacher - Interrelated Secondary Middle School

Position Function\: This position plans, leads, facilitates and provides instruction for maximum student learning in the Interrelated Classroom providing appropriate curriculum to identified special education students. Meets established outcomes based on student's individual education plan (IEP) and capacity to master learning objectives. Provides activities designed to create interest and enthusiasm for personal grasp of knowledge.

Essential Performance Responsibilities\:

  • Participates on pre-assessment teams to determine necessity for comprehensive student evaluation; initiates, schedules and attends IEP meetings' works with multi-disciplinary team to diagnose need; structures/implements IEP for each student identified
  • Defines, structures, and communicates daily expectations according to IEP including but not limited to course goals, objectives, learning methods and activities
  • Communicates with regular education staff members on course instructional and meditative strategies and objectives, students' grasp of material and their outcomes and perspectives for applications of materials learned
  • Receives and reports grades, in-puts student data via computer, negotiates schedules and communicates with all pertinent participants- administration, parents, staff and students, etc.
  • Controls classroom and individual behavior; adapts and adjusts course content and reading levels to specify skills to be taught; discerns means of building memory and study skills; and assists individual students in achieving academic, daily living and social skills, learning objectives by working with them individually and in small groups
  • Presents various listening and learning opportunities appropriate to each student's IEP including by not limited to lecture, VCR, TV, support of regular classroom teachers and other presentations and/or opportunities inside or outside
  • Prepares, displays events and reinforcement activities which encourage participation
  • Evaluates and Communicates
  • Plans assessments for evaluation to include but not limited to various diagnostic techniques\: standardized survey and criterion-referenced test; teacher developed oral and written tests; student personal indices (effort, potential, interests, memory)
  • Designs subject-based reinforcement to follow assessments and student's learning objectives (computer, lab activities, working independently or on group projects, field/community reinforcement.)
  • Designs a grading system which encourages motivation and participation; collects and enters student data in computer from charts and observations and reports progress in growth and development regularly as required
  • Designs classroom rules for student interaction (courtesy and respect for belongings, space and ideas), self control, working independently, appropriately gaining the floor, and accepting reminders from teacher; designs systems for handling all behavior (from simple infractions to severe behavior)
  • Prepares physical condition of classroom to reflect seasons and subject matter to facilitate student learning
  • Keeps daily records on but not limited to student attendance, learning and social needs, assignments, assessments and discipline; supervises paraprofessional(s)
  • Manages all job duties with the mobility, agility, dexterity and focused observation necessary to adequately perform the essential duties, as described above

Additional Duties\: Assists with additional duties as assigned by supervisor.

Equipment\: This position may require the ability to use SMART boards and iPads in addition to basic office equipment such as computers, copiers, scanners, and fax machine. Must always comply with WPS guidelines for equipment use.

Travel\: Limited travel between schools and central offices may be required.

Physical and Mental Demands\:

  • Occasional lifting up to 20 lbs.
  • Occasional carrying up to 20 lbs.
  • Pushing/pulling up to 20 lbs. for distances of up to more than 100 feet
  • Frequent reaching below waist, occasional reaching waist to shoulder, and limited overhead reaching
  • Frequent sitting
  • Frequent standing/walking

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities\:

  • Ability to communicate both verbally and written in order to communicate with others inside and outside of the organization for the purpose of giving and obtaining information
  • Ability to communicate effectively with a Supervisor when their discretion is needed
  • Ability to perform as an effective team player
  • Ability to plan, organize, make decisions and prioritize work to meet the daily demands of the building
  • Exhibit a professional manner and a positive attitude
  • Use good judgment to make decisions on recurring assignments
  • Display a significant degree of professionalism and confidentiality
  • Ability to conform to proper standards of professional dress and appearance
  • Knowledge of company's mission, purpose, goals and the role of every employee in achieving each of them

title: CISO (Chief Information Security Officer)
description:
Wat ga je doen als CISO (Chief Information Security Officer)?

Digitalisering biedt volop kansen. Maar hoe zorgen we ervoor dat dit veilig gebeurt? Daar kom jij in beeld! Als CISO speel je een belangrijke rol in het beschermen van onze informatie, systemen en inwoners. Je denkt vooruit, ziet kansen én risico’s en vertaalt die naar slimme, praktische oplossingen. Je helpt de koers bepalen, brengt collega’s en bestuur in beweging en zorgt ervoor dat informatiebeveiliging een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel wordt van ons werk.

Je ontwikkelt samenhangend beleid, houdt de naleving van de BIO scherp in de gaten en coördineert audits, zoals ENSIA en de audit vanuit de Wet politiegegevens. Maar jouw werk gaat verder dan regels en vinkjes zetten. Je bouwt mee aan een organisatie die blijft leren, zich blijft ontwikkelen en steeds veiliger wordt. Zo maak jij digitalisering niet alleen mogelijk, maar ook betrouwbaar en veilig.

Van strategie naar actie

Je bent een stevige en toegankelijke sparringpartner voor bestuur, directie en management. Je volgt ontwikkelingen in wetgeving, technologie en landelijke kaders en weet deze te vertalen naar concrete plannen, maatregelen en adviezen. Je brengt complexe informatie helder over, creëert draagvlak en weet mensen mee te krijgen.

Ook buiten onze organisatie bouw je aan verbinding. Je onderhoudt een actief netwerk van CISO’s en partners in de regio en deelt kennis en ervaringen. Zo blijven we niet alleen zelf scherp, maar leren we ook van elkaar.

Vooruitkijken én aanpakken

Informatiebeveiliging staat nooit stil. Daarom krijg je in deze rol volop ruimte om mee te bouwen aan vernieuwing. Denk aan cloudtransitie, datagedreven werken en duurzame toegankelijkheid. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze informatiebeveiliging niet alleen op orde is, maar continu groeit en verbetert. Als regisseur van het beveiligingsproces neem je het voortouw bij risicoanalyses, audits, pentests en incidentmanagement. Je bewaakt kwaliteit, voortgang en budget en maakt inzichtelijk waar risico’s en kansen liggen.

Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met de ISO en FG binnen het team Privacy & Informatiebeveiliging. Samen zorgen jullie voor samenhang tussen beleid, uitvoering en bewustwording. Je vervult daarnaast de rol van plaatsvervangend FG. Met de manager Informatievoorziening verbind je strategie en praktijk en zorg je voor duidelijke regie. Kortom, een rol met verantwoordelijkheid, invloed en volop ruimte om te verbeteren.

Wat zoeken wij?

Voor deze functie als CISO (Chief Information Security Officer) beschik je over:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van informatiemanagement, ICT, security management, bestuurskunde of vergelijkbaar.
  • Ruime ervaring als CISO, ISO, adviseur informatieveiligheid of beleidsadviseur binnen IV/ICT; ervaring binnen de overheid is een pré.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met strategische beleidsadvisering op management- en bestuursniveau en je weet complexe vraagstukken met sterke argumentatie en overtuigingskracht over te brengen.
  • Aantoonbare kennis van BIO, ENSIA, AVG, risicomanagement, ISMS principes, informatiearchitectuur en governance binnen het publieke domein.
  • Bij voorkeur gecertificeerd in CISSP, CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor of vergelijkbare security opleidingen.

Aan competenties breng je mee:

  • Inlevingsvermogen: Je begrijpt en voelt aan wat anderen nodig hebben en houdt rekening met de impact van je eigen handelen.
  • Visie: Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en vertaalt trends en ontwikkelingen naar toekomstige ideeën.
  • Initiatief: Je ziet kansen, komt in actie en wacht niet af tot iemand anders iets doet.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een functie voor 32 uur per week;
  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst bij de gemeente Heemstede voor één jaar met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;
  • Een salaris van maximaal € 6.422 (functieschaal 11) bruto per maand o.b.v. 36 uur per week, afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring (per 1 januari 2027 is het salaris maximaal €6.525 bruto per maand, o.b.v. 36 uur per week);
  • Ben jij een ervaren CISO? Dan is een arbeidsmarkttoelage bespreekbaar van maximaal 10%;
  • Bovenop jouw salaris ontvang je een Individueel Keuze Budget van 17,05% (inclusief 8% vakantiegeld). Elke maand kan jij kiezen hoe je dit budget wilt inzetten. Wil je extra salaris ontvangen, of toch liever extra verlofdagen bij kopen?
  • Andere extra’s, zoals een vitaliteitsbudget van € 195,- bruto per jaar, een tegemoetkoming in de ziektekosten van € 168,- bruto per jaar en korting op je maandelijkse premie;
  • Een werkgeversbijdrage van 70% in de opbouw van je pensioen via het ABP;
  • Aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling met uitstekende studiefaciliteiten;

title: Data Analyst, Product Analytics
description:
DATA ANALYST, PRODUCT ANALYTICS

Current is a leading consumer fintech platform transforming financial access for everyday Americans with over 6 million members. We provide access to financial solutions that seamlessly work together to solve the needs of our members and enable all Americans to build better financial futures. Based in NYC, our results-driven environment drives us to build better products, grow faster and empower everyone on our team to have an impact on our business and mission to improve financial outcomes.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Data Analyst, Product Analytics, you will be at the forefront of understanding how our members use and experience Current's products. You will be embedded with product and business teams across areas such as banking, user journey and experience, liquidity, and value-added services, translating business questions into rigorous analyses and clear recommendations. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, business leads and analytics leaders to measure what matters, run experiments, and uncover the insights that shape our roadmap. You enjoy digging into data to understand not just what happened, but why.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Analyze large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and opportunities across customer behavior, product performance, and the user journey.
  • Conduct deep-dive and root-cause analyses to explain changes in key metrics and turn ambiguous data into clear recommendations.
  • Design, run, and interpret A/B tests and other experiments, including success metrics, sample sizing, significance testing, and readouts.
  • Partner with product managers and engineers to define success metrics and measure the impact of new features and initiatives.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track KPIs and deliver clear, actionable insights to stakeholders.
  • Support business cases and prioritization by sizing opportunities and quantifying expected impact.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.
  • Use AI tools to speed up analysis, insight generation, and reporting while keeping accuracy and rigor.
  • Work with analytics engineers and data engineers to ensure accessible, accurate, and high-quality data.
  • Uphold data integrity, accuracy, and governance across your analyses and reporting.

ABOUT YOU

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a data analyst, ideally in product analytics within B2C, financial services, or technology.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for analyses and data development
  • Working experience with Python for data analysis.
  • Experience with A/B testing, experimental design, and statistical inference.
  • Experience building dashboards and reports in Looker, Tableau, or similar BI tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail, and the ability to find the needle in the haystack.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to translate business questions into analysis plans.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear narratives and actionable insights.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Familiarity with the fintech industry and banking products.
  • Experience working with cloud data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift).
  • Experience with product analytics tools and event data (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel, Segment).
  • Exposure to dimensional modeling concepts and dbt.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve analytics efficiency.
  • Familiarity with machine learning techniques and predictive analytics.

title: Consulent Arbeid en Participatie
description:
Pak de ruimte in Maashorst als Consulent Arbeid en Participatie

Uden | 36 uur | 2 jaar | Schaal 9

’n Goeie baan barstensvol:
  • Impact: jij helpt vluchtelingen en statushouders op weg naar werk en een betekenisvolle plek in de samenleving.
  • Vrijheid: je krijgt de ruimte om maatwerk te bieden en samen met inwoners te ontdekken wat werkt.
  • Pionieren: je bouwt mee aan een nieuwe aanpak, legt verbindingen en krijgt de ruimte om te vernieuwen.

Dit ga je doen
Iedereen doet mee. Maar de route daarnaartoe is voor iedereen anders. Als Consulent Arbeid en Participatie begeleid je vluchtelingen, statushouders en bewoners van de COA-locatie richting werk en andere vormen van participatie. Denk aan betaald werk, vrijwilligerswerk of een andere passende en betekenisvolle daginvulling. Vanuit een breed intakeonderzoek ontdek je samen met de inwoner waar iemand staat, wat iemand kan en waar kansen liggen. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar werk, maar naar de persoon als geheel. Wat zijn iemands talenten en ambities? Wat houdt iemand mogelijk tegen? En wat is nodig om een volgende stap te zetten?

Op basis daarvan maak je samen met de inwoner een passend traject. Je begeleidt, motiveert en stimuleert, met oog voor de persoonlijke situatie. Soms is een korte interventie voldoende, terwijl een ander meer tijd en ondersteuning nodig heeft. Je gaat actief op zoek naar kansen op de arbeidsmarkt en richt je op duurzame werkbemiddeling. Je bouwt relaties op met werkgevers en maatschappelijke organisaties en weet deze te vertalen naar passende werkplekken. Waar nodig begeleid je inwoners bij de start, bijvoorbeeld door mee te gaan naar een eerste gesprek of werkdag. Ook daarna blijf je betrokken als aanspreekpunt voor zowel de inwoner als de werkgever. Met aandacht voor nazorg werk je aan een duurzame plaatsing. Waar nodig schakel je met collega's en partners op het gebied van inkomen, inburgering, taal, zorg en schuldhulpverlening.

Deze functie is onderdeel van een tweejarige pilot. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen uitvoert, maar ook samen met collega's onderzoekt wat werkt, voor wie en onder welke voorwaarden. We werken niet vanuit vooraf vastgestelde aantallen plaatsingen. Juist door goed te kijken naar de ervaringen van inwoners, werkgevers en partners, willen we de aanpak steeds verder verbeteren. Je krijgt daarmee de ruimte om te pionieren, nieuwe verbindingen te leggen en samen te ontdekken hoe we vluchtelingen en statushouders zo goed mogelijk kunnen ondersteunen om mee te doen in werk en samenleving. Zowel individueel als groepsgericht.

Je doet het samen met …
Je collega's van team Participatie, Inkomen en Inburgering. Een betrokken team waarin we samenwerken om inwoners verder te helpen en waarin ruimte is voor eigen initiatief en nieuwe ideeën. Je werkt veel samen met consulenten participatie, inkomen en inburgering en andere collega's binnen het sociaal domein. Ook buiten de gemeente weet je de verbinding te leggen. Denk aan de COA-locatie, werkgevers, maatschappelijke organisaties, het Werkcentrum, IBN en andere partners in de regio. Omdat we met deze pilot iets nieuws opbouwen, vinden we het belangrijk om ervaringen te delen en van elkaar te leren. We zoeken elkaar op, denken mee en kijken samen hoe het nóg beter kan.

Passen we bij elkaar?
Jij bent iemand die kansen ziet en graag de verbinding legt. Je weet mensen te motiveren, kunt goed luisteren en kijkt vooral naar wat wél mogelijk is. Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en vindt het leuk om samen met anderen iets nieuws op te bouwen. Daarnaast breng je mee:
  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een sociale, maatschappelijke of arbeidsgerichte richting.
  • Ervaring met participatie, arbeidsbemiddeling, jobcoaching of vergelijkbare werkzaamheden.
  • Kennis van de Participatiewet. Kennis van de Wet inburgering 2021 en ervaring met vluchtelingen en statushouders is een pré.
  • Affiniteit met de doelgroep en het vermogen om aan te sluiten bij verschillende achtergronden, situaties en behoeften.
  • Een ondernemende en praktische instelling. Je legt gemakkelijk contact met werkgevers en ziet kansen om inwoners verder te helpen.
  • De nieuwsgierigheid en flexibiliteit om mee te bouwen aan een nieuwe aanpak en deze vanuit de praktijk te verbeteren.

Herken jij jezelf hierin, maar voldoe je niet aan alle punten? Ook dan maken we graag kennis met je. We vinden jouw motivatie, betrokkenheid en de manier waarop je naar mogelijkheden kijkt minstens zo belangrijk.

En dit helpt jou om ruimte te pakken
  • Een individueel keuzebudget (17,05% van je salaris) waarmee jij de keuzes maakt die bij jou passen. Laat bijvoorbeeld een deel van je maandinkomen uitbetalen of zet dit om in extra verlof of een fietsvergoeding.
  • Je ontvangt een arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd, gekoppeld aan de looptijd van de pilot (max. 2 jaar). Na afloop bekijken we of en hoe de werkzaamheden structureel kunnen worden voortgezet.
  • Duurzaam reizen loont, ontvang € 0,25 per kilometer als je fietst of loopt, óf 100% vergoeding voor het openbaar vervoer. Reis je minimaal 90% duurzaam? Dan ontvang je bovendien een duurzaamheidsbonus tot € 500 per jaar.
  • Reis je met de auto? Dan ontvang je € 0,15 per kilometer van 9,5 tot 40 km enkele reis, fiscaal aan te vullen tot € 0,25 via het IKB. (onder 9,5 km en boven 40 km kun je € 0,25 via het IKB uitruilen).
  • 28 vakantiedagen bij een 36-urige werkweek.
  • Blijf fit met een korting op je sport abonnement, je ontvangt tot €20 per maand.
  • Je bouwt pensioen op bij het ABP. Wij betalen als werkgever 70% van de premie.
  • Betrokken collega’s en veel gezelligheid (onder meer door de actieve personeelsvereniging.
  • Kansen om je te ontwikkelen, op zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk gebied.

Kies jij voor Maashorst?
We zijn benieuwd naar jouw ambitie! Solliciteer daarom uiterlijk 29 november 2026 met je motivatie en cv via het sollicitatieformulier hieronder. Na de sluitingsdatum hoor je zo snel mogelijk of we je uitnodigen voor een gesprek.

title: Post Doctoral Fellow - Extreme Weather and Water Resources in Arid Regions
description: This postdoc position is focused on the intersecting and conflicting ecological and community functions of streams and constructed water systems (e.g., acequias, dams, and stream channeling) in drylands and the roles of both surface and groundwater in these systems during and following extreme weather events. The intent is for the post doctoral fellow to continue or begin a project focused on the impacts of community water sources as a result of weather extremes and how different management regimes can influence the multiple, intersecting, and at times conflicting management priorities. Depending on the research interests of the postdoctoral fellow and their mentor, this may include projects such as (1) how local streams respond to prolonged drought and the associated impacts on community food systems; (2) the functions of acequias or constructed water systems as habitat for endangered aquatic species during drought; (3) how communities can restore local water systems following wildfire and adapt them to be more resilient to future fire; (4) hazard mitigation and climate adaptation planning for community based water systems. An interest in mixed-methods approaches are encouraged to document the changing weather extremes and their impacts on the water system and to understand current uses, values, priorities, and management practices.

title: Manager, Financial Reporting Controls
description:
Manager, Financial Reporting Controls

Permanent Appointment

Regina Head Office


Job Summary:

The Manager, Financial Reporting Controls is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously enhancing the WCB’s Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) framework. This role provides strategic leadership and oversight of the WCB’s financial reporting control environment, ensuring the integrity, reliability, and transparency of financial reporting processes. The Manager partners with Finance, Information Technology, Internal Audit, and business leaders to identify and mitigate financial reporting risks, strengthen governance practices, support regulatory and audit requirements, and foster a culture of accountability and control ownership across the organization. The position serves as the WCB's subject matter expert for ICFR and provides leadership with independent insight into the effectiveness of financial reporting controls, emerging risks, remediation activities, and opportunities for continuous improvement.The Manager also ensures that the ICFR framework remains responsive to organizational, technological, and regulatory changes and supports informed decision-making through a strong and sustainable control environment.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  1. Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of the WCB's Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) framework, ensuring alignment with recognized control standards, regulatory requirements, and organizational objectives.
  2. Provide strategic oversight of financial reporting risks by identifying areas of potential exposure, assessing the impact of business and system changes, and ensuring appropriate controls are designed, maintained, and operating effectively.
  3. Establish and maintain governance practices, policies, methodologies, and monitoring processes that promote accountability, strengthen the control environment, and support reliable financial reporting.
  4. Direct the documentation and maintenance of financial reporting controls, including process narratives, flowcharts, risk and control matrices, control objectives, and evidence requirements, ensuring documentation remains current and audit-ready.
  5. Lead the planning, execution, and evaluation of control testing activities, including assessment methodologies, deficiency evaluations, root cause analysis, remediation plans, and re-testing activities.
  6. Oversee the identification, assessment, and reporting of control deficiencies, providing recommendations to management and monitoring corrective actions to ensure timely and sustainable resolution.
  7. Partner with Finance, Information Technology, Internal Audit, and operational leaders to evaluate and strengthen controls related to financial reporting systems, data integrity, automated processes, IT General Controls, and end-user computing tools.
  8. Serve as the primary liaison with internal and external auditors on matters related to financial reporting controls, coordinating walkthroughs, testing activities, audit requests, and management responses.
  9. Provide regular reporting, strategic advice, and recommendations to senior leadership regarding the effectiveness of the control environment, key risks, remediation progress, emerging issues, and overall ICFR program maturity.
  10. Lead initiatives that enhance control awareness, promote ownership and accountability across the organization, and foster a culture of risk management, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  11. Identify opportunities to strengthen governance, improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, leverage automation, and enhance the effectiveness and sustainability of financial reporting controls.
  12. Performs other related duties as required.

Qualifications:

A Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation and a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited post-secondary institution in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline.

A minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience demonstrating the ability to:

  • Lead and support organization-wide internal control, financial reporting, audit, or risk management initiatives.
  • Apply knowledge of Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR), the COSO Framework, financial statement assertions, and applicable accounting standards.
  • Assess risks, evaluate control effectiveness, identify deficiencies, and develop practical recommendations to strengthen governance and financial reporting processes.
  • Build collaborative relationships and effectively communicate with senior leaders, auditors, business partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Prepare and present clear, concise reports, recommendations, and technical information for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines while maintaining a high degree of accuracy, professionalism, and attention to detail.


Applications:

It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that the application is received through the online application system prior to close. Each application must include a cover letter explaining how each qualification is met and an updated resume.

The Saskatchewan Workers' Compensation Board is committed to achieving a representative workforce. Members of designated groups (women, aboriginal people, people with disabilities and visible minorities) are encouraged to apply.

Application Deadline: November 22, 2026

title: Ervaren medewerker Omgevingsvergunningen
description:
Wil jij werken in een enthousiast team waar kennis wordt gedeeld? Wil jij samen focussen op wat wél kan? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?
Jij neemt besluiten! Besluiten op het gebied van het omgevingsrecht. Je werkt van concept tot verleende vergunningen en werkt samen met allerlei disciplines en instanties, zoals de Veiligheidsregio en de Omgevingsdienst. Dagelijks krijg je uiteenlopende aanvragen binnen die je gaat behandelen. Van particuliere aanvragen voor het plaatsen van een dakkapel tot aanvragen van ondernemers voor omvangrijke bouwactiviteiten. Jij bent de verbindende factor tussen klant en de BUCH en je begeleidt en adviseert de klant (casemanager).

Je zet aanvragen voor advies uit bij interne collega's en externe partijen, haalt adviezen op, beoordeelt deze op motivatie en vertaalt deze naar een besluit. Je bent een vraagbaak met betrekking tot (vergunningsvrij) bouwen en omgevingsplannen. Je zoekt de juridische puzzel uit en lost deze op; hierin werk je nauw samen met de juridisch adviseur. Er is veel contact met aanvragers en gemachtigden, zoals architecten, aannemers en andere betrokkenen.

De Omgevingswet is per 1 januari 2024 in werking getreden. Deze wet staat voor een goede balans tussen het benutten en beschermen van de fysieke leefomgeving. Samen hebben wij de uitdaging om deze wet binnen de BUCH op de juiste manier toe te passen.

Jij?
Staat klaar voor de klant met je creatieve instelling. Je staat stevig in je schoenen, neemt initiatief en bent nieuwsgierig. Je hebt gevoel voor politieke en bestuurlijke verhoudingen en bent op ieder niveau een prettige gesprekspartner. Je stelt de juiste prioriteiten in je werk en zoekt altijd naar verbetermogelijkheden.

Verder heb jij:
  • Een afgeronde mbo-opleiding bouwkunde, Ruimtelijke Ordening of een andere relevante opleiding;
  • Een diploma ABW1 (ABW2 is een pré);
  • Recent vakinhoudelijke cursussen gevolgd op het gebied van omgevingsrecht of je bent bereid deze te volgen;
  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke functie.

En wij?
Wij werken als één werkorganisatie voor de gemeenten Bergen, Uitgeest, Castricum en Heiloo. Bij ons gebeurt van alles. Iedere dag lees je onderwerpen in de media waaraan jij een bijdrage hebt geleverd.

Bij team Vergunningen werken we met 50 enthousiaste collega's. Binnen het cluster Omgevingsvergunningen heb je 20 tot 25 directe collega's. Wij bieden kwalitatief hoogwaardige, efficiënte en innovatieve dienstverlening aan onze klanten: het bestuur, inwoners, ondernemers en instellingen. Onze focus ligt op het proces, waarbij initiatieven worden ondersteund. Ons motto hierbij is: "ja, mits". Wij helpen elkaar waar nodig en werken hard, mét humor. Naast de directe collega's werken er binnen de BUCH nog ongeveer 850 enthousiaste collega's die klaarstaan voor onze inwoners, ondernemers en bezoekers.

Collega, medewerker Omgevingsvergunningen:
"Wij werken in een enthousiast team met fijne collega's, waar je de mogelijkheid hebt om met elkaar zaken te delen en samen naar mogelijkheden te zoeken. Mijn direct leidinggevenden zijn hierbij op een prettige manier betrokken."

Een goed begin is het halve werk. Daarom begin je bij ons met een introductieprogramma zodat jij je snel thuis voelt. Je persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling vinden wij belangrijk. Daarom hebben wij onze eigen BUCH-academie met een divers aanbod aan opleidingen en trainingen die bijdragen aan je professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Ben je jonger dan 35 jaar? Dan kun je je aansluiten bij BUCH Jong. Bij BUCH Jong ligt de focus op verbinding, kennis delen en ontwikkeling, maar er wordt ook genoeg aandacht besteed aan ontmoeting en ontspanning.

En verder:
  • Met flexibele werktijden en goede faciliteiten om werken op kantoor en thuis te combineren bieden we goede balans tussen werk en privé.
  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €3.568,- € 5.096,- (schaal 9) bij een 36-urige werkweek.
  • Daarbovenop krijg je 17,05% Individueel Keuze Budget over je brutosalaris dat je naar eigen voorkeur kunt besteden. Met het IKB maak jij keuzes die bij jou passen en stel je zelf een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden samen. Je kunt bijvoorbeeld je maandinkomen aanvullen, het omzetten in extra verlof of bruto-netto voordelen behalen bij de aanschaf van bijvoorbeeld een sportabonnement, museumjaarkaart of een opleiding die niet door de werkgever wordt vergoed. Jaarlijks mag je €1.250,- uit je IKB inzetten voor het aflossen van je studieschuld bij DUO.
  • Een uitstekende pensioenopbouw bij ABP - waarvan de werkgever 70% betaalt
  • Jaarlijks ontvang je in de maand november een vitaliteitsbonus van netto €200,- en een bijdrage aan je zorgverzekering van bruto € 168,- in december;
  • Een laptop, telefoon en thuiswerkvergoeding.
  • Voor de dagen dat je op locatie komt werken ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer of kan je kiezen voor een persoonlijke NS-businesscard waarmee je gebruik kan maken van alle vormen van openbaar vervoer 2e klasse, OV fiets, P+R parkeren en fietsenstalling.
  • Ruim 5 weken vakantie per jaar.
  • Een jaarcontract met de intentie om dit na afloop om te zetten in een vast dienstverband.

Leuk?
Leuk! Solliciteer dan vóór 10 december 2026. Heb je vragen of wil je weten hoe een dag als Medewerker Omgevingsvergunningen eruitziet? Neem dan gerust contact op met Evelyne Kühne, Teammanager Vergunningen domein Ruimtelijke Ontwikkeling, te bereiken op: 06 2575 6011. Evelyne staat je graag te woord.

Matchen we?
Als we allebei enthousiast zijn, bellen wij jou om je uit te nodigen voor een gesprek op dinsdagmiddag 15 december. Houd je hier alvast rekening mee in je agenda? Hierna volgt mogelijk nog een 2e sollicitatiegesprek op dinsdagochtend 22 december we ronden de procedure af met een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek.

title: Ford Master Technician
description:
Ford Master Technician

Location: Ennis, TX
Job type: Full-time
Schedule: Monday–Friday; Saturdays as needed to complete your work
Pay: Negotiable based on experience and qualifications

Build your career at Ennis Ford

Ennis Ford, part of the family-owned Toliver Auto Group, is looking for an experienced Ford technician to join our service team. We value the people behind the work and aim to create a workplace grounded in respect, transparency, teamwork, and professional growth.

Our newly remodeled shop offers a comfortable, well-equipped place to do your best work—with A/C, updated equipment, and a team that appreciates the skill and care expert technicians bring to every repair.

About the role

As a Ford Master Technician, you’ll take on advanced diagnostic and repair work across a range of Ford vehicles and systems. Ford Master status reflects broad, manufacturer-specific technical knowledge—not simply years on the job. Ford’s technician training covers areas such as diagnostics, electrical and electronic systems, engines, diesel, steering and suspension, and hybrid and electric vehicle technology. The role calls for sound judgment, precise troubleshooting, and a commitment to following current Ford procedures.

You’ll work closely with Service Advisors and fellow technicians to identify concerns, document findings, explain needed repairs, and help deliver a reliable, “Fixed Right First Time” experience for our guests.

What you’ll do

  • Diagnose and repair complex engine, transmission, electrical, and chassis concerns.
  • Complete Ford recalls and warranty repairs in accordance with manufacturer procedures.
  • Use Ford diagnostic software and equipment, including IDS/FDRS, to support accurate troubleshooting and repairs.
  • Document diagnostic results, repair steps, and recommendations clearly and thoroughly.
  • Collaborate with Service Advisors on repair estimates and timelines.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area while supporting an efficient team workflow.
  • Keep your Ford technical knowledge current as vehicle systems and service procedures evolve.

What you’ll bring

  • At least five years of professional experience in a Ford dealership service environment.
  • Current Ford certification at the “34” level or higher; Ford Master or Senior Master certification preferred.
  • Strong diagnostic skills and in-depth knowledge of modern automotive systems.
  • A professional tool set and the ability to use it safely and effectively.
  • A valid driver’s license and clean driving record.
  • A self-directed, quality-focused approach to productivity and teamwork.
  • Ability to commute to Ennis, TX.
  • Ability to pass a background check and drug screening.

Why Ennis Ford?

  • A refreshed workspace: Newly remodeled shop with A/C, new flooring, fresh paint, upgraded insulation, new roll-up doors, and updated bathrooms and break room.
  • Equipment for the work: Up-to-date shop equipment to help you diagnose and repair vehicles efficiently.
  • A family-owned culture: Personal, respectful day-to-day relationships backed by the stability of the Toliver Auto Group.
  • A chance to grow: Ford’s manufacturer-specific training and credentials help technicians continue developing their expertise as vehicle technology advances.
  • Confidential conversations: We understand that you may be working elsewhere. Inquiries will be handled confidentially.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Employee vehicle purchase and service discounts

Equal opportunity

Ennis Ford is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a respectful workplace and do not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any characteristic protected by applicable law.

  • izvedba energetskih projektov: samostojno vodenje izvedbe od naročila opreme in gradnje do zagona in predaje v obratovanje, usklajevanje s projektanti, dobavitelji, izvajalci in operaterji omrežij,

  • projekti EU: iskanje evropskih in nacionalnih razpisov in priprava prijav, oblikovanje konzorcijev, vodenje delovnih sklopov ali celotnih projektov, vsebinsko in finančno poročanje ter skrb za skladnost s pravili financerjev,

  • projekti IT: vodenje razvoja in uvajanja programskih rešitev in podatkovne platforme, povezanih z energetskimi projekti (zahteve, prioritete, načrt izdaj, prevzem), usklajevanje notranjih razvijalcev in zunanjih izvajalcev ter integracije s sistemi naročnikov, trgov in operaterjev,

  • načrtovanje in nadzor: terminski plan, proračun, viri in tveganja projektov, spremljanje napredka in pravočasno ukrepanje ob odstopanjih,

  • pogodbe in dokumentacija: sodelovanje pri pripravi pogodb s partnerji, naročniki in financerji, vodenje projektne dokumentacije, poročil in analiz,

  • komunikacija: redno poročanje vodstvu in naročnikom, sodelovanje z ekipo in zunanjimi deležniki ter predstavitve projektov v slovenskem in angleškem jeziku,

  • pridobivanje novih projektov: sodelovanje pri pripravi ponudb, oceni izvedljivosti in oblikovanju novih storitev in poslovnih modelov,

  • izboljšave: uvajanje dobrih praks projektnega vodenja in orodij (vključno z orodji umetne inteligence) za hitrejše in preglednejše vodenje projektov.

Pričakujemo

  • Najmanj VI. stopnjo izobrazbe tehnične (FE, FS, FRI …), naravoslovne ali ekonomske smeri,

  • aktivno znanje angleškega jezika,

  • vsaj 5 let izkušenj z vodenjem projektov, od tega več uspešno zaključenih projektov s področja energetike (priprava in izvedba postrojev ali energetske infrastrukture),

  • izkušnje z vodenjem projektnih ekip in zunanjih izvajalcev,

  • poznavanje metod in orodij projektnega vodenja (načrtovanje, proračun, tveganja, klasični in agilni pristopi),

  • dobro poznavanje energetskih sistemov ter tehničnega in poslovnega vidika projektov,

  • sposobnost usklajevanja različnih deležnikov in odločnost pri zaključevanju nalog,

  • odlične komunikacijske veščine: jasno pisanje poročil in prijav ter predstavitev pred večjimi skupinami,

  • samostojnost, natančnost, organiziranost in samoiniciativnost.

Prednost – na pa pogoj predstavljajo:

  • Izkušnje s prijavo, vodenjem ter finančnim in administrativnim poročanjem projektov EU,

  • izkušnje z vodenjem IT projektov (Scrum/Kanban, Azure DevOps, Jira ali podobno),

  • izkušnje s projekti baterijskih hranilnikov, OVE, vodika ali priključevanja na omrežje,

  • poznavanje trga z električno energijo in sistemskih storitev,

  • certifikat projektnega vodenja (IPMA, PMP, PRINCE2 ali podobno),

  • vozniški izpit kategorije B,

  • če imate javno dostopen projekt (npr. GitHub), ki prikazuje vaše delo, nam pošljite povezavo.

Nudimo

  • Zaposlitev za nedoločen čas s poskusno dobo 6 mesecev,

  • vodenje zahtevnih energetskih projektov, ki jih povezujemo s projekti EU in razvojem programske opreme,

  • visoko stopnjo avtonomije in samostojnosti ter priložnosti za uresničitev lastnih idej,

  • sodelovanje na »state-of-the-art« projektih s partnerji iz Slovenije in tujine,

  • strukturirano uvajanje in možnost napredovanja,

  • močan razvoj znanj (mentorstvo, uvajanje, izobraževanja),

  • dinamično okolje, kjer se dobre ideje hitro uresničijo,

  • stimulativno plačilo in paket ugodnosti.

  • fleksibilen delovni čas in možnost dela od doma (2 dni/tedensko).

Podjetje vsem svojim zaposlenim financira:

  • dodatno pokojninsko zavarovanje;

  • zavarovanje za primer operacije ali bolezni;

  • zavarovanje, ki omogoča hiter dostop do specialista;

  • kolektivno nezgodno zavarovanje.

Na željo oz. dogovor z zaposlenim pa še:

  • udeležbo na Maratonu Franja;

  • udeležbo na Ljubljanskem maratonu;

  • sofinanciranje študija ob delu;

  • vključitev družinskih članov v zdravstvena zavarovanja po znižanih premijah.

title: BAY01EB
