title: Senior Cross Enclave Printing Engineer II
description:
About Agile Defense
At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.
Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.

Requisition #: 2003
Job Title: Senior Cross Enclave Printing Engineer II
Location: Pocatello, ID, hybrid
Clearance Level: TS / SCI and ability to obtain and maintain a CI Polygraph

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Cross Enclave Print Engineer. This role will be responsible for maintaining, documenting, upgrading, and patching the FBI’s cross-enclave printing systems. Experience with Forcepoint or other cross-enclave and trusted gateway solutions is a plus. A strong understanding of Linux OS, Windows OS and their associated printing services as is desired.

Responsibilities

  • Engineer, design, install, implement, and configure new cross enclave systems.
  • Provide ongoing integration and support of the existing Linux Infrastructure.
  • Engineer and configure secure data routes between enclaves with varying classification levels, ensuring the security of data.
  • Engineer and configure printing between enclaves with secure configurations sufficient to acquire Authority to Operate.
  • Served as cross enclave printing subject matter expert, providing 4th-level support.
  • Assist with system accreditations and resolve security vulnerabilities, findings, or mitigate concerns.
  • Work with security and engineering groups to ensure all components are monitored and remain within approved specifications.
  • Evaluate, improve, and maintain information security throughout the Linux infrastructure.
  • Maintain security, backup, and redundancy strategies.
  • Integrate systems with Windows as it applies to authentication and core services dependencies (such as single sign-on and Active Directory). Engineer and implement solutions for multi-factor authentication using FBI-standardized software and hardware.
  • Ensure the daily operations of the cross-enclave environment.
  • Carry out all component patching, maintenance, and upgrades. Ensure any changes are documented and verify that changes do not introduce new operational or vulnerability issues.
  • Resolve performance and operational issues both proactively and as they occur.
  • Liaise with vendors and other IT personnel for problem resolution.
  • Monitor and correct server issues, and create recovery processes for failures and performance bottlenecks.
  • Monitor and test application performance for potential bottlenecks, identify possible solutions, and work with developers to implement those fixes.
  • Proactively ensure the highest levels of systems and infrastructure availability.
  • Manage and monitor all installed systems and infrastructure.

Required Skills

  • Six years of Linux OS experience.
  • Active Top Secret clearance; must be capable of obtaining and maintaining CI-Poly.

Preferred Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Firm understanding of Linux printing services
  • Firm understanding of Linux OS
  • A good understanding of Windows printing services
  • A reasonable understand of Windows OS
  • Secure, cross enclave systems experience
  • Linux OS certifications
  • A reasonable understanding of DNS, DHCP, LDAP, TCP/IP, iDRAC, iLO, and IMC

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

  • Office and datacenter environment.
  • Ability to sit and stand for extended periods.
  • Occasionally lift 50+ lbs. (team lift).
In addition, Agile Defense invests in its employees beyond just compensation. Agile’s benefits offerings include, dependent upon position, Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, short-term and long-term Disability, Retirement and Learning and Development opportunities as well as other optional benefit elections.

Our Core Values
Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.
What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. It's who we are.
  • Happy - Be Infectious. Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do.
  • Helpful - Be Supportive. Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated.
  • Honest - Be Trustworthy. Honesty serves as our compass, ensuring transparent communication and ethical conduct, essential to who we are and the complex domains we support.
  • Humble - Be Grounded. Success is not achieved alone, humility ensures a culture of mutual respect, encouraging open communication, and a willingness to learn from one another and take on any task.
  • Hungry - Be Eager. Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges.
  • Hustle - Be Driven. Hustle is reflected in our relentless work ethic, where we are each committed to going above and beyond to advance the mission and achieve success.
Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

title: Nuorempi ohjelmistosuunnittelija
description: Oletko urasi alkupuolella oleva ohjelmistokehittäjä? Haluatko kasvattaa osaamistasi älykkään liikenteen ja kaupunkien ratkaisujen parissa, monialaisen tiimin tukemana?Haemme nyt **nuorempaa ohjelmistosuunnittelijaa** Jyväskylään vahvistamaan ohjelmistotekemistämme!Nodeon on älykkään infran teknologia-asiantuntija. Tavoitteenamme on luoda ihmisille parempia elinympäristöjä kehittämällä tulevaisuuden infrasta entistä älykkäämpää. Olemme yksi toimialamme johtavista teknologiaosaajista. Ydinosaamistamme ovat ohjelmistokehitys ja IoT-ratkaisut sekä tietoliikenne-, automaatio-, sähkö- ja valaistussuunnittelu.**Ohjelmistosuunnittelijamme** työskentelevät asiakasprojekteissa sekä Nodeonin omassa tuote- ja palvelukehityksessä. Kehitämme älykkään liikenteen, kaupunkien ja infrastruktuurin teknologiaratkaisuja, jotka parantavat arjen sujuvuutta, turvallisuutta ja elinympäristöjen toimivuutta. Asiakkaitamme ja yhteistyökumppaneitamme ovat muun muassa Fintraffic, muut alan valtakunnalliset julkiset toimijat ja Suomen suurimmat kaupungit sekä laaja joukko alan yrityksiä urakoitsijoista teknologia- ja järjestelmätoimittajiin sekä suunnittelu- ja konsulttiyrityksiin.Oman tuotekehityksemme keskiössä on **Asgard-ratkaisukokonaisuus**, joka kattaa liikenteenhallinnan ja opastusjärjestelmät, liikennetiedon hallinnan ja reaaliaikaiset tilannekuvaratkaisut sekä liikenteen mittauspalvelut.**Lue lisää ohjelmistosuunnittelustamme täältä: /****Lue lisää Nodeon Asgard -palveluistamme täältä: /**Tule kanssamme kehittämään infran ohjelmistoratkaisuja ja samalla toimivampia ja turvallisempia elinympäristöjä!**Mitä työsi pitää sisällään**Suunnittelet ja toteutat monipuolisia ohjelmistoratkaisuja taustajärjestelmistä ja selainpohjaisista käyttöliittymistä rajapintoihin, integraatioihin ja laiteläheisiin tiedonkeruuratkaisuihin. Kehittämämme järjestelmät liittyvät usein fyysisen ympäristön ohjaukseen, valvontaan ja tiedonkeruuseen. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä eri alojen suunnittelu- ja kehitystiimien kanssa. Aloitat kokeneempien suunnittelijoiden rinnalla ja pääset mukaan oikeisiin asiakasprojekteihin heti — tehtäväsi laajenevat sitä mukaa kuin osaamisesi karttuu. Et ole yksin: sinulle nimetään tehtävään perehdyttäjä ja tuki on lähellä.**Ajattelutapa, jota arvostamme:** Arvostamme asiantuntijaa, jonka ammattiylpeys näkyy haluna oppia uutta, tarttua teknologisiin haasteisiin ja olla ylpeä työnsä jäljestä. Teknisen arkkitehtuurin ja integraatioiden lisäksi kiinnostuksen tulee ulottua siihen, miksi ja mihin tarkoitukseen järjestelmiä rakennetaan. Tekoälyn aikakaudella korostuvat kokonaisuuksien hahmottaminen, syvällinen ymmärrys ja kyky ilmaista ajatukset täsmällisesti myös kirjallisesti. Arvostamme itsenäistä työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja rohkeutta tuoda omat ideat esiin.**Tässä tehtävässä menestyt, kun sinulla on...**- Aitoa innostusta ohjelmistokehitykseen, rohkeutta tarttua uusiin teknologioihin ja haasteisiin sekä vahvaa halua oppia ja kehittää omaa osaamistaan - Hieman jo kokemusta tekoälyavusteisesta ohjelmistokehityksestä ja AI-työkalujen hyödyntämisestä sekä kykyä jakaa ongelmia hallittaviin kokonaisuuksiin ja ottaa vastuuta oman työn tuloksista - Ohjelmistokehityksen perusteet hallussa sekä valmiuksia ohjelmistojen suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen kokeneempien asiantuntijoiden ohjauksessa - Oma-aloitteinen ja luotettava työote sekä valmiutta työskennellä osana tiimiä **Plussaksi laskemme:**- Alan koulutuksen tai loppuvaiheessa olevat opinnot – myös opinnäytetyön aihe voi löytyä meiltä - Omat harjoitus- ja harrastusprojektit tai muun teknologiaan liittyvän harrastuneisuuden - Kokemuksen yleisistä ohjelmistoteknologioista, kuten C#, Javasta, Reactista tai SQL-pohjaisista tietokannoista - Kokemuksen pilvipalveluiden, kuten Azuren tai AWS, käytöstä ja hallinnasta **Mitä saat meiltä:**- **Merkityksellisiä ja monipuolisia projekteja**, joissa työsi näkyy konkreettisesti kaupunki- ja liikenneympäristöjen turvallisuudessa ja toimivuudessa - **Uniikin yrityskulttuurin ja vahvan tiimihengen**. Löydämme aina syytä juhlaan esim. joulu- ja kevätpäivien, legendaksi muodostuneiden lanien ja muiden ajanviettojen merkeissä - **Tilaa kasvaa ja kehittyä**. Pääset laajentamaan osaamistasi kiinnostuksesi mukaan uusissa tehtävissä ja projekteissa, osaavan ja monialaisen tiimin tukemana. Tuemme kehittymistäsi myös tarvittaessa koulutuksilla - **Matalan hierarkian ja jaetun johtamisen mallin**, jossa työyhteisömme jäseniä osallistetaan laajasti päätöksentekoon ja toimintamme kehittämiseen - **Monipuoliset edut,** kuten Epassin lounas- ja Flex-edut sekä puhelin- ja polkupyöräedut sekä joustavat työskentelymallit

title: Senior UX Researcher / Designer (5 week contract)
description:
We’re looking for an experienced UX researcher and designer to join us for a five week contract on a client project. You’ll hit the ground running, planning and running user research through interviews, usability testing and workshops, then turning what you find into insights, personas and journey maps the team can act on.

From there, you’ll translate that work into wireframes and prototypes in Figma and present findings and design decisions to clients and stakeholders with confidence, working closely with developers, product and delivery in an agile team throughout.

You’ll have 6+ years in UX design with a strong research and service design focus, ideally in an agency or consulting environment, plus a portfolio showing research led work such as journey maps, personas and prototypes. You’re confident in Figma and Miro, and comfortable presenting to clients and getting buy in quickly. Above all, you can start on 16 November and be productive from day one.

Bilue = Big + Blue Ocean. Are you ready to set sail? Apply now!

This position description illustrates the scope and responsibilities of the role and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. You may be expected to perform other related tasks as requested.

We believe that having balanced teams is fundamental to our success. We will not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status or disability status.

title: Oman äidinkielen kiertävä sivutoiminen tuntiopettaja (romani)
description:
Etsimme joukkoomme oman äidinkielen sivutoimista opettajaa tukemaan Espoon monikielisiä oppilaita heidän kieli- ja kulttuuri-identiteettinsä vahvistamisessa. Opettaja työskentelee oppilaiden kanssa eri Espoon kouluista. Tehtävässä ohjaat oppilaita kehittämään omaa äidinkieltään, arvostamaan monikielisyyttä sekä hyödyntämään kielitaitoaan oppimisessa, vuorovaikutuksessa ja ajattelun tukena.

Oman äidinkielen opetus edistää oppilaiden aktiivista monikielisyyttä, laajentaa kulttuurista ymmärrystä ja tukee myös suomen tai ruotsin kielen oppimista. Työhösi kuuluu tiivis yhteistyö eri koulujen henkilöstön sekä huoltajien kanssa, jotta oppilaiden kielellistä ja kulttuurista kehitystä voidaan tukea kokonaisvaltaisesti. Opetustunnit järjestetään pääasiassa klo 16 jälkeen.

Jos haluat olla mukana vahvistamassa oppilaiden kielellisiä ja kulttuurisia voimavaroja, tervetuloa osaksi asiantuntevaa ja monikielisyyttä arvostavaa työyhteisöämme!

Työpaikan nimi ja osoite: Kasvun ja oppimisen toimiala, Suomenkielisen perusopetuksen tulosyksikkö, Monikulttuuristen opetuspalvelujen palvelualue, Karaportti 1, 02610 Espoo.
Työaika: 2 opetustuntia viikossa
Tehtävä on määräaikainen.

Opettajien kelpoisuudet määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen no 986/98 mukaisesti. Asetuksen 9 §:n mukaisesti perusopetusta antavalla opettajalla tulee olla suomen kielen erinomainen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

(If studies have not been completed in Finland, the degree must be recognized by the Finnish National Agency for Education.)

Määräaikaisissa tehtävissä huomioimme myös ei-kelpoiset hakijat.

Edellytämme kielialueiden kulttuurien hyvää tuntemusta, tietoteknisiä taitoja, kokemusta lasten ja nuorten opetuksesta peruskoulussa, eriyttävien opetusmenetelmien hallintaa sekä kokemusta sähköisten opetusvälineiden pedagogisesta käytöstä. Opetettavan kielen tulee olla hakijalla äidinkielenveroinen.

Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6.2 §:n tarkoittama rikosrekisteriote.

Arvostamme erinomaisia tiimi-, vuorovaikutus- sekä työyhteisötaitoja, oma-aloitteisuutta ja joustavuutta nopeasti muuttuvassa arjessa, kehittämismyönteisyyttä ja sitoutuneisuutta.

Edelläkävijöiden Espoo - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää

Espoo on edelläkävijöiden kaupunki. Työnantajalupauksemme - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää - näkyy arjessamme sujuvana työnä, osaamisen pitkäjänteisenä kehittämisenä ja fiksuna johtamisena. Rakennamme yhdessä kaupunkia, jossa työn merkitys on selkeä ja asiantuntijuutta arvostetaan.

Tuemme ammatillista oppimistasi ja kehittymistäsi sekä työn ja muun elämän yhteensovittamista joustavilla käytännöillä.

Toimintamme perustuu avoimuuteen ja luottamukseen, ja kohtaamme toisemme arvostavasti. Olemme sitoutuneet yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseen ja toivomme työyhteisöömme eri-ikäisiä, eri taustoista ja eri kieliä puhuvia osaajia.

Tehtävään ja hakuprosessiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit olla yhteydessä tehtävän lisätietojen antajaan.

title: Personal Injury Case Manager
description:
Position Summary Personal Injury Case Manager Bilingual English/Spanish
About us Our company is a client-focused personal injury law firm dedicated to representing individuals injured in motor vehicle accidents and other negligence-related incidents. The firm combines compassionate client service, experienced legal advocacy, measurable performance standards, and advanced technology to move cases efficiently toward resolution. The firm is an early adopter of legal technology and artificial intelligence. After using Filevine for case management since 2017, the firm is transitioning to EvenUp's AI-powered case management platform to streamline routine administrative tasks, improve workflow consistency, and allow Case Managers to focus on medical management, strategy, negotiation, and client relationships.
Position Summary We are seeking an experienced, bilingual Personal Injury Case Manager to oversee a portfolio of pre-litigation personal injury cases from initial case development through settlement. The Case Manager will serve as the client's primary point of contact and will be responsible for medical management, treatment monitoring, client communication, insurance-adjuster communication, case strategy, settlement preparation, and negotiation under attorney supervision. This is not a purely administrative position. The firm has Case Coordinators and technology systems that support claims setup, records collection, lien matters, and other administrative processes. The Case Manager is expected to understand the complete case, identify opportunities and risks, guide the client's medical treatment journey, resolve bottlenecks, and make informed recommendations to the supervising attorney. The ideal candidate can independently manage approximately 70 to 80 active cases while maintaining close attention to the facts, injuries, treatment, insurance coverage, damages, and strategic nuances of each matter. As the firm's AI tools and standard operating procedures continue to develop, the caseload may increase to approximately 100 active cases. Success requires more than high-volume experience. The firm is seeking someone who can manage a substantial caseload while providing thoughtful case strategy, accurate documentation, timely follow-up, strong client service, and individualized attention.
Work Arrangement This is an on-site position based at the firm's office in Henderson, Nevada 89052. Candidates must be able to commute reliably to the office and work the established full-time schedule. Remote employment is not currently available for this opening.
Caseload and Performance Expectations Active Caseload The expected starting caseload is approximately 70 to 80 active pre-litigation cases. The caseload may increase to approximately 100 cases as the firm completes its technology implementation and improves workflows. The firm currently signs approximately 30 new cases per month across a team of approximately five to six Case Managers. Case Managers must move cases forward consistently so that incoming and resolved cases remain reasonably balanced. Performance Expectations Case Managers are expected to: Meet established key performance indicators. Follow the firm's standard operating procedures. Maintain accurate and current case-management records. Progress cases without unnecessary delay. Complete timely client follow-up. Monitor treatment and prevent gaps in care. Obtain and evaluate insurance coverage information promptly. Review and finalize demands efficiently. Resolve cases at an appropriate pace while maintaining quality. Work independently and ask targeted questions when attorney input is genuinely required. Use AI and automation to improve efficiency without sacrificing accuracy or professional judgment. Key Responsibilities Pre-Litigation Case Management Manage a portfolio of personal injury matters from post-intake case development through pre-litigation settlement. Maintain a complete understanding of the facts, liability, injuries, treatment, insurance coverage, damages, and strategic posture of every assigned case. Develop and update case plans based on the unique circumstances of each client. Monitor deadlines, case milestones, outstanding tasks, and potential delays. Identify case risks, missing information, and strategic opportunities. Advance cases consistently in accordance with firm KPIs and SOPs. Escalate legal, ethical, medical, coverage, or valuation concerns to the supervising attorney. Prepare matters for attorney review, demand submission, negotiation, settlement, or transfer to litigation. Medical Management Guide clients through the treatment phase of their personal injury claims. Monitor medical treatment, diagnoses, referrals, imaging, specialist care, procedures, and recovery progress. Review medical records, diagnostic reports, billing ledgers, treatment summaries, and provider recommendations. Identify treatment gaps, missed appointments, unresolved referrals, or documentation deficiencies. Communicate with clients regarding the importance of treatment compliance and medical follow-up. Help coordinate communication with medical providers when records, bills, referrals, or treatment updates are needed. Evaluate whether the medical documentation supports the reported injuries and claimed damages. Identify when attorney input is needed regarding treatment strategy or case value. Maintain accurate and timely medical-management notes in the case-management system. Medical management and client communication are the primary responsibilities of this position. Client Communication and Support Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients. Provide regular and meaningful case-status updates. Explain the pre-litigation process, treatment expectations, insurance procedures, and next steps. Communicate complex legal and medical information clearly in English and Spanish. Respond to client questions promptly and professionally. Set appropriate expectations regarding timelines, settlement, treatment, and case progression. Document all important client communications. Recognize when a client concern requires attorney involvement. Maintain empathy while encouraging accountability and cooperation. Deliver an organized, responsive, and professional client experience throughout the case. Insurance Coverage and Adjuster Communication Communicate with liability and first-party insurance adjusters. Obtain policy information, declaration pages, and available coverage limits promptly. Follow up consistently when carriers fail to provide required information. Use approved third-party services when necessary to obtain policy-limit or insurance-coverage information. Monitor liability decisions, coverage questions, recorded-statement requests, and claim developments. Maintain accurate documentation of adjuster communications. Escalate disputed liability, inadequate coverage, bad-faith concerns, or complex insurance issues to the supervising attorney. Avoid unnecessary delay when a firm-approved cost or vendor service is necessary to move the case forward. Demand Package Review Use the firm's AI-supported demand process to generate draft demand packages. Review AI-generated demands carefully for factual, medical, financial, and legal accuracy. Confirm that the treatment chronology, injuries, diagnoses, medical expenses, lost wages, and damages are accurately represented. Verify that exhibits and supporting documents are complete, correctly labeled, and consistent with the demand. Identify missing records, bills, reports, photographs, wage documentation, or other evidence. Correct errors or incomplete information before attorney review. Submit the demand to the supervising attorney for approval. Finalize and send approved demands to the appropriate insurance carrier. Track demand deadlines and adjuster response dates. The Case Manager does not write demands manually from the beginning. The firm uses AI to prepare the initial draft, but the Case Manager remains responsible for reviewing its accuracy and ensuring that the final package is complete and appropriate. Settlement Negotiation Review settlement offers and supporting case information. Communicate with adjusters regarding offers, counteroffers, and outstanding case issues. Negotiate personal injury claims under attorney supervision. Prepare case summaries and recommendations for attorney review. Understand the relationship among liability, causation, treatment, damages, coverage, liens, and settlement value. Communicate authorized offers and settlement developments to clients. Document negotiations accurately and promptly. Follow attorney direction regarding settlement authority and negotiation strategy. Recognize when a matter should be escalated or evaluated for litigation. Property Damage Support Work with Case Coordinators to help clients resolve property-damage matters. Assist with vehicle-repair coordination. Help clients obtain rental vehicles when coverage is available. Support total-loss documentation and communication. Communicate with insurance carriers regarding property-damage status. Escalate disputed valuation, coverage, or liability matters when appropriate. Prior property-damage experience is helpful but not required. The firm can provide training in this area. Case Coordinator Collaboration The Case Manager works in tandem with a Case Coordinator who may assist with: Opening insurance claims. Requesting medical records and billing statements. Supporting lien-reduction activities. Maintaining administrative documentation. Completing other routine case-support tasks. The Case Manager remains responsible for overall case strategy, medical management, client communication, meaningful follow-up, demand readiness, and case progression. Settlement and Case Handoff Continue communicating with clients after a pre-litigation settlement. Coordinate with the accounting and disbursement team as it prepares the final settlement distribution. Keep clients informed regarding lien resolution and expected disbursement timing. Confirm that case-management tasks are complete before closure. Transfer cases to the litigation team when a lawsuit becomes necessary. Prepare clear handoff information when transferring a matter. Ensure that the client understands the transition to the litigation team. Case Managers do not remain responsible for the litigation phase once a case is formally transferred. Technology and AI Adoption Use EvenUp's AI-powered case management platform as the firm's primary case-management system. Follow automated workflows, voice-agent processes, task reminders, and future SOPs. Use AI-generated work product as a starting point while independently verifying accuracy. Adapt quickly to system modifications and new technology. Maintain complete and accurate data within the CRM. Use technology to reduce routine administrative work and increase time available for strategy and client service. Provide feedback on workflows and system improvements. Remain open to continued automation, artificial intelligence, and legal-technology developments. Because the EvenUp case-management platform is new, previous experience with it is not required. Experience with Filevine or another legal case-management platform is beneficial. More important is a demonstrated ability to learn and embrace new technology.
Required Qualifications Must-Have Qualifications At least one year of direct personal injury law firm experience. Experience managing or materially supporting pre-litigation personal injury cases. Professional fluency in English and Spanish, both written and spoken. Ability to communicate legal and medical concepts accurately in both languages. Experience communicating directly with personal injury clients. Working knowledge of motor vehicle accident claims. Ability to interpret medical records, diagnostic reports, treatment notes, and billing ledgers. Understanding of the pre-litigation personal injury case lifecycle. Experience communicating with insurance adjusters and medical providers. Ability to manage a substantial caseload and multiple competing deadlines. Strong attention to detail. Strong organization, prioritization, and follow-up skills. Ability to work independently after training. Sound judgment regarding when to act independently and when to request attorney guidance. Comfort using case-management software and digital workflows. Willingness to adopt AI-based technology and changing SOPs. Professional, empathetic, and client-focused communication skills. Reliable transportation and ability to work on-site in Henderson, Nevada. Preferred Qualifications Three or more years of personal injury case-management experience. Experience independently managing 70 or more active cases. Experience managing motor vehicle accident claims from intake through settlement. Experience with medical-management strategy. Experience reviewing demands or AI-generated demand packages. Experience negotiating personal injury claims under attorney supervision. Experience obtaining policy limits and declaration pages. Property-damage experience. Experience with Filevine, EvenUp, or comparable legal case-management software. Familiarity with Nevada personal injury practice and insurance procedures. Experience working with KPIs, productivity expectations, and formal SOPs. Certified Nevada Notary Public or willingness to obtain notary certification.
Core Competencies Personal Injury Case Management Pre-Litigation Case Management Motor Vehicle Accident Claims Medical Management Client Communication Bilingual English and Spanish Insurance Adjuster Communication Settlement Negotiation Demand Package Review AI-Generated Legal Documents EvenUp Filevine Legal Case Management Software Medical Records Review Medical Billing Review Insurance Coverage Analysis Policy Limits Property Damage Claims Case Strategy Caseload Management KPI Management SOP Compliance Legal Technology Attention to Detail Client Advocacy Time Management Independent Decision-Making Profile The ideal candidate: Has meaningful experience managing pre-litigation personal injury files. Understands how to develop a case rather than simply complete assigned tasks. Can explain their strategy for moving a case from initial treatment through settlement. Maintains close attention to the individual facts and medical details of every matter. Can manage 70 to 80 active cases without losing control of deadlines, treatment, communication, or strategy. Is prepared to manage additional files as improved systems reduce routine administrative work. Communicates professionally and empathetically in English and Spanish. Understands when to follow up persistently with adjusters, providers, or vendors. Is comfortable recommending necessary case expenses when they will prevent larger delays or problems. Reviews AI-generated work carefully instead of assuming that technology is always correct. Embraces new technology and is willing to change established work habits. Can meet KPIs without requiring constant reminders. Works independently but seeks guidance at the correct time. Demonstrates sound judgment, accountability, professionalism, and urgency. Values both the big-picture case strategy and the details that determine the quality of the outcome.
What Success Looks Like A successful Personal Injury Case Manager will: Maintain an organized caseload of approximately 70 to 80 active matters. Be prepared to scale toward approximately 100 cases as technology and workflows improve. Keep clients informed and engaged throughout the pre-litigation process. Prevent unnecessary gaps in medical treatment. Identify case issues before they become major delays. Obtain policy-limit and insurance information promptly. Review and finalize AI-generated demands accurately. Move demands to attorney review without avoidable bottlenecks. Negotiate claims effectively under attorney supervision. Maintain accurate and current case-management records. Meet the firm's KPIs and follow established SOPs. Balance empathy with professional case leadership. Use technology to improve productivity while maintaining independent judgment. Require minimal handholding after completing onboarding and training.
Non-Desirable Candidate Characteristics Likely Disqualifiers No personal injury law firm experience. Cannot communicate professionally in both English and Spanish. Cannot work on-site in Henderson, Nevada. Is uncomfortable managing a substantial caseload. Is unwilling to use AI, legal technology, or changing case-management systems. Cannot interpret medical records or billing information. Has no understanding of the pre-litigation personal injury lifecycle. Requires continuous supervision after training. Cannot maintain client confidentiality. Demonstrates poor client communication or unprofessional conduct. Case-Management Red Flags Claims to have managed a large caseload but handled only a small, segmented portion of each file. Cannot explain how they develop or "work up” a personal injury case. Focuses exclusively on completing tasks without understanding case strategy. Does not monitor medical treatment or treatment gaps. Cannot explain how liability, causation, treatment, damages, liens, and coverage affect case value. Allows policy-limit requests or demands to remain pending without persistent follow-up. Cannot describe prior communication with adjusters, providers, or clients. Has weak documentation habits. Frequently misses deadlines or follow-up dates. Cannot prioritize files based on urgency, medical status, or settlement readiness. Is hesitant to escalate significant issues to the supervising attorney. Avoids making decisions even when authority and procedures are clear. Technology Red Flags Resists changing established processes. Refuses to use AI-generated work product. Relies on AI output without checking it for accuracy. Has difficulty learning new case-management systems. Cannot comfortably communicate with a client while entering accurate notes. Avoids digital workflows or automated task systems. Views SOPs and KPIs as unnecessary restrictions. Is unwilling to adapt as the firm improves its processes. Behavioral Red Flags Requires repeated reminders to complete routine follow-up. Lacks empathy or patience with injured clients. Demonstrates poor judgment regarding case expenses. Delays necessary action to avoid reasonable case costs. Becomes overwhelmed by competing deadlines. Is defensive when receiving feedback. Demonstrates poor accountability for case delays or mistakes. Is overly confident but cannot support claims of expertise with detailed examples. Is primarily interested in using an offer to negotiate higher compensation with a current employer. Cannot provide a credible reason for seeking a new position. Shows limited interest in long-term growth with the firm.

title: IT Architect
description:
Werken voor Haarlem en Zandvoort is werk dat ertoe doet. Je ziet de resultaten terug in de stad en het dorp. Ook binnen de afdeling I-ontwikkeling maken we dagelijks impact. De afdeling bestaat uit vier teams: Changemanagement, Privacy & Security, Informatie- en Projectmanagement en Data-expertise. Jij komt te werken binnen het team Changemanagement.

Wij werken intensief samen, delen kennis en ondersteunen elkaar waar nodig. Daarbij streven we ernaar om maximale toegevoegde waarde te leveren aan de organisatie. Ons team is divers, deskundig, enthousiast en betrokken. We combineren inhoudelijke expertise met een praktische aanpak en vinden het belangrijk om ook buiten het werk tijd met elkaar door te brengen tijdens team- en afdelingsactiviteiten.



Functiebeschrijving

Je komt het bestaande Architectuurteam binnen het cluster Team Change Management versterken. Als architect ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor een samenhangende, toekomstbestendige informatie- en IT en OT architectuur en zorg je voor de samenhang tussen applicaties, bedrijfsprocessen en bedrijfsgegevens. Dit doe je met behulp van architectuurbeleidskaders, modelmatige beschrijvingen van het applicatielandschap, advisering, kennisdeling en het verbinden van betrokkenen binnen business en IT. Alles in nauwe samenwerking met andere experts in multidisciplinaire programma- en projectteams.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je draagt bij aan een samenhangend applicatielandschap dat efficiënt en doelmatig de bedrijfsprocessen ondersteunt. Dit doe je onder andere door architectuurbeleid te vertalen naar de informatievoorziening met behulp van architectuurmodellen en -documenten zoals roadmaps, projectarchitecturen en doelarchitecturen.
  • Je draagt bij aan de uitvoering van IT- en OT-aanbestedingen door het definiëren van de context waarbinnen IT- en OT-oplossingen moeten functioneren. Je adviseert bij het opstellen van eisen en wensen en beoordeelt gezamenlijk de uiteindelijke inschrijvingen.
  • Je bewaakt dat veranderingen in de informatievoorziening worden uitgevoerd in lijn met het gemeente brede architectuurbeleid.
  • Je zorgt voor goede afstemming met betrokkenen zoals collega's, opdrachtgevers, besluitvormingsorganen, programma- en projectteams.


Functie-eisen
  • Je hebt een afgeronde relevante opleiding op minimaal HBO-niveau.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring als IT-architect binnen een complexe en politiek-bestuurlijke omgeving. Ervaring met OT is gewenst.
  • Je kennis van architectuurontwikkeling en gemeentelijke informatievoorziening, waaronder Common Ground, GEMMA, GIBIT en BIO, is actueel.
  • Je hebt ervaring met cloudoplossingen en het begeleiden van cloudtransities.
  • Je hebt sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen complexe architectuurvraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor diverse stakeholders.
  • Je bent een resultaatgerichte teamspeler en bruggenbouwer, met een zelfstandige en initiatiefrijke werkstijl binnen project- en programmastructuren.


Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Wij waarderen, omarmen en benutten de verschillen en talenten van mensen. Wij bieden een plek waar iedereen zich thuis kan voelen en zichzelf mag zijn. Daar maken wij ons hard voor. Dat is goed voor onze medewerkers én leidt tot de beste resultaten voor de stad en het dorp.

  • Voor jouw persoonlijke groei en vitaliteit bieden wij tal van mogelijkheden. Denk aan het volgen van opleidingen, certificeringen, cursussen via onze ‘Academie Haarlem' en ook een fietsregeling en een tegemoetkoming in je sportabonnement.
  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 32 - 36 uur per week. Je start met een jaarcontract dat we bij goed functioneren graag omzetten in een vast contract.
  • Het salaris is afhankelijk van ervaring en opleiding en bedraagt maximaal € 6.422 bruto per maand (schaal 11) bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur per week. Indien je nog niet volledig aan de ervaring voldoet, is een aanloopschaal van toepassing.
  • Daarbovenop krijg je 17,05% Individueel Keuze Budget over je bruto salaris, waarmee je zelf je eigen arbeidsvoorwaarden samenstelt.
  • Hybride werken is bij onze gemeente aan de orde van de dag. De ene dag ben je op kantoor, een ander moment kies je voor thuiswerken. Wij faciliteren je daarbij. Waar je ook werkt, je bent altijd in verbinding met je collega's.
  • Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals vergoeding OV-reiskosten, gedeeltelijk betaald ouderschapsverlof en een goede pensioenregeling bij het ABP. Bekijk de arbeidsvoorwaarden van de Cao Gemeenten

Onze organisatiewaarden zijn open, gedreven en betrokken.

title: Adviseur innovatie
description:
Bij voldoende geschikte sollicitaties kan deze vacature eerder worden gesloten. Wacht daarom niet te lang met solliciteren.

Misschien ken je Purmerend al goed, of is dit juist jouw eerste ontmoeting met onze gemeente. Misschien weet je dat we die plek zijn ten noorden van Amsterdam, óf woon je hier al jaren met plezier. Wat we je in ieder geval kunnen vertellen: we groeien door naar een gemeente met 100.000 inwoners en werken elke dag aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst. En dat merk je. We bouwen, vernieuwen, professionaliseren en dat doen we samen.

Purmerend groeit snel, en dat vraagt om een organisatie die digitaal net zo sterk meebeweegt. We hebben een directie die een duidelijke focus heeft op het gebied van digitale transformatie en informatievoorziening. Wat zorgt voor prioriteit, middelen en bestuurlijke steun.

Die ontwikkeling zijn we ondersteund worden door innovatieve ontwikkelingen zoals Robotic Process Automation (RPA) en AI. Door techniek in te zetten om efficiënter te kunnen werken ontstaat er ruimte in het proces om meer tijd te creëren voor het menselijke contact met inwoners en collega’s.

Wat ga je doen?

We zoeken een ervaren Adviseur Innovatie die ontwikkelingen van buiten naar binnen weet te vertalen en helpt om deze op een passende manier te introduceren, te implementeren en te borgen binnen onze organisatie. Het is een nieuwe functie met ruimte voor ontwikkeling. We zoeken een gedreven adviseur die risico's en weerstand weet om te zetten naar kansen en de organisatie daarin weet mee te nemen.

De Adviseur Innovatie vervult een zelfstandige advies- en projectrol binnen het team Beleidsonderzoek en Informatiemanagement en werkt nauw samen met het IV-programma, informatiemanagers, projectleiders, ICT, functioneel beheer, privacy- en informatiebeveiliging, de Werkgroep AI en andere relevante collega’s binnen de gemeente. De exacte positie van deze functie staat nog niet vast. Onze I-organisatie is volop in ontwikkeling en de komende jaren verwachten we hier nog verdere ontwikkelingen.

Dit is dus een nieuwe functie die voor een groot deel zal bestaan uit eigen invulling en die gaandeweg in overleg steeds meer is vorm te geven. Jouw rol gaat verder groeien aan de hand van de behoefte en mogelijkheden binnen de organisatie. Als onderdeel van de werkgroep AI maar zeker ook de bredere advisering over innovatieve projecten binnen de gemeente. Denk aan drones, beeldherkenning, etc. Daarbij is het belangrijk om een langetermijnvisie rondom innovatie binnen de gemeente op te stellen en te bewaken,in overleg en samenhang met onze architecten en andere belangrijke stakeholders.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Adviseren op en begeleiden van de implementatie van pilots.
  • Meeschrijven aan beleid en vertaling van Europees/landelijk beleid naar gemeentelijke toepassingen.
  • Projectleiding van de werkgroep AI onder het programma Uitvoering IV strategie.
  • Verbinden van verschillende teams en domeinen binnen de organisatie op gebied van innovatie.
  • Analyseren waar kansen, behoeften en mogelijkheden liggen in het IV-proces.
  • Beleidsvorming rondom richtlijnen en procedures.
  • Een breed (gemeentelijk) netwerk onderhouden met andere organisaties
  • Jouw focusgebieden zijn procesoptimalisatie, het Uitvoeringsprogramma IV-strategie, AI, RPA, nieuwe producten & ontwikkelingen, digitalisering en uiteraard verandermanagement.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Gemeentelijke ervaring is een pré.
  • Uitstekende communicatieve- en adviesvaardigheden.
  • Uitgebreide kennis van digitale innovatie.
  • Een sterke voorkeur om te pionieren binnen een context van een groeiende gemeente.
  • Kennis van verandermanagement of vergelijkbaar.
  • HBO+ met B1 vaardigheden Nederlands.

Competenties:

Verder ben je uiteraard nieuwsgierig en continu gericht op nieuwe ontwikkelingen en mogelijkheden. Daarbij ben je verbindend en in staat om verschillende perspectieven samen te brengen. Wat betekent dat je bestuurlijk sensitief en organisatiesensitief bent, analytisch sterk en in staat om behoeftes te vertalen naar concrete en passende oplossingen.

Jouw verhaal is overtuigend maar je kunt ook goed luisteren en jouw plannen aanpassen aan de organisatie. Waarvoor je vaak moet schakelen tussen tactisch en strategisch niveau en visie met uitvoeringskracht weet te combineren. Plus de balans houden tussen enthousiasmeren, informeren en zorgvuldig implementeren.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Wij bieden een inspirerende en prettige werkomgeving binnen een team dat in verbinding staat met de organisatie en daarmee de organisatie goed kan ondersteunen.
  • Een uitdagende, zelfstandige en verantwoordelijke functie waarbij je zelf actief meedenkt en bijdraagt aan het vormgeven en de inhoud van de functie.
  • Een werkweek van 36 uur.
  • Volop ruimte voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
  • Voor een ervaren Adviseur Innovatie en AI geldt functieschaal 11, maximaal € 6.525, - op basis van 36 uur per week, met daarbij aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.
  • Een individueel keuzebudget (IKB) van 17,05%.

Ben je die gedreven en verbindende Adviseur Innovatie & AI én breng jij mee wat wij zoeken? Solliciteer dan snel via onderstaande knop. Wil je graag meer informatie over deze vacature? Dan kun je terecht bij Sanne Griffioen, teammanager GEO en B&I via 0299-452884.

Het verkrijgen van een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) is een voorwaarde om bij ons te kunnen werken.

title: Assessment Referral Coordinator
description:
Job Summary

The Assessment Referral Coordinator supports patient care by coordinating referrals, authorizations, and follow-up appointments in collaboration with physicians and other care team members. This role ensures timely scheduling, accurate documentation, and clear communication with patients to facilitate continued access to services and high-quality care.

Essential Functions

  • Communicates with patients and families to explain next steps, provide instructions, and ensure understanding of referral and appointment requirements.
  • Obtains prior authorizations and referral approvals as needed, and accurately documents information in the electronic health record.
  • Schedules appointments and follows up with external providers to confirm referral completion and collect consult notes.
  • Responds to incoming calls and referral requests, triaging appropriately and ensuring timely processing.
  • Maintains accurate and organized patient records, ensuring documentation is complete and submitted according to policy.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
Qualifications
  • Associate Degree in Healthcare Administration or related field preferred
  • 0-2 years of experience in a healthcare administrative or referral coordination role required

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

title: Transformation Consulting Director
description:
About Valiantys

Valiantys helps organizations transform how work gets done across the enterprise, leading with transformation consulting, enterprise service management (ESM), and engineering productivity. By combining deep process expertise with modern collaboration, automation, and value stream practices, Valiantys enables business, IT, and product teams to design connected, efficient, and human-centered ways of working. With a strong focus on the modern workforce, the company helps customers reimagine service delivery beyond IT, streamline cross-functional workflows, and improve flow and throughput for engineering teams. For more information, visit .

Job Summary

As Transformation Consulting Director, you will lead strategic transformation programs for our key clients and play a critical role in the growth of our UK consulting business. You will own executive-level client relationships, drive the development of innovative solutions, and lead cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact business outcomes.
You will also contribute to our consulting strategy, mentor senior consultants, and work closely with sales and delivery leadership to evolve our transformation offering. This role reports to the EMEA SVP Transformation Consulting.
What You’ll Be Working On
Client Partnership & Strategic Engagement Leadership
Own senior client relationships and act as a trusted advisor across complex transformation programs.
Understand client business models, challenges, and objectives to shape high-impact consulting engagements.
Oversee the successful delivery of large-scale initiatives, ensuring quality, client satisfaction, and business value.
Facilitate executive steering meetings and provide thought leadership throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Practice Development & Value Creation
Drive the development of scalable consulting offerings and go-to-market strategies.
Design reusable frameworks and methodologies in areas such as ITSM, Agile at scale, cloud transformation, and change management.
Collaborate with technical teams to align delivery with strategic business outcomes.
Contribute to innovation initiatives within the consulting practice.
Business Development & Account Expansion
Partner with sales and pre-sales to shape opportunities and support proposal development.
Identify strategic growth opportunities within existing accounts.
Represent the consulting practice in client pitches, marketing events, and internal growth initiatives.
Team Leadership & Talent Development
Provide mentorship and coaching to Principal and Senior Consultants.
Foster a culture of knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and client-centric delivery.
Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new consultants, ensuring alignment with the practice’s growth objectives.
What We’re Looking For:
-10+ years of experience in management consulting, with proven experience leading digital, business, or IT transformation programs.
-Strong experience in client-facing roles with executive-level stakeholders.
-Background in structuring and delivering large-scale change initiatives.
-Familiarity with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence) or adjacent ecosystems is a plus.
-Comfortable leading cross-functional, hybrid, or international teams.
-Experience in both strategic advisory and delivery oversight.
-MBA or equivalent business/technology background is a plus.

Languages & Location

Fluent in English (company-wide working language)

You can be based anywhere in the United Kingdom (full remote possible) but be ready to travel for work.

Why Join Valiantys?

At Valiantys, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make an impact.

Meaning : Drive strategic transformation projects and influence outcomes
Learning : Continuous development through training, certifications, and communities
Flexibility : Hybrid work model supporting work-life balance

Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to personal background, identity, or beliefs.

title: Acute Care Tech I–  Telemetry Stepdown Unit
description:
Acute Care Tech I– Telemetry Stepdown Unit

Location: Good Samaritan Hospital – 375 Dixmyth Ave, Cincinnati, OH 45220
Job Type: Part -Time Nights

About TriHealth & This Role

11ABCD Medical Cardiac Step-Down Unit – Good Samaritan Hospital

The 11ABCD Medical Cardiac Step-Down unit at Good Samaritan Hospital is an intermediate care area dedicated to patients with a variety of cardiac conditions. Our team focuses on caring for patients experiencing chest pain, those recovering from myocardial infarctions (MI), congestive heart failure (CHF), and cardiac arrhythmias. This unit provides an essential bridge for patients transitioning from critical care to a less intensive setting while still requiring specialized cardiac monitoring and support. In addition to cardiac care, the unit also provides high-intensity non-invasive ventilation and serves as a back-up stroke unit.

The unit features 39 beds, and staffing is carefully tailored to meet the needs of our patients

We welcome both experienced nurses and new graduates to our team. With a supportive environment and opportunities for growth, we ensure that all staff members have the tools they need to provide exceptional care to our patients.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Supportive, team‑centered culture built on communication, compassion, and respect.
  • Hands‑on experience in a high‑acuity Telemetry setting that strengthens clinical skills.

  • Leadership that promotes professional growth and continuous learning.
  • Comprehensive TriHealth benefits, wellness programs, and career support.

At TriHealth, we believe there is no responsibility more important than to SERVE our patients, our communities, and our fellow team members. To achieve our vision and mission, ALL TriHealth team members are expected to demonstrate and live the following:

title: Handläggande konstruktör inom styrteknik
description:
Vill du vara med och konstruera framtidens styrsystem i spännande och samhällsviktiga projekt?

Vi söker dig som är ingenjör eller konstruktör med god teknisk förståelse och som vill ta en viktig roll som handläggande konstruktör inom styrteknik. Du får arbeta i varierande uppdrag inom fastighetsautomation, infrastruktur och anläggning, där hög driftsäkerhet, robust funktion och modern styrteknik är avgörande faktorer för långsiktig samhällsnytta.

I rollen får du kombinera konstruktionsarbete, handläggning och nära samarbete med kollegor, entreprenörer och beställare i långsiktiga och tekniskt krävande projekt. Du kommer att arbeta i en miljö med höga krav på kvalitet, funktion, säkerhet, dokumentation och samordning.

Du blir en del av ett erfaret team inom styr, automation och tekniska system, med stöd av kollegor på flera orter och tillgång till WSP:s etablerade nätverk, gemensamma arbetssätt och metodstöd inom styr- och övervakningssystem. Hos oss får du goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll som konstruktör.

Om Gruppen Styrteknik SydVäst

Inom gruppen arbetar vi med styr- och övervakningssystem för fastighetsautomation samt styrtekniska system i infrastruktur- och anläggningsprojekt och inom vår avdelning Project Delivery finns det också grupper som arbetar med BIM-samordning och Projekteringsledning.

Vårt team präglas av kvalitet, glädje och värme, både inom gruppen samt hur vi tar oss an våra kunders utmaningar - vi har ett starkt lagarbete för att utvecklas tillsammans. Vi arbetar i ett öppet arbetsklimat där framtidstänk och individuellt inflytande är mycket viktiga hörnstenar i kombination med proaktivitet och innovation. WSP har även ett Styrnätverk och vi samarbetar för att fördela uppdrag samt arbetsmetoder och mallar.

Vår verksamhet kännetecknas av kvalitet, engagemang och samarbete. Vi arbetar i ett öppet arbetsklimat där framtidstänk, ansvarstagande, struktur, proaktivitet och innovation är viktiga hörnstenar. Inom WSP finns dessutom ett nationellt styrnätverk och gemensamma arbetssätt som stödjer konstruktörer och specialister i både leverans och utveckling.

Gruppen är placerad både i Göteborg och Malmö.

Om rollen

Som handläggande konstruktör inom styrteknik ansvarar du för att ta fram, handlägga och kvalitetssäkra styrtekniska lösningar och handlingar inom ditt ansvarsområde, med rätt kvalitet, funktion och framdrift.

Rollen kombinerar konstruktionsarbete, handläggning och teknisk samordning. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:

Handläggning och samordning

  • Handlägga och konstruera styrtekniska delar av uppdraget i samverkan med uppdragsledare och tekniskt ansvariga
  • Medverka i samordning för gränsdragning och samverkan mellan styrteknik, andra teknikområden, entreprenör och beställare
  • Säkerställa att ditt arbete uppfyller kraven i kontraktshandlingar, myndighetskrav och relevanta tekniska regelverk
  • Medverka i arbetet genom tidiga skeden, systemhandlingar och bygghandlingsskeden


Konstruktion av tekniska system

  • Konstruera styrtekniska lösningar för fastigheter, infrastruktur och anläggningar
  • Apparatskåpskonstruktioner, inklusive scheman och tillhörande underlag
  • Underlag och funktionsbeskrivningar för PLC-system, operatörspaneler och SCADA-lösningar
  • Telesystem, kommunikation, IT-system, ITV och PA-system
  • IT-frågor mellan WSP, entreprenör och beställare
  • Övergripande system för drift och övervakning samt flytt och integration av befintliga anläggningar
  • Tekniska lösningar för implementering och integration mot andra tekniska system och installationer


Kvalitet, säkerhet och verifiering

  • Medverka i riskanalyser, CE-märkning och säkerhetsrelaterad dokumentation
  • Ta fram och medverka i genomförandet av funktionstestdokumentation såsom FAT, SAT och OAT


Dokumentation och förvaltning

  • Ta fram beskrivningsdokument, tekniska manualer och IT-manualer
  • Upprätta planritningar och relationshandlingar
  • Ta fram underhållsplaner, underhållsinstruktioner och tillhörande mallar
  • Sammanställa kemikalieförteckningar och materialförteckningar


Det här är en roll för dig som vill arbeta praktiskt med konstruktion och handläggning i långsiktiga och tekniskt krävande uppdrag, där noggrannhet, struktur och teknisk förståelse är avgörande för framgång.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Ingenjörsexamen, högskole- eller civilingenjör, exempelvis inom automation, elektroteknik, maskinteknik, installationsteknik eller motsvarande alternativt motsvarande yrkesmässig erfarenhet.
  • Erfarenhet av konstruktion eller handläggning inom tekniska uppdrag inom fastighet, infrastruktur, industri eller anläggning
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta som konstruktör, handläggare eller i annan teknisk specialistroll
  • God förståelse för styr- och automationssystem eller angränsande tekniska system, gärna med erfarenhet av att ta fram ritningar och schemahandlingar
  • Erfarenhet av samarbete mellan flera teknikområden och aktörer
  • God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


Det är meriterande om du har:

  • erfarenhet av uppdrag åt offentliga eller industriella beställare
  • erfarenhet av stora, komplexa och formellt styrda projekt
  • erfarenhet av apparatskåpskonstruktion, PLC/SCADA eller funktionstester såsom FAT och SAT
  • konsulterfarenhet samt vana att arbeta med systemhandlingar och bygghandlingar


Om dig

Du är en strukturerad, noggrann och engagerad person som trivs med att ta eget ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och samarbeta med många olika kontaktpersoner. title: Pomočnik vodje poslovne enote (m/ž) Lesce
description:
Smo podjetje, ki verjame v potencial vsakega sodelavca in gradi zgodbo ekipe, ki želi rasti. Cenimo odgovornost in sodelovanje, da smo na pravi poti, pa dokazuje visoka stopnja zadovoljstva naših sodelavcev in pridobljena certifikata Družini prijazno podjetje ter Top zaposlovalec leta 2026.

Tvoje naloge

  • dosledno opravljanje dela v skladu s prodajnimi načeli,

  • upoštevanje vrstnega reda zlaganja blaga in načel ureditve prodajnega prostora za celotno prodajno ponudbo, zalaganje polic s prehrambnimi in neprehrambnimi izdelki,

  • delo na blagajni, vodenje osebne blagajne, redni in pravilni obračuni po opravljenem blagajniškem delu,

  • zagotavljanje stroškovno ugodne izvedbe Lidlovega koncepta poslovanja v konkurenčnem okolju ob upoštevanju zakonskih določil, standardov in načel podjetja,

  • zagotavljanje uspešne in stimulativne delovne klime.

Navdušuje nas

  • znanje slovenskega jezika,

  • dinamičnost in veselje do dela s kupci,

  • dobre komunikacijske in organizacijske sposobnosti ter izkušnje pri tem,

  • samozavesten nastop in usmerjenost k ciljem,

  • prilagodljivost in zmožnost timskega dela,

  • potrdilo o nekaznovanosti.

Ponujamo

  • redno mesečno plačilo za polni delovni čas 40 ur tedensko, ki je nad slovenskim povprečjem v trgovinski dejavnosti:

  • v 1. letu zaposlitve bruto plača znaša 1.950 EUR bruto/mesec z vključenim stalnim dodatkom,

  • vsako nadaljnje leto zaposlitve se plača samodejno zviša vse do zadnje stopnje, kjer plačilo znaša 2.360 EUR bruto/mesec z vključenim stalnim dodatkom,

  • nadpovprečno izplačilo letnega regresa (2.000 EUR) in izplačilo zimskega regresa,

  • vplačilo v 2. pokojninski steber po 6 mesecih zaposlitve (480 EUR letno) in vključitev v dodatno kolektivno zdravstveno zavarovanje,

  • pogodbo o zaposlitvi za nedoločen čas s poskusno dobo 6 mesecev,

  • 7,96 EUR povračila stroškov prehrane na delovni dan in povračilo stroškov prevoza na delo v skladu s KP dejavnosti trgovine Slovenije,

  • neenakomerno razporejen delovni čas (dela se 5 dni na teden, 2 dneva sta prosta),

  • stalni razvoj in osebnostno rast z jasnimi možnostmi kariernega napredovanja,

  • skrb za dobro počutje sodelavcev (zdravje na delovnem mestu, uravnoteženi obroki – sadni dan, zdravi zajtrki …, brezplačna psihološka, finančna in pravna pomoč, službeni odklop)

  • družabne aktivnosti in ugodnosti za sodelavce (kartica ugodnosti, letni piknik zaposlenih, novoletna zabava, brezplačno letovanje za otroke, prijavnine za razne športne dogodke).

Verjamemo vate, zato se prijavi in pokaži svoj karierni potencial.

O podjetju

Lidl Slovenija, ki na slovenskem trgu posluje od leta 2007, ima danes 69 trgovin in več kot 2.000 zaposlenih. Smo zanesljiv partner za preprost nakup, kjer na enem mestu najdete vse, kar potrebujete za vsakodnevno uporabo.

Če razmišljate o novi službi in vas zanima delo v podjetju, ki daje velik poudarek skrbi za zaposlene, potem ste na pravem mestu.

Omenjena prizadevanja podjetja med drugim potrjujejo številna priznanja neodvisnih ustanov. Lidl Slovenija je letos že sedmič zapored prejel certifikat Top Employer Slovenija in certifikat Top Employer Europe 2026, naziv, ki ga najboljšim delodajalcem po svetu podeljuje mednarodna organizacija Top Employers Institute. Po zaslugi mnogih ukrepov, uvedenih s ciljem lažjega usklajevanja delovnih in zasebnih obveznosti, pa smo že vrsto let tudi nosilci polnega certifikata Družini prijazno podjetje.

Za iskalce zaposlitve so takšna priznanja lahko dobro znamenje, da podjetje resno vlaga v zaposlene.

title: Vodja službe m/ž za vzdrževanje
description:
Čeprav boš uradno del ekipe FNG Property SI d.o.o., bo tvoje delo prepletalo delovanje maloprodajne mreže in logistike Mercator d.o.o. Obe podjetji sta del skupine Fortenova Group, kar pomeni širše sodelovanje, večjo povezanost in skupne cilje

Iščemo izkušenega, zavzetega in proaktivnega sodelavca, ki bo prevzel vodenje službe vzdrževanja, ki bo s svojim znanjem in organizacijskimi sposobnostmi prispeval k zanesljivemu in učinkovitemu delovanju procesov.
Če te navdušujeta organizacija dela, izboljševanje procesov in vodenje ljudi, te vabimo, da se nam pridružiš.

Tvoje ključne naloge bodo:

  • vodenje, koordiniranje in organiziranje dela službe vzdrževanja;

  • načrtovanje in usklajevanje operativnih aktivnosti;

  • priprava in usklajevanje strokovne dokumentacije (predpisi, tehnična navodila, standardi ipd.);

  • zagotavljanje varnega dela ter skrb za urejeno delovno okolje;

  • priprava strokovnih analiz, poročil in podlag za sprejemanje poslovnih odločitev;

  • spremljanje ključnih kazalnikov, ugotavljanje trendov in odstopanj ter priprava predlogov za izboljšave;

  • oblikovanje rešitev in predlogov za optimizacijo procesov ter učinkovitejše poslovanje;

  • spremljanje razvoja stroke in uvajanje novosti na področju vzdrževanja.

Z izbranim kandidatom bomo sklenili delovno razmerje za nedoločen čas, s 6-mesečnim poskusnim delom.

Vsi kandidati, ki se bodo uvrstili v ožji izbor, bodo opravljali psihološko testiranje.

Vaše prijave na prosto delovno mesto z življenjepisom in dokazili o izpolnjevanju pogojev pošljite preko obrazca.

Prijave pričakujemo do 23.11.2026. Obravnavali jih bomo z najvišjo stopnjo diskretnosti.

Pričakujemo

Od tebe pričakujemo:

  • VII. stopnjo izobrazbe tehnične smeri;

  • vsaj 5 let delovnih izkušenj na primerljivem delovnem mestu;

  • dobro poznavanje orodij MS Office in splošno računalniško pismenost;

  • praktičen pristop k delu in sistematičnost;

  • veselje do timskega in terenskega dela;

  • pripravljenost za stalno učenje in deljenje znanja;

  • organiziranost, samoiniciativnost ter sposobnost učinkovitega določanja prioritet;

  • vozniški izpit B kategorije.

Iščemo sodelavca, ki:

  • zna povezovati ljudi in ustvarjati spodbudno delovno okolje;

  • prevzema odgovornost za rezultate;

  • razume pomen varnosti, kakovosti in zanesljivosti procesov;

  • je usmerjena k iskanju rešitev in nenehnim izboljšavam.

Nudimo

Nudimo:

  • delo v stabilnem in mednarodno povezanem poslovnem okolju,

  • dinamično in raznoliko delo,

  • možnost strokovnega razvoja in dodatnih izobraževanj,

  • sodelovanje z izkušenimi strokovnjaki z različnih področij,

  • dolgoročno zaposlitev v okviru skupine Fortenova Groupe.

Ne odlašaj – morda si prav ti tista prava oseba, ki jo pogrešamo v naši ekipi! Če se prepoznaš v opisu, nam piši – z veseljem te spoznamo.

description:

The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. Find out more by visiting .
Position Summary The Service Operations Supervisor is responsible for managing client relationships, ensuring the seamless delivery of services, and supporting payroll and tax-related processes. This role involves coordinating user setup and training, facilitating client retention strategies, and acting as a liaison between clients and internal operations. The Service Supervisor will also oversee payroll processing, analyze data for process improvements, and provide guidance on tax and reporting requirements.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
• Act as the primary contact for assigned group of clients.
• Coordinate user set-up and provide training for client-facing web-based payroll, custom reporting software and service platforms.
• Facilitate proactive intervention steps for at-risk clients, collaborating with internal teams, clients, and business consultants for successful retention.
• Manage client accounts by establishing and reinforcing strong relationships with clients, internal partners, brokers, and peers through proactive touch points and service recommendations.
• Act as a liaison between clients and internal operations to ensure seamless delivery of services in line with department SOPs.
• Coordinate and lead client meetings to review and discuss escalated issues or significant matters related to the client’s account.
• Identify gaps in client processes and introduce new products and services based on identified client needs.
• Manage and escalate client issues through various communication platforms, including submitting cases in Client Space to internal departments for resolution.
• Determine and recommend annual increases and/or reductions to client’s administrative fees.
• Assist with client tax account registration guidance, provide education on payroll tax questions, and obtain clients' tax account login credentials when entering a new state.
• Manage and escalate payroll tax notices and drive them to resolution.
• Assist and provide guidance with required state and federal reporting.
• Ensure timely and accurate payroll processing.
• Review processed payrolls and resolve payroll errors and issues; assist the team as needed.
• Monitor the work of Payroll Specialists who input payroll data and ensure payroll accuracy.
• Assist in payroll calculations and deductions.
• Maintain clear and consistent client communications.
• Work with the Quality Control Team to process current and prior year voids and resolve posted payroll errors.
• Analyze payroll problems and provide appropriate resolutions.
• Facilitate frequent communication regarding Service Associates performance, recommend training areas, and assist with coaching employees.
• Collaborate with the Manager to implement changes, provide feedback on team performance, and escalate client issues.
• Schedule and facilitate weekly POD team huddles to discuss client escalations and learning opportunities.
Marginal Functions
• Build, maintain and promote relationships with team members, peers across disciplines, and all other company team members ensuring effective coordination of communications and services affecting clients.
• Assist in organizing and maintaining shared team resources, such as checklists, templates, and reference materials.
• Provide occasional backup support for routine payroll processing during high‑volume periods or team member absences.
• Attend webinars and training to stay up to date on best practices related to the company and department.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and build positive working relationships.
• Strong time‑management skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast‑paced environment.
• Flexibility to perform a variety of assignments within the office, including operating different equipment, running varied production jobs, and learning new processes as needed.

• Strong work ethic and commitment to teamwork, contributing positively to a collaborative and supportive work environment.

• High level of professionalism, reliability, and enthusiasm, contributing to a positive workplace culture.
• Exceptional attention to detail, including the ability to thoroughly review printed documents and ensure they meet quality and accuracy standards.
Education & Experience
• High School Diploma required; 2+ years of PEO, ASO, HCM, multistate experience preferred or equivalent combination of experience, skills, education (including other relevant non-traditional degree programs or job training programs).
• 2-4 years of experience in customer service, payroll, HRIS, or related PEO/ASO/HCM environment preferred.

Required Licenses And/Or Certifications

Physical, Mental, & Communication Demands

Manual Dexterity: Frequent use of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment. Mobility: Occasionally walking or traversing throughout the office to meet with leaders and other employees. Visual Acuity: Ability to read and analyze data on a computer screen (or to read and analyze data with reasonable accommodation) and in printed materials. Decision Making: Ability to make quick, informed decisions based on data and market conditions. Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy needed for managing presentations, reports and communications. Problem-Solving: Continuous need to identify and resolve issues that may impact performance. Multitasking: Manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously, often under tight deadlines. Stress Management: Ability to handle high-pressure situations calmly and effectively, especially when dealing with client concerns.

Cultural Sensitivity: Communicate with individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds, demonstrating cultural awareness and sensitivity. Written Communication: Prepare clear and concise documentation, including emails and notes. Verbal Communication: Conduct presentations and employee training sessions; provide clear instructions and support to clients, employees and managers.
Environmental Conditions

The work setting is climate-controlled with typical office lighting and low to moderate noise levels. The role involves extended periods of screen time, in-person collaboration and meetings, and minimal exposure to physical hazards.

title: Asiakashankkija - Kehity ja etene myynnin alalla
description:
Etsimme myynnin innoittamia vahvan kehittymishalun omaavia henkilöitä edustamaan yhteistyökumppaneitamme asiakashankinnassa. Tarjoamme laadukkaan koulutuksen ja jatkuvan valmennuksen, jotta onnistut työssäsi. Asiakashankkijan työ on rakennettu selkeäksi, jotta työ on mielekästä. Kehittyessäsi sinulla on mahdollisuus edetä myynnin esihenkilötehtäviin.

Asiakashankkijana keskityt tarkasti valittujen yhteistyökumppaneidemme uusiin sekä aiempiin asiakkaisiin. Toimit edustettavan yrityksen brändin äänenä uusasiakashankinnassa ja huomioit aiemmat asiakkaat heille räätälöidyillä kampanjaeduilla. Asiakasrekisterit ovat kohdistettuja eli asiakashankkijana tiedät aina, kenelle soitat ja miksi. Työlläsi olet merkittävässä roolissa kasvattamassa tunnettujen yritysten liiketoimintaa.

Työn tavoitteet nousevat oppimisesi mukaan. Tärkeintä meille on, että olet hyvän asenteen ja sisukkuuden omaava henkilö, jolla riittää intoa ja motivaatiota kehittyä, jopa vastuutehtäviin asti. Arvostamme asiakaspalvelu-/myyntitaustaa. Tietokoneen peruskäyttö tulee olla sinulle luontevaa, ja edellytämme sinulta sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä nopeaa uuden omaksumista.

Työpäivämme ovat normaalisti arkisin 8:45-16 sisältäen 30 min ruokatauon ja 3 kahvitaukoa. Toimistomme sijaitsee ydinkeskustassa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien äärellä.

Takuupalkka toimii turvanasi. Provisioiden ja bonusten ansiosta voit kuitenkin odottaa ensimmäisen kuukauden jälkeen palkkasi olevan noin 2 000 €/kk ja kehityksen kautta 3 000-4 000 €/kk. Lisäksi meillä on jatkuvasti kisoja mm. ulkomaanmatkoista tapahtumista, bonuksista ja lahjakorteista. Palkkakertymän opit laskemaan onnistumisista itse, mutta tarkastelemme sitä viikoittain myös yhdessä.

Tiimimme on varustettu hyvällä energialla ja samanhenkisyydellä. Avoimuus, joustaminen ja toisten ymmärtäminen on arkipäivää toimistoillamme. Esihenkilöt ovat tiiviisti arjessa mukana. Meille on tärkeää tuntea työntekijämme, jotta voimme valmentaa ja palkita jokaisen yksilöllisesti.

Kyselyn tuloksena 100 % tiimistämme uskoo pystyvänsä kehittämään taitojaan entisestään Dynastialla.

Työ alkaa sovitusti heti/loppuvuoden aikana.

Olemme Vastuullinen Työnantaja -sertifioitu yritys ja noudatamme näitä periaatteita päivittäisessä toiminnassamme. Olemme myös Jamk:in virallinen kumppaniyritys.

Join M&S as a Customer Assistant in our Food section, where you'll be at the frontline of the UK’s fastest-growing retailer. We’re not just looking for someone to fill shelves – we need down-to-earth colleagues who thrive under pressure, deliver five-star service at pace, and embrace the transformation we're driving.

We're seeking passionate individuals who not only take pride in their knowledge of M&S Food products but are also ready to roll their sleeves up and go again, day in and day out, meeting strong customer demand head-on.

You'll be a resilient and committed brand ambassador who’s ready to raise the bar by confidently recommending and selling our newest food products to our customers. Through remarkable service you'll make sure our customers feel truly valued every time they shop with us.

This is a frontline role, not for the faint-hearted. But for those who are ready to roll up their sleeves, there’s huge opportunity. Are you ready for it? Take Your Marks and apply today.

title: Contract Analyst
description:
Be yourself at Protolabs
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse team that feels they are valued in the workplace. So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply! You can help make our company even better. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself. We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams.
Why Protolabs?
We are the leaders in digital manufacturing. We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds. We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home.

Join our team as a

Contract Analyst!

This is a HYBRID role - onsite Tuesday-Thursday in Maple Plain, MN.

Play a key role in helping Protolabs do business with confidence. As a Contract Analyst, you'll review and negotiate contracts, support compliance initiatives, and partner with customers and internal teams to ensure agreements, documentation, and processes are handled efficiently and accurately. This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by reducing risk, supporting business growth, and driving operational excellence across the organization.

What You Will Do:

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • 1-3 years of experience in commercial, regulatory or corporate law areas
  • Experience in contract law
  • Ability to handle multiple assignments, work well under pressure, and have the flexibility to assist team in meeting demands on accelerated schedules.
  • Proven ability to set clear priorities and demonstrated organizational skills
  • A detail oriented individual with strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Highest level of integrity and business ethics
  • Ability to maintain effective working relationships with team members; demonstrate cooperation and flexibility and willingness to handle a variety of tasks
  • Excellent communication skills, positive attitude and strong sense of urgency

What Sets You Apart:

  • Government contract experience desirable

What's In It For You:

  • We offer a competitive salary and total rewards package
  • We offer amazing benefits including but not limited to:
  • Health Insurance: Traditional OR High Deductible plan
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Health Savings Account (including employer contributions)
  • Dental and Vision
  • Basic and Supplemental Life Insurance
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  • Paid caregiver leave
  • You will receive at least 3 weeks of PTO + Wellness + Holiday Pay + Volunteer Hours
  • 401k with company match and immediate vest
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program at a discounted rate
  • Matching grants through Protolabs foundation
  • And More!
