This position provides assistance and/or performs basic activities of daily living and specified treatments and procedures under the direct supervision of the nurse. This position may perform non-direct patient care activities as assigned, requested, or directed. This position also performs clerical duties as assigned. Must have the interpersonal skill to communicate with respect and compassion to customers. This position also communicates information through various telecommunication devices and assists in coordinating patient flow.

Job Requirements:

2 years High School Education (Required)

Age 17 with work permit

Reading and math ability appropriate to the position. Multi-line phone skills, familiar with patient call systems and pagers.

Basic Life Support (BLS) Basic Life Support for Healthcare Providers (BLS) Required

Job Responsibilities:

Acknowledges need for self growth and accountability. Identifies area for self improvement. Demonstrates/maintains knowledge of organizational and unit changes. Supports organizational and unit changes.

Communicates effectively with others, and works in collaboration with all members of the health care team, and internal departments. Utilizes chain of command appropriately. Shows respect to patients, families, and co-workers. Reports patient related information in a timely manner, as well as problems completing assignment/tasks. Documents observations and tasks performed. Answers phone and patient calls promptly and courteously. Relays accurate and complete messages to the appropriate person, and provides complete follow-up. Assists internal and external customers by directing them and facilitating unit flow.

Maintains a safe environment. Reports safety hazards to appropriate personnel. Completes safety event report as necessary. Complies with Infection Control policies. Demonstrates knowledge of safety/emergency policies and procedures and appropriately corrects any identified hazards. Places emergency calls timely as directed (Code Blue, Fire, Special Alert, Rapid Response Team).

Maintains the medical record. Documents accurately in the medical record as per unit/TriHealth guidelines. Performs computer downtime procedures according to unit/TriHealth guidelines. Maintains proficient knowledge of computer applications specific to their unit/job. Provides other clerical support to unit as needed and directed by charge nurse or manager.

Performs and documents basic patient care tasks under the direct supervision of an RN. Maintains competency of tasks in which the PCA has been trained. Completes assigned tasks within required timeframe. Seeks clarification from the nurse when in doubt about how to proceed.

Performs supply, equipment, and environmental-related activities as required. Recognizes and reports problems with supply/equipment availability in a timely manner. Reports and follows through per unit standard concerning equipment that is broken or malfunctioning. Assures equipment/supplies are readily available for use by next person. title: Technical Director - Roads
description:
Establishment and Growth: The Roads team in India was established in 2012, primarily to support your UK offices. Over the last three years, it has tripled in size, aligning with our strategic growth plan.

Services Offered: The team offers a comprehensive set of services, including design of road features and geometrics, modeling, RRRAP (Road Restraints Risk Assessment Programme), traffic signs and road markings, earthworks, drainage design, SUDS (Sustainable Urban Drainage Systems), BIM (Building Information Modeling), production of drawings, technical specifications, and reports. We also offer services in roads operations and maintenance projects, project management services on projects and frameworks, design visualization, photomontage, motion graphics, video, and multimedia.

Strategic Growth: Our organization has pursued a strategy of organic growth, building a portfolio of frameworks and projects that require a leader to further strengthen and expand the teams in India.

Role Description: The Technical Lead will collaborate with team members in India and spearheads in the UK to offer technical expertise on projects by utilising their operational leadership and management skills. Your proficiency in the road industry of the UK, coupled with your capacity for innovative thinking, will be required to ascertain the underlying causes of the problems. Ensuring technical prowess, compliance with regulations, and efficient project management are integral components of this position in order to satisfy the expanding requirements of a contemporary and environmentally conscious road infrastructure.

Leadership and Innovation: The role emphasises promoting innovation and efficiency to ensure the development and maintenance of the road infrastructure in the UK in a safe and efficient manner.. It's part of the India Senior Management Team and requires collaborative behaviours to enhance the wider business.

Focus on People and Resources: The role particularly focuses on effective governance on technical, people management, assuring quality and financial performance in the overall project delivery.

WSP's Mission: At WSP, there’s nothing we love more than pushing boundaries, harnessing innovation and sharing insights across our diverse, international team to create a tomorrow’s world that's cleaner, greener and safer. Join us and you’ll be part of an organization that takes pride in its people and purpose: creating long-lasting, future-ready, solutions to meet the needs of generations to come.

Overall, this is a critical position in our organization, responsible for the growth, leadership, and successful project delivery of your Roads team in India, in alignment with your organization's goals and values. Top of Form.

As the Technical Head – Roads, you will lead the charge in delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions while guiding a team of skilled professionals. Your role will encompass:

  • Providing visionary leadership to a high-performing team of road design engineers.
  • Managing all technical dimensions of road infrastructure projects.
  • Driving innovation and engineering excellence across project lifecycles.
  • Offering expert guidance and support for road design and related technical activities.
  • Supervising and mentoring engineers in assessing surveys and preparing road designs.
  • Ensuring adherence to UK standards such as DMRB, MCHW, and BS codes.
  • Delivering projects on schedule, within budget, and to top-tier quality benchmarks.
  • Supporting technical aspects of demolition, site clearance, utilities, and infrastructure works for infrastructure developments.
  • Serving as a technical liaison across regional teams in India and the UK.
  • Strengthening client relationships, enhancing team capabilities, and contributing to business development.
  • Overseeing project management functions including forecasting, resource planning, and commercial governance.
  • Ensuring technical quality and compliance of all roads deliverables in coordination with UK governance teams.
  • Collaborating with project directors and managers to align technical inputs with project goals and client expectations.
  • Assisting resource teams with bid preparation and strategic pursuits to allocate adequate resources meeting scope and client requirements.
  • Leading performance reviews, promotions, and professional development for team members.
  • Drive Technical Leadership Group initiatives and conduct periodic town halls to strengthen technical profile of team in compliance to the UK industry requirements
  • Fostering a culture of continuous learning, mentorship, and grow technical skills meeting industry requirements.

You will work closely with the UK Technical Leadership Group (TLG), including the UK GCC SBU Head, Operations Director, Regional and Project Directors, and the Business Development team within the T&I Strategic Business Unit and the broader WSP UK/global network.

  • Educated to Bachelor / Master’s degree level in a Highways related discipline such as Civil Engineering.
  • Chartered Engineer status of a recognised professional institution (e.g. ICE, CIHT) is preferred.
  • Substantial experience in managing large-scale structural projects.
  • Possess a solid understanding of various contract forms to effectively manage project scope and associated design responsibilities
  • Seasoned professional with at least 20 years’ experience in design and management of UK roads, project management, project delivery or in leadership in a consulting engineering environment.

BGV:

  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”

title: Technology Client Executive
description:
At Lockton, our Client Executives serve as trusted advisors, strategic consultants, and advocates for our clients. This role is responsible for building and strengthening long-term client relationships while delivering innovative insurance, risk management, and employee benefits solutions that align with clients' business objectives. The Client Executive partners closely with clients, carriers, vendors, and internal service teams to provide strategic guidance, oversee complex insurance and benefits programs, drive client retention and growth, and ensure an exceptional service experience. Through industry expertise, market insight, and a commitment to client success, this individual plays a critical role in helping clients navigate an evolving risk landscape while advancing Lockton's reputation as the world's largest privately held insurance brokerage.

Essential Responsibilities

-Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with assigned clients through proactive and ongoing engagement.

-Serve as the primary strategic advisor, understanding each client's unique business goals, challenges, and risk management objectives.

-Provide strategic planning and consultative support, including the development of Requests for Proposal (RFPs), coordination of vendor responses, comparative analysis, and recommendation development.

-Advise clients on insurance, employee benefits, investment options, vendor services, fee structures, and overall program strategies.

-Review client claims activity, utilization trends, and financial performance to identify opportunities and provide recommendations.

-Evaluate and issue profitability assessments for fee-at-risk proposals.

-Support the achievement of revenue and growth objectives through client retention, cross-selling, and new business development opportunities.

-Coordinate marketing strategies and market selection for new and renewal business.

-Negotiate favorable program terms, coverage solutions, and pricing with carriers and vendors.

-Facilitate issue resolution between clients and insurance carriers, vendors, and service providers.

-Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless delivery of client services, including claims, loss control, and account management support.

-Develop and maintain strong relationships with insurance carriers, broker servicing networks, and strategic partners.

-Contribute to the development and implementation of departmental procedures, operating practices, and strategic initiatives.

-Monitor industry trends, emerging products, competitive market conditions, and regulatory developments to provide informed client guidance.

-Mentor, coach, and support the development of junior team members.

-Participate in business development activities and represent Lockton in client and industry settings.

-Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

title: Senior Environmental Project Manager and Technical Lead
description:
This Opportunity

Join WSP's New England Environmental Planning and Permitting team as a Senior Environmental Project Manager and Technical Lead. We are seeking a practitioner who can manage environmental permitting and planning projects from pursuit through delivery, develop winning proposals, develop and maintain client relationships, and serve as a trusted advisor to clients navigating complex regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate will bring strong experience developing scopes and budgets, managing multidisciplinary proposal and project teams, preparing high-quality technical deliverables, and leading agency coordination efforts. Experience with energy/utility clients, hazard mitigation and/or resilience planning projects, transportation infrastructure, permitting strategy, and federal and state environmental review processes is highly desired. Existing client relationships and a demonstrated ability to support business development efforts are a plus.

Your Impact

  • Lead environmental permitting and planning projects for transportation, infrastructure, resilience, energy/utility, and public-sector clients.
  • Develop and manage project scope, schedule, budget, staffing, client communications and relationships, and overall project delivery.
  • Develop permitting and regulatory compliance strategies involving agencies such as NHDES, USACE, FHWA, state DOTs, coastal management agencies, and environmental resource agencies.
  • Prepare and oversee high-quality technical reports, permit applications, environmental assessments, environmental impact evaluations, and regulatory correspondence.
  • Lead proposal efforts, including capture planning, technical approach development, scope and fee preparation, interviews, and client presentations.
  • Build and maintain relationships with existing and prospective clients, teaming partners, and regulatory agencies.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities aligned with WSP's environmental planning and permitting services.
  • Mentor environmental planners, permitting specialists, and early-career staff while helping grow the Planning, Permitting, and Licensing practice in New England.
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental Planning, Urban Planning, Geography, Environmental Science and Policy, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years of experience managing environmental planning, permitting, and regulatory compliance projects.
  • Highly proficient analytical skills and prior experience with research techniques, local/regional ecology, habitats, and applicable regulatory zone.
  • Expertise and experience relevant environmental laws, permitting requirements, notification and compliance practices, and applicable Regional/State/Federal regulatory framework.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and reviewing environmental planning technical reports, environmental impact evaluations, siting reports, and environmental permit applications and licensing, including field surveys and reporting, and resource and impact evaluations (e.g. commercial, renewable energy, infrastructure, etc.)
  • Established experience coordinating with clients, regulatory permitting and resource agencies, and environmental technical staff required.
  • Well-developed expertise with consulting practices, conducting NEPA / CEQA / other analysis and preparation of associated documentation.
  • Highly proficient self-leadership and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively, persuasively, and tactfully interact with employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently and provide guidance and leadership to junior team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
  • Proficiency with technical writing, office automation and communication software, technology, and tools.
  • Well-developed critical thinking and problem-solving skills required to reach conclusions from testing results, data collation, and identify the most effective solutions to accomplish objectives of assigned projects.
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
  • Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.
  • Attendance at least one day per week in WSP’s Manchester office is required.
  • Occasional travel may be required depending on business development and project-specific requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree.
  • AICP certification.
  • PMP certification.

title: CRM System Administrator
description:
The major function of this role includes strategic development of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system, design and configuration, conversion mapping, user training, customer case history and on-going support. System configuration requires this role to work closely with various functional staff to understand and define business processes and integrate multiple standard operating procedures into the CRM software. Will be required to work with outside vendors and consultants to develop system enhancements and modifications as necessary.

Identifies development opportunities and manage all major upgrades in the CRM. Responsible to continuously review and develop CRM processes for the contacts management, event organizing and tracking, agreements execution, workflows and operational related functions to improve user productivity and transparency across functional teams. Must also have the ability to work with additional Net/Java based integration applications such as SharePoint and Microsoft Visual Studio.

User training is a major component of user adoption and requires this role to design and conduct both process and technology training by various means to include web casts as well as small and large interactive training sessions. Responsible for assessing user proficiency and "certifying" user competency in day-to-day system use. Responsible for all ongoing modifications, upgrades and future training requirements.

Responsible to ensure integrity of data held in the CRM database. Works closely with Business Development teams to ensure CRM designs are aligned with the overall business strategies. Provides oversight to Business Development staff to ensure data quality and appropriate process control.

Responsible to serve as a support person to staff. Hardware support includes distributing and upgrading computer and mobile tools. Must be able to support remote tools and software to staff based on remote employees requirements. Must be familiar with Remote access processes and Mayo approved mobile apps.

This is a hybrid role and the employee must live within 100 miles of the Rochester, MN campus.

BA/BS degree and five years’ experience working with multiple systems and databases in support of marketing, sales and operational activities. Requires in depth knowledge of a customer contact management system, in particular with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, including system development and support. MA/MS preferred. Must have strong trouble shooting and communication skills.

title: Adviseur BTW en BCF
description:
Werken bij Haarlem en Zandvoort is werk dat ertoe doet, met resultaten die je ziet als je door de stad of het dorp loopt. Met een goede werk-privébalans en met mooie secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.

De afdeling Financiën voert de financiële administratie van de twee gemeenten uit. In ons team Specialisten werken ruim 25 collega's. Wij verzorgen het beheer van het systeem waarin de P&C producten worden opgesteld (Lias), de technische inrichting van de organisatie brede P&C producten (begroting, voorjaarsnota/ kadernota, bestuursrapportages en de jaarrekening) en voeren een eerste toets uit op begrotingswijzigingen.



Functiebeschrijving

Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor de advisering over BTW-BCF gerelateerde vraagstukken. Je vertaalt wet- en regelgeving naar praktische oplossingen en zorgt ervoor dat de gemeente voldoet aan haar verplichtingen. Je maakt deel uit van het team Specialisten binnen de afdeling Financiën. In deze zelfstandige en veelzijdige functie werk je nauw samen met financieel adviseurs, projectleiders en andere collega's uit de organisatie. Geen dag is hetzelfde: je bent betrokken bij uiteenlopende vraagstukken op het gebied van investeringen, vastgoed, subsidies en gemeentelijke projecten.

  • Je bent hét aanspreekpunt voor BTW- en BCF-vraagstukken binnen de gemeenten Haarlem en Zandvoort. Collega's weten jou te vinden voor advies over onder andere contracten, offertes, projecten en raadsvoorstellen.
  • Je analyseert fiscale vraagstukken en vertaalt deze naar heldere, praktische en goed onderbouwde adviezen. Bij complexe dossiers werk je samen met externe fiscale experts.
  • Je ondersteunt collega's binnen de financiële administratie bij een juiste verwerking van BTW en BCF.
  • Je verzorgt de jaarlijkse fiscale rapportage inzake de omzetbelasting.
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de BTW- aangiftes, BCF-declaraties en suppleties.
  • Je voert interne controles uit binnen jouw vakgebied.
  • Je draagt zorg voor correctieboekingen en nacalculaties voor BTW.
  • Je bent de contactpersoon voor de belastingdienst voor beide gemeentes over BTW en BCF.
  • Je vertegenwoordigt de gemeenten in fiscale overleggen met externe partijen.
  • Je volgt ontwikkelingen in wet- en regelgeving, jurisprudentie en fiscale actualiteiten op de voet en vertaalt deze naar beleid, processen en praktische werkwijzen binnen de organisatie.


Functie-eisen
  • Je hebt een afgeronde financiële opleiding op minimaal HBO-niveau in de richting Finance & Tax, Fiscaal Recht, (Fiscale) Economie of vergelijkbaar.
  • Je hebt tenminste 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie.
  • Je beschikt over kennis van BTW-regelgeving binnen de overheid en het BTW- compensatiefonds. Kennis van de BBV en de financiële processen binnen gemeenten is een sterke pré.
  • Je hebt goede communicatieve en adviesvaardigheden.
  • Je bent proactief, resultaatgericht en kunt goed prioriteren en onder tijdsdruk werken.

Ook als je niet geheel aan de voorwaarden voldoet maar gemotiveerd bent je te ontwikkelen tot BTW/BCF specialist nodigen we je uit te solliciteren.



Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Wij waarderen, omarmen en benutten de verschillen en talenten van mensen. Wij bieden een plek waar iedereen zich thuis kan voelen en zichzelf mag zijn. Daar maken wij ons hard voor. Dat is goed voor onze medewerkers én leidt tot de beste resultaten voor de stad en het dorp.

  • Voor jouw persoonlijke groei en vitaliteit bieden wij tal van mogelijkheden. Denk aan het volgen van opleidingen, certificeringen, cursussen via onze ‘Academie Haarlem' en ook een fietsregeling en een tegemoetkoming in je sportabonnement.

title: Life Sciences Partner
description:
Partner – Life Sciences

Biopharma & Medical Technology | United States

Build a business. Shape an industry. Share in the success.

Life sciences companies face a defining challenge: turning scientific innovation, data and technology into better outcomes for patients and sustainable commercial growth.

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to help grow Elixirr’s US Life Sciences business, with a particular focus on Biopharma. Expertise spanning medical devices and medical technology would broaden your impact.

You will bring deep sector knowledge, trusted senior relationships and a proven ability to win and deliver consulting work. In return, you’ll have the opportunity to build within an ambitious global consultancy, bringing together strategy, transformation, digital engineering, data and AI to solve clients’ most important challenges.

The opportunity

This is a role for a business builder who wants to remain close to clients and delivery.

You will shape our life sciences proposition, develop existing relationships across the Elixirr Group and open new ones. Working with fellow Partners and specialist teams, you will translate industry challenges into practical solutions—from growth strategy and commercial effectiveness to R&D productivity, operating-model transformation and technology-enabled change.

Your expertise will strengthen our sector credibility. Your ambition will help determine how far we take it.

What you’ll do

  • Build and grow client relationships. Become a trusted adviser to senior biopharma and medtech leaders, developing a clear understanding of their business priorities.
  • Originate and convert opportunities. Build a sustainable pipeline, lead compelling proposals and take accountability for revenue generation, profitability and collection.
  • Deliver meaningful results. Lead complex engagements, maintain high standards and stay personally accountable for the quality and impact of our work.
  • Connect strategy with execution. Bring together sector expertise, transformation capability, digital, data and AI to deliver change that works in practice.
  • Develop our proposition. Identify where Elixirr can make the greatest difference and build distinctive offerings around those opportunities.
  • Build exceptional teams. Attract, coach and develop talented people, creating opportunities for others as the business grows.
  • Contribute to the partnership. Share relationships, ideas and opportunities across the Group, putting collective success at the centre of how you operate.

What you’ll bring

  • Deep knowledge of the US biopharma market, its commercial dynamics and the challenges facing pharmaceutical and biotechnology businesses. Additional medical-device or medtech expertise is highly valued.
  • An established network of senior decision-makers and a track record of turning trusted relationships into sustained consulting revenue.
  • Evidence of originating, winning and leading substantial engagements, with the capacity to build and carry a significant annual revenue target.
  • Experience in strategy, business transformation or digital, data and technology consulting, with the judgement to connect specialist capabilities to business outcomes.
  • The credibility to challenge senior executives, alongside the curiosity and humility to listen, learn and work closely with delivery teams.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable creating opportunities, taking ownership and building in an environment where initiative matters.
  • A collaborative leadership style and a commitment to developing people, strengthening the firm and delivering for clients.

You may already be a Partner, Managing Director or practice leader, or be ready to step into partnership with a strong record of commercial and client leadership.

Why Elixirr?

At Elixirr, you can combine the ambition of building a business with the capabilities of a global consulting group.

We value initiative, client impact and shared success. You’ll work alongside colleagues across consulting, creative, digital, data and technology, with the opportunity to shape our life sciences business and contribute to the wider firm.

We’re looking for someone who wants to help build the next chapter—and create lasting opportunities for clients, colleagues and future Partners.

If that sounds like you, we’d like to hear from you.

We welcome different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Please let us know if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

title: Operational Excellence Manager
description:
At a Glance

Legrand has an exciting opportunity for a Operational Excellence Manager to join the Power & Thermal Management division in Reno, NV.

Reporting to the Sr. Director of Global Operations, this position is responsible for global deployment of operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives and policies in Reno, Mexico, and Taiwan to support the division operational strategy and annual goals. This position is tasked with identifying opportunities across the business, driving change, and developing plans to assist with achievement of Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Capex, and Working Capital targets.

What Will You Do?

Main Job Duties:

• Establish and communicate the vision for utilizing lean principles and a continuous improvement culture to drive operational excellence throughout the organization. Work with various sites to plan and execute short-term and long-term operational goals using lean tools and processes.

• Train and mentor business process owners, plant managers, and site leaders in the concepts of CI and other available Lean and Six Sigma tools. Formulate and oversee implementation, adoption, and effectiveness of Legrand Way tools.

• Assist in developing a CI roadmap and driving lean manufacturing philosophy throughout the organization. Improve the “Visual Factory” at various sites by incorporating management dashboards and visual indicators for “Standard Work”.

• Collaborate with plant managers and other functions to manage the annual operating budget for the OPEX group, including productivity savings and capital expenditures.

• Identify and facilitate projects and meetings to drive desired outcomes. Lead project meetings and ensure an open flow of communication and information across the organization.

• Partner with Quality to establish tools and methodologies for addressing production/customer/quality issues.

• Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering and Value Stream/Production Manager to optimize and align manufacturing data accuracy across the organization.

• Partner with plant personnel in identifying improvements in equipment, processes, or technologies to assure satisfactory process capability and achieve cost improvements.

• Travel will be required to international locations, up to 30%.

• Perform other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

Education:

• Bachelor’s Degree in a science, engineering, math, business, or other technical related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Six Sigma Green Belt and/or Black Belt certification preferred.

Experience:

• A minimum of 7 years or more supporting Lean/CI activities in an industrial manufacturing & assembly or customer service environment are required.

• A minimum of three to five years leading kaizens and training teams on lean principles & tools is a requirement preferably in a multi-site operation. Additional experience accepted over Six Sigma Green Belt certification.

• Must have a proven “Lean”/Six Sigma success track record with progressive manufacturing/support organizations.

• Experience in developing and leading continuous improvement initiatives.

• Problem analysis and problem resolution at both a strategic and functional level.

Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:

• Lean manufacturing and Six Sigma experience; Six Sigma Green Belt certification preferred.

• Strong interpersonal and leadership skills with demonstrated ability to motivate others, achieve results and accomplish overall business objectives.

• Must possess excellent project management, organizational and time management skills, including demonstrated ability to develop and manage to a project plan, establish priorities, work to deadlines, and control several projects at various stages of work.

• Must possess strong lean knowledge, analytical skills, and the ability to identify trends and establish proactive corrective actions. Must have demonstrated statistical analysis capabilities.

• Must have outstanding verbal and written communications skills and be able to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization. Must be a strong facilitator and effective listener, able to maintain focus, extract necessary information and validate understanding of the information.

• Able to create effective reports, presentations and business correspondence and be comfortable presenting such to senior Legrand leadership and key customers.

Note: The above Job Description is representative of the responsibilities and qualifications necessary to be successful in this role. It does not encompass every job duty or responsibility; other tasks may be assigned as necessary. Further the job description does not alter the at-will nature of employment with Legrand and does not create a contract of employment.

Representing more than 150 years of innovation, Legrand is the global specialist in electrical and digital building infrastructures. Our purpose is improving lives by transforming the spaces where people live, work and meet with electrical and digital infrastructures and connected solutions that are simple, innovative and sustainable. Legrand North and Central America (LNCA) employs over 6,500 associates in 50 locations, working across six divisions/sector: Audio Visual, Building Controls Systems, Data Power and Controls, Electrical Wiring Systems, and Lighting. We hold a leading position in every North American market we serve and focus on exceeding our customers’ needs within the commercial, residential, and industrial industries. LNCA offers comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, as well as distinctive benefits like a high employer 401K match, abovebenchmark paid maternity and parental leave, paid time off to volunteer, and an active/growing Employee Resource Group network. The Appraisals Specialist is responsible for performing and supporting a broad range of commercial real estate valuation and appraisal assignments for financial reporting, risk assessment analysis and portfolio valuation. This role works closely with project sponsors, internal stakeholders, and market participants to review and reconcile appraisal valuations, validate collateral and analyze changes in value year over year. The position requires strong analytical capabilities, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate valuation findings clearly and effectively.

Summary of Primary Duties and Responsibilities

The Appraisals Specialist is an LA-based position on a hybrid schedule with at least two (2) days in-office. This position will report to the Director, Risk Management. While not an exhaustive list, the Appraisals Specialistwill be responsible for:

  • Execute commercial real estate valuation and appraisal assignments for financial reporting, risk assessment analysis and portfolio valuation.
  • Analyze appraised values for different commercial property types and real estate interests using recognized appraisal methodologies and industry standards.
  • Gather, verify, and analyze property-specific, market, and economic data to support valuation conclusions.
  • Conduct market research, including sales, leasing, operating expense, capitalization rate, and demographic analyses.
  • Independently interact with clients, brokers, property managers, and other market participants to obtain relevant information and market intelligence.
  • Review and interpret leases, operating statements, rent rolls, property tax records, budgets, and other property-level documentation.
  • Evaluate industry surveys, market benchmarks, economic indicators, and demographic trends impacting property values.
  • Reconcile valuation changes from historical valuations.
  • Assist in preparing valuation analyses and reporting
  • Present valuation findings, assumptions, and conclusions in a clear, concise, and defensible manner.
  • Collaborate with team members across multiple markets and geographic regions to ensure consistency, quality, and timely project delivery.
  • Support quality control reviews and ensure accuracy and completeness of valuation assignments.

Education and Experience

  • Degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, or a related field preferred.
  • 3 to 5 years of relevant commercial real estate valuation, appraisal, consulting, or real estate analysis experience.
  • Experience performing valuation reviews for institutional-quality real estate assets preferred.
  • Experience supporting reporting and portfolio valuation assignments preferred.
  • Strong understanding of commercial and construction real estate valuation principles and appraisal methodologies.
  • Knowledge of reporting valuations, replacement cost, collateral allocation, portfolio valuations, and lending-related appraisals.
  • Ability to analyze financial, operational, and market data.
  • Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Commercial Real Estate (CRE) valuation and appraisal experience across multiple property types.
  • Understanding of market trends, capital markets, and real estate investment strategies.

Compensation

This position is exempt full-time, with salary range: $90,000 - $110,000 depending on experience level, plus discretionary bonus potential.

Benefits

This position is eligible for the following benefits:

  • Annual discretionary bonus program.
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance.
  • 401K with Safe Harbor contribution.
  • Two weeks (ten days) paid time away excluding sick time.
  • Six sick days.
  • Ten paid holidays
  • One floating holiday.

Note: This is not an all-inclusive list. The Appraisals Specialist will be involved and participate in related business matters and duties as assigned. Arixa is an ‘at-will’ employer.

title: MRI Tech PRN
description:
Job Summary

The MRI Technologist II performs advanced MRI imaging procedures while ensuring patient safety, comfort, and the production of high-quality diagnostic images. This role collaborates with radiologists and departmental leadership to optimize imaging protocols and standards. The MRI Technologist II serves as a key resource for MRI safety, quality assurance, and educational efforts within the department.

Essential Functions

  • Coordinates MRI schedules, prioritizing patient needs and department workflow for optimal efficiency.
  • Reviews patient history, including prior surgeries, implants, or foreign bodies, to assess MRI safety and ensure proper pre-scan evaluation.
  • Researches implant materials and consults with the MRSO (Magnetic Resonance Safety Officer) or radiologist to determine safety for MRI procedures.
  • Operates MRI and image processing equipment proficiently, ensuring accurate, high-quality images in compliance with established protocols.
  • Develops, maintains, and updates MRI scan protocols in collaboration with radiologists, the MRSO, and department leadership.
  • Prepares and positions patients for MRI exams, providing clear explanations and instructions to alleviate anxiety and ensure cooperation.
  • Maintains MRI safety zones, ensuring compliance with safety protocols for patients, staff, and visitors.
  • Monitors and maintains an adequate inventory of MRI supplies and equipment, ensuring functionality and readiness for procedures.
  • Conducts quality checks on images, ensuring they meet diagnostic and organizational standards.
  • Provides guidance and evaluation for students and new technologists, fostering professional development and skill enhancement.
  • Documents patient clinical history accurately and ensures relevant documentation is sent to the radiologist in PACS.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • Graduate of an accredited Radiologic Technology or MRI program required
  • Associate Degree in Radiologic Technology or related field preferred
  • 2-4 years of clinical experience as a registered MRI Technologist required
  • 1-2 years of clinical experience as a Radiologic Technologist required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Expertise in MRI operations, safety protocols, and diagnostic imaging techniques.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills for interacting with patients and healthcare team members.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues with MRI equipment and imaging processes.
  • Commitment to maintaining a safe and organized clinical environment.
  • Proficient in electronic medical records (EMR) and imaging software systems.

Licenses and Certifications

  • ARRT - American Registry of Radiologic Technologists required or
  • ARMRIT - Registered Magnetic Resonance Imaging Technologist required
  • BCLS - Basic Life Support within 30 days of hire required
  • Advanced MRI safety certification (e.g., MRSO) preferred

title: Sorter Loader - Parcel Buster
description:
Want to be part of a UK hub, in a global business that is scaling rapidly, evolving fast and radically changing the decades-old delivery universe? If so, read on, as we’re looking for Parcel Busters to join our Wednesbury team!

Our mission? To switch up the status quo and become the UK’s leading out-of-home business. With a fast-growing network of thousands of smart lockers, hundreds of leading retail partners and the launch of our transformative Send service, we’re bringing freedom to anyone with a parcel.

At InPost UK, we’re building an unparalleled group of talent that’s committed to help us power our mission to reshape the way parcels move, and redefine eCommerce logistics. Our team is packed full of top-notch experts in e-commerce, technology, scale-up growth, sustainability, logistics and supply chain. We’re a passionate bunch with high ambition – we collaborate, innovate, support each other, and leave egos at the door.

About the role:

InPost are seeking a dedicated and proactive Sorter Loader Parcel Buster to join our dynamic team in our Sort at our Wednesbury and Hatfield Hubs. This pivotal role keeps the conveyors that carry parcels around the Sort moving, so that customer parcels are sorted, scanned and dispatched quickly and accurately.

As a Parcel Buster, you'll play a key part in the Sort. You'll clear oversized or awkwardly shaped parcels before they cause blockages, and spot and report faults to Engineering before they become downtime. If you enjoy working on your feet in a fast-paced environment, and you're committed to doing it safely and well, this opportunity is perfect for you.

Join us and be part of a company that values teamwork, innovation, and excellence in delivery services.

📍 Location: Wednesbury, Midland Road, WV13 2PZ

📅 Shift Pattern: 5 out of 7 days

🕒 Hours: 09:00 - 17:30 (40 hours)

💰 Salary: £27,510.28 Per Annum

What you'll be doing:

  • Keep conveyors free of blockages by identifying and removing oversized or irregularly shaped parcels, working in all areas of the parcel sort centre.

  • Monitor the carousels using the control room systems and respond promptly when alerted.

  • Safely access belts, and the areas underneath them, to dislodge parcels and restore the flow of the Sort, in line with Health & Safety guidelines.

  • Report any faults or issues you notice to Engineering promptly.

  • Champion Health & Safety excellence, including safe working on and around conveyors, using the LOTO process and wearing the right PPE when parcel busting.

  • Communicate and work closely with colleagues across the Sort, including the control room, Sorter Loaders, Team Leaders and managers, to keep the operation running smoothly at pace.

  • Work flexibly to complete Sorter Loader duties, and any other reasonable activities to support the Sort, as directed by management.

What we need from you:

  • Previous experience in a warehouse or parcel distribution environment is valued, but it isn't essential. We welcome people who are eager to learn.

  • You're comfortable getting onto and under conveyor belts safely, following Health & Safety guidelines.

  • You can stay on your feet for long periods and keep up with a fast-paced operation.

  • You can work with IT systems that monitor the carousels.

  • You're a confident communicator who works well with lots of different people across the Sort.

  • You're observant and proactive, with the initiative to spot and report potential faults and to prioritise when several alerts come in at once.

  • You're a team player, flexible and adaptable.

  • You must have the legal right to work in the UK.

We love to reward our people for the great work they do:

🪴 Build a secure future with a competitive Pension Scheme

🌟 Peace of mind with Life Insurance

🚴 Stay active with our Cycle2Work scheme

🤝 Get the support you need with our Employee Assistance Program

The InPost process:

We pride ourselves on our candidate experience. We want to make this as straightforward as possible, for you and for us! We will try our best to get back to you within a few days to let you know if we'd like to take you to the first stage. This normally involves a 20-30 minute chat with our Talent Team. If you are successful after this stage, there will generally be another two stages including a site visit.

Throughout our process, you will get the opportunity to meet a cross-section of our friendly team members to get a sense of our culture, and a good understanding of the role, team and business. Your talent partner will guide you through each stage.

At InPost, we love uniqueness. Our strength is our people.

title: Pomočnik vodje poslovne enote (m/ž) Tržič
description:
Smo podjetje, ki verjame v potencial vsakega sodelavca in gradi zgodbo ekipe, ki želi rasti. Cenimo odgovornost in sodelovanje, da smo na pravi poti, pa dokazuje visoka stopnja zadovoljstva naših sodelavcev in pridobljena certifikata Družini prijazno podjetje ter Top zaposlovalec leta 2026.

Tvoje naloge

  • dosledno opravljanje dela v skladu s prodajnimi načeli,

  • upoštevanje vrstnega reda zlaganja blaga in načel ureditve prodajnega prostora za celotno prodajno ponudbo, zalaganje polic s prehrambnimi in neprehrambnimi izdelki,

  • delo na blagajni, vodenje osebne blagajne, redni in pravilni obračuni po opravljenem blagajniškem delu,

  • zagotavljanje stroškovno ugodne izvedbe Lidlovega koncepta poslovanja v konkurenčnem okolju ob upoštevanju zakonskih določil, standardov in načel podjetja,

  • zagotavljanje uspešne in stimulativne delovne klime.

Navdušuje nas

  • znanje slovenskega jezika,

  • dinamičnost in veselje do dela s kupci,

  • dobre komunikacijske in organizacijske sposobnosti ter izkušnje pri tem,

  • samozavesten nastop in usmerjenost k ciljem,

  • prilagodljivost in zmožnost timskega dela,

  • potrdilo o nekaznovanosti.

Ponujamo

  • redno mesečno plačilo za polni delovni čas 40 ur tedensko, ki je nad slovenskim povprečjem v trgovinski dejavnosti:

  • v 1. letu zaposlitve bruto plača znaša 1.950 EUR bruto/mesec z vključenim stalnim dodatkom,

  • vsako nadaljnje leto zaposlitve se plača samodejno zviša vse do zadnje stopnje, kjer plačilo znaša 2.360 EUR bruto/mesec z vključenim stalnim dodatkom,

  • nadpovprečno izplačilo letnega regresa (2.000 EUR) in izplačilo zimskega regresa,

  • vplačilo v 2. pokojninski steber po 6 mesecih zaposlitve (480 EUR letno) in vključitev v dodatno kolektivno zdravstveno zavarovanje,

  • pogodbo o zaposlitvi za nedoločen čas s poskusno dobo 6 mesecev,

  • 7,96 EUR povračila stroškov prehrane na delovni dan in povračilo stroškov prevoza na delo v skladu s KP dejavnosti trgovine Slovenije,

  • neenakomerno razporejen delovni čas (dela se 5 dni na teden, 2 dneva sta prosta),

  • stalni razvoj in osebnostno rast z jasnimi možnostmi kariernega napredovanja,

  • skrb za dobro počutje sodelavcev (zdravje na delovnem mestu, uravnoteženi obroki – sadni dan, zdravi zajtrki …, brezplačna psihološka, finančna in pravna pomoč, službeni odklop)

  • družabne aktivnosti in ugodnosti za sodelavce (kartica ugodnosti, letni piknik zaposlenih, novoletna zabava, brezplačno letovanje za otroke, prijavnine za razne športne dogodke).

Verjamemo vate, zato se prijavi in pokaži svoj karierni potencial.

title: Engineering Specialist, Hardware (R6658)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Staff Mechanical Specialist to lead hands-on mechanical build, design-support, and release activities for hardware test equipment. You will help turn engineering concepts into reliable fixtures, jigs, test stands, and mechanical assemblies used to test aircraft components and subsystems.

This is an advanced individual-contributor role for someone who combines strong fabrication and assembly judgment with practical CAD, troubleshooting, and documentation skills. You will independently plan and execute complex build assignments, contribute directly to fixture designs within agreed engineering requirements, and drive complete, accurate documentation through established release workflows. You will also mentor specialists and technicians and improve how the team designs, builds, and maintains test hardware, partnering with responsible engineers on analysis, safety-critical decisions, and design approval.

What you'll do:

  • Own complex mechanical builds: Plan and execute the fabrication coordination, assembly, fit-up, installation, and checkout of fixtures and mechanical test equipment. Identify required parts, tooling, build sequences, and dependencies, and resolve execution issues within approved requirements.
  • Contribute directly to fixture designs: Develop CAD models, assemblies, and drawings for fixtures, tooling, mounting hardware, and equipment modifications within an agreed design scope. Turn sketches and functional requirements into practical design proposals for engineering review.
  • Drive design-release execution: Prepare and check drawing packages, bills of materials, part records, and change documentation for completeness and consistency. Coordinate reviews, resolve documentation discrepancies, track approvals, and keep released records aligned with approved as-built configurations.
  • Resolve difficult build and integration problems: Investigate fit, alignment, tolerance, access, and repeatability issues using measurements and hands-on troubleshooting. Develop corrective proposals, obtain required engineering review, and implement approved changes.
  • Coordinate fabrication and suppliers: Work with internal shops and external suppliers to clarify fabrication documentation, address manufacturability concerns, and track hardware readiness. Resolve questions within approved documentation and escalate deviations or design changes to the responsible engineer.
  • Improve buildability and serviceability: Bring practical feedback into design reviews, including assembly access, locating and clamping approaches, inspection needs, maintenance, and replacement of wear components. Develop reusable build aids and documentation that reduce recurring rework.
  • Guide specialists and technicians: Help break down build assignments, demonstrate sound assembly and inspection practices, and check work against documented requirements. Share expertise and help teammates recognize when to stop and seek engineering guidance.
  • Support safe checkout and handoff: Verify mechanical assembly against approved requirements, support equipment checkout, and prepare clear operating, assembly, and maintenance instructions. Identify hazards, stop unsafe work, and escalate unresolved discrepancies before use.

Required qualifications:

  • Advanced hands-on capability: Demonstrated ability to independently plan, assemble, integrate, and troubleshoot complex mechanical fixtures, tooling, test equipment, or comparable hardware.
  • Practical mechanical design: Proficiency creating and modifying 3D CAD parts, assemblies, and manufacturing drawings, with evidence of contributing designs that were fabricated and used successfully.
  • Drawing and inspection judgment: Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings, dimensional tolerances, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, and assembly requirements, and to select appropriate measurement methods for fit and alignment checks.
  • Configuration and release discipline: Experience preparing and maintaining drawing packages, bills of materials, revisions, and engineering-change documentation through controlled workflows.
  • Build planning and fabrication coordination: Ability to translate approved designs into executable build plans, coordinate with shops and suppliers, and recognize changes that require engineering evaluation.
  • Technical leadership: Evidence of mentoring others, improving build or documentation practices, and communicating technical risks clearly while working within defined authority and review boundaries.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Relevant equipment experience: Experience with aerospace, robotics, automotive, or other precision mechanical test fixtures and electromechanical equipment.
  • Fabrication depth: Experience with machining, sheet metal, additive manufacturing, weldments, or other prototype and tooling fabrication methods.
  • Release tools: Experience with product data or lifecycle management systems and structured drawing-release or engineering-change workflows.
  • Test-system integration: Experience with instrumentation mounting, actuation hardware, cooling interfaces, or mechanical packaging for test systems.
  • Repeatable build methods: Experience developing standard fixture components, assembly instructions, inspection checklists, or reusable tooling across multiple equipment builds.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Key Responsibilities
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
–Design performance and load testing.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
Compliance & Security:
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
Automation & Change Management:
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.


Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
Collaboration & Partnership:
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
Problem Solving:
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
Continuous Learning:
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
Continuous Improvement:
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
Performance and Development:
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

  • Meet with various public or private entities or individuals to discuss issues relating to a variety of engineering/construction challenges and programs.
  • Ensure that engineering discipline certifications, accreditations, and value proposition is developed and continuously improved.
  • Conduct needs analyses and client value surveys to align the engineering discipline’s function with business and project strategy, identifying and addressing any skill gaps or risks within the sector business operations.

title: Representative, Health Plan Provider Relations - Remote
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Provides administrative, operational, and provider relations support to ensure the effective coordination and execution of Provider Relations activities. Responsible for organizing, tracking, scheduling, reporting, documenting, and maintaining systems and workflows that support provider engagement, issue resolution, network activities, and departmental priorities.

Coordinates meetings, maintains provider and operational trackers, pulls and analyzes routine reports, develops dashboards, monitors work queues and deliverables, and supports accurate documentation within applicable systems, including Salesforce and Microsoft 365 tools.

Provides support to Provider Relations leadership and representatives by coordinating information and follow-up across internal teams. May also support routine provider communications, education, issue intake, research, and resolution as needed.

The role requires strong organization, attention to detail, follow-through, technical proficiency, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly matrixed healthcare environment.

Essential Job Duties

Provider Relations Operations & Administrative Coordination

  • Provides administrative and operational support for Provider Relations activities, initiatives, projects, and departmental priorities.

  • Tracks action items, deliverables, due dates, escalations, and outstanding requests to support timely completion and appropriate follow-through.
  • Maintains organized documentation and ensures information is accurately recorded in applicable systems and shared resources.

  • Coordinates information between Provider Relations and internal departments to ensure requests are routed appropriately and outstanding items are tracked through completion.

Reporting, Tracking & Dashboards

  • Pulls routine operational reports and compiles data to support Provider Relations leadership and team activities.
  • Creates and maintains dashboards, trackers, spreadsheets, and other reporting tools to monitor workload, outreach, provider issues, assignments, performance measures, and departmental activities.
  • Reviews reports and tracking tools for completeness and accuracy and follows up on missing or incomplete information.
  • Organizes data into clear summaries, reports, presentations, and dashboards for leadership and team review.
  • Supports recurring monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting requirements.
  • Identifies trends, overdue activities, workflow gaps, and other items requiring follow-up and communicates them to appropriate team members or leadership.
  • Maintains reporting calendars and coordinates timely completion of recurring reports and deliverables.

Systems & Documentation

  • Maintains Provider Relations information within applicable systems, including Salesforce, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Excel, and other department tools.
  • Supports consistent documentation of provider contacts, outreach, issues, escalations, meetings, and follow-up activities.
  • Performs data entry, data validation, reconciliation, and routine quality checks to maintain accurate provider and departmental information.
  • Maintains electronic files, shared resources, templates, provider contact information, and departmental records.
  • Assists with development and maintenance of standardized workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, visibility, and accountability.

Provider Relations Support

  • Serves as a support resource for routine and non-complex Provider Relations activities.
  • Assists with provider communications, outreach, education, and follow-up as assigned.
  • Responds to or appropriately routes routine provider questions and requests.
  • Researches routine provider issues and coordinates with internal departments to support resolution.
  • Accurately triages provider claim and operational issues to the appropriate department or Provider Relations representative.
  • Assists with provider roster, demographic, contact, and other data updates.
  • Supports provider orientations, trainings, Joint Operating Committee meetings, outreach campaigns, and other provider engagement activities.
  • May maintain relationships with a limited portfolio of non-complex providers or provide coverage for Provider Relations representatives as needed.
  • Supports network development, provider research, recruitment, contracting activities, regulatory audits, and special projects as assigned.
  • Provides additional provider-facing support during periods of increased volume, vacancies, special projects, or other business needs.

Required Qualifications

• At least 2 years of customer service, provider services, or claims experience in a managed care or medical office setting, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
• General understanding of the health care delivery system, including government-sponsored health plans.
• Organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.
• Interpersonal skills, including ability to interface with providers and medical office staff.
• Ability to work in a cross-functional highly matrixed organization.
• Effective verbal and written communication skills.
• Microsoft Office suite and applicable software programs proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with various managed health care provider compensation methodologies, primarily across Medicaid and Medicare lines of business, including: fee-for service (FFS), capitation and various forms of risk, ASO, etc.
• Experience delivering training and facilitating educational presentations.

title: Director Infection Prevention - Full Time
description:
The Director of Infection Prevention provides strategic leadership and day‑to‑day guidance for AtlantiCare Regional Medical Center’s Infection Prevention Program. This role oversees surveillance, policy development, education, and crisis response while ensuring accurate reporting to NHSN and meeting all regulatory and public reporting requirements. The Director mentors the IP team, collaborates with the Corporate Director of Patient Safety, and drives improvement initiatives to protect patients, staff, and visitors from healthcare‑associated infections.
  • Oversee identification, surveillance, and reporting of healthcare‑associated infections (HAIs) and serve as the facility’s NHSN administrator.
  • Develop, recommend, and implement infection control policies, procedures, and protocols aligned with best practices and regulatory standards.
  • Coordinate and lead infection prevention improvement projects and special initiatives across all AtlantiCare campuses.
  • Provide mentorship, training, and certification support to IP team members and other healthcare staff.
  • Manage coverage and staffing for infection control activities, including construction rounds and on‑call emergency response.
  • Lead crisis management efforts, including rapid response to emerging pathogens and communicable disease outbreaks.
  • Collaborate with the Corporate Director of Patient Safety to develop the annual infection prevention plan and conduct risk assessments.
  • Ensure timely and accurate regulatory reporting of infection‑related metrics and mandatory public disclosures.
  • Analyze infection data, generate reports, and present findings to senior leadership to drive safety priorities.
  • Maintain expertise in microbiology, multidrug‑resistant organisms, and emerging clinical technologies.
  • Master’s degree in a health‑related field (e.g., Nursing, Microbiology, Public Health, Medical Technology).
  • Current Certification in Infection Control (CIC) from the Certification Board in Infection Control and Hospital Epidemiology.
  • Fellowship status with the Association for Professionals in Infection Prevention and Control (FAPIC) preferred.
  • If a registered nurse, active RN licensure in the State of New Jersey.
  • Minimum 7 years of infection prevention experience, including at least 2 years in program planning and implementation.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of microbiology and current multidrug‑resistant pathogens.
  • Proficiency with clinical applications and computer spreadsheet software; ability to become fully proficient within 30‑60 days.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to be on‑call for emergencies and critical communicable disease test results.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to work in a hospital environment with occasional lifting (up to 20 lb).

title: Software Engineer I
description:

We are seeking a hands-on Software/Embedded Systems Engineer to join our UAS development team. This role focuses primarily on developing C++ software running on embedded Linux platforms, integrating sensors and avionics, and working closely with hardware. title: Analitik kontrole kakovosti (m/ž/d)
location: Brnik (do odprtja obrata bo delo potekalo v Ljubljani)
description:
Pridružite se nam pri soustvarjanju nove zgodbe na Brniku, kjer nastaja najsodobnejši visokotehnološki center za proizvodnjo podobnih bioloških zdravil. V centru bo potekala aseptična proizvodnja injektabilnih izdelkov za obstoječi in prihajajoči portfelj podobnih bioloških zdravil, od priprave in polnjenja do sestavljanja, pakiranja in laboratorijev za kontrolo kakovosti.

V našo novo ekipo kontrole kakovosti vabimo dva Analitika kontrole kakovosti II, ki se bosta pridružila dvema različnima področjema: kontroli vhodnih materialov (Incoming Materials) in testiranju ovojnine (Packaging Testing). Glede na področje dela boste izvajali laboratorijske analize in testiranja ter sodelovali pri vzpostavitvi novih laboratorijev, opreme in procesov za prihodnje rutinsko GMP delovanje.

Vaše ključne odgovornosti:

  • Sodelovanje pri vzpostavitvi, kvalifikaciji in zagotavljanju operativne pripravljenosti novih laboratorijev za kontrolo kakovosti vhodnih materialov in ovojnine.

  • Izvajanje fizikalno-kemijskih analiz vhodnih materialov za proizvodnjo bioinjektabilnih izdelkov z uporabo analitskih tehnik, kot so UV-Vis spektroskopija, potenciometrične in volumetrične titracije, FT-IR spektroskopija in identifikacijske reakcije.

  • Izvajanje funkcionalnega testiranja medicinskih pripomočkov in fizikalnega testiranja ovojnine ter sodelovanje pri validacijskih aktivnostih ob uvajanju novih medicinskih pripomočkov.

  • Izvajanje rutinskih laboratorijskih analiz in testiranj v skladu z odobrenimi postopki in GMP zahtevami.

  • Sodelovanje pri kvalifikaciji (PQ), uvajanju in vzdrževanju nove laboratorijske opreme.

  • Skrb za laboratorijske materiale, vzorce in dokumentacijo ter njihovo ustrezno upravljanje.

  • Zagotavljanje kakovostne in pravočasne izvedbe analiz ter ustreznega dokumentiranja rezultatov.

  • Delo v skladu z GMP, varnostnimi in okoljskimi zahtevami ter internimi postopki.

Pričakujemo

Vaš prispevek k delovnemu mestu:

  • Najmanj srednješolsko izobrazbo s področja farmacije, kemije, veterine ali druge primerljive smeri.

  • Najmanj 2 leti delovnih izkušenj z laboratorijskimi procesi.

  • Zaželeno poznavanje GMP okolja in laboratorijske dokumentacije.

  • Izkušnje z laboratorijskimi analiznimi tehnikami, fizikalno-kemijskimi analizami oziroma testiranjem materialov so prednost.

  • Osnovno znanje angleškega jezika.

  • Poznavanje orodij Microsoft Office.

  • Natančnost, odgovornost in usmerjenost v kakovostno ter pravočasno izvajanje laboratorijskega dela.

  • Pripravljenost na učenje in sodelovanje pri vzpostavljanju novega laboratorijskega okolja.

Nudimo

Kaj nudimo:

Lokacija dela: Brnik (do odprtja obrata bo delo potekalo v Ljubljani)

Vrsta pogodbe: pogodba za nedoločen čas s 6-mesečnim poskusnim obdobjem

Predvideni tedenski delovni čas: 40 ur

Plačni razpon (letna bruto plača): 20.320 – 30.480 EUR*

Plača v Sandozu temelji na nivoju delovnega mesta, kvalifikacijah, specifičnih veščinah in znanjih ter delovnih izkušnjah. Visoko usposobljeni kandidati so običajno umeščeni okoli mediane plačnega razpona, manj izkušeni na spodnji del razpona, kandidati z izrazito močnimi ali nišnimi kompetencami pa višje. Pri umeščanju v plačni razpon upoštevamo tudi notranjo uravnoteženost plač in zunanje tržne podatke.

Naš paket ugodnosti dodatno vključuje:

  • Letni bonus (STI): odstotek letne plače.

  • Regres za letni dopust: leta 2026 je znašal 2.450,00 EUR (neto).

  • Božičnica: leta 2025 je znašala 2.100 EUR (bruto).

  • OurShare: Vsako leto bo zaposleni v družbi Lek d.d. upravičen do prejema delnic družbe Sandoz AG.

  • Prostovoljno dodatno pokojninsko zavarovanje: družba Lek d.d. v celoti krije mesečni prispevek za dodatno pokojninsko zavarovanje v višini 5,844 % vaše mesečne bruto plače (zgornja zneskovna omejitev je 3.224,18 EUR letno).

  • Dodatek za izmensko delo (15 %); turnusno delo (20 %), nočno delo (70 %), delo ob nedeljah in praznikih (50 %), nadurno delo (30 %).

  • Kolektivno življenjsko in nezgodno zavarovanje (kritje velja 24/7).


Ste pripravljeni na naslednji korak v karieri?
Prijavo z življenjepisom v angleškem in slovenskem jeziku lahko oddate najpozneje do 24. novembra 2026.

Zakaj Sandoz?

Sandoz je vodilni svetovni proizvajalec generičnih in podobnih bioloških zdravil – segmenta zdravstvene industrije, ki zagotavlja 80 % vseh zdravil na svetu po 30-odstotni ceni ter s tem vpliva na življenja več kot milijarde ljudi v več kot 100 državah. Čeprav smo ponosni na svoje dosežke, si prizadevamo narediti še več, da bi vsakdo imel dostop do temeljne človekove pravice – pravice do dobrega zdravja.

Z naložbami v nove razvojne zmogljivosti, proizvodne lokacije, nove pridobitve in partnerstva imamo priložnost oblikovati prihodnost Sandoza ter še večjemu številu ljudi omogočiti trajnostni dostop do cenovno ugodnih in visokokakovostnih zdravil.

Naš zagon temelji na odprti kulturi sodelovanja, katere srce so naši talentirani in ambiciozni sodelavci in sodelavke. V okolju, kjer so raznoliki načini razmišljanja dobrodošli in kjer se podpira osebna rast, imajo v zameno za uporabo svojih znanj možnost v celoti izkusiti delo v agilnem in povezovalnem okolju ter razvijati svojo uspešno kariero.

Pridružite se nam in nam pomagajte povečati pravičnost in hitrost zdravstvenega varstva.

Prihodnost je v naših rokah.

Predani smo raznolikosti in vključenosti:

Zavzemamo se za raznolikost, enake možnosti in vključenost. Prizadevamo si za oblikovanje raznolikih timov, saj ti predstavljajo naše bolnike in skupnosti, ki jih oskrbujemo.

O podjetju

Lek, član skupine Sandoz, je prva in najstarejša farmacevtska družba v Sloveniji, kjer razvijamo, izdelujemo in tržimo učinkovita, varna ter kakovostna generična in podobna biološka zdravila, namenjena bolnikom po vsem svetu. Pri delu nas vodijo visoki etični standardi, inovativno razmišljanje in prebojni dosežki naših vrhunskih strokovnjakov. Z več kot 4000 sodelavci že desetletja dejavno soustvarjamo slovenski, evropski in svetovni razvojno-raziskovalni prostor. Gradimo kulturo odprtega dialoga in ponosno ter odgovorno nosimo naziv najuglednejšega delodajalca v Sloveniji.
