title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
description:
About Agile Defense
At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.
Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.

Requisition #: 1617
Job Title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
Location: On-Site, Arlington, VA
Clearance Level: Top Secret, must have Clearance to Start

Job Description

Agile Defense is actively seeking a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst with background experience on Russia to apply their technical and analytic expertise to evaluate advanced and emerging cyber threats targeting Federal Departments and Agencies (D/A) and National Critical Functions (NCF). The selected candidate will produce all-source, strategic cyber intelligence assessments using various industry and government tools and classified and unclassified data sets.
They will Identify, Investigate, and pursue cyber events of significance and communicate findings to key decision makers via a broad range of intelligence products while adhering to intelligence tradecraft and methods. Position is contingent on successfully completing a program-based background investigation.
Duties include:
  • Collect and analyze threat data from multiple sources (open-source intelligence, dark web, threat feeds, internal logs).
  • Identify threat actors, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) used in cyberattacks.
  • Assess vulnerabilities and risks to the organization based on current threat landscape.
  • Produce intelligence reports for security teams and leadership to guide decision-making.

Education and Background

A minimum Bachelor’s with 5+ years of experience, MS 3+ years of experience or PHD 0+ years of experience.

Required Skills

  • Active Top-Secret Clearance.
  • Familiarity with dia writing standards, and applicable knowledge on icd203 & icd106 standards.
  • Understanding of indicators of compromise and how they are utilized with CTI.
  • Knowledge on how to use and implement the MITRE framework.
  • Working knowledge of what an APT is.
  • Know how to utilize TTP's from an APT to leverage against potential targets.

Preferred Skills

  • ICS/SCADA/OT experience.
  • Experience working with ICS/SCADA/OT equipment and/or have certifications/education relating to industrial control systems.
  • Experienced with Russian threat in the context of the intelligence community world related to cybersecurity.
Our Core Values
Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.
What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. It's who we are.
  • Happy - Be Infectious. Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do.
  • Helpful - Be Supportive. Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated.
  • Honest - Be Trustworthy. Honesty serves as our compass, ensuring transparent communication and ethical conduct, essential to who we are and the complex domains we support.
  • Humble - Be Grounded. Success is not achieved alone, humility ensures a culture of mutual respect, encouraging open communication, and a willingness to learn from one another and take on any task.
  • Hungry - Be Eager. Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges.
  • Hustle - Be Driven. Hustle is reflected in our relentless work ethic, where we are each committed to going above and beyond to advance the mission and achieve success.

description:

Job Summary

The Director, ICU provides strategic and operational leadership for the Intensive Care Unit (ICU), ensuring the delivery of high-quality, patient-centered care. This role oversees clinical and administrative operations, including staffing, budgeting, quality improvement, and service line development. The Director collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to optimize patient outcomes, enhance staff engagement, and drive innovation in critical care services. This position requires 24-hour accountability for the ICU.

Essential Functions

  • Oversees the planning, implementation, and evaluation of critical care nursing services for adult and geriatric populations in the ICU.

  • Directs the recruitment, hiring, evaluation, coaching, and professional development of ICU staff to maintain a skilled and engaged workforce.
  • Establishes and monitors clinical practice standards, ensuring the delivery of evidence-based care and superior customer service.
  • Develops and enforces policies and procedures for ICU operations, including disaster preparedness plans.
  • Collaborates with hospital leadership to market the Critical Care service line and support the development of educational programs.
  • Coordinates and facilitates staff education and in-service training on new equipment, procedures, and technologies.
  • Maintains 24-hour accountability for problem resolution and operational oversight of ICU services.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Supervision and Staff Management
    • Provides leadership, mentorship and professional development opportunities for departmental staff.
    • Schedules employees to ensure effective use of resources. Consults with leadership on any potential staffing issues.
    • Conducts performance evaluations, sets goals and provides feedback to staff on their performance and development.
  • Strategic Planning and Financial Oversight
    • Collaborates with hospital leadership to set the strategic direction for the department, including budgeting, resource allocation and long-term planning.
    • Monitors expenditures, ensuring cost-effective delivery of services.
    • Evaluates and implements new technologies to enhance operational efficiency.
    • Develops and implements departmental policies and procedures and protocols to optimize quality and overall efficiencies.
  • Quality Assurance and Regulatory Compliance
    • Ensures compliance with all relevant regulatory bodies. May oversee the accreditation process with relevant agencies ensuring that services meet or exceed industry standards.
    • Participates in audits, inspections and accreditation processes as applicable.
    • Follows established quality control practices to ensure accuracy, consistency and safety.
  • Collaboration and Communication
    • Works closely with leadership teams to coordinate and improve service delivery.
    • Stays up-to-date with industry advancements, new technologies, and regulatory changes.
  • Staff Responsibilities
    • May work in a staff role, when required. Ensures that duties and responsibilities are fulfilled while meeting all competencies established for that job.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in relevant field required or
  • Seven (7) plus years of direct experience in lieu of a Bachelor's degree required
  • Master's Degree preferred
  • 3-5 years of experience in closely related field with Bachelor's degree required
  • 3-5 years of previous leadership experience preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with interdisciplinary teams and manage cross-functional relationships.
  • Foster a positive work environment that promotes teamwork, professionalism, and continuous improvement.
  • Communicate effectively with leadership, team members, and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work effectively with others, delegate responsibilities, and independently manage tasks while meeting established deadlines.
  • Problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
  • In depth knowledge of industry best practices and regulatory compliance (if applicable).
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Proficiency with Google and Microsoft platforms, healthcare software systems, and data analysis tools.

Licenses and Certifications

  • RN - Registered Nurse - State Licensure and/or Compact State Licensure required
  • BCLS - Basic Life Support required
  • ACLS - Advanced Cardiac Life Support preferred

At NKMC, we’re more than healthcare providers, we’re a team dedicated to compassionate care and community wellness. Join us for a supportive work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to make a real difference in the lives of our patients every day. Your skills, your passion, and your commitment matter here.

title: Programmamanager Woonwagenbeleid en Standplaatsen
description:
Werk bij Haarlem en Zandvoort is werk dat ertoe doet, met resultaten die je ziet als je door de stad of het dorp loopt. Met een goede werk-privébalans en met mooie secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Ook bij team Programma's maken we impact.

De afdeling Programma- en Gebiedsmanagement bestaat uit zo'n 90 collega's en is verdeeld in drie teams: Strategie, Programmamanagement en Gebiedsmanagement. Deze teams werken aan beleid en projecten voor Haarlem en Zandvoort. We werken altijd in opdracht, vaak van de directie en richten ons op belangrijke, vaak complexe opgaven van de stad. Deze maatschappelijke opgaven zijn domeinbreed en afdeling overstijgend en volgen het coalitieprogramma.



Functiebeschrijving

De gemeente Haarlem staat voor een ambitieuze woonwagenopgave. De komende jaren realiseren we nieuwe standplaatsen, verbeteren we bestaande locaties en versterken we de samenwerking met woningcorporaties en woonwagenbewoners. Dit vraagt om een programmatische aanpak waarin gebiedsontwikkeling, participatie en communicatie, veiligheid en handhaving en bestuurlijke besluitvorming samenkomen.

Je brengt samenhang tussen projecten, beleid, beheer- en exploitatievraagstukken en de samenwerking met interne en externe partners. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen bestuur, organisatie, bewoners en corporaties en zorgt ervoor dat de programmadoelen worden vertaald naar concrete resultaten. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de integrale aansturing van het programma Woonwagens 2027-2030 en eindverantwoordelijk voor de voortgang, samenhang en realisatie van de doelstellingen. Daarbij stuur je op inhoud, proces, mensen en middelen en bestuurlijke besluitvorming. Het programmateam bestaat uit drie projectleiders en collega's uit verschillende afdelingen.

Als nieuwe collega van team Wonen bestaat je takenpakket onder andere uit:

  • Het adviseren van bestuur, directie en management over strategische vraagstukken, kansen, risico's en noodzakelijke keuzes binnen het programma.
  • Het voorbereiden van bestuurlijke besluitvorming en het opstellen van college- en raadsvoorstellen, bestuurlijke rapportages en voortgangsdocumenten.
  • Het aansturen van het multidisciplinaire programmateam en het organiseren van samenwerking tussen de betrokken gemeentelijke disciplines.
  • Het onderhouden van relaties met woningcorporaties, woonwagenbewoners, belangenorganisaties en andere betrokken stakeholders.
  • Het regisseren van participatie- en communicatietrajecten rondom nieuwe en bestaande woonwagenlocaties.
  • Het sturen op de realisatie van nieuwe woonwagenstandplaatsen en de verbetering van bestaande locaties.
  • Het voorbereiden van afspraken over beheer, eigendom, exploitatie, financiering en verantwoordelijkheden van woonwagenlocaties.
  • Het monitoren van voortgang, resultaten en risico's en hierover periodiek rapporteren aan opdrachtgevers en bestuur.


Functie-eisen
  • Je hebt academisch werk- en denkniveau.
  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als programmamanager, strategisch adviseur of vergelijkbare functie binnen een publieke organisatie.
  • Je hebt ervaring met bestuurlijke advisering binnen een politiek-bestuurlijke omgeving.
  • Je hebt ervaring met complexe ruimtelijke, volkshuisvestelijke of maatschappelijke opgaven.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en met het samenwerken met verschillende belangenorganisaties en maatschappelijke partners.
  • Kennis van volkshuisvesting, wonen, gebiedsontwikkeling of vastgoedvraagstukken is een sterke pré.
  • Je bent analytisch sterk, resultaatgericht en organisatiesensitief.
  • Je bent een natuurlijke verbinder en beschikt over uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatieve vaardigheden.
  • Je kunt omgaan met tegenstrijdige belangen en weet ook in complexe dossiers voortgang te realiseren.


Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Wij waarderen, omarmen en benutten de verschillen en talenten van mensen. Wij bieden een plek waar iedereen zich thuis kan voelen en zichzelf mag zijn. Daar maken wij ons hard voor. Dat is goed voor onze medewerkers én leidt tot de beste resultaten voor de stad en het dorp.

  • Voor jouw persoonlijke groei en vitaliteit bieden wij tal van mogelijkheden. Denk aan het volgen van opleidingen, certificeringen, cursussen via onze ‘Academie Haarlem' en ook een fietsregeling en een tegemoetkoming in je sportabonnement.
  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 32 - 36 uur per week. Je start met een jaarcontract dat we bij goed functioneren graag verlengen met nog een jaar. Gedurende deze periode wordt ook duidelijk hoe de functie daarna wordt vormgegeven.
  • Het salaris is afhankelijk van ervaring en opleiding en bedraagt maximaal € 7.837 bruto per maand (schaal 13) bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur per week. Daarbovenop krijg je 17,05% Individueel Keuze Budget over je bruto salaris, waarmee je zelf je eigen arbeidsvoorwaarden samenstelt.
  • Hybride werken is bij onze gemeente aan de orde van de dag. De ene dag ben je op kantoor, een ander moment kies je voor thuiswerken. Wij faciliteren je daarbij. Waar je ook werkt, je bent altijd in verbinding met je collega's.
  • Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals vergoeding OV-reiskosten, gedeeltelijk betaald ouderschapsverlof en een goede pensioenregeling bij het ABP. Bekijk de arbeidsvoorwaarden van de Cao Gemeenten

Onze organisatiewaarden zijn open, gedreven en betrokken.

title: Principal Health Service Analyst
description:
Provides both lead and collaborative roles in multiple concurrent health services research evaluation projects. Applies scientific expertise to the design, implementation, analysis, interpretation and reporting of research, clinical and administrative studies. Defines the project's direction, scope and analysis plan. Acts as a co-investigator and is responsible for the overall management and analysis of multiple concurrent research projects intended to analyze practice patterns, provider-payer relations, health care utilization, cost effectiveness, physician profiling, risk adjustment, severity adjustment and episodes of care analysis, patient reported outcomes, and variation in clinical practice for the Mayo Clinic Enterprise. Has broad responsibility and accountability for multiple complex projects. Manages and resolves complex interrelationship among projects; determines resource requirements, organizes work and sets priorities. Provides health services research expertise for both Mayo Clinic and inter-institutional projects.

Master’s degree required with a minimum of 10 years of experience or Ph.D. with 2 years of experience in Health Services Research, Health Economics, Public Health, Bio-Statistics, Operations Research, Epidemiology, Health Informatics or related fields. Must have substantial technical expertise in quantitative and/or qualitative analysis. Involves a high degree of autonomous decision making, judgment, and initiative. Able to identify issues/problems, initiate plans to address and make appropriate and timely decisions. Demonstrated management skills, including the ability to direct the management of complex projects and tasks and monitor progress. Must have strong teamwork, communication, organizational and interpersonal skills. Must tolerate a high degree of ambiguity. Knowledgeable of current health care delivery trends, economic and regulatory issues. Experience with large administrative and/or clinical databases preferred. Experience with statistical analysis software( SAS or Stata) preferred. Familiarity with coding (CPT, ICD-9) systems and risk adjustment methodologies preferred.

Works with general direction: receives general direction in terms of broad goals and overall objectives and is responsible for establishing the methods to attain them.

title: Residential Counselor I/II - Monroe House Thurs/Fri/Sat AON 8pm-8am
description:
WellPower envisions a community where every person’s mental health is fostered through strength, resilience and hope. We empower people to overcome barriers and achieve lasting well-being through collaborative behavioral health care and comprehensive support.

Our Guiding Principles:

  • Person Centered. We honor people’s identities, lived experience and journeys and treat every person with the dignity we all deserve.
  • Exceptional Care. We offer compassionate, innovative services that meet people where they are, from immediate support to long-term recovery.
  • Integrity. We operate from a deep foundation of ethical, accountable practices in all we do.
  • Organizational Resilience. We meet the moment and adapt to changing contexts with collaborative creativity, agile business processes, and financial stewardship.

Position Summary:

Residential Counselors facilitate and work with consumers on a variety of activities of daily living (ADLs) needed for consumers to become more self-sufficient and move toward recovery. Additionally, you will facilitate group therapy, manage intakes/discharges, monitor medications, create a safe environment for the consumers, help coordinate treatment, and advocate for individuals with severe and persistent mental illness. Responsible for direct service care to consumers as part of a multi-disciplinary team.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • RCI – $27.79/hr
  • RCII – $30.12/hr
  • AON - $3.00/hr
  • For complete overview of our robust Benefits:

The posted range represents the full hiring range. Offers will not exceed this range, the majority of candidates are placed near the midpoint based on experience and qualifications.

Job Duties & Functions:

  • Provide individual psychotherapy with consumers to provide support and insight.
  • Facilitate group therapy sessions within the house.
  • Coordinate clinical care with case management services and other services both inside and outside of MHCD.
  • Assess consumers throughout the workday, and provide appropriate interventions.
  • Encourage, support, and train consumers in activities of daily living (ADLs) - teaching consumers about hygiene, help make appointments, show how to do household duties/chores, such as cooking, cleaning, etc.
  • As part of a multi-disciplinary system, help facilitate the treatment and continuity of clinical care.
  • Complete intake and discharge tasks for consumers being place in the house as new residents or moving out of the house.
  • Maintain household safety in regards to a variety of household chores and activities, such as cooking, cleaning, and laundry.
  • Document all significant consumer interactions toward recovery and continuity of care.
  • Complete necessary clinical documentation, such as the daily log, consumer record, and medication records.
  • Respond to consumer and building emergencies, and facilitate appropriate interventions. In emergency situations, contact other residential staff, your supervisor, or other clinicians when needed.
  • Advocate for acceptance and integration of individuals with mental illness within the neighborhood and community in which they live.
  • Maintain a trauma informed environment of wellbeing.
  • Required to attend scheduled team meetings.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Must meet qualifications under Chapter 7 of the Residential Care Facilities - Mentally Ill requirements. Shift work and/or weekend work is required. Certain programs may require a Class "S" driver's license.
  • Maintain a trauma informed environment of wellbeing.
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements & Qualifications:

EDUCATION:

  • RC I: Pursuing Bachelor's Degree in social work, psychology, human services, or related field; or, seeking Certified Nurse’s Aid (C.N.A.) or Home Health Aid (HHA) Certification preferred.
  • RC II: Bachelor's Degree in social work, psychology, human services, or related field.

EXPERIENCE:

  • One year of mental health experience or in related field preferred. Must be 21yrs. of age to apply.

Certifications:

  • QMAP (Qualified Medication Administration Person)
  • CPR & First Aid

Work Location: 1425 Monroe St, Denver CO

Shift/Hours: Awake Overnight, Thursday, Friday & Saturday 8pm - 8am.

Physical Requirements: Requires sitting, standing, bending, lifting. Must be able to perform a variety of household tasks, climb stairs, move throughout the house, and quickly respond to emergencies. May require lifting 50 pounds.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

title: Bouwplantoetser
description:
Ben jij een bouwplantoetser die energie krijgt van uiteenlopende bouwinitiatieven en graag meedenkt over wat er wél mogelijk is? Heb jij oog voor kwaliteit, weet je de weg binnen de Omgevingswet en vind je het leuk om met verschillende partijen samen te werken? En wil je bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van een gemeente waar volop wordt gebouwd en vernieuwd? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Als bouwplantoetser bij gemeente Hilversum krijg je een veelzijdige rol binnen ons team Vergunningen. Je beoordeelt uiteenlopende bouwplannen, begeleidt vergunningaanvragen en zorgt ervoor dat initiatiefnemers weten waar ze aan toe zijn. Daarbij combineer je jouw kennis van wet- en regelgeving met een praktische, oplossingsgerichte aanpak.

🌱 Wat houdt je functie in?

Van een verbouwing van een karakteristiek pand tot een nieuwbouwproject of een bijzonder initiatief in de stad: in Hilversum is altijd iets in ontwikkeling. En jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol!

Als bouwplantoetser behandel je vooronderzoeken, maatwerkinitiatieven en aanvragen voor omgevingsvergunningen. Je beoordeelt deze aan de hand van geldend beleid en wet- en regelgeving, waaronder de Omgevingswet. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar wat juridisch mogelijk is, maar denk je ook actief mee over passende oplossingen.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van jouw aanvragen. Je verzamelt de benodigde adviezen, stemt af met collega's en externe partijen en zorgt ervoor dat aanvragen zorgvuldig en tijdig worden afgehandeld. Je stelt beschikkingen, beoordelingen en adviesrapportages op en verzorgt de bijbehorende correspondentie.

Je bent een belangrijke schakel tussen initiatiefnemers, adviseurs en andere betrokkenen. Je weet verschillende belangen zorgvuldig af te wegen, communiceert helder en houdt overzicht, ook wanneer meerdere aanvragen tegelijkertijd lopen.

Daarnaast kijk je verder dan alleen jouw eigen dossiers. Je denkt mee over de prioritering van aanvragen, signaleert kansen om werkprocessen te verbeteren en draagt bij aan een klantgerichte dienstverlening. Met jouw 'ja, mits'-houding zoek je binnen de geldende kaders naar mogelijkheden om initiatieven verder te helpen.

Kortom: een veelzijdige functie waarin jouw bouwkundige en juridische kennis, zelfstandigheid en oplossingsgerichte houding écht het verschil maken!

🧭 Dit zijn jouw kerntaken als bouwplantoetser:

  • Je behandelt en coördineert vooronderzoeken, maatwerkinitiatieven en aanvragen voor omgevingsvergunningen.
  • Je toetst bouwplannen aan de Omgevingswet en relevante wet- en regelgeving en gemeentelijk beleid.
  • Je verzamelt en beoordeelt adviezen en stemt af met interne en externe betrokkenen.
  • Je begeleidt het vergunningproces van aanvraag tot besluitvorming en zorgt voor een zorgvuldige en tijdige afhandeling.
  • Je stelt beschikkingen, adviesrapportages, beoordelingen en correspondentie op.
  • Je adviseert over de prioritering en afhandeling van aanvragen en verzoeken.
  • Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor initiatiefnemers en andere betrokken partijen en denkt actief mee over haalbare oplossingen.
  • Je beheert zelfstandig jouw werkvoorraad, bewaakt termijnen en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van jouw dossiers.

Je krijgt dus niet alleen de verantwoordelijkheid om aanvragen zorgvuldig te behandelen, maar ook de ruimte om mee te denken over hoe we onze dienstverlening verder kunnen verbeteren.

🎓 Wat breng je mee en welke competenties zijn belangrijk?

Jij bent een betrokken en zelfstandige professional die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt. Je weet wet- en regelgeving te vertalen naar de praktijk, communiceert duidelijk en denkt liever in mogelijkheden dan in beperkingen.

Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • Je hebt een afgeronde, relevante hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Bouwkunde, Ruimtelijke Ordening of Omgevingsrecht/Fysieke Leefomgeving. Een mbo+-opleiding met aantoonbare kennis en ervaring op hbo-niveau is ook mogelijk.
  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring met vergunningverlening binnen de Omgevingswet.
  • Je beschikt over kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving en weet deze toe te passen bij het beoordelen van bouwplannen.
  • Je kunt zelfstandig dossiers behandelen en bent vaardig in het opstellen van besluiten en adviezen. De opleiding ABW I is een pre.

Dit zijn de belangrijkste competenties voor deze functie:

  1. Analytisch vermogen – Je doorgrondt complexe aanvragen, ziet verbanden en komt tot goed onderbouwde beoordelingen.
  2. Klantgerichtheid – Je denkt vanuit een 'ja, mits'-houding mee met initiatiefnemers en zoekt naar mogelijkheden binnen de geldende kaders.
  3. Eigenaarschap – Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor jouw dossiers, bewaakt de voortgang en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen.
  4. Communicatieve vaardigheden – Je communiceert helder en weet jouw standpunten goed uit te leggen aan verschillende betrokkenen.
  5. Samenwerkingsgerichtheid – Je zoekt actief de verbinding met collega's en externe partners en draagt bij aan een prettige samenwerking.
  6. Plannen en organiseren – Je houdt overzicht over jouw werkvoorraad, stelt prioriteiten en werkt zorgvuldig en resultaatgericht.

🤝 Wat kun je van ons verwachten?

✔ Werkweek: 36 uur per week.
✔ Salaris: Schaal 9, maximaal € 5.096 bruto per maand bij 36 uur, afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring. Plaatsing in aanloopschaal 8 is mogelijk.
✔ Extra's: Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) van 17,05% per jaar, dat je kunt laten uitbetalen of inzetten voor verschillende doeleinden.
✔ Voorzieningen: Pensioenopbouw bij ABP en goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.
✔ Ontwikkeling: Ruime opleidingsmogelijkheden voor jouw persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.
✔ Werk-privébalans: Mogelijkheden om flexibel te werken.

📍 Zo ziet jouw nieuwe team eruit:

Je komt te werken in het team Vergunningen van de gemeente Hilversum. Binnen dit team houden we ons bezig met uiteenlopende vergunningaanvragen en initiatieven die bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van onze gemeente.

Je werkt samen met collega's en adviseurs vanuit verschillende vakgebieden. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat aanvragen zorgvuldig, tijdig en met oog voor de belangen van inwoners, ondernemers en andere betrokkenen worden behandeld.

Je komt terecht in een werkomgeving waarin samenwerking, vakmanschap en dienstverlening centraal staan. We denken in mogelijkheden, helpen elkaar verder en werken samen aan een toekomstbestendig Hilversum.

💪🏽 Samen sterker!

Wijdemeren en Hilversum zijn vanaf 1 januari 2027 één gemeente. Zo kunnen we de dienstverlening aan onze 120.000 inwoners en bijna 20.000 bedrijven niet alleen blijven garanderen, maar ook verbeteren. Door onze krachten te bundelen, staan we sterker in het aanpakken van belangrijke uitdagingen, zoals wonen, natuur, economie en bereikbaarheid.

Hilversum en Wijdemeren delen een historie en zijn al langer met elkaar verbonden. De samenvoeging biedt nieuwe energie om die verbondenheid te versterken.

De dorpen Ankeveen, Breukeleveen, 's-Graveland, Kortenhoef, Loosdrecht en Nederhorst den Berg behouden hun eigen karakter en vormen een waardevolle aanvulling op het meer stadse karakter van Hilversum. Van veen en water naar zand en heide. Die diversiteit maakt Hilversum aantrekkelijk om in te wonen, te werken én te recreëren.

📞 Enthousiast?

We komen graag met jou in contact! Laat jouw cv en motivatie achter en wij nemen contact met je op. De sluitingsdatum van deze vacature is maandag 23 november 2026.

Heb je nog inhoudelijke vragen over de functie of de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem dan contact op met Willem Jan van Heek, Teammanager Vergunningen, via 035-6292853.

Heb je nog vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem dan nu contact op met onze recruiter Chantal de Bont op 06 -38772280 of werving@hilversum.nl

title: Pomočnik vodje poslovne enote (m/ž) Koper Šalara

Tvoje naloge

  • dosledno opravljanje dela v skladu s prodajnimi načeli,

  • upoštevanje vrstnega reda zlaganja blaga in načel ureditve prodajnega prostora za celotno prodajno ponudbo, zalaganje polic s prehrambnimi in neprehrambnimi izdelki,

  • zagotavljanje stroškovno ugodne izvedbe Lidlovega koncepta poslovanja v konkurenčnem okolju ob upoštevanju zakonskih določil, standardov in načel podjetja,

Navdušuje nas

  • znanje slovenskega jezika,

  • dinamičnost in veselje do dela s kupci,

  • dobre komunikacijske in organizacijske sposobnosti ter izkušnje pri tem,

  • samozavesten nastop in usmerjenost k ciljem,

  • prilagodljivost in zmožnost timskega dela,

  • potrdilo o nekaznovanosti.

Ponujamo

  • redno mesečno plačilo za polni delovni čas 40 ur tedensko, ki je nad slovenskim povprečjem v trgovinski dejavnosti:

  • v 1. letu zaposlitve bruto plača znaša 1.950 EUR bruto/mesec z vključenim stalnim dodatkom,

  • vsako nadaljnje leto zaposlitve se plača samodejno zviša vse do zadnje stopnje, kjer plačilo znaša 2.360 EUR bruto/mesec z vključenim stalnim dodatkom,

  • nadpovprečno izplačilo letnega regresa (2.000 EUR) in izplačilo zimskega regresa,

  • vplačilo v 2. pokojninski steber po 6 mesecih zaposlitve (480 EUR letno) in vključitev v dodatno kolektivno zdravstveno zavarovanje,

  • pogodbo o zaposlitvi za nedoločen čas s poskusno dobo 6 mesecev,

  • 7,96 EUR povračila stroškov prehrane na delovni dan in povračilo stroškov prevoza na delo v skladu s KP dejavnosti trgovine Slovenije,

  • neenakomerno razporejen delovni čas (dela se 5 dni na teden, 2 dneva sta prosta),

  • stalni razvoj in osebnostno rast z jasnimi možnostmi kariernega napredovanja,

Verjamemo vate, zato se prijavi in pokaži svoj karierni potencial.

O podjetju

Lidl Slovenija, ki na slovenskem trgu posluje od leta 2007, ima danes 69 trgovin in več kot 2.000 zaposlenih. Smo zanesljiv partner za preprost nakup, kjer na enem mestu najdete vse, kar potrebujete za vsakodnevno uporabo.

Če razmišljate o novi službi in vas zanima delo v podjetju, ki daje velik poudarek skrbi za zaposlene, potem ste na pravem mestu.

Omenjena prizadevanja podjetja med drugim potrjujejo številna priznanja neodvisnih ustanov. Lidl Slovenija je letos že sedmič zapored prejel certifikat Top Employer Slovenija in certifikat Top Employer Europe 2026, naziv, ki ga najboljšim delodajalcem po svetu podeljuje mednarodna organizacija Top Employers Institute. Po zaslugi mnogih ukrepov, uvedenih s ciljem lažjega usklajevanja delovnih in zasebnih obveznosti, pa smo že vrsto let tudi nosilci polnega certifikata Družini prijazno podjetje.

Za iskalce zaposlitve so takšna priznanja lahko dobro znamenje, da podjetje resno vlaga v zaposlene.

title: Trainer
description:
Lights on. Energy up. Learning in action!

We're looking for a dynamic Trainer who can spark curiosity, challenge thinking and turn everyday learning into extraordinary growth. If you love developing people and making an impact, we want you!

So, what will you do?

  • You will design and deliver impactful learning interventions across all levels and functions of the organisation, tailored to enhance technical, functional, and behavioural competencies.
  • You will ensure that employees are equipped to perform effectively and excel in their roles through diverse and engaging training mediums.
  • You will foster a culture of continuous learning, aligning training initiatives with organisational goals and promote the development of skills critical to business success.

In addition to the above, you will:

  • Conduct onboarding and training for new hires as well as provide a consistent, uniformed training approach on both functional and technical knowledge, with all new starters in their relevant roles and departments, across the business at different levels.
  • Create training programs that are tailored to the needs of specific roles and levels within the organisation.
  • Develop engaging and interactive training materials, including e-learning modules, presentations, job aids, and workshop guides.
  • Develop scenarios for role playing activities as well as to accommodate various learning interventions.
  • Collaborates effectively with the rest of the team to brief Designs and develop training materials, ensuring comprehensive coverage of technical information while meeting learning objectives.
  • Conduct impactful learning experiences tailored to the audience that drive skill development and behavioural change across all levels of the organisation.
  • Adapt facilitation techniques to ensure relevance and engagement for diverse learner profiles.
  • Deliver training in various formats, including in-person workshops, virtual sessions, and hybrid models, ensuring seamless execution in each.
  • Leverage appropriate tools and technologies to enhance learning experiences, such as virtual breakout rooms, collaborative whiteboards, and simulations.
  • Train across multiple levels across the organisation and ensuring training sessions are inclusive, engaging, and impactful.
  • Facilitate training on all learning materials across the organisation, encompassing technical, functional, and soft skills development.
  • Ensure learners gain proficiency in key subject areas, adapting delivery style to maximise understanding and application.
  • Create a positive, interactive learning environment that fosters open communication and collaboration, and knowledge retention.
  • Use storytelling, role-playing, case studies, and hands-on activities to enhance engagement and retention.
  • Use gamification, microlearning, and scenario-based training to align with modern learning preferences.
  • Actively encourage participation, addressing resistance or disengagement constructively.
  • Address learner questions and challenges effectively during sessions.
  • Serve as a post-training resource, offering follow-up support and clarification to reinforce learning.
  • Measure the effectiveness of training initiatives and apply insights to improve future programs.
  • Provide feedback and performance data to the Learning Manager and Instructional Designer training team to assess training impact and refine collateral.
  • Provide evidence of training to Learning and Development Specialist.
  • Continuously refine delivery methods based on evaluation results.
  • Be responsible for accurately storing, managing, and distributing training materials across the business to ensure consistency and accessibility.
  • Work closely with the Learning Manager, foster strong relationships with stakeholders to ensure training aligns with business objectives and employee needs.
  • Communicate training plans, schedules, updates and outcomes effectively to all stakeholders.
  • Support cross-functional projects that require training expertise.
  • Foster cross-functional collaboration to integrate training into broader initiatives and within the organisation's overall strategic direction.
  • Coordinate diaries with stakeholders and employees requiring training.
  • Ensure the logistics of the venue, refreshments have been arranged and secured for the training.
  • Maintain and ensure up to date training records and registers are stored on SharePoint, according to compliance reporting standards.
  • Works closely with the Learning and Development Specialist to coordinate and administer training programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with organizational goals.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Education, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

Deal Breakers:

Minimum 6 years’ experience in training and development of which 4 years’ experience in a role training a diverse audience across all levels and functions with the following:

  • Proven expertise in designing and delivering training content across technical, functional, and behavioural competencies along with a demonstrated ability to design and conduct role-playing scenarios to enhance skill application.
  • Hands-on experience using Learning Management Systems (LMS), e-learning platforms, and scenario-based learning techniques.
  • Demonstrated expertise in instructional design models (e.g., ADDIE, SAM) and adult learning principles.
  • Proficiency in multiple delivery methods: in-person, virtual, hybrid, and self-directed learning as well as advanced facilitation and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt techniques to suit varied learner profiles and organisational needs.
  • Ability to design engaging and easy to understand presentations and supporting collateral.
  • Proficient with industry-standard tools such as Microsoft Office, Miro, Canva, and other collaborative technologies.
  • Travel will be required for on-site training delivery based on business needs.
  • Ability to develop and conduct summative and formative assessments and the ability to compile and present detailed progress reports.

In addition to the above, the experience in the following technologies, domains and best practices will make you a frontrunner for the role:

  • Certification in training delivery or instructional design (e.g., Train-the-Trainer, Certified Professional in Talent Development (CPTD), or equivalent would be advantageous.
  • Qualification in facilitation and assessment would be advantageous.
  • Experience in a fast-paced, diverse industry such as fintech or sales preferred as well as staying up to date with the new market trends.
  • Comprehensive understanding of functional and technical skills required in sales, customer support, and operational roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, engaging training that is easily understood by diverse audiences.
  • Proven learning mindset with strong adaptability to stay current with the latest training methodologies and industry trends.
  • Analytical skills to assess training effectiveness and implement continuous improvements, and understanding of training evaluation frameworks (e.g., Kirkpatrick’s Model).
  • Knowledge of technical concepts, product development cycles, and customer-centric processes.
  • Strong knowledge of the sales process, sales techniques and its best practices.
  • Ability to work individually and as a team player, have good time management skills and a strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent stakeholder relationship building and management as well as the ability to influence implementation.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and coaching skills to engage and support diverse audiences and stakeholders.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills to handle multiple training initiatives simultaneously.

Perks of joining the Tribe?

  • Work in a high-growth company with tangible results you're accountable for.
  • Enjoy hybrid, remote, and in-office work models.
  • Competitive remuneration and benefits, including reduced Gap cover rates. Medical Aid and Group Risk scheme contributions.
  • Visionary leadership.
  • Seize the opportunity for study leave.
  • Access to on-demand learning at your fingertips.
  • Experience a friendly, collaborative culture with a team of all-round-lekker humans (it’s true, we surveyed our Employees and they told us so).
  • If you find yourself at HQ, coffee on tap and a selection of hot beverages provided by our very own onsite Barista.

Stay Sharp!
Job scams are out there, but we’ve got your back. Here’s how to keep it real when applying:

Apply the iK way:
Go via our Careers page or verified platforms (Smart Recruiters).
We’ll never ask for payment, personal financial details, or anything unusual during the hiring process. If someone does, it’s a scam, report it.
If something feels off, pause and confirm the role on our site before responding.

Your journey to join the iKTribe starts with trust and we’re here to keep it simple and secure.

title: Research Associate II - High Throughput Screening Core
description:
Join the forefront of groundbreaking research at the Beckman Research Institute of City of Hope, where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life-threatening illnesses. Our dedicated and compassionate faculty and staff are driven by a common mission\: Contribute to innovative approaches in predicting, preventing, and curing diseases, shaping the future of medicine through cutting-edge research.

A Research Assistant II position is available within the High Throughput Screening (HTS) Core. The HTS Core supports early-stage drug discovery through assay development and optimization, high-throughput small-molecule screening, hit identification and validation, and lead optimization. The Core provides investigators with access to automated screening capabilities, a collection of more than 250,000 small molecules, and scientific expertise in biochemical and cell-based assay development.

We are seeking a highly motivated and collaborative research professional with experience in cell biology, biochemistry, assay development, and/or drug discovery. You will work closely with investigators and support the development, optimization, execution of small molecule screening, hit validation, and quantitative data analysis. The position will involve extensive hands-on laboratory work and close collaboration with HTS Core staff and investigators across multiple drug-discovery and translational research projects.

In addition to traditional HTS approaches, the HTS Core also involves advanced translational screening technologies, including 3D/organoid models imaging and profiling, high-content imaging and image-based phenotypic screening. Experience in one or more of these emerging areas would be highly valued.

As a successful candidate you will\:

· Develop, optimize, validate, and miniaturize biochemical and cell-based assays for drug discovery and small-molecule screening.

· Design and execute high-throughput and medium-throughput screening campaigns, including primary screening, hit confirmation, concentration-response studies, counter-screens, and orthogonal/secondary validation assays.

· Utilize and support laboratory automation, liquid handling, multimode detection, and other screening technologies to establish efficient and reproducible drug-discovery workflows.

· Develop and apply high-content imaging and image-based phenotypic assays, including live-cell and multiparametric imaging.

· Manage multiple collaborative projects while maintaining high standards for experimental rigor, reproducibility, data integrity, documentation, and timely project execution.

· Develop and standardize protocols, provide technical guidance and training, and contribute to a collaborative multidisciplinary research environment.

  • Develop an engineering culture that prioritizes speed, ownership, collaboration, and high-quality execution.

  • Translate ambiguous scientific, product, and business requirements into actionable engineering priorities.

  • Lead the engineering organization through rapid hiring, architectural evolution, and customer deployments.

Ideal Candidate Background

  • 8–15 years of professional software engineering experience, including several years of senior engineering leadership.

  • Previous experience leading software engineering teams at a startup.

  • Demonstrated success personally building an engineering team from fewer than approximately 15 people within the last five years.

  • Prior people management experience at a Head of Engineering or comparable senior leadership level.

  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Go and/or Python.

  • Currently writes or ships production code rather than exclusively managing or reviewing engineering work.

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, system design, and software architecture.

  • Proven ability to establish engineering processes that improve execution without unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • Strong communication and cross-functional leadership skills.

  • Comfortable working closely with founders and multidisciplinary technical teams.

  • Willing to work onsite in Brooklyn five days per week.

Preferred

  • Previous Head of Engineering, VP Engineering, Director of Engineering, or equivalent startup leadership experience.

  • Experience scaling software teams during periods of rapid company growth.

  • Background in complex distributed systems, infrastructure, or backend platforms.

  • Experience working in deep technology, robotics, industrial automation, scientific computing, or hardware-integrated software environments.

  • Strong experience with Go, Python, and production software architecture.

  • Experience leading teams through demanding customer deployments.

  • Demonstrated ability to balance technical excellence with rapid product delivery.

  • Experience collaborating with scientists, hardware engineers, or other highly specialized technical stakeholders.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Compensation details available through the hiring team.

  • Relocation assistance of approximately $5,000–$10,000, reimbursed against receipts.

  • O-1, H-1B transfers, and TN visa support available.

  • Opportunity to lead a growing software engineering organization.

  • Significant influence over engineering culture, architecture, and technical strategy.

  • Hands-on involvement in advanced software and autonomous laboratory technology.

This opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineering leader who wants to remain technically hands-on while building a world-class software organization from an early stage.

title: Strokovni sodelavec pravnim osebam za mikro segment (m/ž)
description:
Ključne naloge in odgovornosti:

  • Aktivno trženje bančnih produktov in storitev za mikro podjetja, predvsem na področju plačilnega prometa in drugih komercialnih poslov, ter izvajanje prodajnih in trženjskih aktivnosti,

  • proaktivna komunikacija s komitenti, prepoznavanje njihovih potreb, priprava ponudb ter zagotavljanje strokovne in operativne podpore,

  • svetovanje in podpora sodelavcem v prodajni mreži, predstavitev produktov ter prenos znanja in novosti znotraj banke,

  • priprava in usklajevanje dokumentacije za sklepanje poslov, vključno s predlogi za organe odločanja, ter sodelovanje z drugimi strokovnimi službami banke,

  • spremljanje poslovanja in finančnega položaja komitentov ter izvajanje aktivnosti skladno z zahtevami preprečevanja pranja denarja in financiranja terorizma,

  • spremljanje doseganja prodajnih ciljev, priprava potrebnih analiz in poročil ter sodelovanje pri izboljšavah produktov, procesov in projektih s področja prodaje in trženja.

Pričakujemo

Kaj iščemo pri novih sodelavcih?

  • Veselje do dela s podjetniki in mikro podjetji,

  • prepoznati potrebe podjetnikov in poslovne priložnosti,

  • prodajna in ciljna usmerjenost – motivacija so rezultati,

  • jasna in prepričljiva predstavitev ustrezne bančne rešitve stranki,

  • komunikativnost, samostojnost in proaktivnost,

  • grajenje dobrih odnosov s strankami in sodelavci je visoko na prioritetni lestvici,

  • natančnost, odgovornost in analitičnost ter iznajdljivost pri delu s poslovnimi podatki in dokumentacijo,

  • sodelovanje in delitev znanja s sodelavci ter učinkovito povezovanje različnih strokovnih služb,

  • željo po učenju, razvoju in izboljšavah ter aktivno iskanje priložnosti za izboljšanje produktov, storitev in procesov.

Nudimo

Kaj ponujamo?

  • Zaposlitev s poskusno dobo 5 mesecev, na delovnem mestu, ki ponuja številne priložnosti za rast in razvoj,

  • dinamično delo v pozitivnem kolektivu in motiviranem okolju, ki prinaša sodelovanje z zaposlenimi v banki in Skupini,

  • razvijanje področja investicijskega bančništva v banki,

  • pretvarjanje poslovnih zahtev v tehnične rešitve.

Ustvari svojo prihodnost pri nas!

  • Soustvarjaj rezultate v multidisciplinarnih ekipah in se uči od izkušenih strokovnjakov,

  • skrbi zase – pri nas sta zdravje in dobro počutje zaposlenih ena od prioritet,

  • izkoristi fleksibilen delovni čas, ki ti omogoča boljše ravnovesje med delom in zasebnim življenjem,

  • delaj od doma in si delo organiziraj po svoje,

  • postani del pozitivnega, povezanega in odprtega kolektiva, kjer cenimo sodelovanje in dobre odnose,

  • nadgrajuj svoje znanje in pridobi dragocene izkušnje v bančnem okolju,

  • deluj v okolju, kjer so rezultati opaženi, uspehi pa prepoznani in cenjeni,

  • soustvarjaj okolje, ki temelji na vrednotah odličnosti, odgovornosti, predanosti, inovativnosti in zaupanja ter nosi certifikat družbeno odgovornega delodajalca.

Prijava:

V kolikor ste prepoznali svojo predanost ponujenemu in našo odličnost, vabljeni k oddaji vaše predstavitve preko prijavnega obrazca do vključno 24. 11. 2026, s pripisom: »Strokovni sodelavec pravnim osebam za mikro segment«, in nam dajte priložnost, da se spoznamo. Ob prijavi priložite življenjepis.

title: QIDP Manager Supported Living
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The QIDP Manager is responsible for program development for client facilitation of the team approach, and acting as the QIDP, to ensure compliance with federal, state, agency, and program regulations, policies and procedures. In addition, they will oversee all aspects of their caseload including supervision of staff and the site.


DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Function as the QIDP and member of the Interdisciplinary Team ensuring compliance with all State and Federal regulations.
  • Conduct monthly review of client progress including all areas in the client’s home.
  • Assist the IDT to develop and tailor IPPs to match client needs and wants through a Person-Centered Approach.
  • Ensure staff have necessary records, tools, devices or other items necessary to provide formal and informal training for clients.
  • Assist the IDT to develop content of the behavior support plans and ensure appropriate behavior training is in place to meet the needs of the clients.
  • Develop and ensure implementation of appropriate Individual Program Plans (IPP).
  • Participate in quarterly and annual case conferences for clients with other appropriate members of IDT.
  • Be a liaison with family, case managers, and behavior specialists.
  • Refer, schedule appointments, and/or arrange transportation for clients, as needed, to appropriate agency and/or community resources.
  • Update and maintain client files (master and home) including emergency information;
  • Plan, direct and/or attend appropriate program, agency and other organizational meetings and/or training within the specified timeframe.
  • Know how to read and understand an NOA and request appropriate waiver reimbursement from the Case Manager for client services desired.
  • Review all Plans of Care when received to ensure correct services are listed.
  • Review Therap documentation (GER’s, T Logs, etc.) daily and provide appropriate follow up (BDDS reports, IDT notification, etc.).
  • Attend appropriate In-Services in accordance with Medicaid regulations.
  • Be an appropriate role model for staff and clients and always maintain professionalism.
  • Demonstrate teamwork with staff and clients in the agency across all departments.
  • Ensure compliance with agency and departmental policy and procedures.
  • Responsible for ensuring the agency is meeting necessary agency/state/federal regulations and policy and procedures.
  • Be available as scheduled or as needed to provide/receive emergency communication/assistance during daytime hours.
  • Be available during non-traditional work times to support staff through a client’s behavior in the home and/or transporting clients to the urgent care or emergency room.
  • Required to be on call, which includes overnights, on a rotating basis.
  • Expected to be reachable via agency provided phone for staff until agreed upon time.
  • Conduct quarterly house checks.
  • Direct Support Professional responsibilities as needed.
  • Ensure treatment sheets are always up to date and in each home.
  • Supervise and train House Leads and Direct Support Professionals on the following: implementation of financial materials/needs, medications, policies, procedures, and other job functions.
  • Plans, assigns and directs work; appraises performance; rewards and counsels for employees, addresses complaints and resolves problems with support from Human Resources.
  • Ensures compliance with agency and departmental policy and procedures.
  • Ensures that Clients, House Leads and DSP’s are treated with dignity and respect.
  • Ensure that staff order medications.
  • Maintain acceptable work standards in all areas.
  • Assume other responsibilities as requested by the director.


PHYSICAL TASKS

  • Must be able to lift or move up to 50 pounds
  • Prolonged periods of standing and walking
  • Prolonged periods of sitting


REQUIRED SKILLS/ ABILITIES

  • Employee must have the ability to write routine reports and correspondence
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite or related software
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Exercise good judgment
  • Ability to transport clients in your own vehicle


EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in a professional category and at least one (1) year of work experience in educational or habilitative services for developmentally disabled persons. If candidate does not possess a bachelor’s degree but has suitable experience of 2-5 years, they may also be considered.
  • High school diploma/GED required.
  • Must be 18 years or older.

  • Privlačen paket finančnih in drugih ugodnosti:

    • Osnovna bruto plača za 40ur tedensko znaša 1.800€ bruto/mesec.

    • Redno in pravočasno izplačilo plače (5. delovni dan v mesecu).

    • Dodatek za delovno dobo.

    • Povračilo stroškov prevoza na delo v skladu s KP dejavnosti trgovine Slovenije.

    • 7,32€ povračilo stroškov prehrane na delovni dan.

    • Izplačilo regresa.

    • Nagrada za poslovno uspešnost.

    • Možnost izplačila stimulativnega dodatka.

    • Jubilejna nagrada.

Naša dejavnost po klasifikaciji je trgovina na drobno, naša glavna skrb pa zadovoljstvo kupca in vseh naših zaposlenih.

Mueller Drogerija postaja v Sloveniji vse bolj prepoznaven trgovec. Nabor izdelkov je privlačen in zanimiv za vsakogar. Pri nas najdete izdelke: parfumerije, drogerije (tako osebna nega kot nega vašega doma), naravne kozmetike, papirnice, igrač ,gospodinjstva, nogavice, ročna dela in multimedije.

title: Staff Spacecraft Systems Engineer – Electronics
description:
Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

The Staff Spacecraft Systems Engineer – Electronics provides technical leadership in the development, integration, verification, and lifecycle management of complex aerospace systems. This role is responsible for translating customer requirements, mission objectives, and operational concepts into system architectures, technical requirements, and engineering solutions that enable successful mission execution.

Working with a high degree of independence, the Staff Systems Engineer leads multidisciplinary engineering efforts across the system lifecycle, from concept development through design, integration, verification, production, launch, and operational support. This role collaborates closely with software, electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, integration and test, mission operations, and program management teams to ensure systems meet technical, performance, schedule, and customer requirements while supporting sound engineering practices and technical decision-making.

ESSENTIAL ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Systems Engineering & Architecture

  • Lead development, analysis, allocation, and management of system and subsystem requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Responsible for systems engineering of new electronics subsystems for CesiumAstro satellites
  • Collaborate with technical design leads to bring new spacecraft electronics products to life, integrating requirements across multiple satellites and missions to drive design implementation
  • Communicate technical needs across the spacecraft team, using data from flight operations to drive requirement evolution in future design cycles

Master’s degree in a related technical discipline with typically 6–8 years of relevant experience. PhD in a related technical discipline with typically 3–5 years of relevant experience.

title: E T Consultant
description: At the World Bank , a member of the World Bank Group (WBG) , you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd. At COP27 and CMA4, the Conference of the Parties (COP) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) and the Conference of the Parties serving as the Meeting of the Parties to the Paris Agreement (CMA) established funding arrangements to assist developing countries particularly vulnerable to climate change. This decision established the Fund for responding to Loss and Damage (FRLD) to assist developing countries vulnerable to the economic and non-economic impacts of climate change, including extreme weather and slow onset events. At COP28 and CMA5, the COP/CMA formally approved the Fund’s Governing Instrument, designating it as part of the UNFCCC’s financial mechanism and placing it under the guidance of both COP and CMA. The decision authorized the Fund’s Board to sign a Hosting arrangement with the World Bank as the host for the FRLD Secretariat as well as a Trustee agreement with the World Bank as the interim trustee for four years. The FRLD Secretariat, led by the Executive Director (ED), is an independent Secretariat, accountable to the Board, and is responsible for executing the day to day operations of the Fund in accordance with the decisions of the Board. The Secretariat is composed of 5 divisions led by Program Managers that report to the Office of the Executive Director: Board Affairs and Governance; Programming and Country Engagement; Results, Evaluation and Learning; Resource Mobilization, Communications and Partnerships; and Budget and Finance Management. The Results, Evaluation and Learning (REAL) team within the FRLD Secretariat serves as the central technical unit responsible for overseeing the results management, evaluation and learning activities of FRLD. The Senior Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist will contribute to the design and implementation of results frameworks and M E systems to support FRLD’s operations, including annual results reporting. A strong emphasis is placed on funding request reviews and the learning review and analysis of BIM, as well as knowledge management and organizational learning through dissemination of tools, guidelines, and lessons learned. The Senior M E Specialist will report directly to the Results, Evaluation and Learning (REAL) team Program Manager and collaborate closely with the Secretariat staff and external stakeholders, including governments, access entities, multilateral development banks, UN agencies, vertical climate funds, donor organizations, and civil society. Duties and accountabilities Strategic Technical Support to Programs and Countries • Oversee and manage the review and quality assurance of funding requests of projects and programs to ensure the technical robustness of M E requirements, including completeness, methodological soundness, and full compliance with the Fund’s Results Framework and related policies. • Lead part of the BIM Learning Review and Analysis – with a particular focus on the funding request process and lessons learned under the BIM to date. • Provide M E guidance to access agencies and client countries to strengthen results-orientation in funding requests and projects. • Work closely with FRLD REAL team program manager to ensure M E frameworks and learning objectives are consistently integrated across all levels of programming. • Support country-level capacity to design, manage, and use M E systems for planning, implementation, and adaptive management. Results Frameworks, Systems, and Reporting • Contribute to the implementation of the FRLD results measurement framework, RMF handbook, MEL Policy, Strategic Learning Framework, Knowledge Management, Evaluation System and Approach – and related guidance documents, as needed. • Coordinate the design, development, and continuous improvement of a web-based results management system to support data-driven decision-making and institutional learning (in coordination with the portfolio management system). • Contribute to the results reports that synthesize achievement across projects and programs. Knowledge Management and Learning • Coordinate the development and dissemination of M E and knowledge products, including tools, templates, guidelines, and case studies that promote institutional learning and good practices. • Promote a learning-oriented culture by designing and facilitating knowledge-sharing events, learning reviews, and reflection workshops. • Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to generate, curate, and disseminate knowledge products on emerging topics related to loss and damage. Strategic Communication and Dissemination • Develop and implement a dissemination strategy for evaluation and learning products tailored to multiple audiences. • Prepare briefs, results narratives, impact stories, presentation, and knowledge summaries, etc. For FRLD leadership and stakeholders to inform decision-making and strategic planning. • Provide logistical and substantive support in organizing results-related workshops, consultation, and knowledge-sharing sessions with stakeholders.

title: Cyber Integration Engineer
description:
Who we are.
Platinum Technologies is a Northern Virginia based integrated solutions firm that specializes in Cybersecurity, Cloud and Digital Services to the Public Sector. Our team solves hard problems and helps our Mission Partners achieve their goals. If you are self-motivated, possess demonstrated learning agility, and are passionate about delivering high-quality work products – we want to hear from you.
We lead with technical expertise, but that is just the tip of the iceberg – the ‘Why’ matters. At Platinum, we don’t hire people to do a job. We provide professional and leadership development to complement our self-motivated domain experts. Our teammates are dot-connecting leaders that operate in a mutually accountable environment to deliver thought leadership, expert technical analysis, and quality execution for our clients
You.
Platinum Technologies currently has an opportunity for an experienced Cyber Integration Engineer to help advance the security posture and lead the organization’s Identity, Credential and Access Management (ICAM) environment into compliance with Zero Trust operational and compliance requirements.
The Cyber Integration Engineer is a hands-on technical expert responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the connections between the components of a complex, multi-vendor Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) ecosystem. This role is critical for ensuring that disparate systems—including identity providers, governance platforms, and privileged access management tools—function as a cohesive and secure whole. The ideal candidate is a skilled problem-solver with deep expertise in identity protocols, APIs, and automation who can script and configure the intricate data flows that form the backbone of a Zero Trust architecture.
Located at MacDill AFB, Tampa, Florida. Candidate must hold an active TS/SCI clearance.
What you get to do.
•Develop, test, and maintain Red Hat Ansible playbooks to automate the deployment and configuration of ICAM infrastructure across both Windows and Linux (RHEL) environments.
•Utilize Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) principles to ensure consistent, repeatable, and hardened deployments of all ICAM components.
•Configure and maintain the cross-forest trust between the on-premises Active Directory (AD) and the Red Hat Identity Management (IdM) domain to enable unified authentication for the Linux estate.
•Implement and troubleshoot complex federation scenarios using Ping Federate, including integrating with legacy ADFS and connecting to mission partner environments using SAML and OIDC.
•Configure and manage the data synchronization and virtualization layer, ensuring a consistent Master User Record (MUR) is available to all connected systems.
•Develop and maintain API-driven integrations between SailPoint (IGA), Delinea (PAM), and One Identity Active Roles (ARS).
•Script the workflows that connect SailPoint access requests to Delinea for Just-in-Time (JIT) privileged access elevation.
•Configure SailPoint connectors to provision and de-provision accounts and entitlements in Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and other target systems.
•Integrate all ICAM components with the enterprise SIEM, ensuring logs are properly formatted and forwarded for security analysis.
Required Skills.
•BA/BS and minimum 2 -4 years of relevant experience
•Active TS/SCI Clearance.
•Demonstrated experience scripting with PowerShell and/or Python for systems integration and automation.
•Hands-on experience with Red Hat Ansible for automated configuration management.
•Strong understanding of identity federation protocols (SAML, OIDC, WS-Federation) and directory services (LDAP, Kerberos).
•Experience with REST API integration for enterprise software.
•Familiarity with both Windows Server and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) operating systems.
Preferred Skills.
•Experience integrating enterprise IGA (e.g., SailPoint), PAM (e.g., Delinea), and IdP (e.g., Ping Federate) solutions.
•Knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID architecture and administration.
•Experience with Red Hat Identity Management (IdM) and establishing AD trusts.
•Relevant API/Scripting certifications.
•DoD 8140 Compliance (IAT Level II).

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, protected veteran status, race, color, religious creed, national origin, citizenship, marital status, sex, sexual orientation/gender identity, age, or genetic information.

📍 On-Site | Aerospace Manufacturing 💰 $28–$34/hour, depending on experience 🕐 Full-Time | Flexible Hours 🌟 Benefits Available
About the Role On-site: Tucson, AZ
A locally owned Aerospace Manufacturing Company is looking for an experienced Manufacturing Auditor to join our Engineering/Manufacturing team.
This is a hands-on quality role focused on ensuring manufacturing processes, inspection practices, and documentation meet customer and company standards. The ideal candidate has strong mechanical inspection experience, excellent GD&T and blueprint reading skills, and the confidence to work directly with machinists, supervisors, engineering, and management.
What You'll Do
Perform in-process and floor audits at CNC machines and throughout the manufacturing area.

Investigate first-article and inspection discrepancies using available measurement equipment.
Review previous quality issues, scrap information, SPC trends, and Net-Inspect data to identify potential problems.
Monitor 5S, safety, and FOD prevention throughout the manufacturing floor.
Document audit findings and maintain daily audit/shift records.
Participate in root cause analysis and CAPA activities, including the use of 5 Whys.
Communicate quality trends and recurring issues to machinists, programmers, shop foremen, Engineering, and Quality.
Help train employees on proper inspection equipment use and manufacturing principles.
What We're Looking For
Required:
5+ years of mechanical inspection experience
Strong GD&T and complex blueprint reading skills
Experience with precision measurement and inspection equipment
Knowledge of surface plate setup and inspection techniques
Strong understanding of shop math and mechanical principles
Ability to use and interpret SPC and Six Sigma tools
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to remain objective and unbiased when conducting audits
Preferred:
CMM experience
Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or AS9102
Experience with problem-solving and corrective action
CQT or CMI certification
Experience with Net-Inspect
Spanish language skills
The Right Person Will Be
🔍 Analytical – able to identify trends, investigate discrepancies, and determine root causes. 🤝 People-Oriented – comfortable working with employees at all levels while maintaining professionalism and tact. 🎯 Objective – able to conduct unbiased audits and focus on company and customer requirements. 🛠️ Hands-On – confident using inspection equipment and investigating manufacturing issues. 📣 A Strong Communicator – able to clearly explain findings, provide feedback, and help employees improve.
Work Environment
This position works in a machine shop/manufacturing environment with exposure to manufacturing equipment and noise. The role involves standing, walking, leaning, and occasional lifting of up to 10 lbs.
Drug-Free & Smoke-Free Workplace
If you're an experienced quality/inspection professional looking for a hands-on role in aerospace manufacturing, we'd love to hear from you!
