title: Junior Beleidsmedewerker Omgevingsplannen
description:
In Dijk en Waard werken we aan één omgevingsplan voor de hele gemeente. Daarin moeten beleid, regels en digitale kaarten goed op elkaar aansluiten. Als Junior Medewerker Omgevingsplan help je deze samenhang te bewaken en zorg je dat ruimtelijke regels duidelijk en correct digitaal worden weergegeven. Een mooie kans om het vak te leren en tegelijkertijd bij te dragen aan de leefomgeving van morgen.

Wat ga je doen?
Als Junior Beleidsmedewerker Omgevingsplannen werk je mee aan het opstellen en wijzigen van het omgevingsplan van Dijk en Waard. Een belangrijke opgave waarin ruimtelijke ordening, wet- en regelgeving en digitalisering samenkomen.

Samen met collega's van Ruimtelijke Ordening zorg je ervoor dat beleid en regels op de juiste manier worden vertaald naar digitale kaarten en toepassingen binnen het Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet (DSO). Kloppen de regels met de bijbehorende kaarten? Zijn er tegenstrijdigheden? En is de informatie voor inwoners en initiatiefnemers goed terug te vinden? Met een nauwkeurige en kritische blik help je de kwaliteit van het omgevingsplan te bewaken.

Daarbij hoef je nog niet alles te weten. Je krijgt de ruimte om ervaring op te doen, vragen te stellen en jezelf stap voor stap te ontwikkelen binnen de wereld van de Omgevingswet en digitale planvorming.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:
  • Ondersteunen bij het opstellen en wijzigen van het gemeente dekkende omgevingsplan;
  • Beleid en regels vertalen naar toepasbare digitale kaartlagen binnen het DSO;
  • Verbanden leggen tussen gebieden, regels en ruimtelijk beleid;
  • Controleren of kaarten, regels en toelichtingen goed op elkaar aansluiten en eventuele fouten of tegenstrijdigheden signaleren;
  • Werken met plansoftware zoals RxBase, waarin regels, kaarten en annotaties samenkomen;
  • Verzorgen van de publicatie van documenten;
  • Collega's ondersteunen bij inhoudelijke en digitale vraagstukken.

Wie ben jij?
Je bent nieuwsgierig naar ruimtelijke ordening en vindt het interessant hoe beleid, regels en digitale toepassingen samenkomen. Het uitzoeken van vraagstukken, leggen van verbanden en werken met digitale kaarten spreekt je aan. Daarbij werk je nauwkeurig en gestructureerd en heb je oog voor details.

Ervaring met omgevingsplannen is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste. Belangrijker is de motivatie om te leren en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Met een proactieve houding, een kritische blik en goede communicatieve vaardigheden weet je gemakkelijk de samenwerking met collega's op te zoeken.

Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:
  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van ruimtelijke ordening, planologie, geo-informatie, stedenbouw of sociale geografie;
  • Affiniteit met kaartmateriaal, data en digitale systemen, zoals GIS of CAD;
  • Interesse in de Omgevingswet en omgevingsplannen. Kennis hiervan is een pré, geen vereiste;
  • Een nauwkeurige en gestructureerde manier van werken;
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden, nieuwsgierigheid en een proactieve houding.

Wij bieden jou
Werken bij gemeente Dijk en Waard betekent werken aan zichtbare opgaven, samen met gedreven collega's in een prettige en ontwikkelende werkomgeving. In deze functie krijg je de ruimte om het vak te leren, ervaring op te doen met de Omgevingswet en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen het ruimtelijk domein.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:
  • Salaris: tussen € 3.568- en € 5.096,- bruto per maand (schaal 9, peildatum 1 juli 2026) op basis van 36 uur;
  • Werkweek: 32 tot 36 uur per week, waarbij 4 x 9 uur ook bespreekbaar is;
  • Contract: een contract voor bepaalde tijd, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;
  • Individueel keuzebudget: 18,45% van je bruto salaris;
  • Ontwikkeling: volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen via ons brede aanbod aan trainingen en opleidingen.

Wil je meer weten over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden? Bekijk dan ons aanbod.

Over ons
Wij zijn Dijk en Waard. Een jonge gemeente, ontstaan uit het samengaan van Langedijk en Heerhugowaard. Met 90.000 inwoners zijn wij de één na grootste gemeente van Noord-Holland-Noord. Samen met ruim 800 collega’s zetten wij ons in voor alle mensen die in onze gemeente wonen, leven, werken en ondernemen. Dat doen we met veel plezier, iedere dag weer.

Werken bij Dijk en Waard biedt het beste van twee werelden: grootstedelijke mogelijkheden en een persoonlijke organisatie. Een combinatie die boeiend en veelzijdig werk oplevert voor iedereen. Bij ons is nog niet alles klaar. Daarom zoeken wij collega’s die het leuk vinden om te ontwikkelen en de handen uit de mouwen willen steken. Hierbij werken wij vanuit de kernwaarden Vakmanschap, Vooruitgang en Verbinding.

Nieuwsgierig naar ons? Klik dan hier: . Hier vertellen we je ons verhaal.

De afdeling Beleid Ruimte
Jij bent onderdeel van het team Ruimtelijke Ordening (RO), binnen de afdeling Beleid Ruimte. De afdeling Beleid Ruimte bestaat uit 65 collega’s en kent een aantal teams dat goed samenwerkt zoals mobiliteit, ruimtelijke ordening, economische zaken en wonen. Het team bestaat uit acht vaste medewerkers aangevuld met een flexibele schil.

De Omgevingswet moet worden vertaald naar werkprocessen en naar de nieuwe kerninstrumenten (omgevingsvisie, -plan en programma’s). De werkzaamheden van team RO bestaan o.a. uit het verder vormgeven van en meedenken over de toekomstige regels voor het Omgevingsplan van de gemeente Dijk en Waard.

Enthousiast?
Zie jij jezelf als Junior Beleidsmedewerker Omgevingsplannen voor onze gemeente werken? Dan ontvangen wij graag jouw sollicitatie met cv en motivatiebrief! Binnen vijf werkdagen geven wij een reactie en laten we weten of je wordt uitgenodigd voor een kennismakingsgesprek.

Heb je nog vragen?

Bel of app dan met Joke Bijpost (Teamleider Beleid Ruimte) via 06-14249475. Zij vertelt je graag meer over de functie en het team!

Voor vragen over de procedure kan je contact opnemen met Barry van der Vaart (Recruiter) via 06-48875520.

title: Construction Sr. Client Advocate
description:
The Senior Client Advocate provides strategic relationship management and placement, taking advantage of our specialized Construction industry experience and unparalleled market know-how, to craft strategies for clients to quantify, mitigate, and transfer risk. This position will also create strategies and execute the placement of Builders Risk, Property and Casualty lines of business for both primary and excess policies. If you are client-centric, interested in affiliating with an industry leader, and committed to helping clients unlock their potential through effective risk management strategies, this may be the perfect opportunity for you!

The Role

The Senior Client Advocate is responsible for providing strategic relationship management, placement of Builders Risk , Property and casualty lines, and consultative services to our clients. The Senior Client Advocate is responsible for marshaling Willis Towers Watson resources to provide coordinated service and placement activities that meet the client’s insurance and risk management needs. Responsible for ensuring relevant regulatory and technical standards are met. Leverages advanced skill set with knowledge to design and consult with clients on insurance coverage and services; uses understanding of clients’ needs to expand business opportunities and further solidify client relationships. Ability to focus on delivering exceptional customer service while working in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.

Duties include but are not limited to:

  • Retain existing book of business; develop, and strengthen client relationships
  • Identify, engage, and integrate delivery of all WTW internal resources to deliver on the client experience.
  • Provide strategic planning and consulting advice to clients; monitor insurance and risk management needs in collaboration with WTW resource, practice, and industry groups.
  • Recommend appropriate solutions throughout the policy life cycle (including acquisition due diligence).
  • Design, prepare, negotiate, and deliver fee/compensation agreements to clients.
  • Design and deliver full client presentations/proposals, client advocacy reports, client service plans, and schedules.
  • Increase (maximize) the profitability of the client account and ensure retention of that business over time.
  • Engage with Sales and Broking to understand marketplace changes.
  • Create project risk profiles and prepare marketing materials for underwriting and placement of casualty coverages in the marketplace (Primary and excess for practice and projects)
  • Facilitate binding of broadest available coverage in alignment with the risk profile.

  • Provide strategic design and lead resources to manage large property and Master Builders Risk programs along with large complex project coverage.

  • Able to leverage internal and external relationships to bring WTW resources and assets tailored to client needs; ability to drive conflict resolution.
  • Able to interpret, analyze and present models.
  • Negotiation Skills: able to develop innovative and creative solutions to do complex deals, drive consensus across internal and external stakeholders to close deals.
  • Knowledge of strategy, tactics, and solutions for the client, and/or in the marketplace.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; group presentation skills, ability to drive complex/technical conversations.
  • Effectively advocates for change. Provides encouragement, takes control of team projects, leads key work areas, collaborates with others, and provides clear guidance to ensure others fulfill roles effectively.
  • Excellent project management skills including end-to-end oversight of large, complex, ambiguous, or multi-dimensional projects.
  • Competency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Insurance P&C License required.
  • Travel required.
  • This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until a sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

title: Manager, Valuations
description:
About Allied

Allied is a leading owner-operator of distinctive urban workspace in Canada’s major cities. Our work is grounded in a clear purpose: to provide knowledge-based organizations with distinctive urban environments that support creativity, connectivity and human wellness.

Our vision is more expansive. We seek to make a continuous contribution to cities and culture that elevates and inspires the humanity in all of us. This vision informs how we operate, how we design and how we lead.

Real estate, for us, is not a passive investment. It is a profoundly human endeavour, one that must promote wellness, sustainability, diversity and creativity—today and for generations to come.

Allied is also a place to build a career of consequence. If you are looking for work that is thoughtful, tangible and enduring—work that contributes meaningfully to cities and the people who inhabit them—you will find purpose here.

For more information on Allied’s approach to city-building, visit our Insights page.

Purpose

Drive valuation excellence, portfolio insight, and financial performance across Allied’s national platform through rigorous analysis, process leadership, and strong stakeholder collaboration. As Manager, Valuations will play a key role in the internal valuation of the Company’s investment property portfolio. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Valuations, the Manager will perform and review property-level valuations, manage assigned aspects of the quarterly valuation process, review the work of the junior resource, and support management in establishing well-supported fair value conclusions.

This is a hands-on technical position. The successful candidate must be capable of independently building and reviewing ARGUS Enterprise models, completing complex DCF analyses, valuing development properties and land, assessing market evidence, and explaining and defending valuation conclusions. The role will also support financial reporting under IAS 40 and IFRS 13 and interactions with external appraisers and auditors.

Responsibilities

Valuation Execution and Technical Analysis

  • Independently prepare and review valuations of income-producing investment properties, development land and properties under development using DCF, direct comparison and other appropriate methodologies.
  • Develop and critically assess assumptions used in the valuation of income-producing investment properties.
  • Evaluate highest and best use considerations for development properties and land where applicable.
  • Analyze market transactions and other external evidence supporting capitalization rates, discount rates and major valuation assumptions.
  • Perform and review valuation sensitivity analyses.

Review and Team Management

  • Provide detailed review and constructive challenge of valuations prepared by the junior resource.
  • Ensure calculations, assumptions, market evidence and conclusions are internally consistent and appropriately documented.
  • Coach and develop junior resource’s technical valuation, ARGUS Enterprise, market research and financial modelling capabilities.
  • Allocate property-level responsibilities, establish review timelines and monitor completion against quarterly reporting deadlines.
  • Escalate material valuation matters, control exceptions or unsupported assumptions to the Senior Manager, Valuations.

Quarterly Valuation Process and Governance

  • Assess property-level changes in leasing, capital expenditures, development costs, operating performance and market conditions.
  • Review and explain material quarter-over-quarter fair value movements, identifying the principal property-specific and market drivers.
  • For properties externally valued, review and reconcile internal valuation conclusions against external appraisals, investigate and explain variances in values and underlying assumptions, document the rationale for the concluded fair values, and escalate material or unresolved differences to the Senior Manager, Valuations.
  • Assist the Senior Manager, Valuations in preparing quarterly materials for senior management and the Valuation Committee.
  • Support responses to external auditor and external appraiser questions and track the resolution of review comments.

Financial Reporting

  • Apply practical knowledge of IAS 40 and IFRS 13 in determining and documenting investment property fair values.
  • Work with Finance and Accounting to ensure valuation assumptions and conclusions are appropriately reflected in financial reporting.
  • Support valuation-related financial statement disclosures and management reporting as required.

Qualifications

Must have:

  • Bachelor's degree in real estate, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 5 to 8 years of progressively responsible commercial real estate valuation experience.
  • Strong preference for an AACI designated member, or an advanced-stage AIC Candidate actively progressing toward AACI.
  • Advanced hands-on ARGUS Enterprise and DCF experience; advanced Excel modelling; development land or development property valuation experience; detailed understanding of commercial leases, and recoveries.
  • Working knowledge of IAS 40, IFRS 13 and market-participant fair value concepts.

Core Competencies:

  • Strong independent valuation judgment and willingness to challenge unsupported assumptions.
  • Ability to explain and defend valuation conclusions in clear, practical language.
  • High attention to detail and disciplined documentation.
  • Effective collaboration with Finance, Leasing, Development, Investments, external appraisers and auditors.

Total Rewards* and the Employee Experience

At Allied, total rewards are designed with the same perspective that shapes our operations. They are intended to support sustained contribution, creativity and a genuine sense of ownership in the work we do.

In practice, this includes:

  • Shared financial success and an ownership mindset
    Eligible employees participate in performance-based bonus programs and a retirement savings program, with the option to invest in traditional funds or Allied units. This approach aligns individual effort with Allied’s long-term performance and reinforces a sense of ownership at every level of the organization.

  • Intentional presence and time off
    In addition to vacation, employees receive six personal days and half-days before statutory holidays. Allied supports flexibility while maintaining a strong, in-person culture. This reflects how we collaborate most effectively and how we operate as a business.

  • Health, wellbeing and support
    Comprehensive, company-paid health benefits include vision and dental coverage, along with a healthcare spending account. An employee assistance program is available to provide confidential support when it is needed.

  • Growth through leadership and exposure
    Allied believes in leadership at every level. Employees are encouraged to contribute beyond the boundaries of their role, collaborate across disciplines and develop a broad understanding of the business. For those drawn to real estate, this includes uncommon exposure to how buildings, organizations and cities evolve through hands-on experience and shared responsibility.

  • Professional development grounded in practice
    Learning at Allied is both formal and experiential. Ongoing professional development and a mentorship program support growth through structured learning and day-to-day engagement with experienced colleagues across the organization.

  • Purpose and connection beyond work
    Each year, employees are provided with a paid volunteer day to contribute time and effort to a cause that is personally meaningful to them, reflecting our belief that contribution extends beyond the workplace.

If you are motivated by the role real estate plays in shaping cities and culture, and want your work to contribute to that effort, we encourage you to apply.

More insight into life at Allied, including our ESG and EDI initiatives, can be found in our annual ESG report.

*Temporary or contract roles may not qualify for all the benefits listed, and some roles may follow a modified total rewards structure. We will confirm what benefits you qualify for during the recruitment process.

Additional Information

We value human connection and experience. While Allied uses technology, including AI-enabled tools, to support administrative efficiency, all screening, assessment and hiring decisions are made by people.

We are committed to hiring the most qualified candidates with a dedication towards supporting diversity, equity and inclusion across our organization. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, ethnicity, origin, sexual orientation, disability and socioeconomic background. Diverse perspectives strengthen our organization and help us deliver better outcomes for our tenants, partners and communities. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

We strive to provide an accessible recruitment experience and welcome reasonable accommodation requests at any stage of the recruitment process. Please reach out to talent@alliedreit.com if support is needed.

We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Operations Regulatory Compliance Specialist
description:
Summary
Operations Regulatory Compliance Specialists play a critical role in ensuring Allegiant remains continually aligned with regulatory requirements. This position reports to the Manager of Operations Regulatory Compliance, and assists with maintaining the analysis, oversight, incorporation, and reporting of all applicable regulatory changes, correspondence and program participation between the company and regulatory agencies.

Visa Sponsorship Available: No

Combination of Education and Experience will be considered. Must be authorized to work in the US as defined by the Immigration Act of 1986. Must pass a Criminal Background Check.
Education: Bachelor’s Degree
Education Details: B.S. Aviation Management, Government Affairs' or equivalent work experience.
Years of Experience: Minimum two (2) years of experience in 14 CFR Part 121 safety or regulatory management/oversight.

Valid/Unexpired Passport Book : Yes

Valid/Unexpired Driver's License: Yes


• Broad knowledge of regulatory parts affecting 14 CFR Part 121 air carriers engaging in supplemental, domestic and flag operations.
• Knowledge of regulatory change processes, advisory circulars, 8900.1, INFO's, SAFO's, etc.
• Knowledge of FAA flight standards and voluntary programs.
• Knowledge of 14 CFR Part 5 Safety Management Systems.
• Knowledge of FAA Compliance and Enforcement programs.
• Experience interacting with regulatory agencies involved in air transportation oversight.
• Proficiency in MS Office applications.

• Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and integrity.
• Analytical skills and attention to detail.

Preferred Requirements

Job Duties
• Utilizing the Allegiant compliance management system, continually participate in the intake, dissemination and change management of new and/or amended regulatory parts.
• Maintain and update internal compliance management databases to track the status of company compliance with all regulatory directives and correspondence.
• Investigate and respond to all formal requests for information from regulatory entities.
• Maintain current databases of FAA Data Collection Tools (DCT’s) to ensure company FAA approved or accepted operating manuals remain in compliance.
• Participate in manual change processes and facilitate operating manual reviews between internal stakeholders and external regulators.
• Assist the Manager of Operations Regulatory Compliance (M-ORC) with the administration of the FAA Voluntary Disclosure Reporting Program for all operational departments.
• Ensure the Allegiant Operations Specifications (OpSpecs) remain current and electronically updated, and that required OpSpec changes are facilitated with the Allegiant FAA Certificate Management Office (CMO).
• Produce various regulatory deliverables in association with large scale/major change in operating authority certification projects.
• Participate in industry and/or regulatory oversight meetings and continuing education programs, maintaining close liaison with the FAA, NTSB, and industry organizations and trade associations.
• Actively participate in the safety risk/change management process as a regulatory SME to ensure that compliance with federal regulations and industry best practice is incorporated into operational process change.
• Prepare and submit required daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting to ensure compliance with all FAA reporting requirements.
• Assist with quality assurance oversight of responses to applicable safety and regulatory program comprehensive change proposals.
• Assist with or perform standalone compliance data analysis reviews and visualization projects.
• Present compliance overviews and program highlights to senior department leadership, as requested.
• Apply our Customer Commitment and customer service standards to their daily responsibilities, as appropriate.

May be required to lift, push, pull, or carry up to 20 lbs. May be required to work various shifts/days in a 24-hour situation. Regular attendance is a requirement of the role. title: Director, Leadership Communications
description:
Temple University's Strategic Marketing and Communications Division is searching for a Director of Leadership Communications.

Become a part of the Temple family and you will have access to the following\:
A hybrid work schedule
Full medical, dental, vision coverage
Paid time off
3 Personal Days
Tuition remission - eligible employees and their dependents can obtain a degree TUITION FREE
A generous retirement plan and so much more!

Salary Grade\: T27
A variety of important factors are reviewed by HR when considering salary, including job duties, the applicant’s education and experience, all relevant internal equity considerations, department budget, and funding source.

Position Summary
Reporting to the Executive Director of University Communications and Media Relations, the Director of Leadership Communications serves as the senior writer and editor supporting the president and other members of Temple University’s senior leadership team. The director develops and executes communications that advance institutional priorities, strengthen the university’s reputation and engage key internal and external audiences. The role is primarily responsible for communications supporting the president, including remarks, presentations, executive messaging, thought leadership, written communications and social media.

The director also provides strategic communication support for the Provost and Chief Operating Officer, with particular emphasis on internal communications, leadership messaging and social media.

In addition, the director plays a central role in coordinating high-level internal communications across the university, working closely with academic and administrative offices to ensure university-wide messages are strategically aligned, appropriately sequenced and delivered to key audiences in a timely and coordinated manner. The director maintains visibility into significant institutional communications, identifies potential overlaps, gaps and timing considerations and advises university leaders on message strategy, audience, channel and sequencing.

Serving as a trusted communications adviser to senior leadership, the director brings exceptional judgment, discretion and institutional awareness, with the ability to anticipate communications needs and translate complex issues and priorities into clear, compelling communications for a range of audiences.

Performs other duties as assigned.

Application Requirements
* Resume and cover letter required
* Please include a maximum of 3 writing sample attachments (leadership communications preferred).

Applications will be accepted until close of business Monday, December 7th.

Required Education and Experience
* Bachelor’s degree
* And at least 5 years of directly related experience is required.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Preferred Education and Experience\:
* Master’s degree.
* 8 years of directly related experience.
* Experience in higher education, a complex mission-driven organization, government, health care or another large, decentralized institution strongly preferred.

Required Skills and Abilities
* Proven collaborator who works to unify teams across functions.
* Demonstrated portfolio of high-level executive communications, including speeches, thought leadership, presentations, internal communications and digital or social content.
* Proficient in the Microsoft Office suite of products.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy of work.
* Superior organizational skills - must be able to effectively prioritize and meet deadlines.
* Ability to quickly acclimate to different environments and openness to new processes and technologies.
* Self-directed with a solutions-oriented attitude; values and inspires a positive work environment.
* Ability to work within a continuous improvement environment; able to receive feedback with a positive attitude and a commitment to personal accountability.
* Strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills with the ability to work and collaborate with colleagues and campus partners.
* Brings diplomacy and collegiality to capably address challenges; willingness to tackle issues and collaboratively resolve them.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to utilize data and insights to determine decisions.
* Ability to work well under pressure.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively and collaboratively work as part of a cross-functional team.
* Ability to work independently and efficiently.
* Promotes a culture of high performance and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated excellent organizational time management skills.
* Aligns team strategy and deliverables with divisional objectives.
* Ability to handle confidential matters with discretion.
* Strong ability to monitor the work of others, mentor staff, and manage performance through regular feedback.
* Ability to attend staff events (including occasional nights and weekends), as needed.

Essential Functions of the Position
* Develop and execute an integrated leadership communications strategy and editorial agenda aligned with the President’s priorities, the university’s strategic plan and major institutional initiatives. Anticipate communications needs and identify opportunities to advance key messages and strengthen the President’s and university’s visibility and reputation.
* Lead the development of communications supporting the President, including remarks, talking points, external presentations, opinion and thought leadership pieces, correspondence, messages to the university community, video scripts, social media content and other high-visibility communications. Ensure a consistent, authentic executive voice across channels and audiences.
* Provide targeted communications strategy and content development for the Provost, particularly for internal communications and social media, and for the Chief Operating Officer, particularly for internal and organizational communications. Ensure the distinct voice and priorities of each leader are reflected while maintaining alignment with university-wide messaging.
* Lead the coordination of high-level, university-wide internal communications, partnering with academic and administrative offices to ensure significant institutional messages are aligned, timely and appropriately sequenced.
* Advise senior leaders and campus communications partners on internal communications strategy, including message development, audience, timing, channel and sequencing, while fostering a coordinated approach that supports effective communication across the university.
* Establish and manage an integrated leadership and institutional communications calendar that provides visibility into major university announcements, leadership communications, milestones and events and supports an intentional cadence of communication with key audiences.
* Identify and develop thought leadership opportunities that position Temple’s President and senior leaders as authoritative voices on issues connected to the university’s mission, priorities and areas of expertise. Partner with media relations and other SMC colleagues to maximize appropriate external opportunities.
* Lead executive social media strategy and content development for the President and provide strategic support for the Provost’s social channels, using platform and audience insights to strengthen engagement and extend leadership messaging.
* Develop briefing materials, message frameworks, background documents and other preparation materials that enable senior leaders to communicate effectively in high-visibility settings, including major events, external presentations, stakeholder meetings and media engagements.
* Assist, as needed, in managing crisis communications efforts in partnership with the division’s Executive Director of University Communications and Media Relations and Vice President.
* Monitor the external environment, higher education landscape and relevant news and social conversations to identify issues, opportunities and developments that may inform leadership communications strategy.
* Monitor news and social media channels to identify mentions of Temple leaders. When appropriate, proactively provide potential rapid responses.
* Serve as a senior writer, editor, and proofreader, responding to communications needs that fall outside of standard business hours.
* Ability to work evenings/weekends; including attendance at events, monitoring coverage, and on-call responsibilities during significant university events or emerging issues.
* Serve as a divisional representative on internal and/or external committees as assigned by the Executive Director of University Communications and Media Relations or the Vice President for Strategic Marketing and Communications
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Details
* Offer of employment is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment physical.
* This position requires the following background checks\: Personally Identifiable Information background check. These checks must be completed prior to commencement of service.
* This position is assigned a hybrid work arrangement (on-campus and remote); the duration of this hybrid work arrangement is at the discretion of Temple University and the Departments.

Temple University is committed to a policy of equal opportunity for all in every aspect of its operations, including employment, service, and educational programs. The University has pledged not to discriminate on the basis of age, color, disability, marital status, national origin or ethnic origin, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information or veteran status.

Compliance Statement\: In the performance of their functions as detailed in the position description employees have an obligation to avoid ethical, legal, financial and other conflicts of interest to ensure that their actions and outside activities do not conflict with their primary employment responsibilities at the institution. Employees are also expected to understand and be in compliance with applicable laws, University and employment policies and regulations, including NCAA regulations for areas and departments which their essential functions cause them to interact.

You may request a copy of the report by calling Temple University’s Department of Public Safety at 215-204-7900.

title: Postdoctoral Associate
description:
Required Qualifications\: (as evidenced by an attached resume)
PhD degree (or foreign equivalent) in Biomedical Sciences or a closely related field. Strong competence in Molecular Biology (PCR, cloning, and site-directed mutagenesis, RT-PCR), Immunoprecipitation and Western Blotting. Must be highly proficient in scientific writing.

Preferred Qualifications\:
Research experience with mammalian cell culture, protein expression (E. coli, yeast, and mammalian cells) and purification, and/or Drosophila genetics, including dissection, immunostaining, and confocal microscopy.

Brief Description of Duties\:
The Misra laboratory at Stony Brook University is looking for a Postdoctoral Associate to join our starting group. Our NIH/funded research is centered on growth regulation by Hippo signaling during Drosophila development as well as cancer. We use Drosophila developmental genetics, cell biology and biochemistry to address these questions. Substantial training will be provided for techniques.

Under direct supervision of Dr. Jyoti Misra, the incumbent will perform the following duties\:

● Maintain Drosophila stocks, setup genetic crosses, perform dissections, immunostaining and confocal microscopy

● Protein, RNA and DNA preparation, molecular cloning and purification of recombinant protein from e.coli, insect cells etc. and analyses; mammalian cell culture with sterile techniques.

● Perform biochemical analysis through kinase assay, Western Blotting etc.
Data analysis and participate in manuscript writing for publication; may assist in grant writing.

● Perform other duties as assigned such as training new personnel.

title: Working Student Communications & Branding (m/f/d)
description:
// YOUR MISSION AT PICUS

  • Website: You manage our website and keep it up to date, including portfolio pages and news. As we are launching a new website, you will play an active role in refining and further developing it over time.
  • LinkedIn: You own our LinkedIn presence, from planning posts and campaigns to copywriting and visual execution, e.g. for announcements of new investments and funding rounds.
  • Newsletter & Press: You create our quarterly newsletter, write press releases and maintain our distribution lists.
  • Design & Branding: You design graphics for social media and print, as well as presentations, templates and event materials.
  • Events: You support the preparation and, where applicable, the execution of our events.
  • Strategy: You help shape the further development of our marketing strategy.
  • Performance: You track how our channels perform (e.g. LinkedIn analytics) and turn the insights into concrete improvements.
  • Own Projects: You bring your own ideas, such as new content formats, tools or workflows, and drive them independently from concept to launch.

// ABOUT PICUS

Picus Capital is a leading technology investor operating globally. We partner with ambitious and daring founding teams on their quest to build category-defining technology companies. We aim to be an entrepreneurial sparring partner for visionary founders from ideation to IPO and beyond. A privately financed structure enables us to invest permanent, flexible and long-term capital in a multitude of sectors.

Our young and hungry team has big ambitions and mirrors the founders we work with by constantly reimagining the status quo. We operate as a single aligned team across our offices in Munich, Berlin, London, New York and Bangalore. We believe in technological disruption across all geographies and industries and are guided by our own continuously challenged hypotheses.

// ABOUT YOU

  • Studies: You are enrolled in a Bachelor’s program (3rd semester or above) or a Master’s program and expect to remain enrolled for at least one more year.
  • Experience: You have gained first practical experience in communications, marketing or social media.
  • Writing: You have a strong feel for language and write confidently in both German and English.
  • Design & Tools: You are confident with Microsoft Office and social media and have a good eye for design, ideally with experience in Canva. Experience with Figma or Adobe Creative Suite (e.g. Illustrator, InDesign) is a plus.
  • Tech Affinity: Bonus points for basic web skills (e.g. HTML/CSS, or a CMS such as Webflow or WordPress) or experience using AI tools for content and design.
  • Ownership: You take full responsibility for your topics, proactively bring your own ideas and enjoy turning them into results.
  • Interest: You are excited about startups, venture capital and technology.
  • Way of Working: You are motivated, creative and well organized, communicate clearly and work independently and on your own initiative.
  • Attention to Detail: You work precisely, including documentation and tracking.

// YOUR LEARNING AT PICUS

  • Communications in VC: You learn how a global investor communicates, from investment announcements to the newsletter for our network.
  • Ownership from Day One: You take on your own channels and projects early on and see the direct impact of your work.
  • Ecosystem Insights: You work closely with our investment team and get to know exciting founders and business models.

// YOUR BENEFITS AT PICUS

  • Insights: You will get insights into the most exciting new technologies and business models with a flexible introduction to various business topics and a global perspective on the venture capital sector.
  • Global Network: Engage in conversations with exceptional founders, experts and other stakeholders in the tech ecosystem. As part of these efforts, you will build and maintain a valuable personal network across the globe.
  • Culture: We have an ambitious, entrepreneurial & caring company culture with very high standards, enabling you to take full responsibility early on. You will continuously interact with a global team, collaborate with colleagues across 5 offices and learn about each region’s ecosystems.
  • Personal Buddy: During the onboarding process you will receive a personal buddy at Picus who will provide guidance and support as part of regular buddy sessions.
  • Perks: Our interns and working students meet on a monthly basis for a regulars’ table. Additionally, we also have regular monthly and seasonal team events.

// GENERAL CONDITIONS

  • Please include your current / predicted grade in your CV
  • Please include a few work samples (e.g. designs, posts, texts) or a link to your portfolio
  • Period: At least 12 months, 15–20 hours per week
  • Office: Munich
  • Compensation: Appropriate compensation in line with market standards

// EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Picus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender (including pregnancy and gender identity), national, social or ethnic origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, age, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, competence and merit.

title: Specialist za pravne zadeve in skladnost poslovanja (m/ž)
description:
Ključna področja odgovornosti:

  • Priprava, pregled in usklajevanje pogodb ter druge pravne dokumentacije.

  • Pravna podpora kadrovski funkciji pri delovnopravnih vprašanjih.

  • Prepoznavanje in obvladovanje pravnih tveganj.

  • Pravno svetovanje poslovodstvu in organizacijskim enotam družbe in sodelovanje z zunanjimi pravnimi svetovalci.

  • Spremljanje zakonodaje in pravočasna implementacija regulatornih sprememb v poslovanje družbe.

  • Sodelovanje v sodnih, upravnih, delovnopravnih in inšpekcijskih postopkih.

  • Skrb za skladnost poslovanja (compliance) in nadgradnjo notranjih kontrol.

  • Priprava in posodabljanje internih aktov, politik in pravilnikov.

  • Zagotavljanje skladnosti poslovanja na področjih preprečevanja korupcije, nasprotja interesov, prijave kršitev ter zaščite prijaviteljev.

  • Skrb za področje varstva osebnih podatkov (GDPR) in vodenje pripadajoče dokumentacijo.

Pričakujemo

V tej vlogi boste uspešni, če:

  • imate zaključeno univerzitetno izobrazbo pravne smeri in vsaj 5 let relevantnih delovnih izkušenj v gospodarstvu ali odvetništvu,

  • odlično poznate področja delovnega, gospodarskega in pogodbenega prava,

  • samostojno pripravljate, pregledujete in usklajujete pogodbe ter drugo pravno dokumentacijo,

  • znate prepoznati pravna tveganja ter oblikovati praktične in poslovno vzdržne rešitve,

  • imate izkušnje s področja skladnosti poslovanja (compliance), priprave internih aktov in varstva osebnih podatkov (GDPR),

  • dobro razumete poslovne procese in zmorete pravne zahteve pretvoriti v jasna in uporabna priporočila,

  • vas odlikujejo visoki etični standardi, integriteta, odgovornost in diskretnost,

  • imate odlične komunikacijske in svetovalne veščine ter sposobnost jasnega podajanja tudi zahtevnejših pravnih vsebin,

  • aktivno obvladate slovenski in angleški jezik,

  • ste proaktivni, odgovorni in usmerjeni v iskanje rešitev, ki podpirajo varno, skladno in učinkovito poslovanje podjetja.

Nudimo

Kaj vam ponujamo:

  • Zaposlitev za nedoločen čas s šestmesečnim poskusnim delom ter dolgoročno karierno priložnost.

  • Konkurenčen plačni paket z možnostjo variabilnega nagrajevanja, vezanega na doseganje rezultatov.

  • Dodatne ugodnosti in bonitete v okviru internih motivacijskih programov za zaposlene.

  • Fleksibilen delovni čas in možnost dobrega usklajevanja poklicnega ter zasebnega življenja.

title: Buukkaaja/Ajanvaraaja - Kehity ja etene myynnin alalla
description:
Etsimme myynnin innoittamia vahvan kehittymishalun omaavia henkilöitä edustamaan yhteistyökumppaneitamme buukkauksessa. Tarjoamme laadukkaan koulutuksen ja jatkuvan valmennuksen, jotta onnistut työssäsi. Buukkaajan työssä on huomioitu asiakkaiden kiinnostus ja kysyntä, jotta työ on mielekästä. Kehittyessäsi sinulla on mahdollisuus edetä myynnin esihenkilötehtäviin.

Työssä varaat tapaamisaikoja kuluttaja-asiakkaille yhteistyökumppaniemme asiantuntijoille ja myyjille. Hyvin tehdyllä työlläsi varmistat laadukkaat asiakaskohtaamiset sekä tuet edustamiemme yritysten liiketoimintaa ja brändimielikuvaa.

Työn tavoitteet nousevat oppimisesi mukaan. Tärkeintä meille on, että olet hyvän asenteen ja sisukkuuden omaava henkilö, jolla riittää intoa ja motivaatiota kehittyä, jopa vastuutehtäviin asti. Arvostamme asiakaspalvelu-/myyntitaustaa. Tietokoneen peruskäyttö tulee olla sinulle luontevaa, ja edellytämme sinulta sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä nopeaa uuden omaksumista.

Työpäivämme ovat normaalisti arkisin 8:45-16 sisältäen 30 min ruokatauon ja 3 kahvitaukoa. Toimistomme sijaitsee Savilahdessa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien äärellä ja korkeakoulujen läheisyydessä.

Takuupalkka toimii turvanasi. Provisioiden ja bonusten ansiosta voit kuitenkin odottaa ensimmäisen kuukauden jälkeen palkkasi olevan noin 2 000 €/kk ja kehityksen kautta 3 000-4 000 €/kk. Sinulla on mahdollisuus erinomaisiin ansioihin, sillä parhaimmillaan buukista voit saada 130 €/kpl. Lisäksi meillä on jatkuvasti kisoja mm. ulkomaanmatkoista tapahtumista, bonuksista ja lahjakorteista. Palkkakertymän opit laskemaan onnistumisista itse, mutta tarkastelemme sitä viikoittain myös yhdessä.

Tiimimme on varustettu hyvällä energialla ja samanhenkisyydellä. Avoimuus, joustaminen ja toisten ymmärtäminen on arkipäivää toimistollamme. Esihenkilöt ovat tiiviisti arjessa mukana. Meille on tärkeää tuntea työntekijämme, jotta voimme valmentaa ja palkita jokaisen yksilöllisesti.

Mikäli opiskelet, on sinulla mahdollisuus tehdä työtä myös osa-aikaisena. Työ alkaa sovitusti heti/loppuvuoden aikana.

Kyselyn tuloksena 100 % tiimistämme uskoo pystyvänsä kehittää taitojaan entisestään Dynastialla.

Olemme Vastuullinen Työnantaja -sertifioitu yritys ja noudatamme näitä periaatteita päivittäisessä toiminnassamme. Olemme myös Savonia-amk:n virallinen kumppaniyritys.

Tutustu meihin ja jätä hakemuksesi! https://www.mjdynastia.fi/rekry

title: Policy Director
description:
Policy Director

Get alignment science into the decisions that matter

The AI Alignment Foundation is looking for a Policy Director who can advance our goal of turning technical AI research insights into government action. You will work with researchers to help decide which opportunities to pursue, turn them into actionable policy ideas, and liaise with Congress and the executive branch to make them real - and in doing so, make progress on the most consequential issues of our time.

We have more opportunities than our current team can fully pursue. Congressional staff already consult our team for technical input on AI testing and evaluation legislation and research, and we regularly engage AI and national security officials on alignment research and trustworthy deployment. You would help translate that momentum into concrete results.

We are looking for someone who knows how the U.S. government works, can identify key decision-makers, and can draft actionable policy proposals. The stakes are enormous. AI systems are becoming more capable and autonomous. We want them to remain trustworthy as they learn, adapt, and eventually help begin to improve themselves. Solving this requires breakthroughs in alignment science and public institutions capable of putting those breakthroughs to use. Getting that right could make extraordinary scientific progress and human flourishing possible.

A scientific mission with a foothold in Washington

AIAF is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, incubated by AE Studio, that funds and accelerates technical AI alignment research. We support high-potential research ideas with the funding, engineering teams, compute, and infrastructure needed to develop them. We focus on alignment techniques that can endure as AI becomes more powerful and begins improving itself.

We’ve researched gradient routing and modular pretraining, which investigate how particular capabilities can be separated during training and selectively removed. We’ve also conducted research on AI self-modeling, self-interpretation, and the internal mechanisms behind self-correction and deception. To expand the impact of that work, we are looking for a policy leader that can help turn that evidence into detailed proposals on alignment research, AI evaluation, and AI deployment and procurement; and get those proposals in front of the people who can turn them into reality.

We aim to make alignment an essential part of America’s scientific and national security agenda. This would ensure both that AI acts in the ways we intend it to and unlock enormous benefits for American society.

What you’ll do

  • Manage and execute AIAF’s federal policy strategy in consultation with our leadership, researchers, and partners.
  • Translate technical evidence and findings into concrete legislative and policy recommendations, including legislative language or regulatory recommendations.
  • Build relationships with key congressional offices, executive branch agencies, civil society, and technical organizations; inform them about technical advancements; and make recommendations on how to advance alignment science through Federal action.
  • Organize consequential engagements in DC for AIAF principals and researchers, including setting up meetings, providing oral and written briefing materials, and coordinating with communications, legal, technical, and operational colleagues.
  • Organize demo days, dinners, briefings, roundtables, and other events to elevate the profile of AIAF and alignment science with the DC policymaking ecosystem.
  • Select and manage key policy vendors and partners, such as lobbying and advisory firms.
  • Inform AIAF’s research agenda by communicating government’s hardest practical questions to researchers and identifying areas of research effort most likely to inform active policymaking efforts.
  • Support building our policy team from the ground up and help open our DC office.

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrated experience (at least five years) in a policymaking role on Capitol Hill or in the executive branch, with a strong command of federal institutions and the processes that move policy.
  • Deep, credible relationships in Congress and the executive branch, particularly with Appropriations and Armed Services staff or members.
  • Experience leading policy initiatives and managing policy staff, consultants, or lobbyists, including organizing and supporting engagements for senior principals.
  • Substantial understanding of emerging AI policy, regulation, and legislation, together with the ability to learn technical alignment research well enough to explain its implications accurately.
  • Excellent writing, presentation, and interpersonal judgment. You can brief a principal, work through language with a staffer, and have a productive conversation with an engineer.
  • A strong track record of working effectively across technical, communications, legal, and operations teams, with the organization and persistence to move from strategy to detailed execution.
  • A serious commitment to advancing alignment science and the responsible development and deployment of powerful AI.

This role is based in Washington, DC. It may involve frequent travel for stakeholder meetings and events.

Compensation

This is a full-time employment role with an annual salary of $220,000-$350,000. For an exceptional candidate, we may consider compensation above this range.

We offer a platinum healthcare package with 99% of the premium covered, a 401(k) plan, and 15 days of paid vacation and personal time off.

title: Mechatronics Engineer
description:
We’re Blue River, a team of innovators driven to create intelligent machinery that solves monumental problems for our customers. We empower our customers - farmers, construction crews, and foresters to implement safer and more sustainable solutions, driving increased profitability with less reliance on scarce labor. We believe that focusing on the small stuff, pixel-by-pixel and task-by-task, leads to big gains.

Blue River Technology aligns with John Deere’s vision to “innovate on behalf of humanity” by quickly identifying and solving high-value, high-uncertainty challenges in AI, machine learning, computer vision, and robotics. BRT acts as a research and development flywheel, building not only new products but also new platforms that reliably create value for both Deere and its customers. From fully autonomous machines to highly precise farming equipment, BRT and Deere are partnering to deliver technical breakthroughs across industries such as agriculture and construction.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. Through cross-disciplinary collaboration, this mission-driven team is eager to define the new frontier of robotics. We are always asking hard questions, rapidly iterating, and getting our boots in the field to figure it out. We won’t give up until we’ve made a tangible and positive impact on the planet!

Blue River Technology is based in Santa Clara, CA.

Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Mechatronics Engineer to join our team. In this role, you’ll build and support the test systems and hardware for our computer vision-enabled agricultural products, including the Bay Area’s highest-density compute platform for robotics. Do you thrive in a fast-paced, innovative team environment and get energized about delivering solutions to technical challenges? If so, this role will be an outstanding next step in your career!

  • Employment Type: Full-Time
  • Work Location: Santa Clara, CA (at least 3 days in the office)
  • Visa sponsorship: Available for this position.

Job Responsibilities

A combination, not necessarily all-inclusive, of the following:

  • Design, build, and maintain hardware for our robotics test systems, including fixtures, mounts, cable harnesses, and power distribution.
  • Integrate cameras and other sensors into hardware-in-the-loop test platforms, including physical alignment and target setups.
  • Perform board-level debug, rework, and repair of electronic assemblies.
  • Partner with software and test engineers to bring up new test benches and keep them running.
  • Maintain documentation, schematics, and bills of materials for test hardware.

Required Experience and Skills

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • 1-3 years of experience building and testing electromechanical or robotic systems.
  • Hands-on skills with lab instruments (oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies) and hand tools.
  • Ability to read and create schematics and wiring diagrams.
  • Strong CAD proficiency (preferably in SolidWorks)
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on testing and continuous integration practices.

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Camera and camera interface testing, including testing performance with regard to physical conditions such as shock/vibe, EMI, and temperature.
  • Fixture design experience with CAD tools; 3D printing or light fabrication.
  • PCB rework and soldering proficiency.
  • Experience supporting hardware design transfer from prototype to production builds.
  • Familiarity with Linux-based systems.
  • Experience in agricultural, automotive, or robotics test environments.

Only individual applicants will be considered. We do not work with unsolicited third-party agencies or proxy interview services.

At Blue River, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected pay range is between $108,000 – $162,000/year for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus and a competitive benefit package. During the recruitment process, we may identify an alternative role or level to which you are more suited. If your ideal role at Blue River differs from the advertised position, we will provide an updated pay range as soon as possible during the hiring process.

We’re passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. While we have more work to do to advance diversity and inclusion, we’re investing in our programs, including recruiting, mentorship, career development, and learning & development, to ensure they support our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals. We support each employee in living a full life, enabling a thriving career, and accomplishing a meaningful, challenging mission while collaborating with incredible people. We are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align completely with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

title: Network/Cloud Infrastructure Security Engineer
description:
Position Overview

CFGI is seeking a full-time Network/Cloud Infrastructure Security Engineer to join its corporate Information Technology department, reporting to the Director of Information Technology. This hands-on role owns the identity, access, and cloud foundations behind more than 1,400 users across domestic and international offices, including Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, GitHub, Linear, Jira, and other business-critical applications.

As a professional services firm entrusted with sensitive client financial data, CFGI must meet the security expectations of public companies, private equity sponsors, and auditors, and this role turns those expectations into practical, well-documented controls. The engineer is the primary resource for Identity and Access Management (“IAM”) and infrastructure requests from product development, an escalation point for the IT team, and a partner to IT Service Management and functions across the firm.

Core Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure and Architecture

  • Design, build, and maintain secure Azure environments, including landing zones, subscription structure, networking, and resource governance.
  • Implement and manage infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep) and Azure Policy to keep cloud environments consistent, governed, and auditable.
  • Plan and execute tenant, domain, and workload migrations, including Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant moves related to acquisitions and expansion.
  • Maintain backup and disaster recovery for critical systems, and plan for future multi-cloud expansion, such as AWS.

Identity and Access Management

  • Administer and improve Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, MFA and passwordless authentication, identity protection, and least-privilege RBAC across Azure and Microsoft 365.
  • Create and manage Entra ID enterprise applications and app registrations, including SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM provisioning, API permissions and admin consent, app owners, and certificate and secret expiration.
  • Manage identity and access for GitHub, Linear, and Jira, including Entra ID SSO, SCIM provisioning, team and project permissions, access reviews, and timely offboarding.
  • Enforce GitHub security best practices, including branch protection, required reviews, secret scanning, OIDC federation from GitHub Actions to Azure, and audit log streaming to Microsoft Sentinel.
  • Serve as the primary contact for IAM requests from product development and an escalation point for the IT team on infrastructure and IAM tickets, tracked through Zoho ServiceDesk.
  • Manage guest and external access for client collaboration in Teams and SharePoint, balancing productivity with confidentiality.

Security and Data Protection

  • Design and improve security controls across Microsoft Defender and Defender for Cloud, and remediate posture findings using Microsoft Secure Score and CIS Benchmarks.
  • Manage Microsoft Sentinel data connectors and detection rules, and lead incident response for cloud and identity threats alongside the Director of IT and the firm’s managed 24/7 SOC provider.
  • Secure email, web, and SaaS access through Exchange Online, Mimecast, and Zscaler policy design.
  • Create and manage Azure Key Vaults, including RBAC-based access, managed identity integration, and rotation and expiration monitoring for secrets, certificates, and keys.
  • Design SharePoint and OneDrive permissions, Multi-Geo data residency, and Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, DLP, and retention policies.

Automation and Integration

  • Automate administrative and security tasks using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Python, and the Azure CLI.
  • Build workflow automations with Power Automate, Logic Apps, and REST APIs across IT and business platforms.
  • Ensure AI tools and integrations meet CFGI’s identity, data, and security standards.

Compliance and Client Assurance

  • Provide architecture documentation and technical evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and client-driven security reviews.
  • Support responses to client security questionnaires and due diligence requests on cloud, identity, and data protection controls.
  • Evaluate the security of new vendors and SaaS applications before they are connected to CFGI’s identity provider or data.

Documentation and Knowledge Transfer

  • Maintain architecture diagrams, standards, runbooks, and change records, following change management practices for all environments this role owns.
  • Train IT Specialists on identity, Intune, and cloud administration.

Qualifications

What you must have

  • 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, identity, or security engineering.
  • Experience administering and engineering Microsoft 365 and Azure environments, including at least 2 years of hands-on experience.
  • Working knowledge of information security control frameworks.

What sets you apart

  • Experience engineering identity and access controls, including conditional access, multifactor authentication, privileged identity management, role-based access, enterprise application integration, and hybrid identity.
  • Experience administering cloud infrastructure, including networking, compute, storage, and resource governance.
  • Experience administering source-code hosting organizations, including single sign-on, automated provisioning, team-based permissions, branch protection, secret scanning, and secure credential handling for CI/CD workflows.
  • Proficiency in administrative scripting and API-based automation.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and version control.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including enterprise applications, app registrations, Active Directory, and Entra Connect / Cloud Sync.
  • Experience administering GitHub organizations and securing GitHub Actions.
  • Proficiency with PowerShell and Microsoft Graph.
  • Experience with Terraform, Bicep, or ARM, and Git.
  • Working knowledge of frameworks such as CIS, NIST CSF, SOC 2, or ISO 27001.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice to have

  • Certifications such as Microsoft SC-300, AZ-104, AZ-500, AZ-305, GitHub Administration, or AWS Solutions Architect – Associate.
  • Working knowledge of AWS, including IAM, IAM Identity Center federation with Entra ID, AWS Organizations, and core security services such as CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and Security Hub.
  • Experience administering Jira, including Atlassian Guard, or Linear.
  • Experience in professional services, accounting, or financial services, including supporting client audits and security questionnaires.

Additional Information

Location

  • Primarily remote, with in-person work when required.
  • Eastern Time Zone, in the Northeast or Southeast US.
  • Occasional travel for projects or company events.

title: Construction Project Administrator
description:
The Wrap Up Project Administrator functions as the backbone of our account management teams working collaboratively to meet and exceed client expectations. They interact regularly with both clients and insurance carriers to provide the best coverage protection and knowledgeable understanding of Controlled Insurance Programs. If you enjoy actively preparing for client meetings, coordinating important information, getting out of the office to walk project sites, building, and maintaining long term relationships this role would suit you well.

The Role

Works with Sr. Client Services Specialists, Account Executives and/or Client Advocates, as well as Claims Professionals to implement, maintain, and close-out wrap-up programs. Major Accountabilities:

  • Work with Claims and Safety representative on issues related to the program

  • Ability to multi-task and work under pressure or time constraints. Leadership – applies judgement; promotes teamwork.

  • Relationship Management and customer focus – collaborates to serve clients and help resolve conflicts

  • Problem solving abilities, including critical thinking and adaptability.

  • Project management skills, including attention to detail, organizational skills, prioritization, and time management.

  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills and fluency with other relevant online tools.

  • Ability to work independently

  • Accuracy and attention to detail

  • P&C license preferred. If licensed, must be able to show valid confirmation of current licensing status.

  • If not, must successfully complete appropriate licensing exam(s) g by completing various Continuing Education activities, as needed.

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).

Compensation

The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $80,000.00-$110, 000.00 USD annually.

This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Retirement Benefits: Qualified contributory pension plan (if eligible) and 401(k) plan with annual nonelective company contribution. Non-qualified retirement plans available to senior level colleagues who satisfy the plans’ eligibility requirements.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Quality Source Inspector - Mechanical - Level II
description:
For more than 30 years, SQA Services has been a leading provider of managed supplier quality services, offering audits, assessments, remote surveillance, corrective actions, remediation, inspections, and engineering solutions to manufacturers across all industries. We deliver these services by deploying a network of highly skilled associates based throughout the United States and in over 90 countries worldwide, ensuring rapid on-site support at your supplier locations. Our associates are expert quality assurance professionals with extensive experience and local expertise, enabling us to represent our clients on-demand and with greater speed and efficiency than our competitors.
We’re hiring for a Quality Mechanical Source Inspector. The schedule is for the first shift, part-time, 20-25 hours a week, 2-3 days per week on an as-needed basis. If you have a passion for mechanical products and a keen eye for quality, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform precision inspection verifications on mechanical parts, components, assemblies, and materials
  • Inspection may include, but is not limited to, purchased parts, in-process and final assemblies, and materials for workmanship and conformance to specifications/drawings
  • Perform surface plate inspection of the first article, in-process, and lot sample parts if required
  • Utilize inspection equipment such as micrometers, gauge blocks, dial indicators, height gauges, optical comparators, profilometers, and coordinate measuring machines (CMMs) if necessary
  • Visual acuity and the ability to detect defects in highly complex products
  • Verify documentation packages to industry/commodity-specific standards
  • Classify defect types and verify rework conducted during the time of the inspection

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with precision mechanical parts inspection.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret manufacturing drawings and industry/commodity standards.
  • Proficient in GD&T and validating dimensions (tolerances ≥.005”) using hand tools (e.g., indicators, micrometers, calipers, height gauges).
  • Experience with certificates of conformance and inspection documentation.
  • Ability to adapt to new technology and software.
  • Excellent visual acuity to detect defects in complex products.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate's degree or higher in a related field, or equivalent experience.

title: 2nd Shift Forge Operator
description:
Forge Operator

Position Purpose:

Position is responsible for forging aluminum slugs into parts using a forge press.

Essential Functions:

  • Work from production order, job ticket and/or direction of supervisor;
  • Follow work instructions to produce parts;
  • Verify the material to be forged is correct and the dimensions are according to specifications;
  • Set-up Maxi and Screw presses;
  • Set-up and remove different dies;
  • Perform checks on die and bolster plate bolts;
  • Understand press settings and troubleshoot settings when necessary;
  • Understand proper slug location, tolerances, temperature settings, tonnage, alloys and lube mixtures;
  • Identify defects/non-conforming marks in the forged parts and make appropriate corrections;
  • Complete appropriate paperwork such as visual inspection records, daily checklists, routing sign offs, etc;
  • Identify issues with the equipment and notify supervisor and/or maintenance;
  • Monitor DAS stations to ensure proper operation of press, part rate, and temperature;
  • Monitor furnace temperature and speed to ensure proper heating of slugs and/or parts;
  • Inspect dies after use and tag dies requiring further inspection or rework;
  • Notify Quality of quality issues;
  • Maintain daily timekeeping, production, and interventions on computer systems;
  • Report unusual or unsafe conditions to supervisor;
  • Actively participate in efforts to establish and promote a safe and healthy work environment. Follow policies, programs, and procedures for the reduction and elimination of work related accidents and provide feedback to promote safer work behaviors and conditions.

Education and Training:

  • High School Diploma or GED;
  • Previous experience in forging or heavy machine operation preferred.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Ability to read, comprehend, and follow instructions;
  • Ability to work under pressure and adhere to schedules;
  • Ability to read a tape measure;
  • Ability to operate hand tools such as spray gun and forge tongs;
  • Ability to work safely and keep area clean;
  • Ability to work assigned shift and remain awake and alert during assigned shift is required;
  • Reporting to work for assigned shift, maintaining a physical presence and performing assigned work for the duration of assigned shift is required;
  • Demonstrated ability to work well with all levels of the organization;
  • Good verbal, interpersonal, and written communication skills;
  • Able to communicate clearly, concisely and achieve intended objectives;
  • Ability to work in a variety of environments which may include exposure to extreme heat, humidity, fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, loud noise, and all weather conditions. Reporting to work for assigned shift, maintaining a physical presence and performing assigned work for the duration of assigned shift is required;

Environmental Conditions:

  • High Temperatures: Frequently exposed to extreme heat from the forging process, necessitating proper heat-resistant gear.
  • Noise Levels: Typically works in a loud environment due to machinery and equipment, requiring the use of hearing protection.
  • Dust and Fumes: May encounter metal dust, particulates, and fumes from the forging process, making adequate ventilation essential.
  • Physical Space: Works in a potentially cramped or busy area, requiring good spatial awareness to navigate safely around machinery and other workers.
  • Safety Hazards: Regularly exposed to hazards from heavy machinery, hot materials, and moving parts, necessitating strict adherence to safety protocols.
  • Protective Equipment: Requires the use of personal protective equipment (PPE), including gloves, helmets, and flame-resistant clothing.
  • Lighting Conditions: Adequate lighting is crucial for visibility and safety, especially when handling hot or heavy materials.
  • Surface Conditions: Floors may be uneven or slippery due to oils and water, requiring caution and proper footwear.
  • Physical Stamina: The job often involves physical labor, such as lifting and moving heavy objects, requiring good physical fitness.
  • Team Environment: Works closely with other team members, necessitating effective communication and teamwork in a potentially chaotic setting.

Physical Demands:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee is regularly required to stand for an 8 hour shift. Position requires frequent twisting, turning, reaching, bending, pulling and pushing. Position occasionally requires walking, climbing, stooping, and crouching. The employee must be able to handle up to 80 lbs on a regular basis throughout the 8 hour shift. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision. Working conditions include exposure to extreme temperatures (heat) and humid conditions, dirt, and noise

Behavioral Traits:

  • Attention to Detail: Precision is critical in forging. Operators must be meticulous about measurements, temperatures, and timings.
  • Safety Awareness: Given the hazards associated with hot metals and heavy machinery, a strong commitment to safety protocols is essential.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: The ability to troubleshoot issues that arise during the forging process is vital, whether it's equipment malfunction or material inconsistencies.
  • Technical Aptitude: A solid understanding of machinery, metallurgy, and the forging process helps operators work efficiently and make informed decisions.
  • Physical Stamina: The job often requires standing for long periods, lifting heavy materials, and performing repetitive tasks.
  • Team Collaboration: Forge operators often work as part of a team, so good communication and collaboration skills are important.
  • Adaptability: The ability to adjust to new processes, tools, or changes in production requirements is crucial in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
  • Time Management: Meeting production deadlines requires effective prioritization and time management skills.
  • Initiative: Proactively identifying areas for improvement in processes or equipment can lead to better efficiency and quality.
  • Focus: Maintaining concentration for extended periods helps ensure quality and prevents accidents.

Pay & Benefits

Rate: In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, the hourly payrate for this position is $19 - $29 USD. This payrate is provided to ensure transparency and compliance with local, state, and federal regulations.

  • Job Type: Full time
  • For a full list of benefits please visit: anchorharvey.com/benefits
